rows.source: The course of history pivots around such inflection points, and democracy's inexorable march is accelerated or delayed.
rows.output: Ìtòlẹ́sẹẹsẹ ìtàn yí padà ní àwọn ibi ìpinnu bẹ́ẹ̀, àti ìjọba àwọn ènìyàn tí kò lè yẹra fún rẹ̀ ń yára tàbí dúró sílẹ̀.
rows.reference: Itan wa yika iṣẹlẹ yii, iṣejọba ara ẹni ni o lọsiwaju tabi fa sẹhin.

rows.source: Americans face several of these inflection points now.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà ń dojú kọ́ àwọn ìpèníjà wọ̀nyí ní báyìí.
rows.reference: Awọn Amẹrika wa ni idojukọ asawọ koko yii bayii.

rows.source: What will we do if Mr. Trump fires Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, the man who controls the fate of Mr. Mueller's investigation?
rows.output: Kí ni a ó ṣe bí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump bá lé Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Rod Rosenstein, ẹni tó ń ṣàkóso ìgbàlà ìwádìí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Mueller?
rows.reference: Kini ohun ti a o ṣe bi Arakunrin Trump ba da Igbakeji Agbẹjọro Gbogboogbo Rod Rosenstein duro, ẹni ti o n ṣakoso ayanmọ iwaadi Arakunrin Mueller?

rows.source: Rosenstein has been in hot water ever since this paper reported that, last year, he suggested secretly recording the president and speculated about his being unfit for office.
rows.output: Rosenstein ti wa ni omi gbona lati igba ti iwe iroyin yii royin pe, ni ọdun to kọja, o daba lati ṣe igbasilẹ aṣiri ti aarẹ ati pe o ṣe akiyesi pe ko ni ipo.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ti wa ninu iyọnu lati igba ti akọsilẹ yii ti jabọ pe, lọdun to kọja, o gbohun aarẹ silẹ nikọkọ ti o sọ nip ape oun o peye lati tẹsiwaju lẹnu iṣẹǝ.

rows.source: Mr. Rosenstein says The Times's account is inaccurate.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Rọ́ṣtẹ́nṣọ́n sọ pé àkọsílẹ̀ Ìwé Ìròyìn náà kò tọ̀nà.
rows.reference: Arakunrin Rosenstein wi pe akọọlẹ Times naa ko koju-oṣuwọn.

rows.source: "How will we respond if the newly requested F.B.I. investigation of Brett Kavanaugh is not full or fair - or if he is confirmed to the Supreme Court despite credible accusations of sexual assault and dishonest testimony?
rows.output: Báwo ni a ó ṣe fèsì bí ìwádìí tuntun tí F.B.I. béèrè lọ́wọ́ Brett Kavanaugh kò bá pé tàbí tó tọ́—tàbí bí wọ́n bá fọwọ́ sí i pé kí wọ́n gbé e wá sí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jùlọ nígbà tí wọ́n ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìfipábánilòpọ̀ ìbálòpọ̀ àti ìtàn-ìtàn-ìtàn-ìtàn-ìtàn-ìt
rows.reference: "Báwo ni a ṣe máa fèsì tí ìwádìí túntun tí F.B.I bèèrè fún lórí Brett Kavanaugh kò bá kún tó tàbí tí ó bá ṣègbè - tàbí tí ìwádìí náà bá ṣàfomọ́ rẹ̀ fún Ilé Ẹjọ́ tó ga jùlọ láìwo bí àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìfipabánilòpọ̀ àti ìjẹ́rìí èkè ṣe wúwo sí?

rows.source: And above all, will we vote in the midterms for a Congress that will hold Mr. Trump accountable?
rows.output: Àti lókè gbogbo, ẹ̀yin yóò dìbò ní àárín-ọ̀sẹ̀ fún ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin kan tí yóò mú kí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump jẹ́?
rows.reference: Ní pàtàkì jùlọ, ńjẹ́ a máa ìbò ní ìdìbò tó ń bọ̀ fún Ìlé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tí ó máa mú kí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump tẹ̀lé ìlànà tí òfin là kalẹ̀?

rows.source: If we fail those tests, democracy will be in for a long winter.
rows.output: Ti a ba kuna ninu awon idanwo yẹn, ijọba tiwantiwa yoo wa ni igba otutu pipẹ.
rows.reference: Tí a bá kùnà àwọn ìdánwò wọ̀nyẹn, ìjọba àwaarawa máa ní ìfàṣẹ́yìn fún ọjọ́ pípẹ́.

rows.source: But I believe we will not fail, because of the lesson I learned in Prague.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n mo gbàgbọ́ pé a kò ní kùnà, nítorí ẹ̀kọ́ tí mo kọ́ ní Prague.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n mo gbàgbọ́ pé a kò ní kùnà, nítorí ẹ̀kọ́ tí mo kọ̀ ní Prague.

rows.source: My mother was a Czechoslovak Jew who was deported to Auschwitz by the same Nazi regime that once occupied my ambassadorial home.
rows.output: Ìyá mi jẹ́ Júù Czechoslovak tó ti lé e lọ sí Auschwitz nípasẹ̀ ìjọba Nazi tó ti gba ilé ààrẹ mi tẹ́lẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ìyá mi jẹ́ ẹ̀yà Jew ti Czechoslovak tí ìjọba Nazi kannáà t’ó ń ṣojú orílẹ̀ èdè mi ní ìgbà kan lé kúrò sí Auschwitz.

rows.source: She survived, immigrated to America and, 60 years later, sent me off to light Sabbath candles on that table bearing the swastika.
rows.output: Ó wà láàyè, ó sì lọ sí orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, ní ọdún 60 lẹ́yìn náà, ó rán mi lọ láti tan iná àwọn ìkòkò ìsìn ní tábìlì tí ó ní àmì ẹ̀yẹ náà.
rows.reference: Ó yè é ó ṣì gbọ̀nà Amẹ́ríkà lọ, ọdún 60 sí ìgbà náà, ó rán mi lọ tàn iná àbẹ́là ọjọ́ ìsinmí lórí tábìlì Suwasitikà náà.

rows.source: With that as my heritage, how can I not be an optimist about our future?"
rows.output: Pẹ̀lú ìrètí yẹn gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìtàn mi, báwo ni mo ṣe lè má jẹ́ aláìnírètí nípa ọjọ́ iwájú wa?
rows.reference: Pẹ̀lú ìyẹ́n tó jẹ́ ìpilẹ̀ṣẹ̀ mi, báwo ní n kò ṣe ní jẹ́ onírètí ẹ̀dà nípa ọjọ́ iwájú"

rows.source: Norman Eisen, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, is the chairman of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington and the author of "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.output: Norman Eisen, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀gá àgbà ní Ilé-ìkàwé Brookings, jẹ́ alága àwọn ará ìlú fún Ìdájọ́ àti Ìwà Rere ní Washington, ó sì jẹ́ onkọ̀wé ti “Ilé Ìtàn Ikẹyìn: Ọ̀rúndún Yúróòpù Tó Nira Nínú Màrún Lára Àwọn Ẹ̀dá Mẹ́ta àti Ilé Ìtàn Tó Gbajúmọ̀.”
rows.reference: Norman Eisen, ọ̀kan nínú àwọn ọ̀gá wa ní ilé ẹ̀kọ́ Brookings, jẹ́ alága fún Ojúṣe àti ìhùwàsí ọmọlúàbí fún Ọmọ onílùú ní Washington tí ó sì jẹ́ òǹkọ̀wé “The Last Palace: Ẹgbẹrun ọdun Inira Uropu ninu Igba aye Marun ati Ile Olokiki Kan.”

rows.source: Rangers' Graham Dorrans optimistic ahead of Rapid Vienna clash
rows.output: Àwọn Rangers' Graham Dorrans ní ìrètí nípa ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ pẹ̀lú Vienna
rows.reference: Ireti Rangers Graham Dorrans ṣaaju ikọlu Rapid Vienna

rows.source: Rangers host Rapid Vienna on Thursday, knowing that victory over the Austrians, following the impressive draw in Spain against Villarreal earlier this month, will put them in a strong position to qualify from Group G of the Europa League.
rows.output: Awọn Rangers n gbalejo Vienna Rapid ni Ọjọbọ, mọ pe iṣẹgun lori awọn Austrians, lẹhin ifọwọkan iyalẹnu ni Spain lodi si Villarreal ni ibẹrẹ oṣu yii, yoo fi wọn si ipo to lagbara lati yẹ lati Group G ti Europa League.
rows.reference: Awọn Rangers gbalejo Vidna Rapid ni Ojobo, ti wọn mọ pe iṣẹgun awọn Austrian, lẹhin ọmini ti o ni Spain pẹlu Villarreal ni ibẹẹrẹ oṣu yi, yoo fi wọn si ipo ti o lagbara lati pegede lati Ẹgbẹ G ti Uropa Liigi.

rows.source: A knee injury prevented midfielder Graham Dorrans from making his first appearance of the season until the 2-2 draw with Villarreal but he believes Rangers can use that result as a springboard to greater things.
rows.output: Ìfarapa ẹsẹ̀ ẹ̀yìn dènà Graham Dorrans láti ṣe àfihàn àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ nígbà náà títí di ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ 2-2 pẹ̀lú Villarreal, ṣùgbọ́n ó gbà pé Rangers lè lo abajade yìí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìkọ́kọ́ fún àwọn ohun ńlá.
rows.reference: Ipalara orukun ṣe idiwọ fun olugbabọlu aarin Grafield Dorrans lati ṣe ifarahan akọkọ ti titi ti ayo ọmini 2-2 pẹlu Villarreal ṣugbọn o gbagbọ pe Rangers le lo esi naa gẹgẹ bi orisun igunke si awọn ohun ti o tobi julọ.

rows.source: "It was a good point for us because Villarreal are a good side," said the 31-year-old.
rows.output: "Ó jẹ́ àmì ìdánilójú fún wa nítorí Villarreal jẹ́ ẹgbẹ́ tó dára," ni ọmọ ọdún 31 náà sọ.
rows.reference: "O jẹ koko ti o dara fun wa nitori Villarreal jẹ ẹgbẹ ti o dara," ọmọdun 31 ni o sọ bẹẹ.

rows.source: "We went into the game believing we could get something and came away with a point.
rows.output: A lọ sínú eré náà gbàgbé pé a lè gba nǹkan kan, a sì padà wá pẹ̀lú ìpín kan.
rows.reference: "A lọ sinu ere pẹlu igbagbọ pe a le gba nnkankan a si wa pẹlu koko kan.

rows.source: Maybe we could have nicked it in the end but, overall, a draw was probably a fair result.
rows.output: Bóyá a lè ti gba wọlé ní ìparí, ṣùgbọ́n, gbogbogbòò, ìdánilójú jẹ́ abajade tó tọ́.
rows.reference: Boya a le ti gba ni opin ṣugbọn, ni gbogbo rẹ, ọmini jẹ abajade ti o dara kan.

rows.source: They were probably better in the first half and we came out in the second half and were the better side.
rows.output: Wọ́n ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n dára jù lọ ní ìdá kejì àkọ́kọ́, a sì jáde lọ sí ìdá kejì, a sì jẹ́ ẹgbẹ́ tó dára jù.
rows.reference: Wọn dara julọ ni idaji akọkọ ati pe a jade ni idaji keji asi jẹ ẹgbẹ ti o dara ju.

rows.source: Going into Thursday, it's another big European night.
rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ kẹtàdínlógún, ìrọ̀lẹ́ ọjọ́ yìí jẹ́ ìrọ̀lẹ́ ọjọ́ Yúróòpù mìíràn.
rows.reference: Lilọsi Ọjọbọ, o jẹ aṣalẹ nla Uropu kan.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can get three points but that will be tough game because they had a good result in their last game but, with the crowd behind us, I'm sure we can push on and get a positive result.
rows.output: Bóyá a ó gba àmì mẹ́ta, ṣùgbọ́n yóò jẹ́ ìdíje tó le gan-an nítorí pé wọ́n ní àbájáde rere ní ìdíje tó kọjá, ṣùgbọ́n pẹ̀lú àwọn olùgbọ́ tí ń bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún wa, mo dájú pé a lè gbìyànjú láti gba àbájáde rere.
rows.reference: Pẹlu ireti, a le gba awọn oju ami mẹta ṣugbọn eyi yoo jẹ ere alakikanju nitori pe wọn ni abajade rere ni ere ti wọn gba kẹhin ṣugbọn, pẹlu ero lẹhin wa, Mo mọ daju pe a le tẹsiwaju ki a si ni abajade rere.

rows.source: Last year was definitely tough, between everything that happened with my injuries and the changes at the club itself but there's a feelgood factor about the place now.
rows.output: Ọdún tó kọjá jẹ́ ọdún tó le, láàárín gbogbo ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìfarapa mi àti àwọn ìyípadà tó wà ní ẹgbẹ́ náà fúnra rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ìmọ̀lára rere wà níbẹ̀ báyìí.
rows.reference: Ọdun to kọja jẹ eyi ti o le gidigidi, laarin ohun gbogbo ti o ṣẹlẹ pẹlu awọn ifarapa mi ati awọn ayipada ti o wa ni ẹgbẹ funrararẹ ṣugbọn a ni ero ti o dara nipa ibi bayi.

rows.source: The squad's good and the boys are really enjoying it; the training's good.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ náà dára, àwọn ọmọkùnrin náà sì ń gbádùn rẹ̀; ikẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà dára.
rows.reference: Awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ dara ati pe awọn ọmọkunrin n gbadun rẹ; ikẹkọọ dara.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can push on now, put last season behind us and be successful."
rows.output: Bóyá, a ó lè tẹ̀síwájú báyìí, kí a sì fi àkókò tó kọjá sílẹ̀, kí a sì ṣe àṣeyọrí.”
rows.reference: Pẹlu ireti, a le tẹsiwaju ni bayi, fi akoko to koja sẹhin wa ki a si ṣe aṣeyọri."

rows.source: Women are losing sleep over this retirement savings fear
rows.output: Obinrin n padanu oorun nitori iberu ifipamọ ifẹhinti
rows.reference: Awọn obinrin o ri oorun sun nitori ẹru owo ifipamọ ifẹhinti

rows.source: Despite the fact that survey participants had a clear idea of how they wanted to be cared for, few people were talking to their family members about it.
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn olùṣàkóso ìwádìí náà ní ìmọ̀ràn tó mọ́ nípa bí wọ́n ṣe fẹ́ kí wọ́n tọ́jú wọn, àwọn èèyàn kò pọ̀ tó láti bá àwọn ẹbí wọn sọ̀rọ̀ nípa rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ jẹpe o daju pe awọn olukopa iwaadi ni oye ti o ṣe kedere bi wọn ṣe fẹ ki wọn ṣe itọju fun wọn, diẹ ninu awọn eniyan ni o n sọrọ nipa rẹ fun awọn ẹbi wọn.

rows.source: About half of the individuals in the Nationwide study said they were speaking with their spouses about the cost of long-term care.
rows.output: Nipa idaji awọn eniyan ni iwadii orilẹ-ede sọ pe wọn n ba awọn alabaṣepọ wọn sọrọ nipa iye owo itọju igba pipẹ.
rows.reference: Idaji awọn eniyan kọọkan ni iwaadi gbogbo orilẹ-ede sọ pe wọn n sọrọ pẹlu awọn ti wọn fẹ nipa iye owo iṣeduro igba pipẹ.

rows.source: Only 10 percent said they spoke with their kids about it.
rows.output: Ní ìdá mẹ́wàá nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn tí wọ́n sọ pé wọ́n ń sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ọmọ wọn nípa rẹ̀.
rows.reference: 10 ninu ida ọgọrun sọ pe wọn sọrọ pẹlu awọn ọmọ wọn nipa rẹ.

rows.source: "People want a family member to care for them, but they aren't taking the steps to have the conversation," said Holly Snyder, vice president of Nationwide's life insurance business.
rows.output: "Àwọn èèyàn fẹ́ kí ọmọ ẹbí wọn tọ́jú wọn, ṣùgbọ́n wọn kò ń gbé ìgbésẹ̀ láti ní ìjíròrò náà," ni Holly Snyder, igbakeji ààrẹ orílẹ̀-èdè náà fún iṣẹ́ ìfowópamọ́ ìgbésí ayé.
rows.reference: "Awọn eniyan fẹ pe ẹbi ni o bikita fun wọn, ṣugbọn wọn ko gbe awọn igbesẹ lati ni ibaraẹnisọrọ naa," Holly Snyder, igbakeji aarẹ ti idabobo okowo orilẹ-ede, sọ bẹẹ.

rows.source: Here's where to begin.
rows.output: Ẹ̀wẹ̀, ẹ̀yin yìí ni ibi tí o ti bẹ̀rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ibi ti o ti bẹrẹ niyi.

rows.source: Talk to your spouse and the kids: You can't prepare your family to provide care if you don't make your wishes known well ahead of time.
rows.output: Bá aya rẹ àti àwọn ọmọ rẹ sọ̀rọ̀: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí ẹ ṣe àtúnṣe fún ìdílé rẹ láti pèsè ìtọ́jú bí ẹ kò bá sọ àwọn ìfẹ́ rẹ fún wọn dáadáa kí ẹ tó kúrò ní àyíká.
rows.reference: Ba aya/ọkọ ati awọn ọmọ rẹ sọrọ: O ko le gbaradi ẹbi rẹ lati pese abojuto ti o ko ba jẹki wọn mọ ero rẹ daradara siwaju ti akoko.

rows.source: Work with your advisor and your family to discuss where and how to receive care, as those choices can be a significant factor in determining the cost.
rows.output: Ṣe iṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú olùkọ́ rẹ àti ìdílé rẹ láti jíròrò ibi àti bí a ṣe lè gba ìtọ́jú, nítorí àwọn yíyàn wọ̀nyí lè jẹ́ ohun pàtàkì nínú ìpinnu iye owó.
rows.reference: Ṣiṣe pẹlu agbaninimọran rẹ ati ẹbi rẹ lati jiroro ibi ati bi o ṣe le gba itọju, bi awọn ipinnu wọnyi ṣe le jẹ ipinnu pataki ninu ṣiṣe ipinnu iye owo naa.

rows.source: Bring in your financial advisor: Your advisor can also help you come up with a way to pay for those expenses.
rows.output: Mu olùrànlọ́wọ́ owó rẹ wá: Olùrànlọ́wọ́ rẹ lè ràn ọ́ lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe àtúnṣe bí a ṣe lè san owó náà.
rows.reference: Mu agbaninimọran owo rẹ wa: Agbaninimọran rẹ le tun ṣe iranlọwọ fun ọ lati wa ọna lati sanwo awọn inawo naa.

rows.source: Your funding choices for long-term care can include a traditional long-term care insurance policy, a hybrid cash-value life insurance policy to help cover these expenses or self-insuring with your own wealth - as long as you have the money.
rows.output: Àwọn àṣàyàn ìnáwó rẹ fún ìtọ́jú pẹ́ pẹ́ lè ní ìpò ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìtọ́jú pẹ́ pẹ́, ìpò ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìgbé ayé tí ó ní iye owó tí yóò ràn é lọ́wọ́ láti bo àwọn owó wọ̀nyí tàbí pé kí o ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ara rẹ pẹ̀lú owó tirẹ̀ - bí o bá ní
rows.reference: Awọn ipinnu ifowopamọ fun iṣeduro igba pipẹ le pẹlu eto imulo iṣeduro abojuto igba pipẹ, iṣeduro iye owo onibara lati ṣe iranlọwọ lati bo awọn inawo tabi imuduro ọrọ ara rẹ - niwọn igba ti o ba ni owo naa.

rows.source: Hammer out your legal documents: Head off legal battles at the pass.
rows.output: Ṣe àwọn ìwé òfin rẹ: Kọ́kọ́ kọ́ ìjà òfin ní ọ̀nà.
rows.reference: Tọka awọn iwe ofin rẹ: Gbe igbesẹ ogun ofin ni kia.

rows.source: Get a health-care proxy in place so that you designate a trusted individual to oversee your medical care and ensure that professionals comply with your wishes in case you're unable to communicate.
rows.output: Gba aláṣẹ ìlera kan níbẹ̀ kí o sì pè ẹnìkan tí o gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé láti ṣàkóso ìtọ́jú ìlera rẹ àti láti rí i dájú pé àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà tẹ̀ lé àwọn ìfẹ́ rẹ bí o bá kò lè bá a sọ̀rọ̀.
rows.reference: Gba ilera totọ kan ni ipo ki iwọ ki o yan eniyan kan ti o gbẹkẹle lati ṣetọju ilera rẹ ati ki o ri pe awọn akọṣẹmọṣẹ tẹle ibamu pẹlu awọn ohun ti o fẹ bi o ko ba le sọrọ.

rows.source: Also, consider a power of attorney for your finances.
rows.output: Pẹlupẹlu, ronu nipa agbẹjọro agbara fun awọn inawo rẹ.
rows.reference: Bakan naa, ronu agbara ti agbẹjọro fun awọn inawo rẹ.

rows.source: You would select a trusted person to make financial decisions for you and ensure your bills get paid if you're incapacitated.
rows.output: O yẹ ki o yan ẹni ti o gbẹkẹle lati ṣe awọn ipinnu inawo fun ọ ati rii daju pe awọn owo-owo rẹ ti san ti o ba di alailagbara.
rows.reference: O yan eniyan ti o fọkantan lati ṣe ipinnu owo fun ọ ati rii daju pe owo rẹ yoo di sisan ti o bani idiwọ.

rows.source: Don't forget the small details: Imagine that your elderly parent has a medical emergency and is on the way to the hospital.
rows.output: Maṣe gbagbe awọn alaye kekere: Ro pe obi rẹ ti dagba ni aisan iṣoogun ati pe o n lọ si ile-iwosan.
rows.reference: Maṣe gbagbe awọn alaye kekere: Foju inu wo pe obi rẹ agbalagba ni aisan pajawiri ati pe o wa ni ọna ile-iwosan.

rows.source: Would you be able to answer questions on medications and allergies?
rows.output: Ṣé o lè dáhùn àwọn ìbéèrè nípa àwọn òògùn àti àìsàn?
rows.reference: Ṣe iwọ yoo le dahun awọn ibeere lori awọn oogun ati awọn ikorira ara?

rows.source: Spell out those details in a written plan so that you're ready.
rows.output: Ṣàlàyé àwọn àlàyé yẹn nínú ètò tí a kọ sílẹ̀ kí o sì ṣetan.
rows.reference: Kọ awọn alaye naa jade ni kikun ki o le gbaradi.

rows.source: "It's not just the financials that are in play, but who are the doctors?" asked Martin.
rows.output: "Kò jẹ́ ìṣúná nìkan ni wọ́n ń ṣe, ṣùgbọ́n ẹni tó jẹ́ dókítà wo ni?" béèrè Martin.
rows.reference: "kiiṣe awọn owo nikan ni a n sọ, ṣugbọn awọn wo ni awọn onisegun?" Martin beere.

rows.source: "What are the medications?
rows.output: Kí ni àwọn òògùn?
rows.reference: "Kini awọn oogun naa?

rows.source: Who will care for the dog?
rows.output: Tani yóò tọ́jú ajá náà?
rows.reference: Tani yoo tọju aja?

rows.source: Have that plan in place."
rows.output: "Ṣe àtúnṣe yẹn."
rows.reference: Ni eto naa ni ibikan.”

rows.source: Man shot multiple times with air rifle in Ilfracombe
rows.output: Ọkùnrin kan ni wọ́n yìnbọn lẹ́ẹ̀mejì pẹ̀lú ọ̀bẹ̀ afẹ́fẹ́ ní Ilfracombe
rows.reference: Wọn yinbọn fun ọkunrin kan ni ọpọ igba pẹlu ibọn ojú afẹfẹ ni Ilfracombe

rows.source: A man has been shot multiple times with an air rifle as he walked home from a night out.
rows.output: Ọkùnrin kan ni wọ́n ti yìnbọn mọ́lẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ẹ̀rọ afẹ́fẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti ń rìn lọ sílé láti ìgbà ìrọ̀lẹ́.
rows.reference: Ọkunrin kan ni a ti ta nibọn ni igba pupọ pẹlu ibọn afẹfẹ bi o ti nlọ si ile ni aṣalẹ.

rows.source: The victim, in his 40s, was in the Oxford Grove area of Ilfracombe, Devon, when he was shot in the chest, abdomen and hand.
rows.output: Ẹni tí a fìyà jẹ, ní ọ̀rúndún 40, wà ní agbègbè Oxford Grove ti Ilfracombe, Devon, nígbà tí wọ́n yìnbọn sí àyà, inú àti ọwọ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Olufarapa, jẹ ọjọ ori 40, wa ni agbegbe Oxford Grove ti Ilfracombe, Devon, nigba ti wọn ta ibọn laya, inu ati ọwọ.

rows.source: Officers described the shooting, which took place at about 02:30 BST, as a "random act."
rows.output: Àwọn ọ̀gágun náà ṣàpèjúwe ìbúgbàù náà, èyí tó wáyé ní àárín ọ̀sán, gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ìṣe àìmọ̀kan.”
rows.reference: Awọn ọlọpa ti ṣe apejuwe ibon naa, eyiti o waye ni bii 02:30 BST, gẹgẹbi "leralera".

rows.source: The victim did not see his attacker.
rows.output: Olùfarapa náà kò rí ẹni tó fà á.
rows.reference: Olufarapa naa kori ẹniṣe ni jamba.

rows.source: His injuries are not life-threatening and police have appealed for witnesses.
rows.output: Ìfarapa rẹ̀ kò lè pa ẹ̀mí rẹ̀, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sì ti pè fún àwọn ẹlẹ́ri.
rows.reference: Awọn ipalara rẹ kiiṣe ohun a mu ẹmi lọ ṣugbọn ọlọpa ti pe fun awọn ẹlẹri.

rows.source: Earthquakes and tsunamis in Indonesia
rows.output: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àdánidá àti ìkún omi ní Indonesia
rows.reference: Awọn iwariri-ilẹ ati awọn ruru omi ni Indonesia

rows.source: At least 384 people have been killed by a powerful earthquake and tsunami that hit the Indonesian city of Palu on Friday, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.
rows.output: Ni o kere ju 384 eniyan ni o ti pa nipasẹ ìṣẹlẹ ìbànújẹ́ ńlá kan àti ìkún omi tí o kọlu ìlú Palu ti Indonesia ni ọjọ Jimọ, awọn alaṣẹ sọ, pẹlu iye awọn ti o ku ti a nireti lati pọ si.
rows.reference: O kere ju 384 eniyan ni o ti ku nipasẹ ìṣẹlẹ nla iwariri-ilẹ ati ruru omi ti o kọlu ilu Indonesian ti Palu ni Ọjọ Ẹtì, awọn aṣoju sọ, pẹlu awọn nọmba iku ti a n reti lati pọsi.

rows.source: With communications knocked out, relief officials have not been able to get any information from Donggala regency, an area north of Palu that is closer to the epicenter of the 7.5 magnitude quake.
rows.output: Pẹlu ibaraẹnisọrọ ti o ti bajẹ, awọn oṣiṣẹ iderun ko ti le gba alaye eyikeyi lati ọdọ agbegbe Donggala, agbegbe kan si ariwa ti Palu ti o sunmọ aarin iṣẹlẹ naa ti 7.5 magnitude.
rows.reference: Pẹlu awọn ibaraẹnisọrọ ti kosi, awọn aṣoju iderun ko ni anfani lati gba alaye eyikeyi lati igberiko Donggala, agbegbe kan ariwa ti Palu ti o sunmọ si ẹgbẹ ti iwariri ti wiwa 7.5.

rows.source: In Palu, more than 16,000 people were evacuated after the disaster struck.
rows.output: Ní Palu, àwọn èèyàn tó ju 16,000 lọ ni wọ́n gbé lọ sí ibòmíràn lẹ́yìn ìjàmbá náà.
rows.reference: Ni Palu, ju 16,000 eniyan ni a gbe kuro lẹhin ajalu ti o ṣẹlẹ.

rows.source: Here are some key facts about Palu and Donggala, on the island of Sulawesi:
rows.output: Eyi ni diẹ ninu awọn otitọ pataki nipa Palu ati Donggala, lori erekusu Sulawesi:
rows.reference: Eyi ni awọn ẹri kan nipa Palu ati Donggala, ni erekuṣu ti Sulawesi:

rows.source: Palu is the capital of Central Sulawesi province, located at the end of a narrow bay on the west coast of Sulawesi island, with an estimated population of 379,800 in 2017.
rows.output: Palu ni olu-ilu ti Ipinle Central Sulawesi, ti o wa ni opin okun ti o tẹẹrẹ ni etikun iwọ-oorun ti erekusu Sulawesi, pẹlu olugbe ti a pinnu ti 379,800 ni ọdun 2017.
rows.reference: Palu ni olu-ilu ti Aarin ẹkun Sulawesi, ti o wa ni opin orisun omi ti o wa ni etikun ti erekuṣu Sulawesi, pẹlu awọn olugbe ti o to 379,800 ni ọdun 2017.

rows.source: The city was celebrating its 40th anniversary when the quake and tsunami hit.
rows.output: Ìlú náà ń ṣe ayẹyẹ ọdún mẹ́rìnlélógójì rẹ̀ nígbà tí ìbúgbàù àti ìkún omi náà kọlu.
rows.reference: Ilu naa n ṣe ayẹyẹ ọdun iranti ogoji rẹ nigbati ilẹ mimi ati rur omi ṣẹlẹ.

rows.source: Donggala is a regency stretching along more than 300 km (180 miles) of coastline in the northwest of Sulawesi island.
rows.output: Donggala jẹ́ ìjọba ìbílẹ̀ tó gùn tó 300 km (180 miles) lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ etíkun àríwá-ìwọ̀ oòrùn ilẹ̀ Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Donggala jẹ atunṣe kan ti o gun ju 300 km (180 maili) ti etikun ni iha ariwa ti erekuṣu ilu Sulawesi.

rows.source: The regency, an administrative region below a province, had an estimated population of 299,200 in 2017.
rows.output: Ìjọba ìbílẹ̀, agbègbè ìṣàkóso tó kéré jù lọ ju ìpínlẹ̀ lọ, ní ìwọ̀n ìjọba 299,200 ní ọdún 2017.
rows.reference: Ijọba, agbegbe isakoso ti o wa ni igberiko, ni awọn eniyan to 299,200 ni ọdun 2017.

rows.source: Fishing and farming are the mainstays of the Central Sulawesi province's economy, especially the coastal region of Donggala.
rows.output: Ìkópa àti iṣẹ́ àgbẹ̀ ni àwọn ohun pàtàkì nínú ètò ọrọ̀ ajé ti ìpínlẹ̀ Sulawesi Àárín, pàápàá àwọn agbègbè etí òkun ti Donggala.
rows.reference: Ẹja pipa ati iṣẹ ọgbin ni ojulowo iṣẹ ti ọrọ aje agbegbe Sulawesi, paapa ni agbegbe etikun ti Donggala.

rows.source: Nickel mining is also important in the province, but is mostly concentrated in Morowali, on the opposite coast of Sulawesi.
rows.output: Ìwakùsà nípò pàtàkì ní ìpínlẹ̀ náà, ṣùgbọ́n ó jẹ́ pé ó pọ̀ jùlọ ní Morowali, ní etí òkun tó wà lórí ìlà oòrùn Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Wiwa alumọni nikẹli tunṣe pataki ni agbegbe naa, ṣugbọn o wa julọ ni Morowali, ni etikun keji ti Sulawesi.̀

rows.source: Palu and Donggala have been hit by tsunamis several times in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.
rows.output: Palu àti Donggala ti kọlu nipasẹ awọn igbi omi nla ni ọpọlọpọ igba ni ọdun 100 sẹhin, gẹgẹ bi a ti sọ nipasẹ Ile-iṣẹ Idena Ajalu ti Indonesia.
rows.reference: Palu ati Donggala ti ni akọku omi riru ni igba pupọ ninu ọgọrun ọdun ti o ti kọja, ni ibamu si Ijabọ Ajalu Orilẹ-ede ti Indonesia.̀

rows.source: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of houses in Donggala.
rows.output: Ni ọdun 1938, ìkún omi ìkún omi pa àwọn ènìyàn tó ju 200 lọ, ó sì bàjẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé ní Donggala.
rows.reference: Ni ọdun 1938, riru omi pa ju eniyan 200 lọ, o si ba ogogorun ile jẹ ni Donggala.

rows.source: A tsunami also struck western Donggala in 1996, killing nine.
rows.output: Ìkún omi tún kọlu ìwọ̀ oòrùn Donggala ní ọdún 1996, ó pa ẹ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́sàn-án.
rows.reference: Riru omi tun ṣẹlẹ ni ila oorun Donggala ni 1996, o pa eniyan mẹsan.

rows.source: Indonesia sits on the seismically Pacific Ring of Fire and is regularly hit by earthquakes.
rows.output: Àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ńláńlá ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Indonesia nítorí pé ó wà lórí Ìpínlẹ̀ Òkun Pacific, ibi tí ìbúgbàù ńláńlá ti máa ń wáyé.
rows.reference: Indonesia joko lori Iwọn Ilẹ-oorun ti Ina ti o si maa n ni iriri ilẹ mimi nigbagbogbo.

rows.source: Here are some of the major quakes and tsunamis in recent years:
rows.output: Eyi ni diẹ ninu awọn iwariri nla ati awọn tsunami ni ọdun diẹ sẹhin:
rows.reference: Eyi ni diẹ ninu awọn ilẹ mimi nla ati awọn riru omi ni awọn ọdun diẹ sẹhin:

rows.source: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: Ìkún omi ńlá kan ní etí òkun ìwọ̀ oòrùn ti Aceh ní apá ìwọ̀ oòrùn Sumatra ní ọjọ́ kẹrìndínlógún oṣù Kejìlá ọdún 2004, fa ìkún omi tí ó kọlu orílẹ̀-èdè mẹ́rìnlá, tí ó sì pa ènìyàn 226,000 ní etí òkun Òkun India, ju ìdajì lọ ní Aceh.
rows.reference: 2004: Iwariri nla kan ni iha iwọ-oorùn ti agbegbe Aceh ti Indonesia ni ariwa Sumatra ni 26 Oṣu kejila ṣe okunfa riru omi kan ti o kọlu awọn orilẹ-ede 14, o pa awọn eniyan 226,000 ni etikun okun India, ju idaji wọn lọ ni Aceh.

rows.source: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.
rows.output: 2005: Àwọn ìkún omi tó lágbára kan wáyé ní etí òkun ìwọ̀ oòrùn Sumatra ní ìparí oṣù kẹta àti ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ oṣù kẹrin.
rows.reference: 2005: Ọpọlọpọ awọn iwariri ti o lagbara kọlu iha iwọ-oorùn ti Sumatra ni igbẹhin Oṣu Kẹta ati Oṣu Kẹrin.

rows.source: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.
rows.output: Ọgọ́rùn-ún ni wọ́n pa ní Ìsìláàmù Níàsì, ní etí òkun Sumatra.
rows.reference: Ọgọrun eniyan ku ni erekuṣu Nias, ni etikun Sumatra.

rows.source: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.
rows.output: 2006: Ìjì líle 6.8 kan ṣẹlẹ̀ ní gúúsù Java, erekùṣù tí ó pọ̀ jù lọ ní Indonesia, tí ó fa ìkún omi tí ó fọ́ sí etí gúúsù, tí ó pa ènìyàn tó lé ní 700.
rows.reference: 2006: Iwọn giga 6.8 kọlu iha gusu Java, Orilẹ-ede Indonesia ti o erekuṣu ni o wọpọ julọ, ti o ṣokunfa riru omi kan ti o lọsi etikun gusu, ti o pa awọn eniyan to fere to 700.

rows.source: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.
rows.output: 2009: Ìjì líle 7.6 kan ṣẹlẹ̀ ní nǹkan bí ọgọ́rùn-ún kìlómítà sí ìlú Padang, olú ìlú ìpínlẹ̀ Sumatra Ìwọ̀-oòrùn.
rows.reference: 2009: Iwọn ilẹ mimi 7.6 kọlu ibi ti o sunmọ ilu ti Padang, olu-ilu ti iwọ-oorun agbegbe Sumatra.

rows.source: More than 1,100 people were killed.
rows.output: Àwọn ènìyàn tó ju ẹgbẹ̀rún ọ̀kan ati ọgọ́rùn-ún lọ ni wọ́n pa.
rows.reference: O ju ẹgbẹrun eniyan ti o ku lọ.

rows.source: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.
rows.output: 2010: Ìjì líle 7.5 kan kọlu ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn erekùṣù Mentawai, lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Sumatra, tí ó fa ìjì líle 10 mítà tí ó bàjẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ abúlé àti pé ó pa àwọn ènìyàn tó lé ní 300.
rows.reference: 2010: Iwọn iwariri nla ti 7.5 kan kọlu awọn erekusu Mentawai, niyana Sumatra, ti o fa omi ruru ti o to mita 10 ti o pa ọpọlọpọ awọn abule run ti o ai pa awọn eniyan to 300.

rows.source: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.
rows.output: 2016: Ìkún omi kékeré kan kọlu ìjọba ìbílẹ̀ Pidie Jaya ní Aceh, ó fa ìbàjẹ́ àti ìbẹ̀rù láàárín àwọn ènìyàn nítorí ìrántí ìbànújẹ́ ìkún omi ńlá 2004 àti ìkún omi.
rows.reference: 2016: Ilẹ mimi ti ko jin kọlu agbegbe ijọba Pidie Jaya ni Aceh, o si fa iparun ati ipaya bi awọn eniyan ṣe ranti nipa iparun ti ibanujẹ ati ilẹ mimi ti o lewu ọdun 2004.

rows.source: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.
rows.output: Kò sí ìkún omi tí a fa ní ìgbà yìí, ṣùgbọ́n ju 100 lọ ni wọ́n pa nípa àwọn ìkọ́lé tí wọ́n ṣubú.
rows.reference: Ko si riru omi ti o ṣẹlẹ ni akoko yii, ṣugbọn ju 100 eniyan ni o ku nipasẹ awọn ile ti o wo lulẹ.

rows.source: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.
rows.output: 2018: Awọn iwariri nla kan lu erekusu Lombok ti awọn aririn ajo ti Indonesia, ti o pa ju 500 eniyan lọ, pupọ julọ ni apa ariwa ti erekusu naa.
rows.reference: 2018: Awọn ilẹ mimi ti o lapẹrẹ kọlu erekuṣu awọn alejo ti Lombok ni orile-ede Indonesia, ti o si pa ju eniyan 500 lọ, paapaa julọ ni apa ariwa ti erekusu naa.

rows.source: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.
rows.output: Ibajẹ́ náà ba ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ilé jẹ́, ó sì fi ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ arìnrìn-àjò lọ́wọ́ fún ìgbà díẹ̀.
rows.reference: Iwariri run egbegberun awọn ile ti ẹgbẹgbẹrun awọn alejo kosi le kuro nibẹ.

rows.source: Sarah Palin's Eldest Son Arrested on Domestic Violence Charges
rows.output: Ìjọba Sarah Palin ti ọmọ rẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́ mú fún ìfipá báni lòpọ̀
rows.reference: Agba ọmọ ọkunrin Sarah Palin ni a mu lori ẹsun Iwa Ipa Ilé

rows.source: Track Palin, the eldest son of former Alaska governor and vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on assault charges.
rows.output: Ìkọ̀kọ̀ Palin, ọmọ àkọ́kọ́ Sarah Palin, gómìnà Alaska tẹ́lẹ̀ àti olùdíje fún ipò igbákejì ààrẹ, ni wọ́n ti mú fún ẹ̀sùn ìfipá.
rows.reference: Track Palin, ọmọ akọbi ọkunrin ti gomina tẹlẹ ri ti Alaska ati odije igbakeji aarẹ Sarah Palin, ni wọn mu lori ẹsun ikọluni.

rows.source: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on suspicion of domestic violence, interfering with a report of domestic violence and resisting arrest, according to a report released Saturday by Alaska State Troopers.
rows.output: Palin, 29, ti Wasilla, Alaska, ni wọn mu lori ìfura ìwà ọ̀daràn ilé, ìdènà ìròyìn ìwà ọ̀daràn ilé, àti ìdènà ìdènà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìròyìn kan tí a tú jáde ní ọjọ́ Àìkú.
rows.reference: Palin, 29, ti Wasilla, Alaska, ni a mu ni idaniloju iwa-ipa abele, ni idajọ pẹlu ijabọ kan ti iwa-ipa abele ati lati tako imuni, ni ibamu si ijabọ kan ti Ipinlẹ Alaska Troopers ti ọjọ Satidee.

rows.source: According to the police report, when a female acquaintance attempted to call police to report the alleged crimes, he took her phone from her.
rows.output: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìròyìn ọlọ́pàá ṣe sọ, nígbà tí ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́bìnrin kan gbìyànjú láti pè ọlọ́pàá láti ròyìn àwọn ẹ̀sùn tí wọ́n fi kan an, ó mú fóònù rẹ̀ kúrò lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Gẹgẹbi ijabọ olopa, nigba ti obirin ajumọgbe kan ti o gbiyanju lati pe awọn olopa lati ṣabọ awọn odaran ti o jẹbi, o gba foonu rẹ lọwọ rẹ.

rows.source: Palin is being remanded in Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 unsecured bond, reported KTUU.
rows.output: Palin ti wa ni atimọle ni Mat-Su Pretrial Facility ati pe o wa ni ẹgbẹrun dọla 500 ti ko ni ihamọra, iroyin ni.
rows.reference: Palin ni a timọ ẹwọn Mat-Su Pretrial ati pe a mu nitori owo bọndi ailailabo ti iye rẹ jẹ $500, KTUU njabọ.

rows.source: He appeared in court Saturday, where he declared himself "not guilty, for sure" when asked his plea, reported the network.
rows.output: Ó farahàn ní ilé ẹjọ́ ní ọjọ́ Satide, níbi tí ó ti sọ pé “kò jẹ́ ẹ̀bi, ní ìdánilójú” nígbà tí wọ́n bèèrè pé kí ni ìdáhùn rẹ̀, tí nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì náà sì ròyìn.
rows.reference: O farahan ni ile-ẹjọ ni Satidee, nibi ti o ti sọ pe "n ko jẹbi, o daju" nigba ti wọn beere ẹbẹ rẹ, nẹtiwọki ni o jabọ.

rows.source: Palin faces three Class A misdemeanours, meaning he could be imprisoned for up to a year and fined $250,000.
rows.output: Palin dojú kọ́ ẹ̀sùn mẹ́ta ti ìwà ọ̀daràn Kíláàsì A, èyí tó túmọ̀ sí pé ó lè jẹ́ ẹ̀wọ̀n fún ọdún kan àti pé a lè fún un ní owó ìtanràn $250,000.
rows.reference: Palin ni a fẹsun iwa ibajẹ onipele Kilaasi A kan, eyi ni pe o le wa ni ẹwọn fun ọdun kan ati pe ki o san $250,000 owo itanran.

rows.source: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.
rows.output: Ó tún ti fi ẹ̀sùn kan pé ó jẹ́ ẹ̀sùn ẹ̀sùn Kíláàsì B, tí ó lè jẹ́ ọjọ́ kan nínú ẹ̀wọ̀n àti owó 2,000 dọ́là.
rows.reference: O tun ti gba ifisun iwa ibajẹ onipele Kilaasi B, eyi ti ijiya rẹ jẹ ẹwọn ọjọ kan ati sisan $2,000 owo itanran.

rows.source: It is not the first time criminal charges have been filed against Palin.
rows.output: Kò jẹ́ ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ nìyí tí wọ́n ti fi ẹ̀sùn ìwà ọ̀daràn kàn Palin.
rows.reference: Kiiṣe igba akọkọ ni awọn ẹsun ọdaràn ti a fi sun si Palin.

rows.source: In December 2017, he was accused of assaulting his father, Todd Palin.
rows.output: Ni Oṣu kejila ọdun 2017, wọn fi ẹsun kan an pe o fipa ba baba rẹ, Todd Palin.
rows.reference: Ni osu kejila ọdun 2017, a fi ẹsun kan pe o pa baba rẹ lara, Todd Palin.

rows.source: His mother, Sarah Palin, called police to report the alleged attack.
rows.output: Ìyá rẹ̀ Sarah Palin, pe ọlọ́pàá láti sọ ìròyìn ìkọlù náà.
rows.reference: Iya rẹ, Sarah Palin, pe awọn ọlọpa lati ṣabọ ikọlu yii.

rows.source: The case is currently before Alaska's Veteran's Court.
rows.output: Ìpinnu náà wà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ ní Ilé Ẹjọ́ Alaska fún Àwọn Ọmọ-ogun.
rows.reference: Ọran naa wa ni iwaju ile ẹjọ Olokiki Alaska.

rows.source: In January 2016 he was charged with domestic assault, interfering with the report of a domestic violence crime, and possessing a weapon while intoxicated in connection with the incident.
rows.output: Ni Oṣu Kini ọdun 2016, wọn fi ẹsun kan an pe o ṣe ikọlu ni ile, idilọwọ ijabọ iwa-ipa ni ile, ati pe o ni ohun ija nigba ti o ti mu ọti.
rows.reference: Ni Oṣu Kini ọdun 2016 o gba ẹsun ikọlu abẹle, ti n tako ijabọ ti iwa-ipa ti abele, ati nini ohun ija oloro lakoko ti o ti mu ọti-lile pẹlu asopọ iṣẹlẹ naa.

rows.source: His girlfriend had alleged that he punched her in the face.
rows.output: Ọrẹbinrin rẹ̀ sọ pé ó fọ́ ẹ̀rẹ̀kẹ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ọrẹbinrin rẹ ti sọ wi pe o fi ọwọ gba oun ni oju.

rows.source: Sarah Palin was criticised by veterans groups in 2016 after linking her son's violent behaviour to PTSD stemming from his service in Iraq.
rows.output: Sarah Palin ni a ti bu ẹnu atẹ lu nipasẹ awọn ẹgbẹ awọn ọmọ ogun ni ọdun 2016 lẹhin ti o so iwa iwa-ipa ọmọ rẹ si PTSD ti o wa lati iṣẹ rẹ ni Iraq.
rows.reference: Sarah Palin ni awọn olokiki bẹnu atẹ lu ni ọdun 2016 lẹhin ti o so iwa-ipa iwa ọmọ rẹ mọ PTSD ti o waye lati iṣẹ rẹ ni Iraq.

rows.source: Indonesia earthquake tsunami: hundreds killed
rows.output: Ìjìyà ilẹ̀ Indonesia: ọgọ́rùn-ún ènìyàn ti kú
rows.reference: ìṣẹlẹ ilẹ mimi riru omi Indonesia: awọn ogogorun ni o ku

rows.source: At least 384 people have died after an earthquake hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi on Friday.
rows.output: Àwọn ènìyàn 384 ló kú lẹ́yìn ìkún omi ilẹ̀ náà tó kọlu erekùṣù Sulawesi ti Indonesia ní ọjọ́ Friday.
rows.reference: O kere ju eniyan 384 lẹhin ti ìṣẹlẹ ilẹ mimi waye ni erekuṣu Indonesia ti Sulawesi ni Ọjọ Ẹtì.

rows.source: The 7.5-magnitude earthquake triggered a tsunami and has destroyed thousands of homes.
rows.output: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìbúgbàù 7.5-magnitude náà fa ìkún omi àti pé ó ti bàjẹ́ ẹgbẹ̀rún ilé.
rows.reference: Iwọn iwariri 7.5-nla ti ilẹ mimi mu omi riru waye ti o si run awọn ẹgbẹrun ile.

rows.source: Electricity and communication networks are down with death tolls expected to rise in coming days.
rows.output: Àwọn nẹ́tìwọ́ọ̀kì iná mànàmáná àti ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ ti dín kù, àwọn ìṣirò ikú ń pọ̀ sí i, tí a ń retí pé yóò pọ̀ sí i ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
rows.reference: Kosi ina mọna-mọna ati nẹtiwọki ibaraẹnisọrọ ti o si le mu iku pọsi ni awọn ọjọ to nbọ.

rows.source: The earthquake hit just off central Sulawesi which is northeast of the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.
rows.output: Ibúgbàu náà wáyé ní ìhà ìlà oòrùn Sulawesi, tó sún mọ́ ìlú Jakarta, olú ìlú Indonesia.
rows.reference: ilẹ mimi naa kọlu Aarin Sulawesi ti o wa ni ariwa ti olu-ilu ti Indonesian, Jakarta.

rows.source: Videos are circulating on social media showing the moment of impact.
rows.output: Àwọn fídíò ń lọ lórí ìkànnì àjọlò tí ń fi hàn ìgbà ìbáṣepọ̀ náà.
rows.reference: Awọn fidio n ṣafihan lori midia ti o nfihan akoko ti ikọlu.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a beach festival in the city of Palu when the tsunami smashed on shore.
rows.output: Àwọn ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ ọ̀k
rows.reference: Ọgọrun eniyan ti kojọpọ fun ajọdun apejọ eti okun ni ilu Palu nigba ti omi riru kanlu eti okun.

rows.source: Federal prosecutors seeking rare death penalty for NYC terror attack suspect
rows.output: Àwọn agbẹjọ́rò ìjọba àpapọ̀ ń wá ìjìyà ikú fún ẹlẹ́ṣẹ̀ ìbúgbàù ìbúgbàù ní ìlú New York
rows.reference: Awọn agbẹjọro gbogboogbo n wa ijiya iku fun afurasi aṣekupani NYC.

rows.source: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.
rows.output: Àwọn agbẹjọ́rò ìjọba àpapọ̀ ní New York ń wá ìjìyà ikú fún Sayfullo Saipov, ẹni tí a fura sí nínú ìkọlù ìbúgbàù ní New York City tí ó pa ènìyàn mẹ́jọ́—ìjìyà tí a kò fi ṣe ní ìpínlẹ̀ náà fún ẹ̀sùn ìjọba àpapọ̀ láti ọdún 1953.
rows.reference: Awọn agbẹjọro ilu New York n wa ẹbi iku fun Sayfullo Saipov, afurasi aṣekupani ti New York City ti o pa awọn eniyan mẹjọ - -ijiya ti a ko ṣe ni ipinle naa fun idajọ irufin lati 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, 30, allegedly used a Home Depot rental truck to carry out an attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, mowing down pedestrians and cyclist in his path on Oct.
rows.output: Saipov, 30, ni wọn sọ pe o lo ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ ti ile itaja Home Depot gba lati kọlu ọna keke lẹgbẹẹ ọna West Side ni Lower Manhattan, ti n pa awọn arinrin-ajo ati awọn alupupu ni ọna rẹ ni Oṣu Kẹwa.
rows.reference: Saipov, 30, lo ọkọ Akẹru Ile kan ti Ile Depot lati ṣe ikọlu kan lori ọna opopona kẹkẹ Opopoona Apa Iwọ oorun ni Lower Manhattan, ti osi tẹ awọn ẹlẹsẹ ati awa kẹkẹ pa ni oju ọna ni Oṣu Kẹwa.

rows.source: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.
rows.output: Láti jẹ́ kí ìdájọ́ ikú jẹ́ ìdájọ́, àwọn olùgbéjọ́rò yóò ní láti fi hàn pé Saipov “ní ìfẹ́” pa àwọn olùṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ mẹ́jọ́ náà, àti pé “ní ìfẹ́” ni ó ṣe ìfarapa tó lágbára, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìkìlọ̀ ìfẹ́ láti wá ìdájọ́ ikú, tí a fi sílẹ̀ ní Ìpínlẹ̀ Gúúsù
rows.reference: Lati le ṣe idajọ, awọn agbẹjọro yoo ni lati fi han pe Saipov "mọọmọ" pa awọn eniyan mẹjọ ati "mọọmọ" ṣe ipalara nla, gẹgẹbi akiyesi idiyele lati wa ijiya iku, ti a fiwe si ni Gusu DISTRICT ti New York.

rows.source: Both of those counts carry a possibly death sentence, according to the court document.
rows.output: Mejeji ninu awọn iṣiro wọnyi ni ẹwọn igbesi aye, gẹgẹ bi iwe ẹjọ naa.
rows.reference: Awọn ẹsun mejeji ni o ni ijiya iku, ni ibamu si iwe ile ẹjọ.

rows.source: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn ọ̀sẹ̀ díẹ̀ lẹ́yìn ìkọlù náà, ẹgbẹ́ ìgbìmọ̀ ọ̀daràn àpapọ̀ kan gbé ẹ̀sùn 22 lòdì sí Saipov, tó ní ẹ̀sùn mẹ́jọ̀ ìpànìyàn láti ràn àwọn ẹ̀tọ́ ìbáṣepọ̀ lọ́wọ́, èyí tó máa ń lò nípa àwọn agbẹjọ́rò àpapọ̀ nípa ìwà ọ̀daràn,
rows.reference: Awọn ọsẹ lẹhin ti ikolu naa, adajọ gbogboogbo kan fun Saipov ni idajọ 22 kan ti o ni awọn ẹjọ mẹjọ ti ipaniyan ni iranlowo fun ipalara, eyi ti awọn agbẹjọro nlo ni idajọ ni awọn ajọ ọdaràn, ati idiyele iwa-ipa ati iparun ti ọkọ awọn ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ.

rows.source: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."
rows.output: Ìkọlù náà nílò “ètò ńlá àti ìmúṣẹ ìpinnu,” gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn olùṣèwádìí ṣe sọ, tí wọ́n sì ṣàpèjúwe ìmúṣẹ ìkọlù náà gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ẹ̀gàn, ìbànújẹ́ àti ìbànújẹ́.”
rows.reference: Ipalara naa ni "ipinnu ati iṣeduro pataki," Awọn agbẹjọro sọ bẹẹ, wọn ṣapejuwe ọna ti Saipov gbe gba ṣe gẹgẹbi "oloro, onigbọn ati itiju."

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.
rows.output: "Ìfarapa, ìbàjẹ́, àti ìpadàbọ̀ sí àwọn ìdílé àti ọ̀rẹ́ Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, àti Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," ìkéde ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ náà sọ.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov fa ipalara, ipalara, ati pipadanu si idile ati awọn ọrẹ ti Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, ati Alejandro Damian Pagnucco, "Ifitonileti ti idiyele ni ipinlẹ.

rows.source: Five of the victims were tourists from Argentina.
rows.output: Mẹ́rìnlá nínú àwọn olùfarapa náà jẹ́ arìnrìn-àjò lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ láti Argentina.
rows.reference: Marun ninu awọn olufaragba jẹ awọn alejo afe-ajo lati Argentina.

rows.source: It has been a decade since the Southern District of New York last prosecuted a death penalty case.
rows.output: Ó ti pé ọdún mẹ́wàá látìgbà tí Ìpínlẹ̀ Gúúsù Ìwọ̀ Oòrùn ti kọ́kọ́ gbé ẹjọ́ ẹ̀san ikú kan.
rows.reference: O ti to ọdun mẹwa lati igbati igberiko Gusu ti New York ti ṣe idajọ ẹjọ iku kan.

rows.source: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was convicted of murdering two drug suppliers but was ultimately sentenced to life in prison in September 2009.
rows.output: Ẹ̀sùn náà, Khalid Barnes, ni wọ́n dá lẹ́bi pé ó pa àwọn olùpèsè oògùn méjì, ṣùgbọ́n nígbẹ̀yìn-gbẹ́yín, wọ́n dá a lẹ́bi ìgbà ìkẹyìn ní ọdún 2009.
rows.reference: Olujẹjọ, Khalid Barnes, ni a fi ẹsun pipa awọn onta egbogi oloro meji sugbon o gba ẹjọ ẹwọn gbere ni September 2009.

rows.source: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.
rows.output: Ìgbà tó kẹ́yìn tí wọ́n fi ìjìyà ikú ṣe ní ọ̀ràn ìjọba àpapọ̀ ní New York ni 1953 fún Julius àti Ethel Rosenberg, tọkọtaya kan tí wọ́n pa lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n dá wọn lẹ́jọ́ pé wọ́n ń gbìyànjú láti ṣe ìjìyà fún Soviet Union nígbà Ogun Tútù ọdún méjì ṣáájú.
rows.reference: Ni igba ikẹhin ti a funni ni idajọ iku nni ẹjọ Gbogboogbo New York ni 1953 fun Julius ati Ethel Rosenberg, tọkọtaya kan ti a pa lẹhin ti wọn ti fi ẹsun iyọkẹlẹ wolu fun Soviet Union nigba ogun buburu ni ọdun meji ṣaaju.

rows.source: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.output: Àwọn méjèèjì, Rosenbergs, ni wọ́n pa ní ọjọ́ kẹtàdínlógún oṣù kẹfà, ọdún 1953.
rows.reference: Awọn Rosenbergs mejeeji ni wọn pa nipasẹ ijoko mọnamọna ni June 19, 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, a native of Uzbekistan, demonstrated a lack of remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.
rows.output: Saipov, ọmọ ilẹ̀ Uzbekistan, kò fi ìdùnnú hàn ní àwọn ọjọ́ àti oṣù tó tẹ̀lé ìkọlù náà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ìwé ẹjọ́ ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Saipov, ọmọ abinibi ti Usibekisitani, ko ronupiwada ni awọn ọjọ ati awọn osu lẹhin ikọlu, ni ibamu si awọn iwe ile ẹjọ.

rows.source: He stated to investigators that he felt good about what he had done, police said.
rows.output: Ó sọ fún àwọn olùṣàkóso pé ó dùn ún nípa ohun tí ó ṣe, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sọ.
rows.reference: O sọ fun awọn oluwadi pe inu oun dun si ohun ti oun ṣe, awọn olopa jabọ.

rows.source: Saipov told authorities he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the indictment.
rows.output: Saipov sọ fún àwọn aláṣẹ pé òun fẹ́ ṣe ìkọlù náà lẹ́yìn tó ti wo àwọn fídíò ISIS lórí tẹlifóònù rẹ̀, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìpèníjà náà ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Saipov sọ fun awọn alase pe oun ni imisi lati ṣe ikọlu naa lẹhin wiwo awọn fidio ISIS lori foonu rẹ, gẹgẹbi ibawi naa.

rows.source: He also requested to display the ISIS flag in his hospital room, police said.
rows.output: Ó tún béèrè pé kí wọ́n fi àmì ìsìn ISIS hàn ní yàrá ìwòsàn rẹ̀, àwọn ọlọ́pàá sọ.
rows.reference: O tun bere lati ṣe ifihan asia ISIS ni yara iwosan rẹ, awọn olopa jabọ.

rows.source: He has pleaded not guilty to the 22-count indictment.
rows.output: Ó ti jẹbi pé kò jẹbi ẹ̀sùn 22.
rows.reference: O ti gba ẹbi pe ko jẹbi si ẹsun-aṣiṣe 22.

rows.source: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders representing Saipov, said they are "obviously disappointed" with the prosecution's decision.
rows.output: David Patton, ọkan lára àwọn agbẹjọ́rò ìjọba àpapọ̀ tí ń ṣojú Saipov, sọ pé wọn “jẹ́ aláìníyànjú” pẹ̀lú ìpinnu ìjọba láti ṣe ẹjọ́.
rows.reference: David Patton, ọkan ninu awọn agbẹjọro awọn eniyan gbogboogbo ti o ṣoju Saipov, sọ pe wọn "ni idaniloju ijakulẹ" pẹlu ipinnu ẹjọ naa.

rows.source: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.
rows.output: A rò pé ìpinnu láti wá ìwà ọ̀tẹ̀ dípò gbígba ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀bi ẹ̀
rows.reference: "A ro pe ipinnu lati wa ẹbi iku yatọsi ki eeyan gba ẹsun ijẹbi fun igbesi aye ni tubu laini ọna abayọ yoo mu ero ibanujẹ pupọ ti iṣẹlẹ yii wa fun gbogbo awọn ti o kan," Patton sọ.

rows.source: Saipov's defense team had previously asked prosecutors not to seek the death penalty.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ ààbò Saipov ti béèrè fún àwọn olùgbéjáde kí wọ́n má ṣe fẹ̀sùn ikú.
rows.reference: Awọn ẹgbẹ ajẹjọ ti Saipov beere tẹlẹ bẹẹbẹ lọwọ awọn agbẹjọro lati maa beere fun ijiya iku.

rows.source: Tory MP says NIGEL FARAGE should be put in charge of Brexit negotiations
rows.output: Tori MP sọ pé NIGEL FARAGE yẹ kí ó jẹ́ olùdarí àwọn ìjíròrò Brexit
rows.reference: Tory MP sọ wipe NIGEL FARAGE yẹ ki o wa ni iṣakoso fun awọn ijiroro Brexit

rows.source: Nigel Farage vowed to 'mobilise the people's army' today during a protest at the Tory conference.
rows.output: Nigel Farage ṣe ileri lati "mú àwọn ọmọ ogun àwọn ènìyàn" lónìí nígbà ìfihàn níbi àpéjọ́pọ̀ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú.
rows.reference: Nigel Farage bura lati 'ṣe ikojọ igbimọ ogun awọn eniyan’ loni lakoko iwọde kan ni apejọ Tory.

rows.source: The former Ukip leader said politicians had to 'feel the heat' from Eurosceptics - as one of Theresa May's own MPs suggested he should be in charge of negotiations with the EU.
rows.output: Ẹni tó jẹ́ olórí Ukip tẹ́lẹ̀ sọ pé àwọn olóṣèlú ní láti “ní ìmọ̀lára ìgbóná” láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn alátakò ìpínlẹ̀ Yúróòpù - gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn M.P. Theresa May tó sọ pé kí ó jẹ́ ẹni tó ń bójú tó ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú Ìpínlẹ̀ Yúróòpù.
rows.reference: Olori Ukip tẹlẹ sọ pe awọn oloselu gbọdọ 'ni igbona ooru naa' lati awọn Eurosceptics - gẹgẹbi ọkan ninu awọn MP ti Theresa May ti daba pe o yẹ ki o jẹ olujiroro pẹlu EU:

rows.source: Conservative backbencher Peter Bone told the march in Birmingham that the UK 'would have been out' by now if Mr Farage was Brexit Secretary.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú òkèèrè Peter Bone sọ fún ìrìn àjò náà ní Birmingham pé UK yóò ti jáde ní báyìí tí Màríà ní ìjọba Brexit.
rows.reference: Alatako atẹhinwa Peteru Bone sọ fun iwọde ni Birmingham pe UK yoo 'ti jade' ni bayi bi Mr Farage bajẹ Akowe Brexit.

rows.source: But the challenge Mrs May faces in reconciling her deeply divided ranks has been underlined by pro-Remain Tories joining a separate protest against Brexit in the city.
rows.output: Ṣugbọn ìpèníjà tí ìyàwó May dojú kọ láti ṣàkóso àwọn ẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ tí ó yàtọ̀ síra wọn ti jẹ́ kí àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ tó fẹ́ràn ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú ìlú náà kópa nínú ìfihàn tó yàtọ̀ sí ìfihàn ìjọba.
rows.reference: Ṣugbọn ipenija ti Arabinrin May ni ni ilaja awọn ẹgbẹ ti o pin ti awọn ti awọn Remain Tories darapọ mọ awọn oluwọde miiran lodisi Brexit ni ilu.

rows.source: The premier is struggling to keep her Chequers compromise plan on track amid attacks from Brexiteers, Remainers and the EU.
rows.output: Alákòóso náà ń tiraka láti pa ètò ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀ rẹ̀ mọ́, tí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ Bẹ́rẹ́sìtì, Àwọn tó kùnà láti dúró síbẹ̀, àti Ìpínlẹ̀ Yúróòpù ń kọlu.
rows.reference: Oluṣaju n tiraka lati mu ipinnu ileri rẹ ṣẹ laarin ikọlu lọdọ awọn Brexit, Remainer ati EU.

rows.source: Allies insisted she will push ahead with trying to strike a deal with Brussels despite the backlash - and force Eurosceptics and Labour to choose between her package and 'chaos'.
rows.output: Àwọn alájọṣepọ̀ ń bẹ̀rù pé yóò tẹ̀ síwájú láti gbìyànjú láti ṣe ìpinnu pẹ̀lú Brussels láìka ìdáhùn sílẹ̀, kí wọ́n sì fipá mú àwọn Eurosceptics àti Labour láti yan láàárín àpò rẹ̀ àti ‘ìdàrúdàpọ̀’.
rows.reference: Awọn ẹgbẹ sọ daju pe yoo tẹsiwaju pẹlu igbiyanju lati ni asọye pẹlu Brussels pelu isọrọdisi - ati ki o fi ipa mu Eurosceptics ati Ẹgbẹ oṣiṣẹ lati yan laarin ohun ti o sọ ati 'Idarudapọ'.

rows.source: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Bone sọ fún ìpàdé ìkọ̀sílẹ̀ ìkọ̀sílẹ̀ ní Solihull pé ó fẹ́ “fọ́ Chequers”.
rows.reference: Ọgbẹni Bone sọ fun iwọde Fisilẹ Tumọsi Fisilẹ ni Solihull pe oun fẹ lati 'Fun Awọn Alayẹwo'.

rows.source: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.
rows.output: Ó dámọ̀ràn pé kí wọ́n fún Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Farage ní ipò ọba àti ojúṣe fún ìjíròrò pẹ̀lú Brussels.
rows.reference: O daba pe Ọgbẹni Farage yẹ lati jẹ ọmọ ẹgbẹ kan ki o si ni ojuse lati ṣe idunadura pẹlu Brussels.

rows.source: 'If he had been in charge, we would have been out by now,' he said.
rows.output: Tí ó bá ti jẹ́ ọ̀gá, a ó ti jáde ní báyìí.
rows.reference: 'Ti o ba jẹ olori, a o ti jade ni bayi,' o wi pe

rows.source: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'
rows.output: Ẹ̀ka ìjọba ìbílẹ̀ Wellingborough sọ pé: ‘Èmi yóò dúró fún Brexit ṣùgbọ́n a nílò láti fọ́ Chequers.’
rows.reference: MP ti Welingborough fi kun: 'Emi yoo duro fun Brexit ṣugbọn a nilo lati ṣawari Awọn Oluṣayẹwo.'

rows.source: Setting out his opposition to the EU, he said: 'We didn't fight world wars to be subservient.
rows.output: Nígbà tí ó ń sọ̀rọ̀ lòdì sí Ìpínlẹ̀ Yúróòpù, ó sọ pé: “A kò ja ogun àgbáyé láti jẹ́ aláìṣẹ́.
rows.reference: Ṣiṣeto atako yii si EU, o sọ bẹẹ: 'A ko ja ogun agbaye lati wa laaye.

rows.source: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'
rows.output: A fẹ́ ṣe òfin wa ní orílẹ̀-èdè wa.
rows.reference: A fẹ ṣe awọn ofin ti ara wa ni orilẹ-ede wa.'

rows.source: Mr Bone dismissed suggestions that public opinion had changed since the 2016 vote: 'The idea that the British people have changed their minds and want to remain is completely untrue.'
rows.output: Ọgbẹni Bone kọ̀ láti gbà pé ìmọ̀lára àwọn ènìyàn ti yí padà láti ìdìbò 2016: ‘Ìmọ̀lára pé àwọn ará Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ti yí ìmọ̀ràn wọn padà tí wọ́n sì fẹ́ kí wọ́n wà láàyè kò jẹ́ òtítọ́.’
rows.reference: Ọgbẹni Bone fagile imọran pe ero ti awọn eniyan ti yipada lati ọdun idibo 2016: 'Awọn idaniloju pe awọn eniyan Britani ti yi ọkàn wọn pada ati pe wọn fẹ lati duro jẹ irọ patapata.'

rows.source: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was also at the march, telling reporters: 'I am simply saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.
rows.output: Ẹni tí ó ń ṣe ìpolongo Brexit Andrea Jenkyns tún wà ní ìrìn àjò náà, ó sì sọ fún àwọn oníròyìn pé: “Mo ń sọ pé: Ààrẹ, gbọ́ àwọn ènìyàn.
rows.reference: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns naa wa ni iwọde, o sọ fun awọn oniroyin: 'Mo kan n sọ pe: Minisita Alakoso, fetisi awọn eniyan.

rows.source: 'Chequers is unpopular with the general public, the Opposition's not going to vote for it, it's unpopular with our party and our activists who actually pound the streets and get us elected in the first place.
rows.output: 'Chequers kò gbajúmọ̀ láàárín àwọn ènìyàn, àwọn alátakò kò ní dìbò fún un, kò gbajúmọ̀ láàárín ẹgbẹ́ wa àti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ wa tí wọ́n ń gbé ìgbésẹ̀ kí wọ́n sì dìbò fún wa ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀.
rows.reference: 'Awọn Oluṣayẹwo jẹ alailokiki lọdọ gbogbogbo, Alatako ko ni dibo fun, ko lokiki ninu ẹgbẹ wa ati awọn ajijagbara wa ti o wa ita gbangba lati dibo fun wa.

rows.source: Please drop Chequers and start listening.'
rows.output: Jọ̀wọ́, fi Chequers sílẹ̀ kí o sì bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí gbọ́.'
rows.reference: Jọwọ fi awọn Ṣayẹwo silẹ ki o bẹrẹ si gbọ.'

rows.source: In a pointed message to Mrs May, she added: 'Prime ministers keep their jobs when they keep their promises.'
rows.output: Ní ìfiránṣẹ́ kan tó ṣe pàtàkì sí Ìyáàfin May, ó fi kún un pé: ‘Àwọn aṣáájú ọ̀nà pa àwọn iṣẹ́ wọn mọ́ nígbà tí wọ́n bá pa àwọn ìlérí wọn mọ́.’
rows.reference: Ninu ifiranṣẹ ti o tọ si Arabinrin May, o fi kun: 'Awọn aṣoju Minisita n pa iṣẹ wọn mọ nigba ti wọn ko ba mu awọn ileri wọn ṣẹ.'

rows.source: Mr Farage told the rally politicians must be made to 'feel the heat' if they were about to betray the decision made in the 2016 referendum.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Farage sọ fún ìpàdé náà pé àwọn aṣojú òṣèlú gbọ́dọ̀ “ní ìrora” tí wọ́n bá fẹ́ fọwọ́ kàn án tí wọ́n sì fẹ́ fọwọ́ kàn án ní ìdìbò 2016.
rows.reference: Ọgbẹni Farage sọ fun awọn oluwọlu pe awọn oloselu gbọdọ ‘lero ooru’ lara ti wọn ba fẹ yi ipinnu ti a ṣe ni idibo ti 2016 pada.

rows.source: 'This is now about a matter of trust between us - the people - and our political class,' he said.
rows.output: Èyí sì jẹ́ nípa ìgbàgbọ́ báyìí láàárín wa - àwọn ènìyàn - àti àwọn ìjọba wa.
rows.reference: 'Eyi jẹ nipa ọrọ ifọkantan laarin wa - awọn eniyan - ati egbe oselu wa,' o sọ.

rows.source: 'They are trying to betray Brexit and we are here today to tell them 'we won't let you get away with doing that'.'
rows.output: Wọ́n ń gbìyànjú láti tan ẹ̀tọ́ ìjọba àpapọ̀ náà, a sì wà lónìí láti sọ fún wọn pé “a kò jẹ́ kí ẹ lọ́wọ́.”
rows.reference: 'Wọn n gbiyanju lati da Brexit a wa loni lati sọ fun wọn pe,' Awa ki yoo jẹ ki ẹ mu eleyi jẹ'.

rows.source: In a message to the enthusiastic crowd he added: 'I want you to make our political class, who are on the verge of betraying Brexit, feel the heat.
rows.output: Ní ìkéde kan sí àwọn ènìyàn tí ó ní ìfẹ́, ó fi kún un pé: “Mo fẹ́ kí ẹ ṣe ìyàtọ̀ sí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú wa, tí wọ́n ń lọ sí ìdàrúdàpọ̀ nípa ìdìbò láti kúrò ní ìpínlẹ̀.”
rows.reference: Ninu ifiranṣẹ kan si ero ti o ni itara ti o fi kun: 'Mo fẹ ki ẹ jẹki awọn oselu wa, ti o wa ni ipo dida Brexit, lero ooru naa.

rows.source: 'We are mobilising the people's army of this country that gave us victory in Brexit and will never rest until we have become an independent, self-governing, proud United Kingdom.'
rows.output: A máa ń ṣe ìmúgbòòrò àwọn ọmọ ogun orílẹ̀-èdè yìí tí ó fún wa ní ìṣẹ́gun ní Brexit tí yóò sì máa ṣe ìdàrúdàpọ̀ títí tí a ó fi di orílẹ̀-èdè olominira, tí a ó fi ṣe ìṣàkóso ara wa, tí a ó sì máa ṣe ìṣàkóso ara wa, orílẹ̀-èdè United Kingdom tí a ó fi ṣe ìṣà
rows.reference: 'A n ṣe akojọ ẹgbẹ ọmọ ogun ti orilẹ-ede yii ti o fun wa ni iṣẹgun ni Brexit ati pe ko ni si isimi titi di igba ti a ba ti di ominira, iṣakoso ara-ẹni, ounyangan iṣejọba ara ẹni United Kingdom.'

rows.source: Meanwhile, Remainers marched through Birmingham before holding a two-hour rally in the city centre.
rows.output: Nígbà yẹn, àwọn tó kù ní ìlú náà lọ káàkiri Birmingham kí wọ́n tó ṣe ìpàdé wákàtí méjì ní àárín ìlú náà.
rows.reference: Nibayi, Ramainers wọ kọja Birmingham ṣaaju ki wọn to pejọ fun iwọde wakati meji ni aarin ilu naa.

rows.source: A smattering of activists waved Tories Against Brexit banners after the launch of the group this weekend.
rows.output: Àwọn alágbára kan ń fòyà fún àwọn ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Konsafetifu lòdì sí Brexit lẹ́yìn ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ẹgbẹ́ náà ní ìparí ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí.
rows.reference: Awọn alakikanju ti awọn ajafitafita lo Tories Lodi si Asia Brexit lẹhin ifilole ẹgbẹ naa ni ìparí ọsẹ yii.

rows.source: Labour peer Lord Adonis mocked the Conservatives for the security issues they suffered with a party app as the conference opened.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Labour, ọ̀gá àgbà ọmọ ilẹ̀ Gẹ̀ẹ́sì, Ààrẹ Adonis, ń ṣàríwísí àwọn ìpèníjà ààbò tí àwọn òṣèlú Konsafetifu dojú kọ pẹ̀lú ohun èlò ẹgbẹ́ wọn nígbà tí àpéjọ náà bẹ̀rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ẹlẹgbẹ Oṣiṣẹ Oluwa Adonis ṣe ẹlẹya awọn olutẹle ohun atẹhinwa nitori iṣẹlẹ aabo ti wọn ni pẹlu iṣafilọlẹ ẹgbẹ kan bi apejọ ti ṣí bẹrẹ.

rows.source: 'These are the people who tell us they can have the IT systems in place and all of the technology for Canada plus plus, for the frictionless border, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.
rows.output: Àwọn ènìyàn wọ̀nyí ni wọ́n ń sọ pé wọ́n lè ní àwọn ọ̀nà ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ níbi tí wọ́n ti lè ní ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Canada pẹ̀lú, fún ààlà tí kò ní ìdààmú, fún ìṣòwò tó dára láìsí ààlà ní Ireland, ó fi kún un.
rows.reference: 'Awọn wọnyi ni awọn eniyan ti o sọ fun wa pe wọn le ni awọn ilana IT ni ojuṣe ati gbogbo imọ-ẹrọ fun Canada ni afikun pẹlu, fun iyipo ailopin, fun iṣowo ọfẹ laisi awọn aala ni Ireland,’o fi kun.

rows.source: 'It is a complete farce.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ àṣìṣe pípé.
rows.reference: 'O jẹ aiṣeeṣe patapata.

rows.source: There isn't such a thing as a good Brexit,' he added.
rows.output: Kò sí irú nǹkan bẹ́ẹ̀ bíi ìrìn àjò tó dára, ó sì fi kún un.
rows.reference: Kosi nnkan ti o dabi Brexit ti o dara,’o fi kun.

rows.source: Warren plans to take a 'hard look' at running for president
rows.output: Warren gbero lati ṣe ayẹwo 'lile' fun ipo aarẹ
rows.reference: Warren ń gbèrò ‘gidi gan-an’ láti jẹ ààrẹ

rows.source: U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she'll take a "hard look at running for president" after the November elections.
rows.output: Alagba Amẹrika Elizabeth Warren sọ pé òun yóò “wo ìrìn àjò ààrẹ lẹ́yìn ìdìbò oṣù kọkànlá.”
rows.reference: ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà Sínátọ̀ Elizabeth Wareen ní òun “gbèrò gidi gan-an láti díje fún ipò ààrẹ” lẹ́yìn ibò oṣù kọkànlá.

rows.source: The Boston Globe reports the Massachusetts Democrat spoke about her future during a town hall in western Massachusetts Saturday.
rows.output: Iwe iroyin Boston Globe sọ pe ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Massachusetts Democrat sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ọjọ́ iwájú rẹ̀ nígbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ìgbà ì
rows.reference: The Boston Globe ni àtẹ̀jáde yìí ti jáde ní àkókò tí ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat ti ìlú Massachusetts ṣe ìpàdé pẹ̀lú àwọn ará ẹkùn ẹ̀ ní iwọ̀-oòrùn Massachusetts ní ọjọ́ Sátidé.

rows.source: Warren, a frequent critic of President Donald Trump, is running for re-election in November against GOP state Rep. Geoff Diehl, who was co-chairman of Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.output: Warren, ẹni tí ó máa ń sọ̀rọ̀ lòdì sí Ààrẹ Donald Trump, ń díje láti padà sípò ní November lòdì sí GOP ipinlẹ Rep. Geoff Diehl, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ alága ẹgbẹ́ Trump ní 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.reference: Warren, alátakò Ààrẹ Donald Trump ní gbogbo ìgbà, máa díjẹ lẹ́ẹ̀kan si pẹ̀lú Geoff Diehl , ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Republican àti aṣojú ìpínlẹ̀ ní oṣù kọkànlá. Diehl jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn alága ní ìlú Massachusetts fún ìpolongo Trump ní 2016.

rows.source: She has been at the center of speculation that she might take on Trump in 2020.
rows.output: Ó ti wà ní àárín àríyànjiyàn pé ó lè dojú kọ Trump ní 2020.
rows.reference: Àwọn èèyàn tí n sọ káàkiri pé ó fẹ́ díje ju ipò ààrẹ pẹlú Trump ni ọdún 2020.

rows.source: Saturday afternoon's event in Holyoke was her 36th meeting with constituents using the town hall format since Trump took office.
rows.output: Ọjọ́ Àìkú ọ̀sán ní Holyoke jẹ́ ìpàdé 36th rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ará ìlú nípa lílo fọ́ọ̀mù ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin láti ìgbà tí Trump ti gba ọ́fíìsì.
rows.reference: Ìpàdé tó wáyé ní ọ̀sán Sátidé ní Holyoke ni ìpàdé ìkẹ́rindínlógójì (36) tó ṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn t’ọ́n wà ní ẹkùn ẹ̀ láti ìgbà tí Trump ti wọlé.

rows.source: An attendee asked her if she planned to run for president.
rows.output: Ẹni tí ó wà níbẹ̀ béèrè lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀ bóyá ó ti pinnu láti di ààrẹ.
rows.reference: Ọ̀kan nínú àwọn t’ọ́n wà fún ìpàdé náà bíi léèrè pé ǹjẹ́ ó ń pinnu láti jẹ ààrẹ?

rows.source: Warren replied that it's time "for women to go to Washington to fix our broken government, and that includes a woman at the top."
rows.output: Warren dahun pe o to akoko fun “awọn obinrin lati lọ si Washington lati ṣe atunṣe ijọba wa ti o bajẹ, ati pe eyi pẹlu obinrin ni oke.”
rows.reference: Warren ní àkókò ti tó “fún àwọn òbinrin láti lọ sí Washington láti to ìjọba tó doríkodò, àti pé obìnrin gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ olórí.”

rows.source: Arrest made in shooting death of LSU's Sims
rows.output: Wọ́n mú ọkùnrin kan ní ìbànújẹ́ ikú ìbọn ti LSU's Sims
rows.reference: Ìtìmọ́lé ẹni tó yìnbọn pa Sims, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù àfọwọ́gbá ti LSU

rows.source: Police in Baton Rouge, La., announced Saturday that a suspect has been arrested in the shooting death of LSU basketball player Wayde Sims on Friday.
rows.output: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ní Baton Rouge, La., kéde ní ọjọ́ Àìkú pé wọ́n ti mú ẹlẹ́bi kan tó pa Wayde Sims, agbabọ́ọ̀lù bọ́ọ̀lù ẹgbẹ́ LSU ní ọjọ́ Jimọ.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Sátidé, àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti Baton Rogue, La., kéde àtìmọ́lé olùfurasí tó yìnbọn pa Wayde Sims, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù àfọwọ́gbá ti LSU, ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀.

rows.source: The Baton Rouge Police Department announced the arrest of Dyteon Simpson, 20, at an 11 a.m. ET news conference.
rows.output: Ẹka ọlọpaa Baton Rouge kede imuni Dyteon Simpson, 20, ni apejọ iroyin 11 a.m. ET.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ti Baton Rogue kéde àtìmọ́lé Dyteon Simpson, ọmọ ogún ọdún (20) ní aago mọkànlá òwúrọ̀ lásìkò.

rows.source: They had released a video of the shooting on Friday, asking for help identifying a man seen in the footage.
rows.output: Wọ́n ti tu fidio ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò náà jáde ní ọjọ́ Jimọ, tí wọ́n sì ń béèrè fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ láti mọ̀ ọkùnrin kan tí a rí nínú fídíò náà.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́pàá ṣe àfihàn fídíò ìbọn yínyìn ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀. Wọ́n ní ẹni tó bá dá ẹni tó yìnbọn náà mọ̀, kó sọ fún àwọn.

rows.source: Sims, 20, was shot and killed near Southern University's campus early Friday.
rows.output: Sims, 20, ni a yinbọn pa ni ibi kan ti o wa nitosi ile-ẹkọ giga ti Southern University ni owurọ ọjọ Aarọ.
rows.reference: Ní kùtùkùtù ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, nítọ̀sí Southern University, ni ọta ìbọn ba Sims, ọmọ ogun (20) ọdún, tó sì kú.

rows.source: "Wayde Sims suffered a gunshot wound to the head and ultimately died as a result," police chief Murphy J. Paul told the media Saturday, per 247sports.
rows.output: "Wayde Sims farapa lati inu ibọn si ori o si ku nikẹhin nitori rẹ," Murphy J. Paul, Alakoso ọlọpa sọ fun awọn oniroyin ni Satide, gẹgẹ bi 247sports.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gá ọlọ́pàá, Murphy J. Paul sọ fún ilé-ìròyìn 247sports pe “Ọgbẹ́ orí látàrí ọta ìbọn tó ba Wayde Sims ló pa á.”

rows.source: Wayde stepped in to defend his friend and was shot by Simpson.
rows.output: Wayde ti wọlé láti dáàbò bo ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, ó sì ti yinbọn pa á nípa Simpson.
rows.reference: Wayde ń gbèjà ọ̀rẹ́ ẹ̀ ni kí Simpson tó yìnbọn fun un.

rows.source: Simpson was questioned and admitted to being on scene, in possession of a weapon, and admitted to shooting Wayde Sims.
rows.output: Simpson ni a beere lọwọ rẹ, o si jẹwọ pe o wa ni ibi iṣẹlẹ naa, o si ni ohun ija, o si jẹwọ pe o yinbọn si Wayde Sims.
rows.reference: Nínú ìdáhùn ẹ, Simpson jẹ́wọ́ pé òun wà ní ibi iṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, òun ní ìbọn lọ́wọ́, àti pé òun ló yìnbọn fún Wayde Sims.

rows.source: Simpson was arrested without incident and taken into custody at East Baton Rouge Parish Police Department.
rows.output: Wọ́n mú Simpson láìsí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kankan, wọ́n sì gbé e lọ sí ọ̀dọ̀ Ẹgbẹ́ ọlọ́pàá Ìpínlẹ̀ East Baton Rouge.
rows.reference: Simpson ‘ò bá àwọn ọlọ́pàá ṣagídí bí wọ́n ṣe tì í mọ́ àtìmọ́lẹ́ ti àwọn ọlọ́pàá ní East Baton Rouge Parish.

rows.source: A 6-foot-6 junior who grew up in Baton Rouge, Sims played in 32 games with 10 starts last season and averaged 17.4 minutes, 5.6 points and 2.9 rebounds per game.
rows.output: Ọmọ ọdún mẹ́fà [6] tí ó dúró ní ẹsẹ̀ bàtà mẹ́fà [6] tí ó dàgbà ní Baton Rouge, Sims kópa nínú àwọn eré 32 pẹ̀lú ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ 10 nígbà tó kọjá, ó sì gba ìṣẹ́jú 17.4, 5.6 àwọn àmì àti 2.9 ìkànsí fún eré kan.
rows.reference: Sims, ọmọ tó ga fíofío, ṣe kékeré ẹ̀ ní Baton Rogue. Ní sáà tó kọjá, ó gbá bọ́ọ̀lu-aláfọwọ́gbá fún ẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀ ní ìgbà méjìlélọ́gbọ̀n (32). Ó bá wọn bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ẹ̀mẹwàá nínú ẹ̀.

rows.source: Russian Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton closes in on world title after team orders hand him win over Sebastian Vettel
rows.output: Ìdíje Gíríìkì Rọ́ṣíà: Lewis Hamilton sunmọ́ àmì ẹ̀yẹ àgbáyé lẹ́yìn ìpinnu ẹgbẹ́ náà fún un láti borí Sebastian Vettel
rows.reference: Erésísáonímọ́tò ní Russia Lewis Hamilton ló gbégbá orókè nínú ìdíjẹ àgbáyé. Mọ́tò tuntun tí Mercedes ráà ló fún ní àǹfààní láti borí Sebastian Vettel.

rows.source: It became clear from the moment that Valtteri Bottas qualified ahead of Lewis Hamilton on Saturday that Mercedes" team orders would play a large part in the race.
rows.output: Ó di kedere lẹ́yìn ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Valtteri Bottas lórí ìpèjọpọ̀ Lewis Hamilton ní ọjọ́ Àìkú pé àwọn ìtọ́nisọ́nà ẹgbẹ́ Mercedes yóò ṣe pàtàkì nínú eré náà.
rows.reference: Valtteri Bottas ló kọ́ dé ìfẹsẹ̀wọnsè tó kẹ́yìn ni ọjọ́ Sátidé. Bí Mercedes ṣe gbọ́, wọ́n ra mọ́tò míì tó kó ipa pàtàkì nínú eré náà.

rows.source: From pole, Bottas got a good start and almost hung Hamilton out to dry as he defended his position in the first two turns and invited Vettel to attack his teammate.
rows.output: Láti ibi ìpìlẹ̀, Bottas gba ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ tó dára, ó sì fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ jẹ́ kí Hamilton gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé e nígbà tó ń dáàbò bo ipò rẹ̀ ní àwọn yíyí méjì àkọ́kọ́, ó sì pe Vettel láti kọlu ẹlẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Botta bẹ̀rẹ̀ dáadáa. Ó ku díẹ̀ kó ti Hamilton kúrọ̀ lọ́nà torí ó fẹ́ gbé ipò kìíní. Kódà, ó lo Vettel láti ko lù ú.

rows.source: Vettel went into the pits first and left Hamilton to run into the traffic at the tail of the pack, something which should have been decisive.
rows.output: Vettel lọ sí ibi ìpamọ́ àkọ́kọ́, ó sì fi Hamilton sílẹ̀ láti wọ inú ìkún omi ní ẹ̀yìn ẹgbẹ́ náà, èyí tí ó yẹ kí ó jẹ́ ìpinnu.
rows.reference: Vettel ‘ò fi ọgbọ́n ṣe é. Ó já sí kòtò, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni Hamilton wà lẹyìn nínú súnkere-fàkere.

rows.source: The Mercedes pitted a lap later and came out behind Vettel, but Hamilton went ahead after some wheel-to-wheel action that saw the Ferrari driver reluctantly leave the inside free at risk of holding out after a double-move to defend on the third corner.
rows.output: Ìyàwó Mercedes náà wọ́n sì jáde lẹ́yìn Vettel, ṣùgbọ́n Hamilton lọ síwájú lẹ́yìn ìjà ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ kan tó rí i pé ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ náà kò fẹ́ fi ẹ̀yìn sílẹ̀ ní ewu láti di ọ̀nà kẹta.
rows.reference: Mercedes dúró níbi kòtò láti jáde lẹ́yìn Vettel. Láìpẹ́, Hamilton bọ́ síwájú. Àwọn awakọ̀ náà dá onírúurú ọgbọ́n bí wọ́n ṣe n wọkọ̀ . Awakọ̀ Ferari fi ojú-ọ̀nà sílẹ̀ torí kò fẹ́ ki ọkọ kọ̀ọ̀kan kọjá lára òun nígbà kẹta.

rows.source: Max Verstappen started from the back row of the grid and was in seventh by the end of the first lap on his 21st birthday.
rows.output: Max Verstappen bẹrẹ lati inu ẹgbẹ ti o kẹhin ti gridi ati pe o wa ni keje ni opin ipele akọkọ ni ọjọ-ibi 21st rẹ.
rows.reference: Max Verstappen ló gbẹ̀yìn. Ipò kèje ló wà nígbà tí wọ́n parí ipele kìíní. Ọjọ́ yẹn ló pé ọmọ 21 ọdún.

rows.source: He then led for a large part of the race as he held onto his tyres to target a quick finish and overtake Kimi Raikkonen for fourth.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn náà, ó ṣe ìdarí fún apá ńlá nínú eré-ìje náà gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti di ẹ̀rọ taya rẹ̀ mọ́ láti ṣe àfojúsùn fún ìparí yára kan àti láti kọjá Kimi Raikkonen fún kẹrin.
rows.reference: Ó gbìyànjú, ó sáré gan-an kó lè tètè parí, kó la Kimi Raikkonen kó lè gbé ipò kẹrin.

rows.source: He eventually came into the pits on the 44th lap but was unable to increase his pace in the remaining eight laps as Raikkonen took fourth.
rows.output: Ó wọ inú àwọn ìpàtẹ́wọ́ ní ìpè 44, ṣùgbọ́n kò lè pọ̀ si ìyara rẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìpè mẹ́jọ tó kù bí Raikkonen ṣe gba ìpò kẹrin.
rows.reference: Ní àkàsọ̀ 44, ó jásí kòtò. Bí kò ṣe lè sáré dáadáa mọ́ fún àkàsọ 8 tó kù. Bí Raikkonen se gbé ipò kẹrin nìyẹn.

rows.source: It's a difficult day because Valtteri did a fantastic job all weekend and was a real gentleman told let me by.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ọjọ́ tí ó nira nítorí Valtteri ṣe iṣẹ́ tó dára jùlọ ní gbogbo ìgbà òkè àti pé ó jẹ́ ọkùnrin tó dára tó sọ fún mi pé kí n kọjá.
rows.reference: Ọjọ́ ńlá ní lòní. Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé Valtteri ṣe iṣẹ́ gidi ní ìparí ọ̀sẹ̀ àti èèyàn jẹ́jẹ́.

rows.source: The team have done such an exceptional job to have a one two," said Hamilton.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ náà ti ṣe iṣẹ́ àṣekára tó bẹ́ẹ̀ láti ní ọ̀kan méjì,” ni Hamilton sọ.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ ikọ̀ tó kù ṣe dáadáa jù ú lọ t’ọ́n fi wà ní ipò 1 àti 2,” ni Hamilton sọ.

rows.source: That Was Really Bad Body Language
rows.output: Ìyẹn jẹ́ Ìbànújẹ́ Gidi fún Ìbáṣepọ̀ Ara
rows.reference: Ìfarasọ̀rọ̀ tí kò dára

rows.source: President Donald Trump mocked Senator Dianne Feinstein at a rally on Saturday over her insistence she did not leak the letter from Christine Blasey Ford accusing Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of sexual assault.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Donald Trump ṣe ẹ̀rín sí Sẹ́nétọ̀ Dianne Feinstein ní ìpàdé kan ní ọjọ́ Sátidé nípa ìfẹ́ rẹ̀ pé kò fi lẹ́tà kan tí Christine Blasey Ford kọ sílẹ̀ tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn kan Brett Kavanaugh, olùdíje fún Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jùlọ, ní ìfipábánilòpọ̀.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Donald Trump fi Sínátọ̀ Dianne Feinste ṣe yẹ̀yẹ́ torí ó ní òun ‘ọ́ tú lẹ́tà tí Christine Blasey Ford kọ síta, tó fi ẹ̀sùn ìfipábánilòpọ̀ kan Brett Kavanaugh, ẹni tí ààre yan gẹ́gẹ́ bí adájọ́ sí Ilé-ìdájọ́ Àgbà ti ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà.

rows.source: Speaking at a rally in West Virginia, the president did not directly address the testimony given by Ford before the Senate Judiciary Committee, instead commenting that what was going on in the Senate showed that people were "mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: Nígbà tí ó ń sọ̀rọ̀ ní ìpàdé kan ní West Virginia, ààrẹ kò sọ̀rọ̀ ní pàtó nípa ẹ̀rí tí Ford fi fún Igbimọ́ Ìdájọ́ Ilé Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin, dípò bẹ́ẹ̀, ó sọ pé ohun tí ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Sẹ́nétì náà fi hàn pé àwọn èèyàn jẹ́ “mímọ́, ìbínú, àti àìlòdì.”
rows.reference: Ní ìlú West Virginia, níbi ìpàdé pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ̀ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́, Ààrẹ tí kò sọrọ̀ nípa òun tí Sínátọ̀ yí sọ fún ìgbìmọ̀ ẹjọ́ dídá ti Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà ní ohun tí ó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà ṣàfihàn “ìkà àti àìlóòótó” àwọn èèyàn.

rows.source: "The one thing that could happen and the beautiful thing that is going on over the last few days in the Senate, when you see the anger, when you see people that are angry and mean and nasty and untruthful," he said.
rows.output: "Ìyẹn nìkan ni ohun tí ó lè ṣẹlẹ̀, àti ohun tí ó dára gan-an tí ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Sẹ́nétì ní àwọn ọjọ́ díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn, nígbà tí o bá rí ìbínú, nígbà tí o bá rí àwọn ènìyàn tí ó bínú àti ìbínú àti ìbínú àti àìtọ́ àti àìtọ́," ó sọ.
rows.reference: Ó ní “Ohun tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀, àti ohun tí òun rò pé ó dára nípa ohun tó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà lẹ́nu ọjọ́ mẹ́ta yìí jẹ́ àfihàn ìbínú. Àwọn èèyàn ń bínú, ṣìkà, àti aláìṣòótọ́.”

rows.source: "When you look at releases and leaks and then they say "oh, I didn't do it.
rows.output: Nígbà tí o bá wo ìtújáde àti ìtànkálẹ̀, wọn yóò sọ pé “oh, mi ò ṣe é.
rows.reference: “Wọ́n ń sọ̀rọ̀, wọ́n ń tú àṣírí, àmọ́ ó ní “Mò ‘ò ṣé ééé.

rows.source: I didn't do it."
rows.output: "Mi o ṣe e."
rows.reference: Mò ‘ò ṣé ééé.”

rows.source: Remember?
rows.output: Ranti?
rows.reference: Ṣé ẹ rántí?

rows.source: Dianne Feinstein, did you leak?
rows.output: Dianne Feinstein, ṣe o ṣe àtúnṣe?
rows.reference: Ǹjẹ́ Dianne Feinstein tu síta?

rows.source: Remember her answer... did you leak the document - "oh, oh, what?
rows.output: Ranti idahun rẹ... ṣe o fi iwe naa silẹ - "oh, oh, kini?
rows.reference: Ṣé ẹ rántí ìdáhùn ẹ̀... ǹjẹ́ o tú àkọsílẹ̀ náà síta? Ó kọ lẹ́nu

rows.source: Oh, no.
rows.output: Oh, rara.
rows.reference: Mo ‘ò.

rows.source: I didn't leak."
rows.output: Mo máa ń sọ pé, “Mi ò sọ̀rọ̀.”
rows.reference: Mo ‘ò tu síta.”

rows.source: Well, wait one minute.
rows.output: Ó dára, dúró ní ìṣẹ́jú kan.
rows.reference: Ẹ ní sùúrù.

rows.source: Did we leak...No, we didn't leak," he added, in an impression of the senator.
rows.output: Ṣé a tú...Rárá, a kò tú, "ó fi kún, ní ìmúra ti sẹ́nétọ̀.
rows.reference: Ṣé a jọ tu síta ni...Rárá, a ò jọ tu síta,” ni ó fi kún ọ̀rọ̀ ẹ̀, torí ohun tí ó lérò pé Sínátọ̀ náà lè sọ nìyẹn.

rows.source: Feinstein was sent the letter detailing the allegations against Kavanaugh by Ford back in July, and it was leaked earlier in September - but Feinstein denied that the leak came from her office.
rows.output: Àwọn ẹ̀sùn tí wọ́n fi kan Kávanágh, tí Ford fi ránṣẹ́ sí Feinstein ní July, ti jáde ní September, ṣùgbọ́n Feinstein kọ̀ láti jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ pé ìjákulẹ̀ náà wá láti ọ́fíìsì rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Oṣù keje ni Ford kọ lẹ́tà nípa onírúurú ẹ̀sùn tí Kavanaugh ṣè sí Feinstein, àmọ́ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ oṣù kẹsàn-án, gbogbo èèyàn mọ̀ nípa ẹ̀sùn yí àmọ́ Feinstein ní òun ‘ò tú ẹ̀sùn náà síta fún àwọn èèyàn.

rows.source: "I did not hide Dr. Ford's allegations, I did not leak her story," Feinstein told the committee, The Hill reported.
rows.output: "Mo kò fi ìròyìn Dókítà Ford pamọ́, mo kò sì tú ìtàn rẹ̀ sílẹ̀," ní ìsọ̀rí sí ìgbìmọ̀ náà, Ìwé Ìròyìn Ìlà Oòrùn sọ.
rows.reference: Ìròyìn The Hill ní Feinstein sọ fún ìgbìmọ̀ pé “Mo ‘ò fi onírúurú ẹ̀sùn Ford pamọ́, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni mo ‘ò tu síta.”

rows.source: "She asked me to hold it confidential and I kept it confidential as she asked."
rows.output: Ó béèrè lọ́wọ́ mi pé kí n pa á mọ́, mo sì pa á mọ́ bí ó ti béèrè.
rows.reference: ”Ó ní ki máa sọ fún ẹnìkankan, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni mo ‘ò sọ fún ẹnìkankan.”

rows.source: But her denial did not appear to sit well with the president, who commented during the Saturday night rally: "I'll tell you what, that was really bad body language.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ìdáhùn rẹ̀ kò dàbí ẹni pé ó bá a lọ́kàn, ẹni tó ń ṣe ààrẹ sì sọ nígbà ìpàdé ìpàdé alẹ́ ọjọ́ Sátidé: “Èmi yóò sọ fún ọ, èyí jẹ́ ìbáṣepọ̀ ara tí kò dára.
rows.reference: Irọ́ tó ń pa yìí ‘ò dùn mọ́ ààrẹ nínú. Ìdí rẹ̀ẹ́ ti ààrẹ fi sọ̀rọ̀ ní ọjọ́ Sátidé níbi ìpàdé pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ̀ ọmọ ẹgbẹ́. Ó ní: “Ìfarasọ̀rọ̀ tí kò dára rèé

rows.source: Maybe she didn't, but that's the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: Bóyá kò ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n èyí ni èdè ara tó burú jù lọ tí mo ti rí rí.
rows.reference: Bí ‘ò bá mọ̀, kó lọ pé mo ‘ò ìfarasọ̀rọ̀ tó burú jáyì tó yìí rí.”

rows.source: Continuing his defense of the Supreme Court nominee, who has been accused of sexual misconduct by three women, the president suggested that the Democrats were using the allegations for their own ends.
rows.output: Tẹsiwaju ni aabo fun oludije ile-ẹjọ giga, ẹniti awọn obinrin mẹta ti fi ẹsun ifipabanilopo kan, aarẹ naa daba pe awọn alatako ni wọn n lo awọn ẹsun naa fun awọn idi tiwọn.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ tó gbárúkùtì mọ́ ẹni tó yàn sí ipò adájọ́ ní Ilé-ẹjọ́ Àgbà, eni tí àwọn obìnrin mẹ́ta fi ẹ̀sùn ìfipábánilòpọ̀ kàn, ní àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat fẹ lo ẹ̀sùn yí fún àǹfààní ti wọn ni.

rows.source: "They are determined to take back power by any means necessary.
rows.output: Wọ́n ti pinnu láti gba agbára padà ní ọ̀nà èyíkéyìí.
rows.reference: ”Wọ́n ń lo onírúurú ọ̀nà láti padà sí ipò agbára ni.

rows.source: You see the meanness, the nastiness, they don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over to get power and control," Mediaite reported the president saying.
rows.output: O rí ìwà ìbàjẹ́, ìwà ìbàjẹ́, wọn kò kó ìrora sí ẹni tí wọ́n bá fọwọ́ kàn, ẹni tí wọ́n gbọ́dọ̀ rìn káàkiri láti gba agbára àti ìṣàkóso,” Mediaite ròyìn pé Ààrẹ sọ.
rows.reference: Ṣe ẹ rí ìwà ìkà àti àìbíkìtà nípa ìpalára ẹlòmíì torí ipò àti agbára,” ni àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ ti ìwé iroyin Mediaite sọ pé ààrẹ sọ́ ọ.

rows.source: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.output: Ìdíje Àkọ́kọ́: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.reference: Eré-ìdárayá fún àwọn Gbajúmọ̀: Dundee Stars 5, Belfast Giants 3

rows.source: Patrick Dwyer hit two goals for the Giants against Dundee
rows.output: Patrick Dwyer gba ibi-afẹde meji fun awọn Giants lodi si Dundee
rows.reference: Patrick Dwyekr, ọmọ Giants, ju bọ́ọ̀lù sí àwọ̀n Dundee ní èèmejì

rows.source: Dundee Stars atoned for Friday's Elite League loss against Belfast Giants by winning the return match 5-3 in Dundee on Saturday.
rows.output: Àwọn ìràwọ̀ Dundee ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ fún ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí ìpadàbọ̀ lórí
rows.reference: Belfast Giants na Dundee Stars ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀. Àmọ́ ní ọjọ́ Sátidé ní Dundee, Dundee Stars na Belfast Giants ní 5 sí 3.

rows.source: The Giants got an early two-goal lead through strikes from Patrick Dwyer and Francis Beauvillier.
rows.output: Àwọn Gíàsì náà gba ìlànà méjì ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀pẹ̀pẹ̀ láti ọ̀dọ̀ Patrick Dwyer àti Francis Beauvillier.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ Giants, Patrick Dwyer àti Francis Beauvillier, ni wọ́n ju bọ́ọ̀lù ní èẹ̀mejì sí àwọ̀n Dundee Stars.

rows.source: Mike Sullivan and Jordan Cownie brought the home side level before Dwyer restored the Giants' lead.
rows.output: Mike Sullivan àti Jordan Cownie mú kí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ilé wọn dọ́gba, ṣùgbọ́n Dwyer tún mú kí àwọn Giants lè padà síwájú.
rows.reference: Mike Sullivan àti Jordan Cownie náà sọ bọ́ọ̀lù ní èẹ̀mejì sí àwọ̀n Giants. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni Dwyer sọ ẹyọ kan si i.

rows.source: Francois Bouchard equalised for Dundee before two Lukas Lundvald Nielsen goals secured their victory.
rows.output: François Bouchard ti dọgba fun Dundee ṣaaju ki awọn ibi-afẹde meji Lukas Lundvald Nielsen ṣe idaniloju iṣẹgun wọn.
rows.reference: Francois Bouchard náà padà fún Dundee. Bọ́ọlù tí Lukas Lundvald Nielsen sọ sí àwọ̀n Giants lẹ́ẹ̀mejì ló mu Dundee borí.

rows.source: It was a third Elite League defeat of the season for Adam Keefe's men, who had come from behind to beat Dundee 2-1 in Belfast on Friday night.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìpadà kẹta ti ìdíje Elite League fún ẹgbẹ́ Adam Keefe, tí wọ́n ti wá láti ẹ̀yìn láti ṣẹ́gun Dundee 2-1 ní Belfast ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀kẹ́rin rèé tí àwọn ọmọ Adam Kefee, tí wọ́n na Dundee ní 2 sí 1 ní Belfast ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, máa pàdánù ní Eré-ìdárayá Gbajúmọ̀ ti sáà yí nìyí.

rows.source: It was a fourth meeting of the season between the sides, with the Giants winning the previous three matches.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìpàdé kẹrin ti àkókò láàárín àwọn ẹgbẹ́ méjèèjì, pẹ̀lú àwọn Giants tí wọ́n ti ṣẹ́gun ìdíje mẹ́ta tó ṣáájú.
