rows.reference: Ẹ̀kẹ́rin rèé tí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ méjèèjì máa padà nínú ìdíje. Giants borí ní ìdíje mẹ́ta tó ṣáájú.

rows.source: Dwyer's opener came in the fourth minute on 3:35 from a Kendall McFaull assist, with David Rutherford providing the assist as Beauvillier doubled the lead four minutes later.
rows.output: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Dwyer wá ní ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́rin, 3:35 láti ọ̀dọ̀ Kendall McFaull, pẹ̀lú ìrànlọ́wọ́ David Rutherford gẹ́gẹ́ bí Beauvillier ṣe ìlọ́po méjì àkókò mẹ́rin lẹ́yìn náà.
rows.reference: Kendall McFaull ló gbá bọ́ọ̀lù sí Dwyer, tí Dwyer sì gba wọle láàrin ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́rin tí bọ́ọ̀lù bẹ̀rẹ̀. Láàrin ìṣẹ́jú mẹ́rin mìíì, David Rutherford náà gbá bọ́ọ̀lù sí Beauvillier, tí Beauvillier sì gba wọlé.

rows.source: In what was a busy opening period, Sullivan brought the home side back into the game on 13:10 before Matt Marquardt became provider for Cownie's equaliser on 15:16.
rows.output: Ní àkókò ìbẹ̀rẹ̀pẹ̀pẹ̀ tí ó gbóná janjan, Sullivan mú kí ẹgbẹ́ ilé padà wá sínú eré náà ní 13:10, lẹ́yìn náà, Matt Marquardt di olùpèsè fún Cownie ní ìdánilójú ní 15:16.
rows.reference: Sulivan tún sọ bọ́ọ̀lù sí àwọ̀n, àmọ́ Matt Marquardt fún Crownie ni bọ́ọ̀lù, tí Crownie sì gba wọlé.

rows.source: Dwyer made sure the Giants took a lead into the first break when he hit his second goal of the night at the end of the first period.
rows.output: Dwyer ṣe idaniloju awọn Giants lati gba asiwaju sinu isinmi akọkọ nigbati o gba ibi-afẹde keji rẹ ti alẹ ni opin akoko akọkọ.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ Dwyer, ọmọ Giants, tún sọ bọ́ọ̀lù míì sí àwọ̀n -ẹlẹ́kèjì irú ẹ̀ - kí wọ́n tó sinmi ráńpé.

rows.source: The home side regrouped and Bouchard once again put them on level terms with a power play goal on 27:37.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ ilé náà tún ṣètò, Bouchard sì tún jẹ́ kí wọ́n padà sí ìpò kan pẹ̀lú góòlù ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní 27:37.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọmọ Dundee túnramú. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni Bouchard sọ bọ́ọ̀lù míì sí àwọ̀n.

rows.source: Cownie and Charles Corcoran combined to help Nielsen give Dundee the lead for the first time in the match late in the second period and he made sure of the win with his team's fifth halfway through the final period.
rows.output: Cownie àti Charles Corcoran ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn fún Nielsen láti fi ìlú Dundee sílẹ̀ fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ nínú eré náà pẹ̀lú ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀ nínú ìṣẹ́jú kejì. O sì jẹ́ kí ìbòmíràn ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ pẹ̀lú ìlú rẹ̀ kẹrináà ní àárín ìpín ìkẹyìn.
rows.reference: Bí ìfẹsẹ̀wọnsẹ̀ náà ṣe fẹ kásẹ̀ nílẹ̀ Cownie àti Charles gbá bọ́ọ̀lù sí Nielsen láti sọ bọ́ọ̀lù sí àwọ̀n fún góòlù ẹlẹ́kaarùn-ún.

rows.source: The Giants, who have now lost four of their last five matches, are at home to Milton Keynes in their next match on Friday.
rows.output: Àwọn Gíántì, tí wọ́n ti pàdánù mẹ́rin nínú àwọn ìdíje márùn-ún tó kọjá, wà nílé láti bá Milton Keynes lọ ní ìdíje tó ń bọ̀ ní ọjọ́ Jimọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn ikọ̀ Giants, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé wọ́n pàdánù ìdíje mẹ́rin nínú márùn-ún, máa wà ní gbàgéde ti wọn láti kojú ikọ̀ Milton Keynes ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀.

rows.source: Air Traffic Controller Dies To Ensure Hundreds On Plane Can Escape Earthquake
rows.output: Olùdarí Ìrìn-àjò Afẹ́fẹ́ Kú Láti Rí i pé Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn nínú Ọkọ̀ Òfuurufú Lè Sá kúrò nínú Ìkún-omi
rows.reference: Adarí Ọkọ̀ Òfurúfú Kú Torí Àtigba Ọ̀pọ̀ Èèyàn T’ọ́n Wà Nínú Ọkọ̀-òfúrufú Sílẹ̀ Lọ́wọ́ Ìjì-ilẹ̀

rows.source: An air traffic controller in Indonesia is being hailed as a hero after he died ensuring that a plane carrying hundreds of people made it safely off the ground.
rows.output: Ọ̀gá ọkọ̀ òfuurufú kan ní Indonesia ni wọ́n ń pè ní akíkanjú lẹ́yìn ikú rẹ̀ tí ó jẹ́ kí ọkọ̀ òfuurufú kan tó ń gbé ọgọ́rùn-ún ènìyàn jáde láìséwu.
rows.reference: Adarí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú, ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia, ni ọ̀pọ̀ èèyàn ti kan sárá sí gẹ́gẹ́ bí akínkanjú torí ó kú nítorí kí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú tó gbé ọ̀pọ̀ èèyàn lè fò kúrò nílẹ̀ láì léwu.

rows.source: More than 800 people have died and many are missing after a major earthquake hit the island of Sulawesi on Friday, triggering a tsunami.
rows.output: Àwọn ènìyàn tó ju 800 lọ ti kú, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ sì sọnu lẹ́yìn ìkún omi ńlá kan tó kọlu erekùṣù Sulawesi ní ọjọ́ Friday, tó sì fa ìkún omi.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, yàtọ̀ sí àwọn t’ọ́n sọnù, àwọn èèyàn t’ọ́n lé ní ẹgbẹ̀rin ló kú ní erékùsù Sulawesi látàrí ijì-ilẹ̀ tó fa àgbàrá líle.

rows.source: Strong aftershocks continue to plague the area and many are trapped in debris in the city of Palu.
rows.output: Àwọn ìbànújẹ́ tó lágbára ń bá àgbègbè náà lọ, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ sì wà nínú ìdọ̀tí nínú ìlú Palu.
rows.reference: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ìjì-líle níwọ̀nba ń ja ní àgbègbè yí. Àti pé ọ̀pọ̀ wà ní àhámọ́ ilé tó wó bò wọ́n mọlẹ̀ ní ìlú Palu.

rows.source: But despite his colleagues fleeing for their lives, 21-year-old Anthonius Gunawan Agung refused to leave his post in the wildly swaying control tower at Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Airport Palu airport.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n láìka àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ rẹ̀ tí wọ́n ń sá fún ìyè wọn, Anthonius Gunawan Agung tó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 21 kò fẹ́ kúrò ní ibi iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ní tẹ́ńpìlì ìṣàkóso tó ń yí padà ní pàtàkì ní pápákọ̀ òfurufú Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Palu.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀ lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ sá àsálà fún ẹ̀mí wọn, Anthonius Gunawan Agung, ọmọ ọdún oókanlélógún (21) kọ̀ láti fi iṣẹ́ ẹ̀ sílẹ̀ bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ilé tó ń darí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú ní ibùdó ọkọ-òfúrufú Mutiara Sis Al Jufri ní Palu ń mì gidi gan-an.

rows.source: He stayed put to make sure that the Batik Air Flight 6321, which was on the runway at the time, was able to take off safely.
rows.output: Ó dúró láti rí i dájú pé ọkọ̀ òfuurufú Batik Air Flight 6321, tó wà lórí ọ̀nà òfuurufú ní àkókò yẹn, lè gbéra láìséwu.
rows.reference: Ó dúró pa síbẹ̀ torí kí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú Batik Air 6321, tó fẹ́ gbéra, lè fò kúrò nílẹ̀ láì léwu.

rows.source: He then jumped off the traffic control tower when he thought it was collapsing.
rows.output: Ó sì fò kúrò ní òrùlé ìdarí ìkọ̀kọ̀ nígbà tí ó rò pé ó ń rọ̀.
rows.reference: Ìgbà tí ó fò kúrò ní ilé tó ń darí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú ni ìgbà tí ilé náà fẹ́ dà wó.

rows.source: He died later in hospital.
rows.output: Ó kú lẹ́yìn náà ní ilé ìwòsàn.
rows.reference: Ilé-ìwòsàn ló kú sí.

rows.source: Spokesman for Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, said the decision may have saved hundreds of lives, Australia's ABC News reported.
rows.output: Àlàyé fún Ìrìn-àjò afẹ́fẹ́ Íńdíónésíà, Yohannes Sirait, sọ pé ìpinnu náà lè ti gba ẹgbẹ̀rún àwọn ẹ̀mí là, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìròyìn ABC Australia ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Ní ìròyìn ABC News, Yohannes Sirait, agbẹnusọ àwọn t’ọ́n wa ọkọ̀-òfúrufú, ní ìṣe ọmọkùnrin yìí ni kò jẹ́ kí ọ̀pọ̀ eèyàn kú.

rows.source: We prepared a helicopter from Balikpapan in Kalimantan to take him to a bigger hospital in another city.
rows.output: A ti pese ọkọ ofurufu lati Balikpapan ni Kalimantan lati mu u lọ si ile-iwosan nla kan ni ilu miiran.
rows.reference: A pèṣè hẹlikópítà kan láti Balikpapan ní Kalimantan láti mú lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn tó tún tóbi jù ní ìlú mìíràn.

rows.source: Unfortunately we lost him this morning before the helicopter reached Palu.
rows.output: Ó ṣòro fún wa láti pàdánù rẹ̀ ní òwúrọ̀ yìí kí ọkọ̀ òfuurufú tó dé Palu.
rows.reference: Ó mà ṣe o, a pàdánù rẹ̀ ní òwúrọ̀ yìí kí ó tó di pé hẹlikópítà náà dé Palu.

rows.source: "Our heart breaks to hear about this," he added.
rows.output: "Ìyàlẹ́nu àti ìbànújẹ́ ń bà wa nípa èyí," ó fi kún un.
rows.reference: "Ọkàn wa gbọgbẹ́ láti gbọ́ nípa eléyìí,” Our heart breaks to hear about this," Ó fi kú un.

rows.source: Meanwhile, authorities fear that the death toll could reach the thousands with the country's disaster mitigation agency saying that access to the the towns of Donggala, Sigi and Boutong is limited.
rows.output: Nígbà tí àwọn aláṣẹ ń bẹ̀rù pé ìwọ̀n ikú náà lè dé ẹgbẹ̀rún, àjọ tó ń bójú tó ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìbànújẹ́ orílẹ̀-èdè náà sọ pé ìrìn àjò sí àwọn abúlé ti Donggala, Sigi àti Boutong ti dín kù.
rows.reference: Bayii, awọn alaṣẹ n bẹru pe iye iku yoo ga to ẹgbẹgbẹrun pẹlu bi ajọ oluṣabojuto ajalu ṣe n sọ pe iwọle si awọn ilu bii Donggala, Sigi ati Boutong yoo kere.

rows.source: "The toll is believed to be still increasing since many bodies were still under the wreckage while many have not able to be reached," agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho said.
rows.output: "Ìdààmú náà gbọ́dọ̀ ń pọ̀ sí i nítorí pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ara ni wọ́n ṣì wà lábẹ́ ìkọ́kọ́, nígbà tí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ kò tíì lè dé."
rows.reference: ”Ó ṣeéṣe k’áwọn t’ọ́n kú pọ̀ si torí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn èèyàn ni ilé wò bò mọ́lẹ̀, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni wọn ‘ò gbúròó àwọn míì,” ni ohun tí Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ àjọ náà sọ.

rows.source: Waves that reached up to six meters have devastated Palu which will hold a mass burial on Sunday.
rows.output: Àwọn ìkún omi tí ó dé ẹsẹ̀ mẹ́fà ti bàjẹ́ Palu tí yóò sì ṣe ìsìnkú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ní ọjọ́ Àìkú.
rows.reference: Ìjì omi líle tó tó ìwọn mẹ́fà ti run Palu; ibi tí ìsìnkú ọ̀pọ̀ èèyàn ti máa wáyé ní ọjọ́ Àìkú.

rows.source: Military and commercial aircraft are bringing in aid and supplies.
rows.output: Àwọn ọkọ̀ òfuurufú ológun àti òfuurufú ìtajà ń mú ìrànwọ́ àti ohun èlò wá.
rows.reference: Ọkọ̀-òfúrufú ti àwọn ọmọ-ogun àti ti ilé-iṣẹ́ aládàáni ń gbé oúnjẹ, ẹ̀ṣọ́ ilé àti ẹ̀ṣọ́ ara wá fún àwọn èèyàn.

rows.source: Risa Kusuma, a 35-year-old mother, told Sky News: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
rows.output: Risa Kusuma, ìyá 35 ọdún, sọ fún Sky News: "Gbogbo ìṣẹ́jú, ọkọ̀ aláìsàn ń mú àwọn ara wá.
rows.reference: Risa Kusuma, ọmọ ọdún márùn-úndínlógójiị̀ (35) tó tún jẹ́ òbí sọ fun Sky News pé: “Gbogbo ìgbà ni wọ́n n fi mọ́tò-agbókùú gbé òkú wa.

rows.source: Clean water is scarce.
rows.output: Omí mímọ́ kò rọrùn láti rí.
rows.reference: Ó le láti rí omi tó mọ́.

rows.source: The mini-markets are looted everywhere."
rows.output: Àwọn ilé ìtajà kékeré ni wọ́n ń gbóòórùn ní gbogbo ibi.
rows.reference: Wọ́n ń jí nǹkan ní isọ̀ káàkiri ni.”

rows.source: Jan Gelfand, head of the International Red Cross in Indonesia, told CNN: "The Indonesian Red Cross is racing to help survivors but we don't know what they'll find there.
rows.output: Jan Gelfand, olori Ẹgbẹ́ Àgbáyé Pupa ní Indonesia, sọ fún CNN: “Ẹgbẹ́ Àgbáyé Pupa ní Indonesia ń yára láti ràn àwọn aláìsàn lọ́wọ́, ṣùgbọ́n a kò mọ ohun tí wọ́n yóò rí níbẹ̀.
rows.reference: Jan Gelfand, olórí Red Cross Àgbáyé ti orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia sọ fún CNN pé: “Awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Red Cross ti orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia ń wá àwọn tí wọ́n wà láàyè sùgbọ́n wọn ‘ò mọ ohun tí wọ́n máa bá ní abẹ́ àwọn ilé t’ọ́n wọ́n náà.

rows.source: This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse."
rows.output: Èyí ti jẹ́ ìròyìn tó burú, ṣùgbọ́n ó lè burú si.
rows.reference: Kódà, àdánù yí lè pọ̀ si.”

rows.source: Indonesia's President Joko Widodo arrived in Palu on Sunday and told the country's military: "I am asking all of you to work day and night to complete every tasks related to the evacuation.
rows.output: Ààrẹ Indonesia Joko Widodo dé Palu ní ọjọ́ Sunday àti pé ó sọ fún àwọn ọmọ ogun orílẹ̀-èdè náà pé: "Mo ń béèrè lọ́wọ́ gbogbo yín láti ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́jọ́ àti lọ́jọ́ alẹ́ láti parí gbogbo iṣẹ́ tí ó ní í ṣe pẹ̀lú ìkópa."
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Indonesia, Joko Widodo, wá sí Palu ní ọjọ́ Àìkú. Ó sọ fún àwọn ọmọ-ogun orílẹ̀-èdè náà pé: “Kí wọ́n ṣiṣẹ́ tọ̀san-tòru láti kó àwọn tí ilé wó mọ́ lórí jáde.

rows.source: Are you ready?" CNN reported.
rows.output: "Ṣé o ti ṣetan?" CNN royin.
rows.reference: Ẹ se tán?” Gẹ́gẹ́ bí CNN ṣe sọ.

rows.source: Indonesia was hit earlier this year by earthquakes in Lombok in which more than 550 people died.
rows.output: Àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ilẹ̀ ayé ti kọlu Indonesia ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí ní Lombok, níbi tí ó ti lé ní 550 ènìyàn tí wọ́n ti kú.
rows.reference: Ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí ni ijì-ilẹ̀ jà ní ìlú Lombok ní orílẹ̀-èdè Indonesia. Àwọn t’ọ́n kú lé ni 550.

rows.source: Micronesia plane crash: Air Niugini now says one man missing after lagoon plane crash
rows.output: Ìkún omi ọkọ̀ òfuurufú Micronesia: Air Niugini sọ báyìí pé ọkùnrin kan ń ṣọ̀fọ̀ lẹ́yìn ìkún omi ọkọ̀ òfuurufú lagoon
rows.reference: Ọkọ̀-òfúrufú run ní Micronesia Ile-iṣẹ́ Air Niugini ní àwọn ‘ò rí èèyàn kan látàrí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú tó run sínu ọ̀kun

rows.source: The airline operating a flight that crashed into a Pacific lagoon in Micronesia now says one man is missing, after earlier saying all 47 passengers and crew had safely evacuated the sinking plane.
rows.output: Ẹ̀ka ọkọ̀ òfuurufú tí ọkọ̀ òfuurufú kan tí ó fọ́ sínú adágún omi ní Micronesia sọ pé ọkùnrin kan ṣoṣo ni ó sọnù, lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n ti sọ tẹ́lẹ̀ pé gbogbo àwọn arìnrìn-àjò 47 àti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ náà ti jáde láìsí ìṣòro kankan nínú ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn tí Ile-iṣẹ́ tó ni ọkọ̀-òfúrufú, tó run sínu ọ̀kun ti Micronesia, kéde pé àwọn ti kó èrò àti abániṣiṣẹ́ 47 kúrò nínú ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà, ni wọ́n tún ní àwọn ‘ò rí èèyàn kan.

rows.source: Air Niugini said in a release that as of Saturday afternoon, it was unable to account for a male passenger.
rows.output: Ni ọjọ Satide, Air Niugini sọ ninu atẹjade kan pe ko le ṣe iṣiro fun arinrin-ajo ọkunrin kan.
rows.reference: Ile-iṣẹ́ Air Niugini ní ọ̀sán Sátidé ní àwọn ‘ò rí ọmọkùnrin kan

rows.source: The airline said it was working with local authorities, hospitals and investigators to try to find the man.
rows.output: Ẹ̀ka ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà sọ pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn aláṣẹ àdúgbò, ilé ìwòsàn, àti àwọn olùṣàkóso láti gbìyànjú láti rí ọkùnrin náà.
rows.reference: Ile-iṣẹ́ ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà ní àwọn ń ṣiṣẹ́ pọ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn aláṣẹ, ile-ìwòsaǹ àti olùwádìí láti wá ọmọkùnrin náà.

rows.source: The airline did not immediately respond to requests for more details about the passenger, such as his age or nationality.
rows.output: Ìjọba ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà kò fèsì lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ sí àwọn ìbéèrè fún àlàyé síi nípa arìnrìn-àjò náà, bíi ọjọ́ orí rẹ̀ tàbí orílẹ̀-èdè rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ile-iṣẹ́ ọkọ̀-òfúrufú lọ́ra láti sọ ohunkóhun, bíi ọjọ-orí ẹ̀ tàbí ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè tó jẹ́, nípa ọmọkùnrin náà bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn èèyàn bèrè.

rows.source: Local boats helped rescue the other passengers and crew after the plane hit the water while trying to land at the Chuuk Island airport.
rows.output: Awọn ọkọ oju omi agbegbe ran lọwọ lati gba awọn ero ati awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ miiran silẹ lẹhin ti ọkọ ofurufu naa ti lu omi nigba ti o n gbiyanju lati de papa ọkọ ofurufu Chuuk.
rows.reference: Àwọn ọlọ́kò oju-omi ni wọ́n gbé àwọn èrò àti abániṣíṣẹ́ jáde kúrò nínú omi tí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà jásí lásìkò tó ń gbìyànjú láti bà sí ilé-ọkọ̀ òfurufú ti Chuuk Island.

rows.source: Officials said on Friday that seven people had been taken to a hospital.
rows.output: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìjọba sọ ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ pé àwọn èèyàn mèje ni wọ́n gbé lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Jímọ̀, àwọn aláṣẹ ní èèyàn méje ni wọ́n ti gbé lọ sí ilé-ìwòsàn.

rows.source: The airline said six passengers remained at the hospital Saturday, and all of them were in stable condition.
rows.output: Awọn ọkọ ofurufu naa sọ pe awọn ero mẹfa wa ni ile-iwosan ni Satide, ati pe gbogbo wọn wa ni ipo iduroṣinṣin.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Satidé, àwọn èèyàn mẹ́fà tó kù ní ilé-ìwòsàn. Béẹ̀ ni ara wọn tí n balẹ̀.

rows.source: What caused the crash and the exact sequence of events remains unclear.
rows.output: Kí ni ó fa ìjàǹbá náà àti ìtòlẹ́sẹẹsẹ àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà kò ṣe kedere.
rows.reference: Okùnfà ọkọ̀ tó jà àti àwọn iṣẹ̀lẹ̀ t’ọ́n rọ̀ mọ kọ̀ yẹ́ èèyàn.

rows.source: The airline and the U.S. Navy both said the plane landed in the lagoon short of the runway.
rows.output: Ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà àti Ọgágun Amẹ́ríkà sọ pé ọkọ̀ náà wọ inú adágún omi náà kí ó tó dé pápákọ̀ òfuurufú náà.
rows.reference: Ilé-iṣẹ́ tó ni ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà, àti àjọ tó ń ṣe àmójúto ọkọ̀-òfúrufú ní Amẹ́ríkà ní ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà balẹ̀ kó tó ojú-ọ̀nà tí wọ́n là sílẹ̀ fún àwọn ọkọ̀-òfúrufú.

rows.source: Some witnesses thought the plane overshot the runway.
rows.output: Diẹ ninu awọn ẹlẹri ro pe ọkọ ofurufu naa kọja oju-ọna naa.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ àwọn tí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà ṣojú ẹ̀ ní ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà yà bàrà kọjá ojú-ọ̀nà ẹ ni.

rows.source: American passenger Bill Jaynes said the plane came in very low.
rows.output: Ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà wọlé lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́nà tó lọ́n
rows.reference: Bill Jaynes, ọmọ Amẹ́ríkà to jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn èrò ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà, ní ọkọ̀-òfúrufú yìí rọra wálẹ̀ ni.

rows.source: "That's an extremely good thing," said Jaynes.
rows.output: "Ìyẹn jẹ́ ohun tí ó dára jùlọ," ni Jaynes sọ.
rows.reference: Jaynes ni “Ohun tó da ni o.”

rows.source: Jaynes said he and others managed to wade through waist-deep water to the emergency exits on the sinking plane.
rows.output: Jaynes sọ pé oun àti àwọn mìíràn ló ṣàṣeyọrí láti wọ inú omi tó ń bọ̀ láti dé àwọn ọ̀nà ìgbàlà ọkọ̀ òfuurufú tó ń sá lọ.
rows.reference: Jaynes ní òun àti àwọn t’ọ́n kù láti rìn nínú omi tó mù wọ́n dé ìbàdí k’áwọn tó dé ẹnu ọ̀nà àbájáde ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà.

rows.source: He said the flight attendants were panicking and yelling, and that he suffered a minor head injury.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà ń bẹ̀rù, wọ́n sì ń pariwo, ó sì sọ pé òun ní ìfarapa kékeré kan ní orí.
rows.reference: Ó ní àwọn abániṣíṣẹ́ ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà ń bẹ̀rù, bẹ́ẹ̀ni wọ́n ń jágbe. Ó ní òun ṣìṣe lórí.

rows.source: The U.S. Navy said sailors working nearby on improving a wharf also helped in the rescue by using an inflatable boat to shuttle people ashore before the plane sank in about 30 meters (100 feet) of water.
rows.output: Àwọn ọmọ ogun ọkọ̀ ojú omi ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà sọ pé àwọn ọmọ ogun tí wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ níbiti tí wọ́n ń ṣe àtúnṣe ibi ìkọ̀kọ̀ náà tún ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ nínú ìgbàlà náà nípa lílo ọkọ̀ ojú omi tí wọ́n lè fọwọ́ kan láti gbé àwọn ènìyàn lọ sí etíkun kí ọ
rows.reference: Àjọ ọmọ-ogun omi Ti ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ lóri ibùdóò àwọn ọkọ̀ ojú-omi lo ọkọ̀ ojú-omi láti gbé àwọn èèyàn láti iwọ̀n ọgbọ̀n (30) sí ibi tí ọkọ̀-òfúrufú náà rì sí lọ sí orí ilẹ̀.

rows.source: Data from the Aviation Safety Network indicates 111 people have died in crashes of PNG-registered airlines in the past two decades but none involved Air Niugini.
rows.output: Àwọn data láti ọ̀dọ̀ Nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì Ààbò Ọkọ̀ òfuurufú fihàn pé 111 ènìyàn ti kú nínú ìjàǹbá ọkọ̀ òfuurufú tí wọ́n forúkọ sílẹ̀ ní Pápúà Niu Gini ní ọdún méjì péré ṣùgbọ́n kò sí ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn ìjàǹbá tí ọkọ̀ òfuurufú Air Niugini kópa.
rows.reference: Àkọsílẹ̀ Aviation Safety Network fi hàn pé àwọn èèyàn 111 l’ọ́n ti kú láàrin ogún ọdún látàrí ìjàm̀bá ọkọ-òfúrufú tí wọ́n wà ní egbẹ́ PNG, àmọ́ Air Niugini ‘ò sí níbẹ̀.

rows.source: Analyst lays out timeline of night woman was burned alive
rows.output: Onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sọ ìtàn àkókò òru tí obìnrin náà jóná
rows.reference: Agbaniníyànjú sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àkókò tí wọ́n sun obìnrin tó ń rìnde òru lóòyẹ̀.

rows.source: The prosecution rested its case Saturday in the retrial of a man who is accused of burning a Mississippi woman alive in 2014.
rows.output: Ìgbẹ́jọ́ náà parí ọjọ́ Satidee ní ìgbẹ́jọ́ ẹ̀tọ́ ọmọnìyàn kejì ọkùnrin kan tí wọ́n fi ẹ̀sùn kan pé ó jó ọkùnrin kan nílùú Mississippi ní ọdún 2014.
rows.reference: Olùpẹ̀jọ́ parí ọ̀rọ̀ tiẹ̀ ní àkókò ẹjọ́ tó kan ọmọkùnrin tó sun ọmọbìnrin tó wá láti Mississippi lóòyẹ̀ ní ọdún 2014.

rows.source: U.S. Department of Justice Analyst Paul Rowlett testified for hours as an expert witness in the field of intelligence analysis.
rows.output: Ẹka Idajọ ti Orilẹ-ede Amẹrika Onimọran Paul Rowlett jẹri fun wakati pupọ gẹgẹbi amoye ni aaye itupalẹ ọgbọn.
rows.reference: U.S. Paul Rowlett, tó jẹ́ agbaniníyànjú ní ẹ̀ka Òfin, jẹ́ ẹlẹ́rìí òun akọṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ lórí ọ̀rọ̀ ọ̀tẹlẹ̀múyé.

rows.source: He outlined for the jury how he used cellphone records to piece together the movements of 29-year-old defendant Quinton Tellis and the 19-year-old victim, Jessica Chambers, on the night she died.
rows.output: Ó ṣàlàyé fún ẹgbẹ́ ìgbìmọ̀ náà bí ó ṣe lo àwọn ìwé ìròyìn fóònù láti fi kún àwọn ìrìn àjò ọmọ ọdún 29, Quinton Tellis, àti ọmọ ọdún 19, Jessica Chambers, ní alẹ́ tí ó kú.
rows.reference: Ó ṣàlàyé fún adájọ́ bí òun ṣe fi fóònù fíìmù ẹniàpélẹ́jọ́, Quinton Tellis, ọmọ ọdún 29, àti ẹni tí ó pa, Jessica Chambers, ọmọ ọdún 19, ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ tó kú.

rows.source: Rowlett said he received location data from several cellphones that showed Tellis was with Chambers the evening of her death, contradicting his previous claims, The Clarion Ledger reported .
rows.output: Rowlett sọ pé ó gba data ipò láti ọ̀dọ̀ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ tẹlifóònù alágbèéká tí ó fi hàn pé Tellis wà pẹ̀lú Chambers ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ ikú rẹ̀, èyí tó tako ìtàn rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, ìwé ìròyìn The Clarion Ledger sọ.
rows.reference: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí àtẹ̀jáde tó wà ní The Clarion Ledger, Rowlett ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ fóònù fi hàn pé Tellis àti Chambers jọ wà papọ̀ ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ tí ọmọbìnrin náà kú. Àmọ́ Tellis ní kò rí bẹ́ẹ̀.

rows.source: When data showed his cellphone was with Chambers' during the time he said he was with his friend Michael Sanford, police went to talk to Sanford.
rows.output: Nígbà tí data fi hàn pé fóònù rẹ̀ wà pẹ̀lú Chambers ní àkókò tí ó sọ pé ó wà pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ Michael Sanford, àwọn ọlọ́pàá lọ láti bá Sanford sọ̀rọ̀.
rows.reference: Ní àkókò tó ní òun wà pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ òun, Michael Sanford, ẹ̀rí fi hàn pé fóònù ẹ̀ wà lọ́wọ́ Chambers. Ìdí rèé tí àwọn ọlọ́pàá fi pe Sanford wá sí àágọ wọn.

rows.source: Sanford took the stand Saturday and testified that he wasn't in town that day.
rows.output: Sanford dúró ní ọjọ́ Àìkú àti pé ó sọ pé kò sí ní ìlú náà ní ọjọ́ yẹn.
rows.reference: Sanford náà wá jẹ́rìí ní ọjọ́ Sátidé. Àmọ́ ó ní òun ‘ò sí nílé ní ọjọ́ tí Telli ń sọ.

rows.source: When prosecutors asked if Tellis was telling the truth when he said he was in Sanford's truck that night, Sanford said he was "lying, because my truck was in Nashville."
rows.output: Nígbà tí àwọn olùṣèwádìí bá béèrè bóyá Tẹ́lìsì ń sọ òtítọ́ nígbà tí ó sọ pé òun wà nínú ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ Sanford ní alẹ́ yẹn, Sanford sọ pé òun “ń purọ́, nítorí pé ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ mi wà ní Nashville.”
rows.reference: Olùpẹjọ́ bíi Tellis léèerè pé ǹjẹ́ òótọ́ ni Tellis wà nínú ọkọ̀-ajàgbé ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ tí ìṣẹlẹ̀ yí ṣẹ̀? Sanford dáhùn. Ó ní “Irọ́ ló pa a torí Nashville ni ọkọ̀-ajàgbe wà ní ọjọ́ náà.

rows.source: Another inconsistency was that Tellis said he had known Chambers for about two weeks when she died.
rows.output: Ìyàtọ̀ mìíràn ni pé Tẹ́lìsì sọ pé ó ti mọ́ Ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ fún bí ọ̀sẹ̀ méjì péré nígbà tí ó kú.
rows.reference: Tellis tún pa irọ́ mìíì. Ó ní kòju ọ̀sẹ̀ méjì tí òun mọ Chambers ló kú.

rows.source: Cellphone records indicated they'd only known each other for a week.
rows.output: Àwọn ìwé ìròyìn fóònù fi hàn pé wọ́n ti mọ ara wọn fún ọ̀sẹ̀ kan.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ àkọsílẹ̀ fóònù ní wọn ‘ò mọra ju ọ̀sẹ̀ kan lọ.

rows.source: Rowlett said that sometime after Chambers' death, Tellis deleted Chambers' texts, calls and contact information from his phone.
rows.output: Rowlett sọ pé nígbà kan lẹ́yìn ikú Chambers, Tellis yọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀, ìpè, àti ìbáṣepọ̀ Chambers kúrò nínú tẹlifóònù rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Rowlett ní lẹ́yìn ikú Chambers, Tellis pa lẹ́tà àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́, ìpè, àti nọ́ḿbà Chambers kúrò lóri fóònùu ẹ̀.

rows.source: "He erased her from his life," Hale said.
rows.output: "Ó pa ẹ̀mí rẹ̀ kúrò nínú ayé rẹ̀," Hale sọ.
rows.reference: Lérò Hale, “Ó mu kúrò láyé ẹ̀.”

rows.source: The defense is scheduled to begin its closing arguments Sunday.
rows.output: Ìjọba náà ti ṣètò láti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìjìyà rẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ Àìkú.
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ́ Àìkú, ẹniapèlẹ́jọ́ máa kẹ́sẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ ẹ̀ nílẹ̀

rows.source: The judge said he expected the trial to go to the jury later that day.
rows.output: Onídajọ́ náà sọ pé òun ń retí pé ìgbẹ́jọ́ náà yóò lọ sí ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ìgbìmọ̀ ìgbẹ́jọ́ náà lẹ́yìn náà lóòní.
rows.reference: Adájọ́ ní ẹjọ́ náà máa dé ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn àpapọ̀ adájọ́ kí ilẹ̀ tó ṣú ní ọjọ́ náà.

rows.source: The High Breed: What is conscious hip hop?
rows.output: Ìgbàgbọ́ Gíga: Kí ni ìmọ̀lára hip hop?
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ High Breed Kí ni ìtumọ̀ orin hip hop tó dá lórí òṣèlú àti àwùjọ?

rows.source: A hip hop trio wants to challenge the negative view of the genre by filling their music with positive messages.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ olórin hip hop kan fẹ́ dá àwòrán àìlera ti irú orin náà dúró nípa kíkún orin wọn pẹ̀lú àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ rere.
rows.reference: Àwọn eléré hip hop mẹ́ta ní àwọn ṣe tán láti lo hip hop fún ìdàgbàsókè àti ìwúrí.

rows.source: The High Breed, from Bristol, claim hip hop moved away from its origins of political messages and tackling social issues.
rows.output: Ìgbàgbọ́ Gíga, láti Bristol, sọ pé hip hop yí padà láti oríṣiríṣi ìsọfúnni òṣèlú àti ìṣòro àwùjọ.
rows.reference: Ẹgbẹ́ High Breed láti Bristol ní hip hop ti fi orísun ẹ̀ sílẹ̀ tó dá lórí òṣèlú àti àwùjọ.

rows.source: They want to go back to its roots and make conscious hip hop popular again.
rows.output: Wọn fẹ́ padà sí ìpìlẹ̀ rẹ̀ kí wọn sì mú orin hip hop mọ́lẹ̀ padà sí olokiki.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ wọ́n tí pinnu láti padà sí orísun hip hop.

rows.source: Artists like The Fugees and Common have seen a recent resurgence in the UK through artists such as Akala and Lowkey.
rows.output: Àwọn olorin bíi The Fugees àti Common ti rí ìmúpadàbọ̀sípò ní UK nípasẹ̀ àwọn olorin bíi Akala àti Lowkey.
rows.reference: Fún ìdí èyí, àwọn òǹkọrin bíi Akala àti Lowkey ti tọ ipàsẹ̀ The Fugees àti Common ní orílẹ̀-èdè UK.

rows.source: Another black person?!
rows.output: Ẹni dudu miiran?!
rows.reference: Èèyàn dúdú kẹ̀?

rows.source: NY nanny sues couple over firing after "racist" text
rows.output: Nọọsi NY kan n bẹbẹ fun tọkọtaya lẹhin fifọwọkan “ẹlẹyamẹya”
rows.reference: Agbọmọtọ́ ní New York gbé tọkọtaya t’ọ́n da dúró, t’ọ́n tú tẹ lẹ́tà àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà si lọ sí kọ́ọ̀tù.

rows.source: A New York nanny is suing a couple for discriminatory firing after receiving a misdirected text from the mother complaining that she was "another black person."
rows.output: Obìnrin olùtọ́jú ọmọ ní New York ń bẹ̀bẹ̀ fún ẹ̀tọ́ nípa ìfòfindè lẹ́yìn tí ó ti gba ọ̀rọ̀ ìkọ̀wé tí kò tọ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìyá náà pé òun jẹ́ “ènìyàn dúdú mìíràn.”
rows.reference: Agbọmọtọ́ ní New York gbé tọkọtaya lọ sí ilé-ẹjọ́ látàrí ìdádúró lẹnu iṣẹ́ láìnídìí. K’ọ́n tó dá agbọmọtọ́ dúró, màmá ọmọ náà t pè é ní “èèyàn dúdú.”

rows.source: The couple deny they are racist, likening the suit to "extortion."
rows.output: Àwọn tọkọtaya náà kọ̀ láti jẹ́ ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà, wọ́n sì fi àpèjúwe ẹjọ́ náà wé “ìfipá mú.”
rows.reference: Àmọ́ tọkọtaya ni àwọn kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà. Wọn ní “ìlónilọ́wọ́gbà” ni ìpẹ́jọ yí.

rows.source: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, a mother of two, expressed dismay when finding out that the new child care provider, Giselle Maurice, was black upon arriving for her first day of work in 2016.
rows.output: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, ìyá méjì, fi ìbànújẹ́ hàn nígbà tí ó rí i pé olùpèsè ìtọ́jú ọmọ tuntun, Giselle Maurice, dúdú ni nígbà tí ó dé ibi iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ ní ọdún 2016.
rows.reference: Ní ọdún 2016, gbàrà ti Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, ìyá ọlọ́mọ, bá Giselle Maurice pàdé ní ọjọ́ àkọ́kọ́ tí Giselle Maurice wá sílẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí agbọmọtọ́, ẹnú yà á torí pé èèyàn dúdú ni i.

rows.source: "NOOOOOOOOOOO ANOTHER BLACK PERSON," wrote Mrs Plasco-Flaxman to her husband in a text.
rows.output: "RÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁRÁR
rows.reference: ”ÈÈYÀN DÚDÚ KẸ̀? ‘Ò TÍ OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO,” ni àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ tí Aya Plasco-Flaxman kọ sí ọkọ ẹ̀.

rows.source: However, instead of sending it to her husband, she sent it to Ms. Maurice, twice.
rows.output: Báwo ló ṣe rí lára ​​àwọn ènìyàn, kí wọ́n sì fi ránṣẹ́ sí ọkọ rẹ̀, ó fi ránṣẹ́ sí Ms. Maurice lẹ́ẹ̀mejì.
rows.reference: Dípò kó tẹ̀ ẹ́ sí nọ́ḿbà ọkọ ẹ̀, ó ṣèṣì tẹ̀ ẹ́ sí nọ́ḿbà Omidan Maurice ní èèmejì.

rows.source: After realizing her gaffe, an "uncomfortable" Plasco-Flaxman fired Ms. Maurice, stating that their outgoing nanny, who was African-American, had done a bad job and that she was instead expecting a Filipino, according to the New York Post.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn tí ó mọ̀ pé ìṣòro kan wà, Plasco-Flaxman tó “kò dùn” lé Ms. Maurice kúrò, ní sísọ pé nọ́ọ̀sì wọn tó ń bọ̀, ẹni aláwọ̀ dúdú, kò ṣe iṣẹ́ tó dára, wọ́n sì ń retí ọmọ ilẹ̀ Philippines, gẹ́gẹ́ bí New York Post ṣe sọ.
rows.reference: Látàrí àṣìṣe yìí, ara Aya Plasco-Flaxman “‘ò balẹ̀”. Kíá ló dá Omidan Maurice dúró. Ó ní ọmọ Filipino ni òun ń wá. Àtipé, ọmọ Amẹríkà-ṣe-Adúláwò tí òún gba tẹ́lẹ̀, iṣẹ́ ẹ̀ ‘ò dára tó ni ohun tí New York Post sọ.

rows.source: Ms. Maurice was paid for her one day of work and then sent home for an Uber.
rows.output: Ìyáàfin Maurice ni wọ́n san owó fún ọjọ́ kan tí wọ́n sì rán lọ sílé fún Uber.
rows.reference: Owó ọjọ́ kan ló san an fún omidan náà, Bẹ́ẹ̀ ‘ó ní kí ọkọ̀ Uber da pádà sílé ẹ̀.

rows.source: Now, Maurice is suing the couple for compensation over the firing, and is seeking compensation to the tune of $350 a day for the six-month, live-in gig she had initially been hired to do, albeit without a contract.
rows.output: Báyìí, Maurice ń bá tọkọtaya náà jà fún ìsanwó lórí ìtúsílẹ̀, ó sì ń wá ìsanwó tó tó $350 lójúmọ́ lọ́nà oṣù mẹ́fà, ìgbéyàwó tí wọ́n ti yàn án láti ṣe ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò sí ìwé ìpè.
rows.reference: Omidan Maurice ní kí tọkọtaya yìí san owó-gbaà-má-binú fún òun látàrí ìdáduụró lẹ́nu iṣẹ́. Ó ní kí wọ́n san 350 dọlà ní ojúmọ́ fun oṣù mẹ́fà, gbé àdúgbò olówó ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú àdéhùn tó wà láàrin wọn tẹ́lẹ̀ bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò sí àkọsílẹ̀ láàárin wọn.

rows.source: "I want to show them, look, you don't do stuff like that," she told the Post on Friday, adding "I know it's discrimination."
rows.output: "Mo fẹ́ fi hàn wọn, wo, o kò ṣe irú nǹkan bẹ́ẹ̀," ó sọ fún Post ní ọjọ́ Jimọ, ní fífi kun "Mo mọ̀ pé ó jẹ́ ìyàsọ́tọ̀."
rows.reference: ”Wọ́n á gbà. Wọn kì í ṣe nǹkan bẹ́ẹ̀ yẹn,” ni ohun tí ó sọ fún Post ti ọjọ́ Jímọ̀. Ní àfikún, “Ó ní ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà ni.”

rows.source: The couple have hit back at the claims that they are racist, saying that terminating Maurice's employment was the reasonable thing to do, fearing they could not trust her after offending her.
rows.output: Tọkọtaya náà ti dáhùn sí ẹ̀sùn pé wọ́n jẹ́ ẹlẹ́yàmẹ̀yà, ní sísọ pé ìdádúró ìgbéyàwó Maurice jẹ́ ohun tó yẹ, nítorí pé wọ́n bẹ̀rù pé wọn kò lè gbẹ́kẹ̀ lé òun lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n bá ń ṣe ẹ̀sùn.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ àwọn tọkọtaya yìí ní àwọn kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà. Wọ́n ní bí àwọn ṣe dá Maurice dúró ló da torí kò ṣé e fi inú tán án mọ́ látàrí ẹ̀sẹ̀ tí á̀wọn ṣẹ̀ ẹ́.

rows.source: "My wife had sent her something that she didn't mean to say.
rows.output: Ìyàwó mi rán mi létí pé kí n fi nǹkan kan ránṣẹ́ sí i tí kò ní sọ.
rows.reference: ”Ohun tí ìyàwó mi sọ ṣè ṣì ni.

rows.source: She's not a racist.
rows.output: Kò jẹ́ ẹlẹ́yà.
rows.reference: Kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́yàmẹyá̀.

rows.source: We're not racist people," husband Joel Plasco told the Post.
rows.output: A kò jẹ́ àwọn ènìyàn ẹlẹ́yà, ọkọ Joel Plasco sọ fún Post.
rows.reference: A kì í ṣe ẹlẹ́yàmẹyà,” ni ohun ti ọkọ ẹ̀, Joel Plasco sọ fún Post.

rows.source: "But would you put your children in the hands of someone you've been rude to, even if it was by mistake?
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ṣé ẹ̀yin yóò fi àwọn ọmọ rẹ sí ọwọ́ ẹnìkan tí ẹ̀yin ti bá ń bínú sí, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú?
rows.reference: ”Kò ṣéeṣe fún wa lái kó àwọn ọmọ wa tìí látàrí aáwọ̀ tó wà láàárin wa bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àṣìṣe ló fà á.

rows.source: Your newborn baby?
rows.output: Ìbéèrè ọmọ rẹ tuntun?
rows.reference: Àbí èèyàn lè kó àwọn ọmọbíbí èèyàn tìí?

rows.source: Come on."
rows.output: "Ẹ jẹ́ kí a lọ."
rows.reference: Ka má ri.”

rows.source: Likening the suit to "extortion," Plasco said his wife was just two months off having a baby and was in a "very difficult situation."
rows.output: Nípa àfihàn ẹjọ́ náà sí “ìfipá mú,” Plasco sọ pé ìyàwó rẹ̀ kò ju oṣù méjì lọ láti bí ọmọ kan, ó sì wà nínú ipò “tí ó nira gan.”
rows.reference: Ọkọ ẹ̀ ni “ìlọ́nilọ́wọ́gbà” ni ẹjọ́ náà torí kò ju oṣù méjì tí ìyàwó òun ṣẹ̀ bímọ. Àtipé “kò gbádùn ara ẹ̀.”

rows.source: "You're going to go after someone like that?
rows.output: "Ìwọ yóò lọ lẹ́yìn ẹni bẹ́ẹ̀?"
rows.reference: Ṣé irú èèyàb bẹ́ẹ̀ yẹn ni èèyàn máa bá fa wàhálà?”

rows.source: That's not a very nice thing to do," the investment banker added.
rows.output: Ìyẹn kì í ṣe ohun tí ó dára láti ṣe,” ọ̀gá ìdoko-owo náà fi kún un.
rows.reference: Kò tọ̀nà rárá,” ni ohun tí òṣìṣẹ́ báǹkì lórí ìdókòwò wí,

rows.source: While the legal case is still ongoing, the court of public opinion has been quick to denounce the couple on social media, slamming them for their behavior and logic.
rows.output: Lakoko ti ẹjọ naa ṣi n lọ lọwọ, ile-ẹjọ ti gbogbo eniyan ti yara lati bu ẹnu ati bu ẹnu fun tọkọtaya naa lori media awujọ, ti wọn n bu wọn fun iwa wọn ati ọgbọn wọn.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ejọ́ wà ní ilé-ẹjọ́, àmọ́ àwọn èèyàn káàkiri orí íntánẹ́ẹ́tì ti bu ẹnu àtẹ́ lu tọkọtaya náà fún ìwà t’ọ́n wù.

rows.source: Paddington publishers feared readers wouldn't relate to a talking bear, new letter reveals
rows.output: Àwọn olùtẹ̀jáde Paddington bẹ̀rù pé àwọn olùkàwé kò ní ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú bẹ́ẹ̀rẹ̀, lẹ́tà tuntun kan fi hàn
rows.reference: Lẹ́tà tí èẹ̀yàn kan kọ fi hàn pé ẹ̀rù ń ba ilé-ìtẹ̀wé Paddington torí pé wọ́n ní ó ṣẹéṣe kí àwọn èèyàn máa rí ọgbọ́n nínú àtẹ̀jáde tó ní ajá igbó ń sọ̀rọ̀.

rows.source: Bond's daughter Karen Jankel, who was born shortly after the book was accepted, said of the letter: "It's hard to put oneself in the shoes of somebody reading it for the first time before it was published.
rows.output: Ìyàwó Bond, Karen Jankel, tí a bí ní kíákíá lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n gba ìwé náà, sọ nípa lẹ́tà náà: “Ó nira láti fi ara rẹ̀ sínú àwọn bàtà ẹni tí ń ka a fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ kí a tó tẹ̀ jáde.
rows.reference: Karen Jankel, ọmọ tí Bond bíi lẹ́yìn tí àwọn èèyàn tẹ́wọ́gba ìwé yìí ló sọ̀rọ̀ nípa lẹ́tà náà. Ó ní: “Ǹjẹ́ ó ṣẹéṣe láti fi ara èèyàn sí ipò ẹni tó kọ́ kàwé yìí k’ọ́n tó tẹ̀ ẹ́?

rows.source: It's very amusing knowing now what we know about Paddington's huge success."
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ohun tó dùn mọ́ni láti mọ̀ báyìí nípa ìṣẹ́gun Paddington tó tóbi."
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé gbogbo wa lè sọ nípa àseyọrí ǹlà ti Paddington látàrí ìwé yìí.”

rows.source: Saying her father, who had worked as a BBC cameraman before being inspired to write the children's book by a small toy bear, would have been sanguine about his work being rejected, she added the 60th anniversary of the books publication was "bittersweet" after his death last year.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé bàbá rẹ̀, ẹni tí ó ti ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ BBC tẹlifíṣọ̀nù kí ó tó di ìmísí láti kọ ìwé ọmọdé nípa ẹ̀dá ẹlẹ́gàn tí ó kéré jù, yóò ti ní ìrètí nípa iṣẹ́ rẹ̀ tí a kọ̀. Ó tún sọ pé ọdún 60 tí a ṣe ìwé náà jẹ́ “bittersweet” lẹ́y
rows.reference: Ó ní bàbá òun tó kọ ìwé ná́à ṣiṣẹ́ onífídíò pẹ̀lú BBC rìí. Ó ní bàbá òun ní ìmísí láti kọ ìwé náà látàrí ajá igbó ọlọ́mọlangidi. Ó ní ọkàn kan ni bàbá òun fi kọ ìwé náà bí ó tiẹ̀ ń bẹ̀rù pé àwọn èèyàn lè máa tẹ́wọ́gbà á. “Ìbànújẹ́oọunayọ̀” ni pé ó ti tó ọgọ́ta ọdún tí ìwé náà ti jáde bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé bàbá òun kú ní ọdún tó kọjá.

rows.source: Of Paddington, whom she describes as a "very important member of our family," she added her father was quietly proud of his eventual success.
rows.output: Láti Paddington, ẹni tí ó ṣàpèjúwe gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ọmọ ẹbí pàtàkì nínú ìdílé wa,” ó fi kún pé bàbá rẹ̀ ní ìgbàgbọ́ nínú aṣeyọrí rẹ̀ ní ìkẹyìn.
rows.reference: Ó ní Paddington “ti di ara ẹbí wa,” àtipé inú bàbá mi dùn sí àṣeyọrí ẹ̀.

rows.source: "He was quite a quiet man, and he wasn't a boastful person," she said.
rows.output: "Ó jẹ́ ọkùnrin tó máa ń dákẹ́, kò sì sí ọkùnrin tó máa ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ara rẹ̀," ó wí.
rows.reference: ”Èèyàn jẹ́jẹ́ tí kì í ṣe onígbèrágaa ni.”

rows.source: "But because Paddington was so real to him, it was almost like if you have a child who achieves something: you're proud of them even though it's not your doing really.
rows.output: "Ṣugbọn nitori Paddington jẹ́ gidi gan-an fún un, ó dà bíi pé bí o bá ní ọmọ tí ó ṣe ohun kan: o ní ìyàlẹ́nu fún wọn paapaa bí kò ṣe ìṣe rẹ gan-an.
rows.reference: Torí àjọṣe Paddington àti bàbá mi wọnú ara wọn, àṣeyọrí Paddington jẹ́ ìwúrí fún bàbá mi torí bàbá àti ọmọ ni àwọn méjèèjì.

rows.source: I think he viewed Paddington's success sort of in that way.
rows.output: Mo rò pé ó wo ìṣẹ́gun Paddington bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bí àjọṣẹ wọn ṣe rí nìyẹn.

rows.source: Although it was his creation and his imagination, he always used to give the credit to Paddington himself."
rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ó jẹ́ ẹ̀dá rẹ̀ àti ìmọ̀lára rẹ̀, ó máa ń sọ pé kí Pádingtọ́nú ló gbà gbọ́.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé bàbá mi ló kọ ìwé náà, ó máa n gbóríyìn fún Paddington fún àṣeyọrí ẹ̀.”

rows.source: My daughter was dying and I had to say goodbye over the phone
rows.output: Ọmọbìnrin mi ń kú, mo sì ní láti sọ ìkíyèsára mi fún un lórí tẹlifóònù
rows.reference: Orí fóònù ni mo ti dágbére fún ọmọ mi obìnrin tó ń kú lo pé ó digbére.

rows.source: On landing her daughter had been rushed to Nice's Hospital Louis Pasteur 2, where doctors worked in vain to save her life.
rows.output: Nígbà tí ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà dé, wọ́n gbé ọmọbìnrin náà lọ sí Ilé Ìwòsàn Louis Pasteur 2 ní Nice, níbi tí àwọn dókítà ti ṣiṣẹ́ láìsí àṣeyọrí láti gba ẹ̀mí rẹ̀ là.
rows.reference: Ilé-ìwòsàn Nice ní Louis Pasteur 2 ni wọ́n gbé ọmọbìnrin yìí lọ àmọ́ àwọn dókítà gbìyànjú, síbẹ̀, ó kú ni.

rows.source: "Nad was calling regularly to say it was really bad, that she wasn't expected to make it," said Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.
rows.output: "Nadì ń pè mí lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀ láti sọ pé ó burú jù, pé kò ṣeé ṣe kó wà láàyè," ni ìyáàfin Ednan-Laperouse sọ.
rows.reference: Aya Ednan-Laperouse ní “gbogbo ìgbà ni Nad ń pè láti mọ bóyá ó máa yèé.”

rows.source: "Then I got the call from Nad to say she was going to die within the next two minutes and I had to say goodbye to her.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn náà, mo gba ìpè kan láti ọ̀dọ̀ Nad láti sọ fún mi pé òun yóò kú ní ìṣẹ́jú méjì tó ń bọ̀, mo sì ní láti sọ ìdáwọ́lé fún un.
rows.reference: Nad náà ló tún pè mí láti sọ fún mi pé láàrin ìṣẹ́jú méjì, ọmọ náà máa kú. Bẹ́è ni mo ní ó digbére.

rows.source: And I did.
rows.output: Mo ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.
rows.reference: Mo ní ó digbére.

rows.source: I said, "Tashi, I love you so much, darling.
rows.output: Mo wí pé, “Tashi, mo nífẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ púpọ̀, olólùfẹ́.
rows.reference: Mo ní, “Tashi, ọmọ dáadáa, mo ní ìfẹ ẹ.

rows.source: I'll be with you soon.
rows.output: Mo máa wà pẹ̀lú rẹ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
rows.reference: Mò ń bò láìpẹ́.

rows.source: I'll be with you.
rows.output: Mo máa wà pẹ̀lú rẹ.
rows.reference: Mò ń bò wá bá ẹ.

rows.source: The drugs doctors had given her to keep her heart pumping were slowly petering out and leaving her system.
rows.output: Àwọn òògùn tí àwọn dókítà ti fún un láti pa ọkàn rẹ̀ mọ́ ti ń dín kù, tí wọ́n sì ń jáde lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn oògùn tí dókítà fún láti lè mí kò ṣiṣẹ́ lára mọ.

rows.source: She had died some time before hand and this was it all shutting down.
rows.output: Ó ti kú nígbà kan ṣáájú, èyí ni gbogbo rẹ̀ ń parun.
rows.reference: Ó ti kú sára kó tó dágbére pátápátá.

rows.source: I had to just sit there and wait, knowing this was all unfolding.
rows.output: Mo ní láti jókòó síbẹ̀ kí n dúró de, mo mọ̀ pé gbogbo èyí ń ṣẹlẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni mò ń wòó bó se ń ṣẹlẹ̀.

rows.source: I couldn't howl or scream or cry because I was in a situation surrounded by families and people.
rows.output: Mi ò lè kígbe tàbí kígbe tàbí kígbe nítorí pé mo wà nínú ipò kan tí ó yí mi ká pẹ̀lú àwọn ìdílé àti àwọn ènìyàn.
rows.reference: N kò lè kígbe tàbí ké torí àwọn mọ̀lẹbí t’ọ́n wà pẹ̀lú mi.

rows.source: I had to really hold it together."
rows.output: Mo ní láti máa fi ara mọ́ra.
rows.reference: Mo gbe sára ni.”

rows.source: Eventually Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, by now grieving for the loss of her daughter, boarded the plane alongside the other passengers - oblivious to the ordeal she was going through.
rows.output: Nígbẹ̀yìn-gbẹ́yín, Ìyáàfin Ednan-Laperouse, tó ti ń bẹ̀rù ìpadàbọ̀ ọmọbìnrin rẹ̀, wọ inú ọkọ̀ òfuurufú náà pẹ̀lú àwọn arìnrìn-àjò mìíràn - láì mọ̀ pé ìrìn àjò rẹ̀ ń lọ.
rows.reference: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé Aya Ednan-Laperouse ń ṣàárò ọmọ e tó kú, àmọ́ ó wọ ọkọ̀-òfúrufú pẹ̀lú àwọn èrò tó kù láìmọ ohun tó ṣee ẹ́.

rows.source: "No-one knew," she said.
rows.output: "Kò sí ẹni tí ó mọ̀," ó sọ.
rows.reference: Kò sí ẹni tó mọ̀.

rows.source: "I had my head down, and tears were falling the whole time.
rows.output: Mo fi ori mi silẹ, omije n rọ ni gbogbo igba.
rows.reference: Màmá ẹ̀ sorí kodò, bẹ́è ni omi ń dà lójú ẹ̀.

rows.source: It's hard to explain, but it was on the flight I felt this overwhelming sense of sympathy for Nad.
rows.output: Ó ṣòro láti ṣàlàyé, ṣùgbọ́n ó wà nínú ọkọ̀ òfuurufú tí mo ní ìmọ̀lára ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀ fún Nad.
rows.reference: Nǹkan to fà á mo ‘ò le sọ àmọ́ àánú Nad ṣe mí.

rows.source: That he needed my love and understanding.
rows.output: Pẹ̀lú ìfẹ́ àti ìmọ̀lára mi.
rows.reference: Mo gbọ́dọ̀ fi ìfẹ́ àti àánú ba lo ní àkókò yí.

rows.source: I knew how much he loved her."
rows.output: Mo mọ̀ bí ó ti fẹ́ràn rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ó nífẹ̀ẹ́ ọmọ mi mi obìnrin gan-an.

rows.source: Grieving women post cards to prevent suicides on bridge
rows.output: Obinrin ti n sunkun n fi kaadi ranse lati dena igbẹmi ara ẹni lori afara
rows.reference: Àwọn obìnrin tí wọn pàdánù àwọn èèyàn wọn le káàdì mọ́ afárá-ẹlẹ́sẹ̀.

rows.source: Two women who lost loved ones to suicide are working to prevent others from taking their own lives.
rows.output: Àwọn obìnrin méjì tí wọ́n pàdánù àwọn olólùfẹ́ wọn sí ikú ara ẹni ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti dènà àwọn ẹlòmíràn láti gbé ìgbésẹ̀ ikú ara ẹni.
rows.reference: Àwọn obìnrin méjì tí wọ́n pàddánù àyànfẹ́ wọn nípaṣẹ́ ìgbẹ́mí ara ẹni ni wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti dènà àwọn míràn lọ́wọ́ ìgbẹ̀mí ara ẹni.

rows.source: Sharon Davis and Kelly Humphreys have been posting cards on a Welsh bridge with inspirational messages and phone numbers that people can call for support.
rows.output: Sharon Davis àti Kelly Humphreys ti ń fi àwọn káàdì ránṣẹ́ sí àtẹ̀gùn Welsh pẹ̀lú àwọn ìwé ìròyìn ìmísí àti àwọn nọ́ńbà tẹlifóònù tí àwọn ènìyàn lè pè fún ìrànlọ́wọ́.
rows.reference: Sharon Davis àti Kelly Humphreys ní wọ́n ti ń lẹ Káàdì káàkiri lórí afárá Welsh pẹ̀lú àwọn ìfiránṣẹ́ awúnilórí àti àwọn nọ́ńbà fóònù tí àwọn ènìyàn le pè fún àtìlẹyìn.

rows.source: Ms Davis' son Tyler was 13 when he began suffering with depression and killed himself aged 18.
rows.output: Ìyá Ms Davis' ọmọkùnrin Tyler jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún mẹ́tàlá nígbà tí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní jìyà ìbànújẹ́, ó sì pa ara rẹ̀ nígbà tó pé ọmọ ọdún méjìdínlógún.
rows.reference: Ọmọ ọkùnrin Ìyàáfin Davis, Tyler, jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún 13 nígbàtí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì ọkàn tí ó sì pa ara rẹ.

rows.source: "I don't want any parent to feel the way I have to feel everyday," she said.
rows.output: "Kò sí òbí tí mo fẹ́ kí wọ́n nímọ̀lára ohun tí mo ní láti nímọ̀lára lójoojúmọ́," ó sọ.
rows.reference: "Èmi kó fẹ́ kí òbí kankan fójú sunkún ọmọ bí tèmi lójoojúmọ́ ayé,” ó sọ bẹ́ẹ̀,”

rows.source: Ms Davis, aged 45, who lives in Lydney, said her son was a promising chef with an infectious grin.
rows.output: Arabinrin Davis, ọmọ ọdun 45, ti o ngbe ni Lydney, sọ pe ọmọ rẹ jẹ olounjẹ ti o ni ileri pẹlu ẹrin ti o ni itara.
rows.reference: Ìyàáfin Davis, ọmọ ọdún 45, tíó ń gbé ní Lydney, sọ pé ọmọ òun jẹ́ olúwáńjẹ tí ‘’o ní ọjọ́ iwáajú pẹ̀lú ẹ̀rín tó fanimọ́ra

rows.source: "Everyone knew him for his smile.
rows.output: Gbogbo ènìyàn mọ̀ ọ́n fún ẹ̀rín rẹ̀.
rows.reference: "Gbogbo èníyàn ló mọ́ fún rínrín ẹ̀rín múṣẹ́.

rows.source: They always said his smile lit up any room."
rows.output: Wọ́n máa ń sọ pé ẹ̀rín rẹ̀ ń tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí yàrá kankan.
rows.reference: Wọ́n máa ń sábà sọ wípé ẹ̀rín rẹ̀ máa ń hey always said his smile lit up any room."

rows.source: However, he gave up work before he died, as he was "in a really dark place."
rows.output: Báwo ló ṣe rí lára ​​rẹ̀, ó sì fi iṣẹ́ sílẹ̀ kí ó tó kú, nítorí pé ó wà “ní ibi òkùnkùn gan-an.”
rows.reference: O fi iṣẹ́ sílẹ̀ kó tó kù torí “inú òkùkùn ló wà”.

rows.source: In 2014, Tyler's brother, who was 11 at the time, was the one to find his sibling after he had taken his own life.
rows.output: Ni ọdun 2014, arakunrin Tyler, ẹniti o jẹ ọmọ ọdun 11 ni akoko yẹn, ni ẹni to ri i lẹhin ti o ti gba ẹmi rẹ.
rows.reference: Ní ọdún 2014, àbúrò Tyler, ọmo-ọdún 11, ló rí òkú ẹ̀gbọ́n ẹ̀ tó pa ara ẹ̀.

rows.source: Ms Davis said: "I continually worry that there's going to be a knock on effect."
rows.output: Àríyànjiyàn Ms Davis ni: "Mo máa ń bẹ̀rù pé kí wọ́n máa ṣe ìyípadà."
rows.reference: Ìyáàfin Davis sọ pé: “Èrò mi ni pé ó ma tó kan ilẹ̀kùn.”

rows.source: Ms Davis created the cards, "to let people know there are people out there that you can go to and you can talk to, even if it's a friend.
rows.output: Ìyáàfin Davis dá àwọn káàdì náà sílẹ̀, “kí àwọn èèyàn lè mọ̀ pé àwọn èèyàn wà níbẹ̀ tí ẹ lè lọ sí wọn kí ẹ sì sọ̀rọ̀, kódà bí ọ̀rẹ́ bá ṣe.”
rows.reference: Aya Davis te káàdì yìí láti ta àwọn èèyàn jí láti bá èèyàn kan tàbí ọ̀rẹ́ kan sọ̀rọ̀.”

rows.source: Don't sit in silence - you need to talk."
rows.output: Kí o máa jókòó ní ìdákẹ́jẹ́ẹ́ - o nílò láti sọ̀rọ̀."
rows.reference: Má dakẹ́ – sọ̀rọ̀.

rows.source: Ms Humphreys, who has been friends with Ms Davies for years, lost Mark, her partner of 15 years, not long after the death of his mother.
rows.output: Àwọn ìyàwó Humphreys, ẹni tó ti jẹ́ ọ̀rẹ́ pẹ̀lú Ms Davies fún ọdún mẹ́ta, padà sẹ́yìn nígbà tí Mark, alábàágbé rẹ̀ fún ọdún mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún, kú kí ó tó pé ọmọbìnrin rẹ̀ kú.
rows.reference: Aya Humphreys, ọ̀rẹ́ ọjọ́ pípẹ́ lòun àti Aya Davies. Mark, ọkọ Humphreys fún ọdún 15, kú lẹ́yìn ikú màmá ẹ̀.

rows.source: "He didn't say that he was feeling down or depressed or anything," she said.
rows.output: "Kò sọ pé òun ńní ìmọ̀lára ìbànújẹ́ tàbí ìbànújẹ́ tàbí ohunkóhun," ó sọ.
rows.reference: Humphreys ní ”Kò ní nǹkan mú òun,”

rows.source: "A couple of days before Christmas we noticed his change in attitude.
rows.output: "Ọjọ́ díẹ̀ ṣáájú Kérésìmesì, a rí ìyípadà nínú ìhùwàsí rẹ̀.
rows.reference: ”Kérésìmesì ku ọjọ́ bíi mélòó kan la kófìrí ìyàtọ̀ nínú ìṣesí ẹ̀.

rows.source: He was at rock bottom on Christmas Day - when the kids opened their presents he didn't make eye contact with them or anything."
rows.output: Ó wà ní ìsàlẹ̀ òkè ní ọjọ́ Kérésìmesì - nígbà tí àwọn ọmọ náà ṣí àwọn ẹ̀bùn wọn, kò bá wọn sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú ojú tàbí ohunkóhun.
rows.reference: Kò sọ ‘ó’ ní ọjọ́ Kérésìmesì rárá. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kò sọ nǹkan bí àwọn ọmọ ṣe ṣí ẹ̀bùn ọdún wọn.”

rows.source: She said his death was a huge trauma to them, but they have to work through it: "It rips a hole through the family.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé ikú rẹ̀ jẹ́ ìrora ńlá fún wọn, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ní láti ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́nà rẹ̀: “Ó máa ń gé ìdílé náà mọ́ra.
rows.reference: Ikú ẹ̀ wọ gbogbo wa lára sùgbọ́n a lá ti túraká ni. “Bíi ọ̀gbun ni ikú ẹ̀ nínú ẹbí.

rows.source: It tears us apart.
rows.output: Ó ń fọ́ wa sí méjì.
rows.reference: Ó tú ẹbí tán.

rows.source: But we've all got to carry on and fight."
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n a gbọ́dọ̀ gbé lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ àti jà."
rows.reference: Àmọ́ a láti kórajọ torí ọjọ́-iwájú.”

rows.source: If you are struggling to cope, you can call Samaritans free on 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, or visit the Samaritans website here.
rows.output: Ti o ba n tiraka lati koju, o le pe awon oluranlọwọ Samaritan ni 116 123 (UK ati Ireland), fi imeeli ranṣẹ si jo@samaritans.org, tabi ṣabẹwo si oju opo wẹẹbu Samaritan nibi.
rows.reference: To bá ní irú ìṣoro yìí pe Samaritans sí nọ́ḿbà to lè pè lọ́fẹ̀ẹẹ 116 123 (ní UK àti Ireland), tàbí méèlì jo@samaritans.org tàbí àdírẹ̀sì wa lóri íntánẹ́ẹ́tì.

rows.source: Brett Kavanaugh's future hangs in the balance as FBI begins investigation
rows.output: Ìfẹ́ ọkàn Brett Kavanaugh wà nínú ewu bí FBI ṣe bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìwádìí
rows.reference: Ọjọ́-iwájú Brett Kavanaugh's dálórí ìwádií tí FBI ń se

rows.source: "I thought, if we could actually get something like what he was asking for - an investigation limited in time, limited in scope - we could maybe bring a little unity," said Mr Flake on Saturday, adding that he feared the committee was "falling apart" amid entrenched partisan gridlock.
rows.output: Mo rò pé, bí a bá lè gba nǹkan bíi ohun tí ó ń béèrè - ìwádìí tí a ti dín kù ní àkókò, tí a ti dín kù ní ìwọn - a lè lè mú ìṣọ̀kan díẹ̀ wá,” ni Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Flake sọ ní ọjọ́ Àìkú, ní fífi kún un pé ìgbìmọ̀ náà “ń yà kúrò” nítorí ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìṣèlú tí ó ti di pípé.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Flake ní, “Kí ni ọkùnri yìí fẹ́ gan-an – ìwádìí tí kò ní pẹ́, tàbí iwádìí tó mọ níwọ̀n? Ìbá dára ka mọ ibi tí à ń lọ gan-an. Ó tún ní “ìyapa” ti wà láárin ìgbìmọ̀ olùwádìí látàrí ìbájọṣepọ̀ pẹ̀ú àwọn olóṣèlú.

rows.source: Why didn't Mr Kavanaugh and his Republican supporters want the FBI to investigate?
rows.output: Kí nìdí tí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Kavanaugh àti àwọn alátìlẹ́yìn rẹ̀ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Republican kò fẹ́ kí àwọn ọlọ́pàá FBI ṣe ìwádìí?
rows.reference: Kí ló dé tí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Kavanaugh àti àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Republican tako ìwádìí FBI?

rows.source: Their reluctance is all due to timing.
rows.output: Ìdààmú wọn jẹ́ gbogbo nitori ìgbà.
rows.reference: Àkókò ló fà á

rows.source: The midterm elections are only five weeks away, on November 6 - if, as expected, the Republicans do badly, then they will be severely weakened in their attempts to get the man they want elected to the highest court in the land.
rows.output: Àwọn ìdìbò àárín-àkókò yóò wáyé ní ọ̀sẹ̀ márùn-ún péré lọ́wọ́, ní ọjọ́ kẹfà oṣù kọkànlá - tí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí a ti ń retí, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìjọba ológun bá ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀, wọn yóò sì di aláìlera gidigidi nínú ìsapá wọn láti mú ọkùnrin tí wọ́n fẹ́ dìbò
rows.reference: Ní ọjọ kẹfà, oṣù kọkànlá, nìbò ọlọ́dún mẹ́jì máa wáye, Bí egbẹ́ Republican ‘ò bá se dáadáa, ó ṣeéṣe kí ẹni t’ọ́n fẹ́ yàn sí ipo ní ilé-ẹjọ́ to ga jùlọ má débẹ̀.

rows.source: George W. Bush has been picking up the phone to call Senators, lobbying them to support Mr Kavanaugh, who worked in the White House for Mr Bush and through him met his wife Ashley, who was Mr Bush's personal secretary.
rows.output: George W. Bush ti n gba foonu lati pe awọn Sẹnetọ, n ṣe agbateru fun wọn lati ṣe atilẹyin Ọgbẹni Kavanaugh, ẹniti o ṣiṣẹ ni Ile White fun Ọgbẹni Bush ati pe o pade iyawo rẹ Ashley, ẹniti o jẹ akọwe ti ara ẹni fun Ọgbẹni Bush.
rows.reference: George W. Bush pe ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ Sìnàtọ̀ láti rọ̀ wọn kí wọ́n gbárùkùtì Ọ̀gbẹni Kavanaugh, òṣìṣẹ́ Ọ̀gbẹni Bush ní White House. Làti ipasẹ̀ ẹ̀ ni Ọ̀gbẹni Bush pàdé Ashley, ìyàwó ilé ẹ̀ tó ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú nígbà kan rí gẹ́gẹ́ bí akọ̀wé,

rows.source: What happens after the FBI produces its report?
rows.output: Kí ni yóò ṣẹlẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí FBI bá ti ṣe ìròyìn rẹ̀?
rows.reference: Kí ló máa ṣẹ̀lẹ lẹ́yìn ìwádìí FBI?

rows.source: There will be a vote in the Senate, where 51 Republicans and 49 Democrats currently sit.
rows.output: Àwọn ìdìbò yóò wáyé nínú Sẹ́nétọ̀, níbi tí 51 Òṣèlú Òṣèlú àti 49 Démọ́kíràtì ti wà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́.
rows.reference: Ibò máa wáyé ní Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà láàrin Sínátò 51 fún Republicans, 49 fún Democrats.

rows.source: It's still not clear whether Mr Kavanaugh can get to at least 50 votes on the Senate floor, which would allow Mike Pence, the vice president, to break a tie and confirm him to the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Ó ṣì jẹ́ àìmọ̀ pé Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Kavanaugh lè dé o kere tán 50 ìbò lórí ilẹ̀ Sẹ́nétọ̀, èyí yóò jẹ́ kí Mike Pence, igbákejì ààrẹ, fọ́ ìdààmú náà kí ó sì fọwọ́ sí i lórí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jùlọ.
rows.reference: Kò sí ẹni tó lè sọ bóyá Kavanaugh máa ní tó ibò 50 tó ní lò kí Mike Pence, igbákejì ààrẹ, lè búra fun un gẹ́gẹ́ bí adájọ́ ní Ilé-ẹjọ́ Àgbà.

rows.source: North Korea defector numbers 'drop' under Kim
rows.output: Àwọn ọmọ ogun Kòríà Àríwá tó ń sá lọ “dín kù” lábẹ́ Kim
rows.reference: Àwọn tí wọ́n kúrò ní North Korea ti dínkù láti ìgbà tí Kim ti gorí oyè

rows.source: The number of North Korean defectors to South Korea has fallen since Kim Jong-un came to power seven years ago, a South Korean lawmaker has said.
rows.output: Àwọn ọmọ ogun Kòríà Àríwá tó ń sá lọ sí Gúúsù Kòríà ti dín kù láti ìgbà tí Kim Jong-un tó di olórí orílẹ̀-èdè náà ní ọdún mélòó kan sẹ́yìn, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin Gúúsù Kòríà kan ti sọ.
rows.reference: Iye àwọn ọmọ North korea t’ọ́n lọ si South Korea ti dínkù láàrin ọdún méje tí Kim Jong-un ti di ààrẹ. Ọmọ ile-aṣòfin South Korea ló sọ bẹ́ẹ̀.

rows.source: Park Byeong-seug, citing data from the South's unification ministry, said there had been 1,127 defections last year - compared with 2,706 in 2011.
rows.output: Park Byeong-seug, ti o tọka si data lati ọdọ ijọba isọdọkan ti Guusu, sọ pe awọn 1,127 ti sa lọ ni ọdun to kọja - ni afiwe si 2,706 ni 2011.
rows.reference: Park Byeong-seug ní àkọsílẹ̀ àjọ Unification ti South Korea ní èèyàn 1,127 ọmọ North Korea ló darapọ̀ mọ́ South Korea ní ọdún tó kọjá. Ó ní 2,706 ni wọ́n ní 2011.

rows.source: Mr Park said tighter border controls between North Korea and China and higher rates charged by people smugglers were key factors.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Park sọ pé àwọn ìdènà ààlà tó múná láàárín Kòríà àti Ṣáínà, pẹ̀lú àwọn owó tí àwọn ọ̀daràn ń kó lọ síta, jẹ́ àwọn ohun pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Park ni ohun tó fa ẹ̀dínkù yí ni iṣẹ́ aṣọ́bodè tó lágbára láàrin North Korea àti China. Àti iye owó tabua tí wọ́n ń gbà lọ́wọ́ àwọn olo.

rows.source: Pyongyang has made no public comments.
rows.output: Pyongyang kò ti sọ ohunkóhun ní gbangba.
rows.reference: Pyongyang ‘ò sọ̀rọ̀ ràrà nípa ẹ̀.

rows.source: The vast majority of defectors from the North are eventually offered South Korean citizenship.
rows.output: Àwọn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ẹlẹ́wọ̀n tó ń sá lọ sí Gúúsù Kòríà ni a máa ń fún ní ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè Gúúsù Kòríà nígbà gbogbo.
rows.reference: Púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ọmọ North Korea tó darapọ̀ mọ́ South Korea ló ti di ọmọ South Korea báyìí.

rows.source: Seoul says more than 30,000 North Koreans have illegally crossed the border since the end of the Korean War in 1953.
rows.output: Seoul sọ pé ju 30,000 àwọn ará Kòríà Aṣọ̀kan ti kọjá ààlà náà ní ìgbà tí ogun Kòríà parí ní 1953.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn Ogun Korea t’ọdún 1953, Seoul ní ó tó 30,000 ọmọ North Korea ló ti gba ẹnu ọ̀nà North Korea kọjá láìgbaṣẹ.

rows.source: Most flee via China, which has the longest border with North Korea and is easier to cross than the heavily protected Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) between the two Koreas.
rows.output: Pupọ̀ ń sá lọ nípasẹ̀ Ṣáínà, èyí tí ó ní ààlà tó gùn jù lọ pẹ̀lú Kòríà Àríwá, ó sì rọrùn láti kọjá ju ààlà tó dáàbò bo (DMZ) tó wà láàárín Kòríà méjèèjì.
rows.reference: Enubodè North Korea sí China ni ọ̀pọ̀ nínụ́ wọn ń gbà sálọ. Ó rọrùn láti gba ẹnubodè yí ju ẹnubodè North Korea sí ti South Korea torí àwọn ológun pọ̀ níbẹ̀.

rows.source: China regards the defectors as illegal migrants rather than refugees and often forcibly repatriates them.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Ṣáínà kò kà àwọn aláìgbàgbọ́ náà sí àwọn ará ìlú tí wọ́n ń sá lọ, wọ́n sì máa ń fi agbára mú wọn padà sí orílẹ̀-èdè wọn.
rows.reference: Àwọn àjèjì ̀lọ́nà tí kò bá òfin mu ni China ka àwọn tí wọ́n ń sá kúrò yí kún. Lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà, wọ́n máa dá wọn padà ni.

rows.source: Relations between the North and the South - who are still technically at war - have markedly improved in recent months.
rows.output: Àwọn ìbáṣepọ̀ láàárín Ìwọ̀-oòrùn àti Ìlà-oòrùn, tí wọ́n ṣì ń jà lọ́nà tó tọ́, ti dára púpọ̀ sí i ní oṣù tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Àjọṣẹpọ̀ North àti South Korea – bíi pé wọ́n ń bá ara wọn jà ni – tún sunwọ̀n díẹ̀ si lẹ́nu ọjọ́ mẹ́ta yìí.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the leaders of the two countries met in Pyongyang for talks that centred on the stalled denuclearisation negotiations.
rows.output: Ní oṣù tó kọjá, àwọn aṣáájú orílẹ̀-èdè méjèèjì pàdé ní Pyongyang fún ìjíròrò tó dojú kọ ìdásílẹ̀ ìjíròrò ìdásílẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ní ibẹ̀rẹ̀ oṣù yí, àwọn olórí méjèèjì pàdé ní Pyongyang láti jíròrò lóri ìdẹ́kun ohun ìjà olóró, ìjíròrò tí wọ́n patì tẹ́lẹ̀.

rows.source: This came after June's historic meeting between US President Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un in Singapore, when they agreed in broad terms to work towards the nuclear-free Korean peninsula.
rows.output: Èyí wáyé lẹ́yìn ìpàdé ìtàn ní oṣù kẹfà láàárín Ààrẹ orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà Donald Trump àti Kim Jong-un ní Singapore, nígbà tí wọ́n gbà láti ṣiṣẹ́ lórí ìlà-oòrùn Kòríà tí kò ní ohun ìjà.
rows.reference: Ìpàdé yìí wáyé lẹ́yìn ìpàdé tí Ààrẹ Amẹ́ríkà, Donald Trump àti Kim Jong-un ṣe ní Singapore lóṣù kẹfà. Wọ́n fẹnuko pé orílẹ̀-èdè Korea ‘ò ní ṣẹ̀dá ohun olóró mọ́.

rows.source: But on Saturday, North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong-ho blamed US sanctions for the lack of progress since then.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n ní ọjọ́ Àìkú, Minisita fún ọ̀rọ̀ òkèèrè ti Kòríà Àríwá, Ri Yong-ho, fi ẹ̀sùn kan àwọn ìdènà tí Orílẹ̀-Èdè Amẹ́ríkà fi lé lórí ìdàgbàsókè tí kò sí láti ìgbà náà.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ ní ọjọ́ Sátidé, Mínísítà ilẹ̀-òkèèrè ní orílẹ̀-èdè North Korea, Ri Yong-ho, dá Amẹ́ríkà lẹ́bi látàrí ìjìyà tó fi ń jẹ North Korea gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdènà sí ọ̀rọ̀ àjọsọ yìí.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the US, there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances, there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first," Mr Ri said in a speech to the UN General Assembly in New York.
rows.output: "Laísì ìgbàgbọ́ nínú orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, kò sí ìgbàgbọ́ nínú ààbò orílẹ̀-èdè wa, àti lábẹ́ àwọn ipò bẹ́ẹ̀, kò sí ọ̀nà tí a ó fi ṣe ìfipápadà sílẹ̀ fúnra wa ní àkọ́kọ́," Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Ri sọ ní ọ̀rọ̀ kan sí Ìgbìmọ̀ Àwọn Orílẹ̀-Èdè ní New York.
rows.reference: ”Bí àwọn ọmọ-ogun wa ‘ò bá fọkàntán orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, wọn ‘ò ní dẹkun ogun tàbí dẹ́kun ìṣẹ̀dá ohun ìjà olóró,” ọ̀rọ̀ Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Ri ní ìpàdé Àjọ UN ní New York.

rows.source: Nancy Pelosi calls Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," says he is unfit to serve on the Supreme Court
rows.output: Nancy Pelosi n pe Brett Kavanaugh ni “hysterical,” o si sọ pe ko yẹ lati ṣiṣẹ lori Ile-ẹjọ Giga
rows.reference: Nancy Pelosi ní “aláwàdà” ni Brett Kavanaugh. Fún ìdí èyí, kò tọ́ si i láti wà ní Ilé-ẹjọ́ Àgbà

rows.source: House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi called Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical" and said that he was temperamentally unfit to serve on the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Olórí Ẹgbẹ́ Ìpínlẹ̀ Kékèké Nancy Pelosi pè Brett Kavanaugh, ẹni tí a yàn sí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jùlọ, gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ìbànújẹ́” ó sì sọ pé kò ní ìmúrasílẹ̀ láti ṣe iṣẹ́ ní Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jùlọ.
rows.reference: Nancy Pelosi, Olórí Ẹgbẹ́ Onípò Kejì ní Ile Aṣojú-Ṣòfin, ní ‘aláwàdà’ ni Brett Kavanaugh, eni tí ààre yàn sí Ilé-ẹjọ́ Àgbà. Ó ní ìwà ọmọdé wà làráà.

rows.source: Pelosi made the comments in an interview Saturday at the Texas Tribune Festival in Austin, Texas.
rows.output: Pelosi sọ̀rọ̀ yìí nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò kan ní ọjọ́ Àìkú níbi ayẹyẹ Texas Tribune Festival ní Austin, Texas.
rows.reference: Pelosi sọ̀rọ̀ yí ní ọjọ́ Satidé nínú ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò ní Texas Tribune Festival in Austin, Texas.

rows.source: "I couldn't help but think that if a woman had ever performed that way, they would say 'hysterical,'" Pelosi said about her reaction to Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Thursday.
rows.output: "Mo kò lè dúró láti ronú pé bí obìnrin bá ti ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀, wọn yóò sọ pé “ìyàwó” ni."
rows.reference: Nínú èrò Pelosi nípa ìjẹ́rìí Kavanaugh ní Ilé Aṣòfin Àgbà tó wáyé ní ọjọ Ìṣẹ́gun, ó ní “Bí obìnrin bá ṣe ohun tó ṣe, ‘aláwàdà’ ló máa dì.”

rows.source: Kavanaugh emotionally denied allegations that he had sexually assaulted Dr. Christine Blasey Ford when they were both teenagers.
rows.output: Kavanaugh ń fi ìmọ̀lára hàn pé ó ń tako ẹ̀sùn pé ó ti fipá mú Dr. Christine Blasey Ford nígbà tí wọ́n jẹ́ ọ̀dọ́langba.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh ṣojú fuúrú, ó sẹ́ ẹ̀sùn ìfipábánilopò láàrin ẹ̀ àti Dókítà Christine Blasey Ford nígbà èwe wọn.

rows.source: During his opening statement, Kavanaugh was very emotional, at times nearly shouting and choking up while discussing his family and his high school years.
rows.output: Nígbà tí ó ń sọ̀rọ̀ ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ rẹ̀, Kavanaugh jẹ́ ẹni tí ó ní ìmọ̀lára ẹ̀dùn, nígbà míì ó sì ń fọ́kàn tán, ó sì ń rẹ́rìn-ín, nígbà tí ó ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ìdílé rẹ̀ àti ọdún ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ gíga rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Bí Kavanaugh se bẹ̀rẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ ẹ, bẹ́ẹ̀ ló ń kígbe sọ̀rọ̀ lásìkò tó ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ẹbí àti ilé-ìwé girama to lọ.

rows.source: He also explicitly condemned Democrats on the committee, calling the allegations against him a "grotesque and coordinated character assassination" organized by liberals angry that Hillary Clinton lost the 2016 presidential election.
rows.output: Ó tún sọ̀rọ̀ ní gbangba lòdì sí àwọn Démókíràsì tó wà nínú ìgbìmọ̀ náà, ní pípa àwọn ẹ̀sùn tó wà lòdì sí i gẹ́gẹ́ bí “ìpànìyàn àwòrán ẹ̀gàn àti ìṣètò” tí àwọn òṣèlú òsèlú tó ń bínú pé Hillary Clinton pàdánù ìdìbò ààrẹ ní ọdún 2016.
rows.reference: Ó wọ́ àwọn ọmọ egbẹ́ Democrat t’ọ́n wà nínú ìgbìmọ̀ tó fọ̀rọ̀walẹ́wò wọ́lẹ̀. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ló ní ẹ̀sùn ìfipábánilopò t’ọ́n fi kan òun jámọ́ “ìbanilórúkọjẹ́” láti ọwọ́ àwọn tí inú wọn ko dùn pé Hilary Clinton ‘ò borí ní ìbò ààrẹ tó wáyé ní 2016.

rows.source: Pelosi said that she believed Kavanaugh's testimony proved that he could not serve on the Supreme Court, because it showed that he is biased against Democrats.
rows.output: Pelosi sọ pé òun gbà pé ìtàn Kavanagh fi hàn pé kò lè jẹ́ kí ó wà lórí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jù Lọ, nítorí pé ó fi hàn pé òun kò fẹ́ àwọn Démọ́kírà.
rows.reference: Pelosi ni ọ̀rọ̀ ẹnu Kavanaugh fi hàn pé kò lè ṣiṣẹ́ ní Ilé-ejọ́ Àgbà torí ó sọ̀rọ̀ sí àwọn ọmọ egbẹ́ Democrat.

rows.source: "I think that he disqualifies himself with those statements and the manner in which he went after the Clintons and the Democrats," she said.
rows.output: Mo rò pé ó yọ ọ́ kúrò nínú ìpò rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn ìtàn yẹn àti ọ̀nà tí ó gbà wọ inú ìgbésí ayé àwọn Clinton àti àwọn Démọ́kíràtì.”
rows.reference: Ó ní “Ó ti wọ́gi lé ara ẹ̀ látàrí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tó sọ sí ẹbí Clinton and ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat.”

rows.source: Pelosi demurred when asked if she would try to impeach Kavanaugh if he is confirmed, and if Democrats gain the majority in the House of Representatives.
rows.output: Pelosi kọ̀ láti dáhùn bí ó bá fẹ́ kí wọ́n fẹ̀sùn kan Kavanaugh tí ó bá jẹ́ pé wọ́n fọwọ́ sí i, àti pé bí àwọn Démọ́kíràtì bá gba àwọn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ nínú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: Pelosi ṣọ́ ọ̀rọ̀ sọ nígbà tí wọ́n bíi léèrè ṣó máa gbìyànjú láti yọ Kavanaugh t’ọ́n bá fun ní ipò náà tàbí tí Democrats bá di pátì àkọ́kọ́ ni Ile Aṣojú-ṣòfin

rows.source: "I will say this -- if he is not telling the truth to Congress or to the FBI, then he's not fit not only to be on the Supreme Court, but to be on the court he's on right now," Pelosi said.
rows.output: "Èmi yóò sọ èyí -- bí kò bá sọ òtítọ́ fún Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin tàbí fún FBI, kò yẹ kó wà ní Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga, kò sì yẹ kó wà ní ilé ẹjọ́ tí ó wà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́."
rows.reference: Pelosí ní “Bi kò bá sọ òótọ́ fún àwọn aṣòfin tàbí àjọ ọ̀tẹ̀lẹmúyẹ́ FBI, kò lẹ́tọ̀ọ́ láti wà ní ilé-ẹjọ́ Àgbà àti kọ́ọ̀tù tó wà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ .”

rows.source: Kavanaugh is currently a judge on the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals.
rows.output: Kavanaugh jẹ́ onídàájọ́ lórí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Àpapọ̀ D.C.
rows.reference: Adájọ́ ni Kavanaugh ní Kọ́ọ̀tù Kòtẹ́milọ́rùn tó wà ní D.C. Circuit.

rows.source: Pelosi added that as a Democrat she was concerned about potential Kavanaugh rulings against the Affordable Care Act or Roe v. Wade, as he is considered to be a conservative justice.
rows.output: Pelosi sọ pé gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Democratic, ó ní ìbànújẹ́ nípa àwọn ìpinnu tí Kavanaugh lè ṣe lòdì sí ìlànà ìlera tó lè ṣe tàbí Roe v. Wade, nítorí pé a rí i gẹ́gẹ́ bí adájọ́ òṣèlú òsì.
rows.reference: Pelosi ní gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat òun mọ pé Kavanaugh máa dájọ́ tó lọdì sí Àbádòfin Affordable Care tabí Roe V. Wade torí adájọ tiẹ̀ ‘ò gbàgbọ́ nínú àwọn abádòfin náà.

rows.source: In his confirmation hearings, Kavanaugh sidestepped questions on whether he would overturn certain Supreme Court decisions.
rows.output: Nígbà ìgbàyànjú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ rẹ̀, Kavanaugh yàgò fún àwọn ìbéèrè nípa bóyá yóò yí àwọn ìpinnu ilé ẹjọ́ gíga kan padà.
rows.reference: Lásìkò tí wọ́n ń fọ̀rọ̀walẹ́nuwò fún ipò tuntun yìí, Kavanaugh fi ọgbọ́n fo àwọn ìbéèrè tó ní ṣo máa dájọ́ lòdì sí àwọn ìdájọ́ Ilé-ẹjọ́ Àgbà sáájú àḱkò tiẹ̀.

rows.source: "It's not time for a hysterical, biased person to go to the court and expect us to say, 'isn't that wonderful,'" Pelosi said.
rows.output: "Ko si akoko fun eniyan ti o ni aibikita ati aibikita lati lọ si ile-ẹjọ ki a si sọ pe, 'kii ṣe iyanu.'"
rows.reference: Pelosi ní “A ‘ò wá aláwàda, tàbí tinú-màáṣe ẹ̀dá gẹ́gẹ́ bí adájọ́, láì má pariwo síta.”

rows.source: And Women Need to Wield It.
rows.output: Àwọn Obìnrin Nílò láti Lo Ó.
rows.reference: Àwọn Obìnrin Gbọdọ̀ Lò Ó

rows.source: It is a righteous diatribe, months and years of fury spilling over, and she can't get it out without weeping.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìdánilójú, àwọn oṣù àti ọdún ti ìbínú ń ṣàn, ó sì kò lè gbà á láì bínú.
rows.reference: Ìbáwí olódodo èèyàn, àti ọ̀rọ̀ bínú fún ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ oṣù, kò lè kúrò láa láì sunkún.

rows.source: "We cry when we get angry," Ms. Steinem said to me 45 years later.
rows.output: "A máa ń sunkún nígbà tí a bá bínú," Ms. Steinem sọ fún mi ní ọdún 45 lẹ́yìn náà.
rows.reference: ”Gbogbo ẹ̀dá ló ń binú, ló ń ké,” Aya Steinem sọ bẹ́ẹ̀ fún mi.

rows.source: "I don't think that's uncommon, do you?"
rows.output: "Mo ro pe kii se ohun ti o wọpọ, o seun?"
rows.reference: ”Kì í ṣe ohun tó ṣàjèjì, àbí?”

rows.source: She continued, "I was greatly helped by a woman who was an executive someplace, who said she also cried when she got angry, but developed a technique which meant that when she got angry and started to cry, she'd say to the person she was talking to, "You may think I am sad because I am crying.
rows.output: Ó tẹ̀síwájú, “Mo gba ìrànlọ́wọ́ púpọ̀ lọ́wọ́ obìnrin kan tó jẹ́ aláṣẹ ní ibikíbi, tó sọ pé òun náà máa ń sunkún nígbà tí òun bá bínú, ṣùgbọ́n ó ṣe ìmúlò kan tó túmọ̀ sí pé nígbà tí òun bá bínú ó sì bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí sunkún, ó máa ń sọ fún ẹni tó ń bá sọ̀rọ̀
rows.reference: Ó tún sọ̀rọ̀ lọ. Ó ní,”Ọ̀gá ilé-iṣẹ́ kan ló jẹ́ ki i mò pé kì í ṣe ohun tó ṣàjèjì fún èèyàn láti sunkún tó bá ń binú. Ó ní tí òun bá wà ní ipò yí òun máa sọ fún àwọn èèyàn pé kì í se ìbànújẹ́ ló ń mú òun sọkún.

rows.source: I am angry."
rows.output: Mo bínú."
rows.reference: Ìbínú ni,”

rows.source: And then she just kept going.
rows.output: Àti pé ó tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ó tún sọ̀rọ̀ lọ.

rows.source: And I thought that was brilliant."
rows.output: Ati pe Mo ro pe iyẹn jẹ ẹlẹwa."
rows.reference: Ohun tó dáa ni mò pé.”

rows.source: Tears are permitted as an outlet for wrath in part because they are fundamentally misunderstood.
rows.output: Àwọn ẹ̀jẹ̀ jẹ́ ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀nà ìtúsílẹ̀ fún ìbínú ní apá kan nítorí pé a kò lóye wọn dáadáa.
rows.reference: Ẹkún síssun jẹ́ àfihàn ìbínú àmọ́ àwọn èèyàn ‘ò mọ̀.

rows.source: One of my sharpest memories from an early job, in a male-dominated office, where I once found myself weeping with inexpressible rage, was my being grabbed by the scruff of my neck by an older woman - a chilly manager of whom I'd always been slightly terrified - who dragged me into a stairwell.
rows.output: Ọkan lára ​​àwọn ìrántí tó ṣe kedere jùlọ láti ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ iṣẹ́ mi, nínú ọ́fíìsì tí àwọn ọkùnrin ń jẹ́ olórí, níbi tí mo ti rí ara mi ní ìbànújẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìbínú tí kò lè sọ, ni ọ̀nà tí obìnrin àgbà kan tí mo ti ń bẹ̀rù rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, ẹni tí mo ti ń bẹ̀rù
rows.reference: Mo rántí nígbà tí mo wà ní ibiṣẹ́ kan, ọkụ̀nrin ló pọ̀ jù ní ibiṣẹ́ náà. Lọ́pọ̀ ìgbà tínú bá bí mi, bẹ́è ni máa bú sígbe. Ní ọjọ́ kan ní ọgá wa kan, màmá arúgbó ni wọ́n, ni wọ́n fa mí lọ sí ẹ̀gbẹ́ kan, àmọ́ ẹ̀rù ń bà mí bí wọ́n ṣe mú mi dání.

rows.source: "Never let them see you crying," she told me.
rows.output: "Kò jẹ́ kí wọ́n rí ẹ̀jẹ̀ rẹ," ó sọ fún mi.
rows.reference: ”Má sunkún mọ níwájú àwọn èèyàn,” ni mò ń gbọ́.

rows.source: "They don't know you're furious.
rows.output: Wọn kò mọ̀ pé o fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ bínú.
rows.reference: Kò yé wọn pé inú ló ń bí ẹ.

rows.source: They think you're sad and will be pleased because they got to you."
rows.output: Wọ́n rò pé o nífẹ̀ẹ́ àti pé wọ́n á dùn nítorí pé wọ́n ti dé ọ.
rows.reference: Bí ìgbà tí òfò ń ṣe ẹ ló ń rò. Inú wọn ń dùn ni torí wọ́n rò pé àwọn ló ń mú ẹ sọkún.@

rows.source: Patricia Schroeder, then a Democratic congresswoman from Colorado, had worked with Gary Hart on his presidential runs.
rows.output: Patricia Schroeder, tó jẹ́ aṣojú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin ní Colorado nígbà náà, ti ṣiṣẹ́ pọ̀ pẹ̀lú Gary Hart lórí ìrìn àjò ààrẹ rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Patricia Schroeder, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Democrat àti aṣòfin ní Colorado nígbà kan,bá Gary Hart ṣiṣẹ́ nígbà tó n du ipò ààrẹ.

rows.source: In 1987, when Mr. Hart was caught in an extramarital affair aboard a boat called Monkey Business and bowed out of the race, Ms. Schroeder, deeply frustrated, figured there was no reason she shouldn't explore the idea of running for president herself.
rows.output: Ni ọdun 1987, nigbati Ọgbẹni Hart ti wa ni ẹsun ti o ni ibalopọ ni ita igbeyawo lori ọkọ oju omi ti a npe ni Monkey Business ati pe o yọkuro ninu idije naa, Iyaafin Schroeder, ti o ni ibanujẹ gidigidi, ro pe ko si idi kan ti ko yẹ ki o ṣawari imọran ti ṣiṣe fun aarẹ funrararẹ.
rows.reference: Ní ọdún 1987, tí wọ́n ní Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Hart ní àjọṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú obínrin mìíràn nínú ọkọ ojú-omi Monkey Business, bí Hart ‘ò ṣe díje fún ipò náà mọ́ nìyẹn. Iṣẹ̀lẹ̀ yí ‘ò dùn mọ́ Aya Schroeder nínú. Bí ó ṣe pinnu láti gbégba ìbò ààrẹ nìyẹn.

rows.source: "It was not a well-thought-out decision," she said to me with a laugh 30 years later.
rows.output: "Kò jẹ́ ìpinnu tí a ṣe dáadáa," ó sọ fún mi pẹ̀lú ẹ̀rín ọdún mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dọ́gbọ̀n lẹ́yìn náà.
rows.reference: Lẹ́yìn ọgbọ̀n ọdún, ó ní “ìpinnu yẹn ‘da to ó.

rows.source: "There were already seven other candidates in the race, and the last thing they needed was another one.
rows.output: "Àwọn ẹlẹ́sìn márùn-ún mìíràn wà nínú ìdíje náà, wọn kò sì nílò ẹlẹ́sìn mìíràn.
rows.reference: ”Àwọn méje ti wà nílẹ̀, tí wọ́n dìje du ipò ààrẹ. Wọn ‘ò wa kẹ́lòmíì darapọ̀ mọ́ wọn.

rows.source: Somebody called it "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.""
rows.output: Ẹnikan pe e ni "Ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ Àwọ̀ Fúnfun àti Dwarfs Mẹ́je."
rows.reference: Fíìmù kan tí àkọlé ẹ jẹ́ “Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs” ni èèyàn kan kà á kún.”

rows.source: Because it was late in the campaign, she was behind on fund-raising, and so she vowed that she wouldn't enter the race unless she raised $2 million.
rows.output: Nítorí pé ó pẹ́ jù nínú ìpolongo náà, ó sì jìnnà síra láti gbà owó, ó sì ṣe ìlérí pé kò ní wọ̀lú nínú ìdíje náà nígbà tí kò bá ti gbà mílíọ̀nù méjì dọ́là.
rows.reference: Torí ó pẹ́ kí ọmọbìnrin yìí tó jaHde láti díje, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kò ní owó lọwọ́, ó pinnu láti wáwó tó tó mílíọnu 2 dọ́là kó tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ni lọ káàkiri.

rows.source: It was a losing battle.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ ìjà tí a kò lè ṣẹ́gun.
rows.reference: Ìjà tí kò lè borí rèé.

rows.source: She discovered that some of her supporters who gave $1,000 to men would give her only $250.
rows.output: Ó rí i pé àwọn olùfọkànsìn kan tí wọ́n fún ẹgbẹ̀rún dọ́là 1,000 fún àwọn ọkùnrin yóò fún un ní 250 dọ́là nìkan.
rows.reference: Àwọn t’ọ́n fún ni 250 dọlà, máa fún àwọn ọkùnrin ẹgbẹ́ ẹ̀ ní 1000 dọ́là.

rows.source: "Do they think I get a discount?" she wondered.
rows.output: "Ṣé wọ́n rò pé mo ń gba ìdánilójú?" ó ronú.
rows.reference: ”Ṣé wọ́n rò pé ẹ̀dínwó wà fún mi ni?” ni ìbéèrè tó ń bi ara ẹ̀ léèrè.

rows.source: When she made her speech announcing that she would not launch a formal campaign, she was so overcome by emotions - gratitude for the people who'd supported her, frustration with the system that made it so difficult to raise money and to target voters rather than delegates, and anger at the sexism - that she got choked up.
rows.output: Nígbà tí ó sọ ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ nípa ìkéde pé kò ní ṣe ìpolongo ìṣèlú, ó ní ìmọ̀lára ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìmọ̀lára - ìdùnnú fún àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ti ṣètìlẹ́yìn fún un, ìbànújẹ́ pẹ̀lú ètò náà tí ó jẹ́ kí ó ṣòro láti gbé owó, àti láti fojú sọ́nà sí à
rows.reference: Nígbà tó kéde pé òun ‘ò ní sẹ ìkéde ńlá, ó sọ ẹ̀dùn ọkàn ẹ̀ – ó dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ àwọn t’ọ́n gbárùkùtí, sọ̀rọ̀ lóri ìsoro lóri ọ̀rọ̀ owó tí ó ní lò fún ìkéde sí àwọn olùdìbò àti ìrúnú sí ìyàtọ̀ tó waà láàrin ọkùnrin àti obìnrin – gbogbo ohun tó muú dorí góńgó.

rows.source: "You would have thought I'd had a nervous breakdown," recalled Ms. Schroeder about how the press reacted to her.
rows.output: "Ìwọ yóò ti rò pé mo ti ní ìbànújẹ́," ní Ms. Schroeder sọ̀rọ̀ nípa bí àwọn ìròyìn ṣe fèsì sí i.
rows.reference: ”Bíi ìgbà tí mo ní àrùn lára ni àwọn oníròyìn sọ mí dà.”

rows.source: "You'd have thought Kleenex was my corporate sponsor.
rows.output: "O yẹ ki o ro pe Kleenex ni onigbowo ile-iṣẹ mi.
rows.reference: ”Ọ̀pọ̀ ló ní ile-iṣẹ́ Kleenex jẹ́ agbátẹrù mi.

rows.source: I remember thinking, what are they going to put on my tombstone?
rows.output: Mo rántí pé mo rò pé, kí ni wọ́n máa kọ sí ibojì mi?
rows.reference: Mo ròó débi pé kí ni àwọn èèyàn máa kọ síbi ìtẹ́kùú mi?

rows.source: "She cried"?""
rows.output: "Ó sunkún"?
rows.reference: ”Tígbetigbe ló fi sọ̀rọ̀”?

rows.source: How the US-China trade war may be good for Beijing
rows.output: Bí ìjà ìtajà US àti Ṣáínà ṣe lè dára fún Beijing
rows.reference: Beijing ló máa jẹ àǹfààní ìjà tó dá lórí ọrọ̀-ajé tó wá láàrin Amẹ́ríkà àti China

rows.source: The opening salvos of the trade war between the US and China were deafening, and while the battle is far from over, a rift between the countries may be beneficial to Beijing in the long term, experts say.
rows.output: Àwọn ìbúgbàù ìjà ìtajà láàárín US àti Ṣáínà jẹ́ ohun tó ń bani lẹ́rù, àti pé bí ìjà náà kò bá ti parí, ìyàtọ̀ tó wà láàárín orílẹ̀-èdè méjèèjì lè jẹ́ àǹfààní fún Beijing ní ìgbà pípẹ́, àwọn amòye sọ.
rows.reference: Àwọn onímọ̀ ní ìjà tó dá lórí ọrọ̀-ajé tó wá láàrin Amẹ́ríkà àti China kò ní ojútùú, àtipé kò le parí. Nígbẹ̀yìn, Beijing ló máa jẹ àǹfààní ìjà yí.

rows.source: Donald Trump, the US President, fired the first warning earlier this year by taxing key Chinese exports including solar panels, steel and aluminium.
rows.output: Donald Trump, Ààrẹ Orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, ti kọ́kọ́ dá ìkìlọ̀ kan sílẹ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí nípa fífi owó orí sí àwọn ọjà pàtàkì ti Ṣáínà, títí kan àwọn panẹli oòrùn, irin, àti àlùmọ́nì.
rows.reference: Donald Trump, Ààrẹ Amẹ́ríkà, fìdí ọ̀rọ̀ yí múlẹ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ọdún yìí. Ó gbówó lé owó-orí àwọn ọjà bíi sólà, irin àti alumí t’ọ́n ti China wàá.

rows.source: The most significant escalation rolled in this week with new tariffs affecting $200 billion (£150 billion) worth of items, effectively taxing half of all goods coming into the US from China.
rows.output: Ìyípadà tó ṣe pàtàkì jù lọ tó wáyé ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí ni àwọn òfin ìdènà tuntun tó kan $200 biliọnu (£150 biliọnu) nínú ọjà, tó jẹ́ kí ìdá méjì nínú mẹ́ta gbogbo ọjà tó ń bọ̀ wọ́n lọ sí orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà láti Ṣáínà.
rows.reference: Lọ́sẹ̀ yí àfikún tó dé bá owó-orí kan iye ọjà tó tó bílíọ́nù 200 dọ́là. China ni àwọn ọjà yí tí ń wá sí Amẹ́ríkà.

rows.source: Beijing has retaliated each time in kind, most recently slapping tariffs of five to ten per cent on $60 billion of American goods.
rows.output: Beijing ti dahun ni ẹẹkan, ti o kẹhin ti o fi owo-ori ti o wa lati marun si mẹwa ogorun lori $ 60 bilionu ti awọn ọja Amẹrika.
rows.reference: Beijing náà ṣe tiẹ̀. Ó gbé owó tó lé ní ìdá márùn-ún sí mẹ́wàá lorí àwọn ọjà to tó bílíọ́nù 60 dọ́là lórí àwọn ọjà tó ti Amẹ́ríkà wá.

rows.source: China has pledged to match the US shot-for-shot, and the world's second largest economy is unlikely to blink anytime soon.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Ṣáínà ti ṣèlérí láti bá àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà lọ́wọ́, wọ́n sì jẹ́ ètò-ọrọ̀ ajé kejì tó tóbi jù lọ ní ayé, wọn kì í ṣe àwọn tí wọ́n máa fọwọ́ rọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
rows.reference: China ni ohun tí Amẹ́ríkà bá ṣe ni òun náà máa ṣe e. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kò sí ohun tó lè mi ọ̀rọ̀-ajé China tó wà ní ipò kejì lágbàáyé.

rows.source: Getting Washington to back down means caving into demands, but publicly bowing to the US would be far too embarrassing for Xi Jinping, China's president.
rows.output: Ìdáhùn Washington sí ìdàrúdàpọ̀ náà túmọ̀ sí fífún àwọn ìbéèrè, ṣùgbọ́n fífi ara rẹ̀ hàn sí orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà yóò jẹ́ ìrẹ̀wẹ̀sì púpọ̀ fún Xi Jinping, Ààrẹ Ṣáínà.
rows.reference: T’Ámẹ́ríkà bá jọwọ́ sílẹ̀ bíi ìgbà tí wọ́n ń ṣe ohun tí àwọn èèyàn fẹ́ ni. Ṣùgbọ́n fún Xi Jinping, Ààrẹ China, kò ní gbà sí Amẹ́ríkà lẹ́nu torí ohun ìtìjú ni.

rows.source: Still, experts say if Beijing can play its cards right, US trade war pressures could positively support China over the long term by lowering the inter-dependence of the two economies.
rows.output: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé, àwọn amòye sọ pé bí Beijing bá lè ṣe eré rẹ̀ dáadáa, ìjà ìtajà àgbáyé lè ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn rere fún Ṣáínà ní ìpẹ̀yà pípẹ́ nípa dín ìbáṣepọ̀ láàárín àwọn ọjà méjèèjì.
