rows.source: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.
rows.output: Yawancin abubuwan da suka yi launin fata suna da bakuna da aka dinka kuma sun yi kama da Hannibal Lecter fiye da haute couture.
rows.reference: Da yawa daga cikin safofin fuskar masu launi suna da ɗinki a leɓɓa kuma sun yi kama da Hannibal Lecter a maimakon salon ado na haute couture.

rows.source: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.
rows.output: Wani abu da aka yi ya yi kama da kayan nutsewa na ruwa tare da snorkel da gilashin ruwa, yayin da wani ya yi kama da kankara mai narkewa.
rows.reference: Wata ƙagowar ya yi kama da kayan shiga ruwan teku na scuba tare da snorkel da tubarau, wani kuwa ya yi kama da bututun ƙanƙarar madara mai narkewa.

rows.source: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.
rows.output: Kuma idan ka ci gaba da wannan babban bayanin salo - kana cikin sa'a.
rows.reference: Kuma idan ka ci gaba da babban bayani a kan kayan ado - kana cikin nasara.

rows.source: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.
rows.output: Masu lura da salon sun yi hasashen cewa manyan huluna na iya zuwa kan titunan ku.
rows.reference: Masu kallon salo sun yi kintace cewa manyan bonnets za su iya fara zuwa manyan titunan na kusa da kai.

rows.source: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.output: Girman hula sun zo ne bayan 'La Bomba', hular ciyawa mai fadi biyu da aka gani a kan kowa daga Rihanna zuwa Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.reference: Manyan hulunan suna zuwa da kyau a kan takalma masu tsawo na 'La Bomba', hula mai tsinke tare da ƙafofi biyu gajeru da aka gani a kan kowa daga Rihanna zuwa ga Emily Ratajkowski.

rows.source: The cult label behind the highly impractical hat that was splashed across social media sent another big creation down the catwalk - a straw beach bag almost as big as the swimsuit-clad model toting it.
rows.output: Alamar al'ada a bayan babbar hular da aka yi ta yawa a kafafen sada zumunta ta aika wani babban abu na halitta a kan titin - jakar bakin teku ta ganyayyaki da ta kai kusan girman kayan sawa na samfurin da ke dauke da ita.
rows.reference: An watsa irin yadda hular take da ake maitar so sosai a cikin kafofin sada zumunta mai aika wata babbar kirkira har zuwa wurin tattakin nuna salon ado - ga wata jakar kara ta bakin teku kusan babba kamar samfuri na rigar wanka a ruwa da ake sawa.

rows.source: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jakakkun jak
rows.reference: Jakar mai launin lemo, da aka gyara tare da gefe-gefen raffia mai sama na wani farin mariki na fata, ita ce abin da ya yi fice a cikin kayan La Riviera SS19 na Jacquemus a Makon Kayon Ado na Paris. Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris

rows.source: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'
rows.output: An kira mai tsara salon, Luke Armitage, ya ce da FEMAIL: 'Ina sa ran ganin manyan hula da jakunkuna na bakin teku sun zo kan titi don lokacin rani mai zuwa - saboda mai zanen ya yi tasiri sosai, zai yi wuya a yi watsi da bukatar manyan kayan sawa.'
rows.reference: Sanannen mai salo Luke Armitage ya fada a FEMAIL: ‘Ina tsammanin ganin manyan huluna da jakakkunan bakin teku sun zo a kan babban titi don damuna ta gaba - don saboda mai tsarawar ya yi wani babban tasiri zai yi wahala a manta da buƙatar ta manyan kayayyakin tallafin.’

rows.source: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens
rows.output: Yohanna Edward: Iya harsuna tana da muhimmanci ga 'yan kasa na duniya
rows.reference: John Edward: Muhimman hikimomin harsuna don ‘yan kasa na duniya

rows.source: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.
rows.output: Iyalan makarantun Scotland suna da tarihin nasara a fannin ilimi, kuma wannan ya ci gaba a shekarar 2018 tare da wani saitin sakamakon jarabawar da ya yi fice, wanda ya kara karfi ta hanyar nasarorin da suka samu a wasanni, zane, kiɗa, da sauran ayyukan al'umma.
rows.reference: Makarantun Scotland masu zaman kansu suna riƙe da wani rubutaccen bayani na fice ta fuskar ilmi, kuma wannan ya ci gaba a cikin 2018 tare da wani yanki na sakamakon jarrabawa da ta yi fice, wanda kawai cin nasara mutum da ta tare cikin wasanni, da fasaha, waƙa da sauran al’amuran al’umma ke ƙarfafawa.

rows.source: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.
rows.output: Tare da sama da ɗalibai 30,000 a duk faɗin Scotland, waɗannan makarantu, wanda Majalisar Makarantun 'Yan Kasa ta Scotland (SCIS) ke wakilta, suna ƙoƙarin samar da mafi kyawun sabis ga ɗalibansu da iyayensu.
rows.reference: Tare da samun ƙarin yara ‘yan makaranta 30,000 a faɗin Scotland, wadannan makarantun, wanda Majalisar Makarantu Masu Zaman Kansu (Scottish Council of Independent Schools), ke hoɓɓasa don samar da lebur na aiki mafi kyau ga ƙananan yara da iyayensu.

rows.source: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.
rows.output: Makarantun da ba su da wata alaka suna da burin shirya dalibansu don karatun gaba da kuma karatun gaba, sana'arsu da aka zaba, da kuma matsayinsu na 'yan kasa na duniya.
rows.reference: Makarantu masu zaman kansun na da manufa ta shirya yaransu don karin samun babban ilmi, hanyar rayuwa da suka zaɓa da wurinsu a matsayin ‘yan ƙasa na duniya.

rows.source: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.
rows.output: A matsayin sashen ilimi da zai iya tsara da aiwatar da tsarin karatun makaranta na musamman, muna ganin harsunan zamani suna ci gaba da zama batun da aka fi so da ake so a makarantu.
rows.reference: A matsayin wani sashe na ilmi da zai iya tsara da aiwatar da manhajar makaranta da ake magana, muna ganin harsunan zamani suna ci gaba da da sanuwa da kuma darasi da ake so na zabi a cikin makarantu.

rows.source: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.
rows.output: Nelson Mandela ya ce: "Idan ka yi wa mutum magana da harshen da ya fahimta, hakan zai shiga cikin kai.
rows.reference: Nelson Mandela ya ce: “Idan ka yi magana da wani mutum a cikin wani harshe da yake fahimta, wannan yakan shiga kansa.

rows.source: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."
rows.output: Idan ka yi magana da shi a harshen da ya fi so, hakan yana kaiwa ga zuciyarsa.
rows.reference: Idan ka yi magana da a cikin harshensa wannan yakan shiga zuciyarsa.”

rows.source: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.
rows.output: Wannan wata tunatarwa ce mai ƙarfi cewa ba za mu iya dogaro da Turanci kawai ba idan muna son gina alaƙa da kuma amincewa da mutane daga ƙasashen waje.
rows.reference: Wannan wata tunatarwa ce mai ƙarfi cewa ba za mu iya dogaro da Turanci ba a yayin son gina hulɗoɗi da aminci tare da mutane daga sauran ƙasashe.

rows.source: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.
rows.output: Daga sakamakon jarabawar da aka yi a wannan shekarar, za mu iya ganin cewa harsuna suna kan gaba a cikin teburin gasar da mafi yawan kashi a makarantun da ba na gwamnati ba.
rows.reference: Daga sakamakon jarrabawa na kwanan nan na wannan shekara, za mu iya ganin cewa harsuna suna saman teburan jaddawali tare da kimomi da suka fi girma a cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu.

rows.source: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.
rows.output: A cikin 68 cikin 100 na ɗaliban da suka yi karatun harsunan waje sun sami mafi girman daraja A.
rows.reference: Wata jimillar kashi 68 cikin ɗari ne na ɗalibai da suka karanta harsunan ƙasashen waje suka sami wata Babbar daraja ta A.

rows.source: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.
rows.output: Bayanan da aka tattara daga makarantun 74 da ke cikin SCIS, sun nuna cewa kashi 72 cikin 100 na daliban sun sami maki A a cikin Mandarin, yayin da kashi 72 cikin 100 na wadanda ke karatun Jamusanci, kashi 69 cikin 100 na wadanda ke karatun Faransanci, da kashi 63 cikin 100 na wadanda ke karatun Mutanen Espanya suma sun sami maki A.
rows.reference: Bayanan, da aka tattara daga mambobin makaranta 74 na SCIS ɗin, sun nuna cewa kashi 72 cikin ɗari na ɗaliban sun ci wata Babbar daraja ta A a cikin Mandarin, sai kuma kashi 72 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka karanta Jamusanci, kashi 69 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka karanta Farasanci da kashi 63 cikin ɗari da ke karanta Spanish su ma sun sami wata A.

rows.source: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.
rows.output: Wannan yana nuna cewa makarantun da ba na gwamnati ba a Scotland suna tallafawa harsunan waje a matsayin muhimman ƙwarewa da yara da matasa za su buƙaci a nan gaba.
rows.reference: Wannan yana nuna cewa makarantu masu zaman kansu a cikin Scotland suna goyon bayan harsunan ƙasashen waje a matsayin muhimman hikimomi da yara da samari za su babu shakka buƙata a nan gaba.

rows.source: Languages now, as a subject choice, are being held in the same regard as STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering and mathematics) in independent school curriculums and elsewhere.
rows.output: Yanzu haka, a matsayin zaɓin batun, ana ɗaukar harsuna a matsayin abin daraja iri ɗaya da batutuwan STEM (kimiyya, fasaha, injiniya da lissafi) a cikin tsarin karatun makarantun da ke zaman kansu da kuma a wasu wurare.
rows.reference: Harsuna a yanzu, a matsayin darasin zaɓi, ana riƙe su a matsayi iri guda kamar darussan STEM (kimiyya, injiniya da lissafi) a cikin manhajojin makarantun masu zaman kansu da kuma wasu wani wurin.

rows.source: A survey by the UK Commission for Employment and Skills in 2014 found that of reasons employers gave for struggling to fill vacancies, 17 per cent were attributed to a languages skills shortage.
rows.output: Wani bincike da Hukumar Burtaniya ta Kula da Ma'aikata da Kwarewa ta yi a shekarar 2014 ya gano cewa daga cikin dalilan da ma'aikata suka bayar na rashin iya cike guraben aiki, kashi 17 cikin 100 an danganta shi da karancin kwarewar harshe.
rows.reference: Wani safiyo na Hukumar Ingila don Aiki da Hikimomi a cikin 2014 ya samo dalilai da masu ɗaukan aiki suka bayar don gwagwarmaya wajen cike guraben da ba kowa, an danganta kashi 17 cikin ɗari zuwa ga wani rashin isassun hikimomin harsuna.

rows.source: Therefore more and more, language skills are becoming imperative in order to prepare young people for their future careers.
rows.output: Don haka, ƙarin ƙwarewa a cikin harsuna yana zama wajibi don shirya matasa don ayyukan da za su yi a nan gaba.
rows.reference: Don haka hikimomin harshe da yawa sosai suna sake zama da muhimmanci saboda a shirya samari don abubuwan da za su yi nan gaba a rayuwa.

rows.source: With more prospective job opportunities requiring languages, these skills are essential in a globalised world.
rows.output: Tare da ƙarin damar aiki masu yiwuwa waɗanda ke buƙatar harsuna, waɗannan ƙwarewar suna da mahimmanci a cikin duniya mai haɗin gwiwa.
rows.reference: Tare da ƙarin damammakin aiki da za a iya samu masu buƙatar harsuna, wadannan hikimomi suna da muhimmanci a cikin duniya mai dunƙulewa.

rows.source: Regardless of the career someone chooses, if they've learned a second language, they'll have a real advantage in the future having a life-long skill such as this.
rows.output: Duk da aikin da wani ya zaba, idan sun koyi harshe na biyu, za su sami fa'ida ta gaske a nan gaba da samun kwarewa ta dindindin kamar haka.
rows.reference: Ba tare da la’akari da irin aiki da wani ya zaɓa na rayuwa ba, idan suka koyi wani harshe na biyu, za su haƙiƙa wata fa’ida a nan gaba mai hikima ta tsawon rayuwa irin wannan:

rows.source: Being able to communicate directly with people from foreign countries will automatically put a multilingual person ahead of the competition.
rows.output: Ikon sadarwa kai tsaye da mutane daga kasashen waje zai sanya mutum mai harsuna da yawa a gaban gasa.
rows.reference: Samun dama ta sadarwa kai tsaye tare da mutane daga ƙasashe na waje zai kai tsaye sa wani mutum mai harsuna da yawa a saman gasar.

rows.source: According to a YouGov poll of more than 4,000 UK adults in 2013, 75 per cent were unable to speak a foreign language well enough to hold a conversation and with French being the only language spoken by a double-digit percentage, 15 per cent.
rows.output: Bisa ga wani bincike na YouGov na fiye da 4,000 manyan mutane a Birtaniya a shekarar 2013, kashi 75 cikin 100 ba su iya magana da wani yare na waje da kyau don yin tattaunawa ba, kuma Faransanci shine kawai yaren da kashi 15 cikin 100 ke magana da shi.
rows.reference: A cewar wani zaɓen jin ra’ayi na YouGov na fiye da manya 4,000 ‘yan Ingila a 2013, kashi 75 cikin ɗari sun gagara su yi magana da wani harshen ƙasar waje sosai yadda za su iya yin tattaunawa da kuma Faransanci da ya zama kawai harshen magana da kashi cikin ɗari na wani gurbin lambobi biyu kawai ta mai lamba, kashi 15 cikin ɗari.

rows.source: This is why putting the investment into language teaching now is important for today's children.
rows.output: Wannan shine dalilin da ya sa saka hannun jari a fannin koyar da harshe yanzu yana da matukar muhimmanci ga yaran yau.
rows.reference: Wannan shi ya sa zuba jari a cikin koyar da harshe a yanzu yana da amfani don yaran gobe.

rows.source: Having multiple languages, particularly those of developing economies, will equip children with a better chance of finding meaningful employment.
rows.output: Samun harsuna da yawa, musamman na tattalin arzikin da ke tasowa, zai baiwa yara damar samun aikin da zai baiwa su gudunmawa sosai.
rows.reference: Samun harsuna da yawa, musamman waɗanda na ire-iren tattalin arziki ne masu tasowa, zai ba wa yara wata dama mai kyau ta samun aiki mai ma’ana.

rows.source: Within Scotland, each school will differ in the languages they teach.
rows.output: A cikin Scotland, kowace makaranta za ta bambanta a cikin harsunan da suke koyarwa.
rows.reference: A cikin Scotland, kowace makaranta za ta bambanta a cikin harsuna da suke koyarwa.

rows.source: A number of schools will focus on the more classic modern languages, whereas others will teach languages that are deemed to be most important for the UK when looking ahead to 2020, such as Mandarin or Japanese.
rows.output: Da yawa daga cikin makarantu za su mayar da hankali kan harsunan zamani na gargajiya, yayin da wasu za su koyar da harsuna da ake ganin suna da muhimmanci ga Burtaniya lokacin da ake duba zuwa 2020, kamar Mandarin ko Jafananci.
rows.reference: Da yawan makarantu za su himmatu ne a kan karin fitattun harsunan zamani, amma dai sauran za su koyar da harsuna da ake ganin mafi amfani don Ingila a yayin duba gaba zuwa 2020, kamar su Mandarin ko Jafanisanci.

rows.source: Whatever your child's interest, there will always be a number of languages to choose from within independent schools, with teaching staff who are specialists in this area.
rows.output: Duk da abin da yake sha'awar ɗanku, koyaushe za a sami adadi mai yawa na harsuna da za a zaɓa daga cikin makarantun da ba su da zaman kansu, tare da ma'aikatan koyarwa waɗanda ƙwararru ne a wannan fanni.
rows.reference: Ko ma wace irin sha’awa yaranka ke da ita, koyaushe za a sami wasu harsuna na zaba daga cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu, tare da malamai masu koyarwa da suke kwararru a cikin yankin.

rows.source: Scottish independent schools are dedicated to providing a learning environment that will prepare children and arm them with the skills required to succeed, whatever the future holds.
rows.output: Makarantun Scotland masu zaman kansu suna da niyyar samar da yanayi na koyo da zai shirya yara da kuma ba su ilimin da ake bukata don su yi nasara, duk abin da makomar ta kasance.
rows.reference: Makarantu masu zaman kansu na Scotland suna sadaukar da kai don samar da wani yanayi na koyo da zai shirya yara da ba su karfi na hikimomi da ake nema don ci nasara, duk abin da kuwa zai nan gaba.

rows.source: It can't be denied at this time, in a global business environment, that languages continue to be vitally important to the country's future, so this must be mirrored in education.
rows.output: Ba za a iya musanta wannan ba a wannan lokacin, a cikin yanayin kasuwancin duniya, cewa harsuna suna da matukar muhimmanci ga makomar kasar, don haka dole ne a nuna hakan a cikin ilimi.
rows.reference: Ba za a iya ki a wannan lokacin ba, a cikin wani yanayin kasuwanci na duniya, harsuna suna ci gaba taka rawa mai amfani ga makomar kasar, don haka dole sa wannan a cikin ilmi.

rows.source: Indeed, modern languages should really be considered "international communication skills."
rows.output: Tabbas, harsunan zamani ya kamata a yi la'akari da su a matsayin "kwarewar sadarwa ta duniya."
rows.reference: Hakika, ya kamata a zahiri a dauki harsunan zamani “hikimomin sadarwa na kasa-da-kasa.”

rows.source: Independent schools will continue to offer this choice, diversity and excellence for Scotland's young people.
rows.output: Makarantun da ba na gwamnati ba za su ci gaba da ba da wannan zabi, bambanci da kuma kyakkyawan aiki ga matasa na Scotland.
rows.reference: Makarantu masu zaman kansu za su ci gaba da samar da wannan zabin, zama da juna da fice ga samarin mutane na Scotland.

rows.source: Il faut bien le faire.
rows.output: Ya kamata a yi.
rows.reference: Il faut bien le faire.

rows.source: John Edward is Director of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools
rows.output: John Edward shi ne Darakta na Majalisar Makarantun Iyakance na Scotland
rows.reference: John Edward shi ne Darekta na Majalisar Scotland ta Makarantu Masu Zaman Kansu

rows.source: LeBron to make Lakers debut Sunday in San Diego
rows.output: LeBron zai fara buga wasan Lakers ranar Lahadi a San Diego
rows.reference: LeBron zai sa Lakers su bayyana ranar Lahdi a cikin San Diego

rows.source: The wait is nearly over for fans looking to see LeBron James make his first start for the Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.output: Jiran kusan ƙarewa ga masoya da ke son ganin LeBron James ya fara buga wasa a kungiyar Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.reference: Jiran ya kusan karewa ga magoya bayan da ke neman ganin LeBron James ya yi farawarsa don Los Angeles Lakers.

rows.source: Lakers coach Luke Walton has announced that James will play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Denver Nuggets in San Diego.
rows.output: Kociyan Lakers Luke Walton ya bayyana cewa James zai buga wasan farko na kakar wasa da Denver Nuggets a ranar Lahadi a San Diego.
rows.reference: Mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Lakers Luke Walton ya sanar da cewa James zai yi wasa a farkon wasan bude lokaci na Lahdi da Denver Nuggets a cikin San Diego.

rows.source: But just how many minutes he'll play has yet to be determined.
rows.output: Amma kawai yawan mintuna nawa zai taka rawa har yanzu ba a tantance ba.
rows.reference: Amma kawai ba san mintina nawa ne zai yi wasan ba har yanzu.

rows.source: "It will be more than one and less than 48," said Walton on the Lakers" official website.
rows.output: "Zai fi ɗaya kuma ƙasa da 48," in ji Walton a shafin yanar gizon hukuma na Lakers.
rows.reference: "Zai zama fiye da daya da kusa da 48" inji Walton a kan shafin yanar gizo na Lakers din.

rows.source: Lakers reporter Mike Trudell tweeted that James will likely play limited minutes.
rows.output: An ba da rahoton Lakers Mike Trudell cewa James zai yi wasan kadan.
rows.reference: Mai rahoto na Lakers Mike Trudell a Twitter cewa James zai kila yi kayyadedden wasan mintina ne.

rows.source: Following practice earlier this week, James was asked about his plans for the Lakers" six-game preseason schedule.
rows.output: Bayan aikin da aka yi a baya a wannan makon, an yi wa James tambaya game da shirinsa na wasannin sada zumunta na Lakers guda shida.
rows.reference: A bayan gwaji na farkon wannan makon, an tambayi James game da shirye-shiryensa don tsarin wasanni shida na kafin lokaci na Lakers.

rows.source: "I don't need preseason games at this stage of my career to get ready," he said.
rows.output: "Ba na bukatar wasannin sada zumunta a wannan matakin na sana'ata don shirya," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ba na bukatar wasanni na kafin lokaci a wannan matakin na aikina don na shirya,” inji shi.

rows.source: Trump's West Virginia Rally Time, YouTube Channel
rows.output: Taron Trump a West Virginia, Lokaci, Tashar YouTube
rows.reference: Lokacin Taron Trump na Virginia ta Yamma, Tashar  YouTube Channel

rows.source: President Donald Trump begins a flurry of campaign rallies tonight in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.output: Shugaban Amurka Donald Trump ya fara jerin tarukan yakin neman zabensa a daren nan a Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.reference: Shugaba Donald Trump ya fara ‘yan wasu taruka yau da dare a cikin Wheeling, Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.source: It's Trump's first of five scheduled rallies in the next week, including stops in friendly places including Tennessee and Mississippi.
rows.output: Wannan shine taron farko na Trump na tarurruka biyar da aka shirya a cikin mako mai zuwa, ciki har da tafiye-tafiye zuwa wuraren da suka saba da su, kamar Tennessee da Mississippi.
rows.reference: “Shi ne farkon daya daga cikin tarukan Trump guda biyar a cikin mako mai zuwa da ya hada da tsaye-tsaye a wuraren da ke abota da suka da Tennessee da Mississippi.

rows.source: With the confirmation vote on hold for his pick to fill the Supreme Court vacancy, Trump is aiming to build support for upcoming mid-term elections since Republicans are at risk of losing control of Congress when votes are cast on Nov.
rows.output: Tare da jinkirin kuri'ar tabbatar da zaɓen da ya yi na cike gurbin Kotun Koli, Trump yana nufin gina goyon baya ga zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adi mai zuwa tun da 'yan Republican ke cikin haɗari na rasa ikon Majalisar Dokoki lokacin da za a yi zaɓe a watan Nuwamba.
rows.reference: Tare da dakatar da kada kuri’ar tabbatarwa wanda ya zaba don cike gurbin Kotun Koli, Trump yana da niyyar gina goyon baya don zabubbukan tsakiyar zango da za su zo tun da ‘yan Republican suna cikin hadari na rasa sarrafa Majalisar Dokoki a lokaci da za a kada kuri’un a Nuwamba.

rows.source: What time is Trump's West Virginia rally tonight and how do you watch online?
rows.output: Mene ne lokacin taron Trump a West Virginia a daren yau kuma ta yaya za ku kalli shi a yanar gizo?
rows.reference: Yaushe ne taron Trump na dare na Virginia ta Yamma kuma yaya zan kalla ta yanar gizo?

rows.source: Trump's Wheeling, West Virginia rally is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET tonight, Saturday, September 29, 2018.
rows.output: Taron Trump na Wheeling, West Virginia yana jadawalin 7 na yamma. ET a daren yau, Asabar, 29 ga Satumba, 2018.
rows.reference: An tsara taron Trump din ne na Wheeling, Virginia ta Yamma da karfe 7 na daren yau Asabar, 29 ga Satumba, 2018.

rows.source: You can watch Trump's West Virginia rally online below via live stream on YouTube.
rows.output: Za ka iya kallon gangamin Trump na West Virginia a kan layi a kasa ta hanyar watsa shirye-shirye na YouTube.
rows.reference: Za ka iya kallon taron Trump ɗin na Virginia ta Yamma ta yanar gizo da ke ƙasa lokacin da ake yi a kan YouTube.

rows.source: Trump is likely to address this week's hearings for Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh, which became tense over sexual misconduct allegations with an anticipated Senate confirmation vote on hold for up to a week while the FBI investigates.
rows.output: Trump zai iya magana kan shari'ar da aka yi a makon da ya gabata na zaben Kotun Koli na Brett Kavanaugh, wanda ya yi tsanani kan zargin cin zarafi na jima'i, tare da jiran kuri'ar majalisar dattijai na iya jira har zuwa mako guda yayin da hukumar ta FBI ke bincike.
rows.reference: Trump ba mamaki ya yi magana a kan bahasin wannan mako don zaɓan Brett Kavanaugh Kotun Koli, wanda ya tsananta a kan kagen cin zarafi na jima’i tare da tsammani wata dakatar da kaɗa kuri’a ta Majalisar Dattawa har zuwa wani mako a yayin da hukumar FBI ke bincike.

rows.source: But the primary aim of this flurry of rallies is helping Republicans facing touch November elections gain some momentum.
rows.output: Amma babban buri na wannan guguwar zanga-zanga shi ne taimakawa 'yan Republican da ke fuskantar zaben watan Nuwamba mai matukar muhimmanci samun karin kuzari.
rows.reference: Amma babbar manufa ta wannan dandazon taruka shi ne taimakon ‘yan Republican da ke fuskantar taɓa zaɓuɓɓukan Nuwamba su sami ɗan kuzari.

rows.source: Thus, President Trump's campaign said these five rallies in the next week are aimed at "energizing volunteers and supporters as Republicans try to protect and expand the majorities they hold in the Senate and House of Representatives," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Don haka, yakin neman zaben shugaba Trump ya ce wadannan gangamai biyar a cikin mako mai zuwa na nufin "kawo karfin gwiwa ga masu goyon baya da masu goyon bayan jam'iyyar Republican yayin da suke kokarin karewa da fadada rinjayen da suke da shi a majalisar dattawa da majalisar wakilai," a cewar Reuters.
rows.reference: Don haka, kamfe na Shugaba Trump ya ce manufar waɗannan taruka biyar a cikin mako mai zuwan shi ne “zaburar da masu sa-kai da magoya baya a lokacin da ‘yan Republican ke ƙoƙarin kare da faɗaɗa fin yawan jama’a da suke da shi a Majalisar Dattawa da Majalisar Wakilai,” a cewar Reuters.

rows.source: "Control of Congress is so critical for his agenda that the president will travel to as many states as possible as we head into the busy campaign season," a Trump campaign spokesman who declined to be named told Reuters.
rows.output: "Kula da Majalisar Dokoki yana da matukar muhimmanci ga ajandarsa, shugaban zai tafi kasashe da dama gwargwadon yadda za mu iya shiga cikin lokacin yakin neman zabe," mai magana da yawun yakin neman zaben Trump wanda ya ki amincewa da bayyana sunansa ya fada wa Reuters.
rows.reference: “Sarrafa Majalisar Dokoki yana da muhimmanci sosai ga ajandarsa cewa shugaban ƙasa zai je jihohi masu yawa a yayin da muke shiga lokacin da ba zama,” inji wani mai magana da yawun kamfe na Trump da ya faɗa wa Reuters amma ya ki a ambaci sunansa.

rows.source: Scheduled for Wesbanco Arena in Wheeling, tonight's rally could bring supporters from "Ohio and Pennsylvania and draw coverage from the Pittsburgh media," according to the West Virginia Metro News.
rows.output: An shirya gudanar da taron a filin wasa na Wesbanco a Wheeling, wannan taron na yau na iya jawo masu goyon bayan "Ohio da Pennsylvania da kuma samun rahoto daga kafafen yada labarai na Pittsburgh," a cewar West Virginia Metro News.
rows.reference: Tsarin da aka don Wesbanco Arena a cikin Wheeling, yau da dare zai kawo magoya baya daga "Ohio da Pennsylvania da kuma jawo kafofin watsa labarai su zo na Pittsburgh," a cewar Metro News ta Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.source: Saturday will be the second time in the past month that Trump has visited West Virginia, the state he won by more than 40 percentage points in 2016.
rows.output: Asabar za ta kasance karo na biyu a cikin watan da ya gabata da Trump ya ziyarci yankin Yamma na Virginia, wanda ya lashe shi da kashi 40 cikin 100 na kuri'un da aka kada a shekarar 2016.
rows.reference: Asabar za ta zama lokaci na biyu a watan da ya wuce da Trump zai ziyarci Virginia ta Yamma, jihar da ya ci da fiye da kashi 40 na ɗigo-ɗigo a cikin 2016.

rows.source: Trump is trying to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morrisey, who is trailing in the polls.
rows.output: Trump yana ƙoƙarin taimakawa ƙasar West Virginia Republican Senate mai neman zama Patrick Morrisey, wanda ke baya a cikin zaben.
rows.reference: Trump yana ƙoƙari ne na taimakon ɗan takarar Sanata na Republican na Virginia ta Yamma Patrick Morrisey, wanda ke baya a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan.

rows.source: "It's not a good sign for Morrisey that the president has to come to try to give him a boost in the polls," said Simon Haeder, a political scientist at West Virginia University, according to Reuters.
rows.output: "Ba alama mai kyau ba ce ga Morrisey cewa shugaban kasa ya zo ya yi ƙoƙari ya ba shi ƙarin ƙarfi a zaben," in ji Simon Haeder, masanin siyasa a Jami'ar West Virginia, a cewar Reuters.
rows.reference: “Wannan ba wata alama ce mai kyau ga Morrisey ba cewa har sai da shugaban ƙasa ya zo don ƙoƙarin ya ƙara masa wani farin jini a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan,” inji Simon Haeder, wani masanin kimiyyar siyasa a Jami’ar Virginia ta Yamma, a cewar Reuters.

rows.source: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA show stomach for fight to keep hopes alive heading into Sunday singles
rows.output: Gasar Ryder 2018: Tawagar Amurka ta nuna jajircewa wajen kare fatan rayuwa a cikin wasannin karshe na Lahadi
rows.reference: Kofin Ryder 2018: Team USA sun nuna ciki don yaƙi don raya fatan da ake yi mai shiga cikin ɗaiɗaikun Lahadi

rows.source: After three one-sided sessions, Saturday afternoon's foursomes might just have been what this Ryder Cup needed.
rows.output: Bayan zaman uku na gefe guda, ranar Asabar da rana ta hudu na iya zama abin da wannan gasar cin kofin Ryder ke bukata.
rows.reference: Bayan lokuta masu gefe guda, wasan huɗu-huɗu na Asabar zai kila kawai zama abin da ke wannan Kofin Ryder ke buƙata.

rows.source: The swinging pendulum of momentum is a completely invented sporting concept but one that players truly believe in, and never more so than at competitions like these.
rows.output: Juyin juyin juyin juya hali na motsi wani sabon ra'ayi ne na wasanni, amma 'yan wasan sun yi imani da shi sosai, kuma babu wani lokaci da suka yi imani da shi fiye da gasa kamar haka.
rows.reference: Canjin halin da ake cikin na shekar wani ƙago batun wasa ne gaba ɗaya amma wanda ‘yan wasa da gaske suka yi imani da shi, kuma bai taɓa zama hakan ba sai ma a gasa kamar waɗannan.

rows.source: So where would they say the momentum is now?
rows.output: A ina za su ce yanzu haka?
rows.reference: Don haka a ina za su ce hoɓɓasan take yanzu?

rows.source: "They had a six-point lead and now it's four, so we are carrying that as a little bit of momentum I guess," said Jordan Spieth as he strolled off for the day.
rows.output: "Suna da maki shida, yanzu kuma hudu, don haka muna daukar hakan a matsayin dan kadan na karfin gwiwa, ina tsammanin," in ji Jordan Spieth yayin da ya tafi hutun rana.
rows.reference: “A da suna da ja gaba na ɗigo shida kuma yanzu huɗu ne, don haka muna ɗaukan hakan a matsayin dan hoɓɓasa a tunanina,” inji Jordan Spieth a lokacin da ya gama don ranar.

rows.source: Europe have the advantage, of course, four points ahead with twelve more in play.
rows.output: Turai tana da fa'ida, ba shakka, maki hudu a gaba da maki goma sha biyu a wasan.
rows.reference: Turai tana da fa’ida, haƙiƙa, digo huɗu a gaba tare da ƙarin goma sha biyu a cikin wasa.

rows.source: The Americans, as Spieth says, feel they have a little wind in their sails though and they have plenty to be encouraged by, not least the form of Spieth and Justin Thomas who played together all day and each boast three points from four.
rows.output: Amurkawa, kamar yadda Spieth ya ce, suna jin suna da ɗan iska a cikin jiragen ruwa nasu kuma suna da abubuwa da yawa da za su ƙarfafa musu gwiwa, ba kamar yadda Spieth da Justin Thomas suka yi wasa tare duk rana kuma kowannensu yana da maki uku daga cikin huɗu.
rows.reference: Amurkawa, kamar yadda Spieth ke faɗa, suna jin suna da ɗan taimako ne a cikin lamarin kodayake suna da abubuwa da yawa da za ƙarfafa musu gwiwa, mafi aƙalla ba shi ne nau’i na Spieth da Justin Thomas waɗanda suka yi wasa tare dukkan rana kuma kowanne ya tashi da ɗigo-ɗigo uku daga huɗu.

rows.source: Spieth has been lethal from tee to green and is leading by example.
rows.output: An yi masa kisan kai daga tee zuwa kore kuma yana jagorantar misali.
rows.reference: Spieth ya kasance guba daga tee zuwa kore kuma yana shugabanci da misali.

rows.source: Those guttural screams of celebration got louder as his round went on, sinking a crucial putt to take match four all-square when he and Thomas had been two down after two.
rows.output: Wadannan kururuwar murna da suka fito daga cikin ciki sun kara karfi yayin da zagayowarsa ke ci gaba, ya yi bugun da ya dace don ya kawo wasan zuwa 4-4 lokacin da ya da Thomas suka kasance 2-2 bayan zagaye biyu.
rows.reference: Waɗannan ihu na biki sun yi kamari kamar yadda kewayansa ya ci gaba, yana nutsar da wani muhimmin abu don daukan murabba’i guda huɗu a lokacin da shi da Thomas suka kasance a kashe su biyu bayan biyun.

rows.source: His putt that won them the match on 15 was met with a similar scream, the sort that tells you he believes that the American team is not out of this.
rows.output: Kwallon da ta yi nasara a wasan a kan 15, an yi mata wani irin ihu, irin wanda ke nuna cewa yana ganin cewa kungiyar Amurka ba ta fita daga wannan ba.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarinsa da ya ciyo musu wasan ranar 15 inda ya haɗu da irin ihun, wanda ke nuna maka ya yi imani cewa ƙungiyar Amurkan ba wai ba ta cikin wannan ba ne.

rows.source: "You've really just got to dig deep and worry about your own match," Spieth said.
rows.output: "Kuna buƙatar ku yi zurfi sosai kuma ku damu da wasan ku kaɗai," in ji Spieth.
rows.reference: “Dole sai a zahiri ka shiga ciki ƙasa sosai kuma ka damu game da wasanka,” inji Spieth.

rows.source: It is all each of these players has left now.
rows.output: Yana da komai da ya rage wa kowanne daga cikin wadannan 'yan wasan yanzu.
rows.reference: Shi dukkan kowane daga waɗannan ‘yan wasan ya tafi yanzu.

rows.source: 18 holes to make a mark.
rows.output: Hanyoyi 18 don yin alama.
rows.reference: Ramuka 18 don yin wani maki.

rows.source: The only players with more points than Spieth and Thomas over the past two days are Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, the indisputable story of the Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Kawai 'yan wasan da suka fi maki da Spieth da Thomas a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata sune Francesco Molinari da Tommy Fleetwood, labarin da ba a iya musantawa na gasar Ryder.
rows.reference: ‘Yan wasan kawai da ke da ɗigo-ɗigo da yawa fiye da Spieth da Thomas a sama da kwanaki biyu su ne Francesco Molinari da Tommy Fleetwood, labari da ba isasshe ba na  Ryder Kulob.

rows.source: Europe's odd but adorable couple are four from four and can do no wrong.
rows.output: Kasashen Turai suna da wani abu mai ban mamaki amma mai ban sha'awa, kuma suna da 'yan mata hudu daga cikin hudu kuma ba za su iya yin kuskure ba.
rows.reference: Ma’aurata wani iri amma da ake so na Turai su ne huɗu daga huɗu kuma ba za su yi abin da ba daidai ba.

rows.source: "Moliwood" were the only pair not to shoot a bogey on Saturday afternoon, but they also avoided bogeys on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and the back nine on Friday morning.
rows.output: "Moliwood" su ne kawai biyu da ba su yi bogey a ranar Asabar ba, amma kuma sun guji boge a ranar Asabar da rana, Juma'a da rana, da kuma baya na ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: “Moliwood” sun zama kawai su ne biyu kar su harbe wani shirme a ranar Asabar da rana amma kuma sun guje wa shiririta a ranar Asabar da safe, Juma’a da rana kuma na bayan tara a ranar Juma’a da safe.

rows.source: That run, and the way their energy seems to flow both to and from this boisterous crowd cements that they are the players to beat on Sunday, and there would be no more popular player to seal a potential European victory as the sun sets over Le Golf National than Fleetwood or Molinari.
rows.output: Wannan gudu, da kuma yadda kuzarinsu ke bayyana cewa yana gudana duka zuwa da daga wannan taron mai cike da kuzari, ya tabbatar da cewa su ne 'yan wasan da za su yi nasara a ranar Lahadi, kuma babu wani dan wasa da zai fi shahara wajen tabbatar da nasarar Turai mai yiwuwa yayin da rana ke faduwa a kan Le Golf National fiye da Fleetwood ko Molinari.
rows.reference: Wannan ya wuce, kuma irin yadda kuzarinsu ke wucewa gaba ɗaya daga zuwa da kuma dandazon jama’a da suka ƙarfafa cewa su ne ‘yan wasan da za a buge a ranar Lahdi, kuma ba za a sake samun ƙarin ɗan wasa da zai rufe wani cin nasara da za a iya yi ta Turai kamar yadda rana ta fito a saman Le Golf National maimakon Fleetwood ko Molinari.

rows.source: Preferably both simultaneously on different holes.
rows.output: A mafi kyau, a lokaci guda biyu a kan ramuka daban-daban.
rows.reference: Idan abin so ne gaba ɗaya a lokaci guda a ramuka daban-daban.

rows.source: Talk of European glory remains premature, though.
rows.output: Tattaunawa kan kyawawan abubuwan da suka faru na Turai har yanzu ba su da wani amfani, ko da yake.
rows.reference: Maganar ɗaukakar Turai har yanzu ba ta nuna ba.

rows.source: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made short work of Sergio Garcia, the morning's fourballs hero, when he was paired with Alex Noren.
rows.output: Bubba Watson da Webb Simpson sun yi aiki da sauri a kan Sergio Garcia, jarumin zagayen farko na safe, lokacin da aka hada shi da Alex Noren.
rows.reference: Bubba Watson da Webb Simpson sun yi gajeren aiki na Sergio Garcia, gwarzon ƙwallo huɗu na safe, a lokacin da aka yi musu haɗin biyu tare da Alex Noren.

rows.source: A bogey and two doubles on the front nine dug the Spaniard and the Swede into a hole they never got close to climbing out of.
rows.output: Wani bogey da kuma biyu a kan gaba tara ya sanya dan kasar Spain da dan kasar Sweden cikin rami da ba su taba fita daga ciki ba.
rows.reference: Wani bogey da ruɓanya sau biyu a kan gaban tara mai tona Spaniard da Swede din a cikin wani rami da ba su taɓa zuwa kusa ga fita ba.

rows.source: On Sunday, though, there is nobody to help you out of your hole.
rows.output: A ranar Lahadi, duk da haka, babu wanda zai taimake ka daga ramukan ka.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, kodayake, babu wani da zai taimake ka fita daga raminka ba.

rows.source: The fourballs and foursomes are so fascinating to watch up close because of the interactions between pairings, the advice they give, the advice they don't and the way that a strategy can change in an instant.
rows.output: Kwallon guda huɗu da kuma ƙwallon guda huɗu suna da ban sha'awa sosai a kallon su kusa da su saboda hulɗar da ke tsakanin ƙungiyoyi, shawarwarin da suke bayarwa, shawarwarin da ba su bayar ba, da kuma yadda dabarar za ta iya canzawa cikin daƙiƙa.
rows.reference: Ƙwallaye huɗun da haɗin huɗun suna da ban sha’awa a kalla daga kusa saboda ma’amala tsakanin haɗe-haɗen biyu, shawarar da suke bayarwa, shawarar da ba sa bayarwa da kuma hanyar da wata dabara za ta iya canjuwa a wani bigiren.

rows.source: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.
rows.output: Yanayin Turai ya fi kyau a matsayin ƙungiya har yanzu kuma suna da babban jagora a ranar karshe amma wannan zaman wasan guda huɗu ya kuma nuna cewa Ƙungiyar Amurka tana da ƙarfin hali don faɗa da wasu, musamman waɗanda ke Amurka, sun yi shakku.
rows.reference: Turai sun yi wasa sosai a matsayin wata ƙungiya ya zuwa yanzu kuma sun zama shugabanni a cikin rana ta ƙarshe amma wannan lokacin na huɗu-huɗun yana nuna kuma cewa Team USA yana da ciki don yaƙin na cewa, musamman Stateside, sun yi ta shakka.

rows.source: Europe take 10-6 lead into Ryder Cup final day
rows.output: Yuroopu ta dauki jagoranci 10-6 zuwa ranar karshe ta gasar Ryder Cup
rows.reference: Turai tana ja gaba 10 da 6 a cikin ƙarshen ranan Ryder Cup

rows.source: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.
rows.output: Turai za ta yi amfani da kyakkyawar dama a ranar karshe ta gasar Ryder Cup bayan da ta fito daga wasannin zagaye hudu da kuma wasannin zagaye goma sha biyu da rabi da ke da nasaba da ranar Asabar da ci 10-6 a kan Amurka.
rows.reference: Turai za ta sami wata fa’ida mai amfani a cikin ranar ta ƙarshe ta Ryder Cup bayan tasowa daga ƙwallaye huɗu na Asabar da wasannin huɗu-huɗu tare da wani ja gaba na 10 da 6 a cikin Amurka.

rows.source: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.
rows.output: An yi wa ƙungiyar Tommy Fleetwood da Francesco Molinari ƙarfafa gwiwa, sun jagoranci tare da nasarar da suka samu a kan Tiger Woods da ke fama da matsala, don haka sun kai jimillar maki huɗu a Le Golf National.
rows.reference: Su biyun da suka sami ƙarfin gwiwa Tommy Fleetwood da Francesco Molinari sun jagori canji da cin nasarori biyu a saman Tiger Woods da ke gwagwarmaya don ɗaukan lamba ya zuwa yanzu a Le Golf National zuwa ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu.

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.
rows.output: Thomas Bjorn na Turai, da ke ƙoƙarin riƙe kofin da suka rasa a Hazeltine shekaru biyu da suka wuce, sun yi nasara a kan ɓangaren Amurka da ba su da ƙarfi a cikin wasannin safiya na juna, inda suka ci 3-1.
rows.reference: Sashen Turai na Thomas Bjorn, mai neman riƙe kofin ba su ci nasara ba a Hazeltine shekaru biyu da suka wuce, da mamaye wani rashin sa’a a sashen Amurka a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu na safe, inda suka ɗauki jere-jere 3 da 1.

rows.source: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.
rows.output: Amurka ta yi ƙoƙari sosai a cikin ƙungiyoyin huɗu, inda ta yi nasara a wasanni biyu, amma ba za su iya cin nasara a kan asarar da suka yi ba.
rows.reference: Amurka ta ƙara turjiya a cikin huɗu-huɗun, tana ci nasarar wasanni biyu, amma sun gagara ci a cikin tawayar.

rows.source: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.
rows.output: Kungiyar Jim Furyk tana buƙatar maki takwas daga wasannin guda 12 na ranar Lahadi don kare kofin.
rows.reference: Sashen Jim Furyk suna buƙatar ɗigo-ɗigo daga wasanni ɗaiɗaiku 12 na ranar Lahadi don riƙe kofin.

rows.source: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.
rows.output: Fleetwood shine ɗan wasan Turai na farko da ya ci maki huɗu a jere yayin da shi da Molinari, wanda aka fi sani da "Molliwood" bayan wani ƙarshen mako mai ban mamaki, su ne ƙungiyar ta biyu kawai da suka ci maki huɗu daga wasanninsu huɗu na farko a tarihin gasar Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Fleetwood shi ne farkon rookie na Turai da ya ci ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu a yayin da shi da Molinari, da aka cewa "Molliwood" bayan wani ƙarshen mako da ake magana kuma kawai su ne haɗin biyu da suka ci ɗigo-ɗigo hudu daga budewa wasanninsu huɗu a cikin tarihin Ryder Cup.

rows.source: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.
rows.output: Bayan da suka murƙushe Woods da Patrick Reed a cikin wasan zagaye huɗu, sai suka yi aiki tare cikin sauƙi don cin nasara a kan Woods da sabon ɗan wasan Amurka Bryson Dechambeau da ci 5&4.
rows.reference: Bayan sun buge Woods da Patrick Reed a cikin ƙwallaye huɗun sai kuma suka tashi suke buge Woods da rookie na Amurka Bryson Dechambeau ta kuma wani abin gani na 5 da 4.

rows.source: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.
rows.output: Woods, wanda ya ja kansa a cikin wasanni biyu a ranar Asabar, ya nuna wasu lokuta na haske amma yanzu ya rasa wasanni 19 daga cikin 29 a cikin wasannin biyu da hudu kuma bakwai a jere.
rows.reference: Woods, wanda ya ja kansa zuwa cikin wasanni biyu a ranar Asabar, ya nuna wata bayyana ta ilimi amma yanzu ya rasa 19 na wasanninsa a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu da wasannin huɗu-huɗu da bakwai a cikin wani jeri.

rows.source: Justin Rose, rested for the morning fourballs, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the foursomes to a 2&1 defeat of Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - ranked one and three in the world.
rows.output: Justin Rose, ya huta don wasan safiya na zagaye hudu, ya dawo ya hada kai da Henrik Stenson a wasan zagaye biyu da ya sha kashi da Dustin Johnson da Brooks Koepka - wanda ya kasance na daya da uku a duniya.
rows.reference: Justin Rose, ya huta don ƙwallaye huɗu na safen, ya dawo ga abokin hulɗa Henrik Stenson a cikin wasannin huɗu-huɗu zuwa ga wata dokewa 2 da 1 ci na Dustin Johnson da Brooks Koepka - mai kima ɗaya da uku a cikin duniya.

rows.source: Europe did not have it al their own way though on a pleasant, breezy day south west of Paris.
rows.output: Turai ba ta da shi duka ba, duk da haka a rana mai daɗi, mai iska ta kudu maso yammacin Paris.
rows.reference: Turai ba ta samu ba yadda take da sauki, ranar kudu-maso-yamma mai iska ta Paris.

rows.source: Three-times major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set the benchmark for the Americans with two points on Saturday.
rows.output: Wanda ya lashe kofin sau uku Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas sun kafa ma'aunin Amurkawa da maki biyu a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Babban mai cin nasara sau uku Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas sun kafa wani layi don Amurkawa tare da ɗigo-ɗigo biyu a ranar Asabar.

rows.source: They earned a gritty 2&1 win over Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in the fourballs and returned later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4&3 in the foursomes having lost the opening two holes.
rows.output: Sun samu nasara mai wahala 2&1 akan Spain Jon Rahm da Ian Poulter a cikin wasan hudu kuma suka dawo daga baya don cin nasara akan Poulter da Rory McIlroy 4&3 a cikin wasan hudu, bayan da suka yi rashin nasara a ramukan farko biyu.
rows.reference: Sun sami wani ci da ba daɗi na 2 da 1 a kan Jon Rahm Ian Poulter na Spain a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu da kuma dawowa daga baya don buge Poulter da Rory McIlroy 4 da 3 a cikin wasannin huɗu-huɗu bayan su rasa cin nasara ta buɗewa ramukan biyu.

rows.source: Only twice in Ryder Cup history has a team come back from a four-point deficit going into the singles, although as holders Furyk's side need only draw to retain the trophy.
rows.output: Kawai sau biyu a cikin tarihin gasar Ryder Cup, ƙungiya ta dawo daga raguwar maki huɗu da ke tafe zuwa wasan ƙarshe, kodayake a matsayin masu rike da kambun, tawagar Furyk tana buƙatar kawai ta yi kunnen doki don riƙe kambun.
rows.reference: Kawai sau ɗaya ne a tarihin Ryder Cup wata ƙungiya ta sake dawowa daga wani rasa ɗigo huɗu a cikin ɗaiɗaiku,  kodayake kamar yadda masu riƙon na sashen Furyk ke buƙatar kawai tsayuwar doki don riƙe kofin.

rows.source: After being second-best for two days, however, a Sunday counter-attack looks as though it will be beyond them.
rows.output: Bayan kasancewa na biyu a cikin kwanaki biyu, duk da haka, ana kallon hari na Lahadi a matsayin wanda zai wuce su.
rows.reference: Bayan kasancewa na biyu mafi kyau na kwanaki biyu, amma, wani sake hari na ranar Lahadi ya yi kamar dai zai fi ƙarfinsu.

rows.source: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust
rows.output: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce "babu hanya" za ta rabu da makamai ba tare da amincewa ba
rows.reference: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce ‘ba yadda’ za ta rage makami ita kaɗai ba tare da aminci ba

rows.source: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.
rows.output: Ministan harkokin wajen Koriya ta Arewa ya gaya wa Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a ranar Asabar cewa takunkumin da ake ci gaba da yi ya kara tabarbarewar amincewa da Amurka, kuma babu wata hanya da kasar za ta yi watsi da makaman nukiliya ta kanta a cikin irin wannan yanayi.
rows.reference: Ministan Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Koriya ta Arewa ya faɗa wa Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Asabar ci gaba da takunkumi yana ƙara tura rashin amincewarta da Amurka kuma babu wata hanya da ƙasar za ta bar makamanta na nukiliya ita kaɗai a ƙarƙashin ire-iren yanayin.

rows.source: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.
rows.output: Ri Yong Ho ya gaya wa Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta shekara-shekara cewa Koriya ta Arewa ta dauki "matakai masu kyau na kyautatawa" a cikin shekarar da ta gabata, kamar dakatar da gwaje-gwajen nukiliya da na makamai masu linzami, da kuma kawar da wurin gwajin nukiliya, da kuma alkawarin cewa ba za ta yada makaman nukiliya da fasahar nukiliya ba.
rows.reference: Ri Yong ya faɗa wa Babban Taro na shekara na na hukumar duniya cewa Koriya ta Arewa ta yi “masu matakai na mutunci” a cikin shekarar ta da wuce, kamar tsaida gwaje-gwajen nukiliya da makamai masu linzami, rusa wurin gwajin nukiliya, kuma da yin alkawari ba za ta ƙara makaman nukiliya da fasahar nukiliya ba.

rows.source: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.
rows.output: "Amma, ba mu ga wani martani da ya dace daga Amurka ba," in ji shi.
rows.reference: "Amma, ba mu ga kowane abu na martani daga Amurka,” inji shi.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."
rows.output: "Ba tare da amincewa da Amurka ba, ba za a yi amincewa da tsaron ƙasa ba, kuma a ƙarƙashin irin waɗannan yanayi ba za mu iya kawo cikas ga kai tsaye ba."
rows.reference: “Ba tare da kowane aminci ba na Amurka ba za a sami ƙarfin gwiwa a cikin tsaronmu na ƙasa kuma a ƙarƙashin ire-iren yanayin babu wata hanya da mu kaɗai za mu rage makamai mu da farko.”

rows.source: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.
rows.output: Yayin da Ri ya sake yin magana kan korafe-korafen da ake yi a Koriya ta Arewa game da juriyar Washington ga hanyar "matakai" na kawar da makaman nukiliya, inda Koriya ta Arewa za ta samu lada yayin da take daukar matakai masu sauki, bayaninsa ya bayyana mai muhimmanci domin bai ki amincewa da kawar da makaman nukiliya ba tare da la'akari da ra'ayin Pyongyang ba, wanda ya yi a baya.
rows.reference: A yayin da Rike same maimaita koke-koken Koriya ta Kudu da aka sani game da ƙin Washington na bin wata hanyar “a hankali” don rage makaman nukiliyat a ƙarƙashinsa da za a ba da kyauta ga Koriya ta Arewan a yayin da ɗauki wasu matakai a hankali, jawabin nasa ya bayyana da muhimmanci saboda ba ta ƙi rage makaman nukiliyar ita kaɗai ba haka kawai kamar yadda Pyongyang ɗin ta yi a baya ba.

rows.source: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.
rows.output: Ri ya nufi wata sanarwa ta hadin gwiwa da Kim Jong Un da Donald Trump suka fitar a wani taro na farko tsakanin shugaban kasar Amurka da ke aiki da shugaban Koriya ta Arewa a Singapore a ranar 12 ga watan Yuni, lokacin da Kim ya yi alkawarin yin aiki kan "kawar da makaman nukiliya a kudancin Koriya" yayin da Trump ya yi alkawarin samar da tabbaci kan tsaron Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.reference: Ri ya yi dube ne ga wani jawabin hadin gwiwa daga Kim Jong Un da Donald Trump a wani babban taro da aka taba yi tsakanin shugaban Amurka mai ci da wani shugaban Koriya ta Arewa a cikin Singapore a ranar 12 ga Yuni, a lokacin da Kim ya yi alkawari yin aiki zuwa ga "rage makaman nukiliya a zirin Koriya" a lokacin da Trump ya yi alkawarin ba da garanti na tsaron Koriya ta Arewa din.

rows.source: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.
rows.output: Koriya ta Arewa ta kasance tana neman a kawo karshen yakin Koriya na 1950-53, amma Amurka ta ce Pyongyang dole ne ta fara barin makaman nukiliya.
rows.reference: Koriya ta Arewa tana neman wani kawo wa ƙarshen Yakin Koriya na shekarun 1950 zuwa 53, amma Amurkan ta ce Pyongyang dole ta bar makamanta na nukiliya daga farko.

rows.source: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.
rows.output: Washington kuma ta yi adawa da kiran da ake yi na sassauta takunkumin kasa da kasa kan Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.reference: Haka kuma Washington ta ki kiraye-kiraye na ta sassauta takunkumin ƙasa-da-ƙasa a kan Koriya ta Arewa.

rows.source: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.
rows.output: "Amurka tana jaddada "farkon kawar da makaman nukiliya" kuma tana kara matsin lamba ta hanyar takunkumi don cimma manufarsu ta hanyar tilastawa, har ma suna adawa da "bayyana karshen yakin,"" in ji Ri.
rows.reference: “Amurka ta jajirce a kan “barin nukiliya daga farko” kuma ta ƙara matakin matsai ta takunkumi don cimma manufarta a cikin halin tilastawa, da kuma ma ƙin “furuci na ƙarshen yaƙi,”” inji Ri.

rows.source: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.
rows.output: "Ra'ayin cewa takunkumi na iya sa mu suka yi ƙasa, mafarki ne na mutanen da ba su san mu ba.
rows.reference: “Fahimta ta cewa takunkumi zai iya kawo mu kan gwiwowinmu wani mafarki ne na mutane waɗanda suka zahilci abu game da mu.

rows.source: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."
rows.output: Amma matsalar ita ce cewa takunkumin da ake ci gaba da yi suna kara zurfafa rashin amincewarmu."
rows.reference: Amma matsalar ita ce ci gaba da takunkumi suna kara rashin yardarmu.”

rows.source: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.
rows.output: Ri bai ambaci wani shiri na wani taro na biyu tsakanin Kim da Trump da shugaban Amurka ya haskaka a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a farkon mako.
rows.reference: Ri bai yi furuci na shirye-shirye don wani babban taro na biyu tsakanin Kim da Trump wanda shugaban Amurka da ya tsokaci a Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a cikin farkon makon.

rows.source: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."
rows.output: Ministan ya mayar da hankali kan tarurrukan uku da suka faru tsakanin Kim da shugaban Koriya ta Kudu Moon Jae-in a cikin watanni biyar da suka gabata, ya kara da cewa: "Idan jam'iyyar da ke da alhakin wannan batu na kawar da makaman nukiliya ta Koriya ta Kudu ce, ba Amurka ba, to kawar da makaman nukiliya na kasan Koriya ba za ta kasance a irin wannan makale ba."
rows.reference: A maimakon haka ministan ya yi tsokaci ne na taruka uku tsakanin Kim da shugaban Koriya ta Kudu Moon Jae-in a cikin watanni biyar da suka wuce kuma ya ƙara da cewa: “Idan kasar da ke cikin wannan batun na barin nukiliya za a ce Koriya ta Kudu ne ba Amurka ba da barin nukiliyar na zirin Koriya da ba sami irin matsalar ba.”

rows.source: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.
rows.output: Ko da yake, yanayin jawabin Ri ya bambanta sosai da na shekarar da ta gabata, lokacin da ya gaya wa Majalisar Dinkin Duniya cewa kai hari kan babban yankin Amurka da makaman North Korea ba za a iya gujewa ba bayan da "Mista Shugaban Mugunta" Trump ya kira Kim "mutumin roka" da ke kan hanyar kashe kansa.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, lafazin jawabin na Ri ya dan zama daban daga na shekarar da ta gabata, a lokacin da ya gaya wa Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniyar cewa cikin yankin Amurka da rokokin Koriya wani abu ne da dole zai wakana bayan “Mista Shugaba Mai Neman Bala’i” Trup ya kira Kim da wani “mutum mai roka” da ke neman kashe kansa.

rows.source: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.
rows.output: A wannan shekarar a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Trump, wanda a shekarar da ta gabata ya yi barazanar "gaba daya lalata" Koriya ta Arewa, ya yaba wa Kim bisa jarumtaka wajen daukar matakai na kawar da makaman nukiliya, amma ya ce akwai aiki mai yawa da za a yi kuma takunkumi dole ne su kasance har sai Koriya ta Arewa ta daina nukiliya.
rows.reference: Wannan shekarar a Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, Trump, wanda shekarar da ta gabata ya yi barazana ta “rusa gaba ɗaya” Koriya ta Arewa, ya yabi Kim don karfin halinsa na ɗaukan matakai na rage makamai, amma ya ce har yanzu a akwai aiki da dole za a yi kuma takunkumi suna nan sa har Koriya ta Arewan ta bar nukiliya.

rows.source: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."
rows.output: A ranar Talata, Trump ya ce bai da lokaci na musamman da zai yi wannan ba, yana cewa "Idan ya ɗauki shekaru biyu, uku ko biyar - ba komai."
rows.reference: A ranar Laraba, Trump ya ce ba ya da lokaci ƙayyadedde don wannan, yana cewa “Idan zai ɗauki shekaru biyu, shekaru uku ko shekaru biyar - ba damuwa.”

rows.source: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.
rows.output: Sin da Rasha suna jayayya cewa Majalisar Tsaro ta Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta ba Pyongyang lada saboda matakan da aka dauka.
rows.reference: China da Rasha sun yi mahawara cewa ya kamata Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ya ba da kyauta ga Pyongyang don matakan da ta ɗauka.

rows.source: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."
rows.output: Duk da haka, Sakataren Harkokin Wajen Amurka Mike Pompeo ya gaya wa Majalisar Tsaro ta Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a ranar Alhamis cewa: "Dole ne a ci gaba da aiwatar da takunkumin Majalisar Tsaro ba tare da gajiyawa ba har sai an cimma cikakken, karshe, tabbatar da kawar da makaman nukiliya."
rows.reference: Amma, Sakataren Ƙasashen Waje na Amurka  Mike Pompeo ya faɗa wa Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Alhamis cewa: “Dole tilasta takunkumin Kwamitin Tsaro ya ci gaba sosai ba tare da gazawa ba sai har mun ga cikekken barin nukiliya da aka tantance daga ƙarshe.”

rows.source: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.
rows.output: Majalisar Tsaro ta amince da takunkumi kan Koriya ta Arewa tun 2006 a kokarin dakile kudaden da ake samu na shirye-shiryen nukiliya da makaman raga na Pyongyang.
rows.reference: Kwamitin Tsaro gaba daya ya sa karfafa takunkumi ne a kan Koriya ta Arewa tun 2006 a wani yinkuri na dakile samun kudi don shirye-shiryen Pyongyang na nukiliya da makamin fashewa mai linzami.

rows.source: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.
rows.output: Pompeo ya hadu da Ri a gefen taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, kuma ya ce bayan haka zai ziyarci Pyongyang a watan gobe don shirya wani taro na biyu.
rows.reference: Pompeo ya haɗu da Ri a gefen Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya inda ya ce bayan hakan zai sake ziyartar Pyongyang wata mai zuwa don shirya wani babban taro na biyu.

rows.source: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.
rows.output: Pompeo ya ziyarci Koriya ta Arewa sau uku a wannan shekarar, amma tafiyarsa ta karshe ba ta tafiya da kyau ba.
rows.reference: Pompeo ya ziyarci Koriya ta Arewa sau uku tun tuni wannan shekarar, amma zuwan nasa bai yi daɗi sosai ba.

rows.source: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."
rows.output: Ya bar Pyongyang a watan Yuli yana cewa an samu ci gaba, sai dai a cikin sa'o'i kadan, Koriya ta Arewa ta yi watsi da shi saboda yin "buƙatun da ke kama da 'yan fashi."
rows.reference: Ya bar Pyongyang a cikin Yuli yana mai cewa an samu ci gaba, kawai sai dai a cikin sa’o’i Koriya ta Arewa ta yi watsi da neman “buƙatu kamar na 'yan daba.”

rows.source: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."
rows.output: Koriya ta Arewa ta yi alkawari a wani taro da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan da ya gabata da watan
rows.reference: Koriya ta Arewa ta yi alkawari a wani mitin tare da Moon wannan watan za ta ruguza wani wuri na gwajin makami mai linzami da kuma wani gini na nukiliya idan Amurka ta ɗauki “wasu matakai ta ɓangaren.”

rows.source: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.
rows.output: Ya ce Kim ya gaya masa cewa, "matakan da suka dace" da yake nema sune tabbatar da tsaro da Trump ya yi alkawari a Singapore da kuma kokarin da ake yi na kawo karshen takunkumin da Washington ke da shi.
rows.reference: Ya ce Kim ya faɗa masa "wasu matakai ta ɓangaren" da yake nema su ne garanti na tsaro da Trump ya yi alkawari a Singapore da kuma yin motsi zuwa ga daidaita hulɗoɗi tare da Washington.

rows.source: Harvard students take course in getting enough rest
rows.output: Daliban Harvard suna ɗaukar darasi a kan samun isasshen hutu
rows.reference: Daliban Harvard sun ɗauki kwas a kan samun isasshen barci

rows.source: A new course at Harvard University this year has got all its undergraduates getting more sleep in a bid to combat the growing macho culture of studying through caffeine-fuelled 'all-nighters.'
rows.output: Wani sabon kwasa-kwas a Jami'ar Harvard a wannan shekarar ya sa dukkan daliban da ke karatun digiri su samu karin barci domin yakar al'adun maza da ke karuwa na karatun dare ta hanyar shan kofi.
rows.reference: Wani sabon kwas a Jami’ar Harvard wannan shekarar ya samar wa dukkan ɗalibansa samun ƙarin barci a cikin wani yinƙuri na dakile girman al’adar ƙarti ta karatu ta hanyar shan kafen ‘dukkan dare.’

rows.source: An academic found students at the world's number one university are often clueless when it comes to the very basics about how to look after themselves.
rows.output: Wani malami ya gano cewa dalibai a jami'ar da ta fi kowa a duniya galibi ba su da masaniya game da abubuwan da suka fi dacewa da su game da yadda za su kula da kansu.
rows.reference: Wani malami ya sami ɗalibai a jami’a ta daya a duniyar yawanci ba su san kome ba idan an zo maganar muhimman abubuwa game da yadda za su kula da kansu.

rows.source: Charles Czeisler, professor of sleep medicine at Harvard Medical School and a specialist at the Brigham and Women's Hospital, designed the course, which he believes is the first of its kind in the US.
rows.output: Charles Czeisler, farfesa a fannin likitancin barci a Jami'ar Harvard da kuma kwararre a Asibitin Brigham da Mata, ya tsara wannan kwasa-kwasan, wanda ya yi imanin cewa shi ne na farko a irinsa a Amurka.
rows.reference: Charles Czeisler, farfesa na maganin barci a Makarantar Koyon Aikin Likita ta Harvard kuma wani kwararre a Brigham da Asibitin Mata, shi ne ya tsara kwas din, wanda ya yi imani shi ne na farko irinsa a cikin Amurka.

rows.source: He was inspired to start the course after giving a talk on the impact sleep deprivation had on learning.
rows.output: Ya samu wahayi ya fara wannan aikin bayan ya yi jawabi kan illar rashin barci da ke yi wa koyo.
rows.reference: An janyo hankalinsa ya fara kwas ɗin bayan ya yi jawabi a kan tasiri na hana barci a kan koyon ilmi.

rows.source: 'At the end of it one girl came up to me and said: 'Why am I only being told this now, in my senior year?'
rows.output: A ƙarshen ta wata yarinya ta zo gare ni ta ce: 'Me ya sa aka gaya mani wannan yanzu, a shekarar karshe ta sakandare ta?'
rows.reference: ‘Daga ƙarshe wata yarinya guda ɗaya ta zo ta same ni ta ce: ‘Me ya sa sai yanzu aka gaya mun wannan, a cikin shekarata ta karshe?’

rows.source: She said no one had ever told her about the importance of sleep - which surprised me,' he told The Telegraph.
rows.output: Ta ce babu wanda ya taba gaya mata muhimmancin barci - wanda ya kaduwa.
rows.reference: Ta ce ba wanda ya taɓa gaya mata game da amfani na barci - abin da ya ba ta mamaki,’ ta faɗa wa The Telegraph.

rows.source: The course, rolled out for the first time this year, explains to students the essentials of how good sleep habits help academic and athletic performance, as well as improve their general wellbeing.
rows.output: Darasin, wanda aka fara gabatar da shi a wannan shekarar, yana bayyana wa ɗalibai abubuwan da suka dace na yadda kyawawan halayen barci ke taimakawa wajen aikin ilimi da wasanni, da kuma inganta lafiyarsu gaba ɗaya.
rows.reference: Kwas ɗin ya fara ne yin lokacin farko a wannan shekarar, inda aka yi bayani ga dalibai fa’idoji na yadda halaye masu kyau na barci ke taimakon aikin koyon ilimi da wasan tsalle-tsalle, har ma da inganta lafiyarsu gaba ɗaya.

rows.source: Paul Barreira, professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and executive director of the university's health services, said the university decided to introduce the course after finding students were seriously sleep deprived during the week.
rows.output: Paul Barreira, farfesa a fannin ilimin halayyar ɗan adam a Jami'ar Harvard da kuma daraktan gudanarwa na sashen lafiya na jami'ar, ya ce jami'ar ta yanke shawarar gabatar da wannan kwasa-kwasan ne bayan gano cewa dalibai suna fama da rashin barci mai tsanani a cikin mako.
rows.reference: Paul Barreira, farfesan ilmin mahaukata a Makarantar Koyon Aikin Asibiti ta Harvard kuma babban darakta na ayyukan lafiya na jami’ar, ya ce jami’ar ta yanke hukunci ne na gabatar da kwas ɗin bayan ta gano ana matuƙar hana ɗalibai yin barci a lokacin mako.

rows.source: The hour long course involves a series of interactive tasks.
rows.output: Akwai sa'o'i na tsawon sa'o'i, wanda ya ƙunshi jerin ayyukan hulɗa.
rows.reference: Kwas mai tsawon sa’a ɗayan ya haɗa ne da jerin wasu ayyukan tattaunawa.

rows.source: In one section there is an image of a dorm room, where students click on coffee cups, curtains, trainers and books to be told about the effects of caffeine and light and how athletic performance is impacted by sleep deficiency, and the importance of a bedtime routine.
rows.output: A cikin wani sashe akwai hoto na dakin kwana, inda ɗalibai ke danna kofuna na kofi, labule, takalma, da littattafai don a faɗa musu game da illolin kafeyin da haske da yadda aikin motsa jiki ke shafar rashin barci, da mahimmancin tsarin barci.
rows.reference: A wani sashe akwai wata sura ta wani ɗakin kwana, inda ɗalibai suka danne kofunan kofi, labulaye, masu horarwa da litattafai don a fada musu illoli na kafen da haske da yadda aikin tsale-tsalle ke tasiri a kan rashin isasshen barci, da amfani na al’adar abin da za a yi lokacin kwanciya.

rows.source: In another section, participants are told how long-term sleep deprivation can increase risks of heart attacks, stroke, depression and cancer.
rows.output: A wani sashe, mahalarta suna samun bayanai kan yadda rashin barci na dogon lokaci zai iya kara hadarin bugun zuciya, bugun jini, damuwa da ciwon daji.
rows.reference: A cikin wani sashen, an gaya wa masu shigan yadda hana barci na zango mai tsawo zai iya ƙara haɗuran hare-haren zuciya, shanyewar jiki, baƙin ciki da sankara.

rows.source: A map of the campus, with interactive icons, then encourages participants to think about their daily routine.
rows.output: Wani taswirar harabar, tare da alamomin hulɗa, sannan yana ƙarfafa mahalarta su yi tunani game da ayyukansu na yau da kullum.
rows.reference: Wata taswirar makarantar, tare da alamomi na ma’amala, sa’an nan ƙarfafa gwiwar masu halartar don tunani game da abin da suke yi a kullum ɗinsu.

rows.source: 'We know it won't change students' behaviour instantly.
rows.output: "Muna da tabbacin ba zai canza halayen ɗalibai nan take ba.
rows.reference: ‘Mun sani ba zai canza ɗabi’ar ɗalibai nan take ba.

rows.source: But we believe they have a right to know - just as you have a right to know the health effects of choosing to smoke cigarettes,' Prof Czeisler added.
rows.output: Amma muna tunanin suna da hakkin sanin - kamar yadda kuke da hakkin sanin illolin lafiya na zabar shan taba, 'in ji Farfesa Czeisler.
rows.reference: Amma mun yi imani suna da ‘yanci su sani - kawai kamar yadda kake da wani ‘yanci na sanin illoli ga lafiya na zaɓan shan sigari,’ Farfesa Czeisler ya ƙara da cewa.

rows.source: The culture of pride in 'pulling an all-nighter' still exists, he said, adding that modern technology and ever-increasing pressure on students meant sleep deprivation was a growing problem.
rows.output: Al'adun alfahari da 'yin karatun dare bai ɓace ba, ya ce, yana ƙara cewa fasahar zamani da kuma matsin lamba da ake yi wa ɗalibai suna nufin rashin barci yana zama matsala mai girma.
rows.reference: Al’adar cika baki a cikin ‘jan dukkan dare’ har yanzu tana nan, inji shi, yana mai ƙari da cewa fasahar zamani da kuma ci gaba da matsi a kan ɗalibai yana nufin hana barci yana fara zama wata matsala mai girma.

rows.source: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.
rows.output: Tabbatar da cewa kana samun isasshen barci, na inganci, ya kamata ya zama makamin sirri ga ɗalibi don yaƙar damuwa, gajiya da damuwa, ya ce - har ma don guje wa yin kiba, saboda rashin barci yana sanya kwakwalwa cikin yanayin yunwa, yana sa su ci abinci a kowane lokaci.
rows.reference: Ya kamata tabbacin samun isasshen barci, wani mai kyau, ya zama wa ɗalibi ‘makami na boye’ don daƙile baƙin ciki, gajiya da tashin hankali, inji shi - ko don guje wa yin ƙiba, saboda hana barci yakan sa ƙwaƙwalwa a cikin yanayin rashin abinci, yana mai sa su koyaushe a yunwa.

rows.source: Raymond So, a 19-year-old Californian studying chemical and physical biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course, having taken one of his classes last year during his first year at Harvard.
rows.output: Raymond So, wani matashi mai shekaru 19 daga California yana karatun kimiyyar sinadarai da kimiyyar jiki, ya taimaka wa Farfesa Czeisler wajen tsara wannan kwasa-kwasan, bayan ya dauki daya daga cikin darussan sa a shekarar da ta gabata a farkon shekararsa a Harvard.
rows.reference: Raymond So, wani mai shekaru 19 dan California mai karanta ilmin sinadarai da ilmin tsirrai da dabbobi na zahiri, shi ya taimaka wa Farfesa Czeisler tsara kwas ɗin, bayan ya ɗauki ɗaya daga ajizuwan shekarar da ta wuce a lokacin shekararsa ta farko a Harvard.

rows.source: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.
rows.output: Ya ce wannan darasi ya bude idanunsa ya kuma zaburar da shi ya yi yunkurin samun wani darasi a dukkanin makarantar.
rows.reference: Ya ce kwas ɗin ya buɗe masa idanuwansa da jan hankali don tura samun kwas ɗin a faɗin makarantar.

rows.source: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.
rows.output: Mataki na gaba, ina fatan, shi ne a nemi duk daliban da suka kammala karatun digiri na biyu su kammala shirin karatun da ya yi kama da wannan kafin su shiga cikin cibiyar gasa.
rows.reference: Yana fatan mataki na gaba, zai nemi dukkan ɗaliban sashen ƙarin karatu bayan digiri su cika irin shiri na karatun kafin su shiga makaranta mai gasar.

rows.source: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.
rows.output: Farfesa Czeisler ya ba da shawarar cewa ɗalibai su yi la'akari da saita ƙararrawa don lokacin da za su yi barci, da kuma lokacin da za su tashi, kuma su san illolin da ke tattare da hasken 'blue' da ke fitowa daga allunan lantarki da fitilun LED, wanda zai iya jefa tsarin juyin halittar jiki cikin rudani, wanda zai haifar da matsalolin barci.
rows.reference: Farfesa Czeisler  ya ba shawarar cewa ya kamata ɗalibai su kula da saita wata faɗakarwa ta lokacin da za su kwanta barci, har ma da lokacin da za su farka, da kuma sanin illolin cutarwa na ‘shuɗin haske’ da ke fitowa daga fuskokin kayayyakin lantarki da haske na LED, wanda zai iya jefa tsarin lafiyarku ta tashi a barci a cikin wani yanayi, wanda zai kai ga matsalolin kasa barci.

rows.source: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men
rows.output: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Kwallon da Menga ta yi ta sa 'yan wasan Rangers suka yi rashin nasara
rows.reference: Livingston 1 da Rangers 0: Cin Menga ya ƙasƙantar da mutanen Gerrard

rows.source: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.
rows.output: Rangers ta sha kashi a wasan da suka yi da Dolly Menga a bugun daga kai sai mai tsaron gida, wanda ya sa Steven Gerrard ya yi rashin nasara a wasan da suka yi da Livingston.
rows.reference: Rangers ta sami koma baya a lokacin da harin Dolly Menga ya taƙaita gefen Steven Gerrard da ya rabu zuwa ga ci 1 da 0 a Livingston.

rows.source: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.
rows.output: Kungiyar Ibrox na neman samun nasarar farko a wajen tun watan Fabrairu da suka doke St Johnstone da ci 4-1. Amma kungiyar Gary Holt ta yi rashin nasara a kan Gerrard a karo na biyu a wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manaja, wanda ya bar kungiyarsa da maki takwas a bayan kungiyar Ladbrokes Premiership ta Hearts.
rows.reference: Gefen Ibrox suna neman su samar da cinsu na farko ne a kan hanyar tun cin nasara ta 4 da 1 a Fabarairu a St Johnstone, amma ƙungiyar Gary Holt ta janyo doke kawai  Gerrard karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 games a matsayin manaja inda ya bar gefensa da ɗigo-ɗigo takwas a ruguje kan hanyar Ladbrokes shugabannin Hearts na Premiership.

rows.source: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.
rows.output: Menga ya buga minti bakwai kafin rabin lokaci, kuma layin Rangers da ke da karancin ilhama bai yi kama da daidaita ba.
rows.reference: Menga sun kai harin ne mintina bakwai kafin rabin lokaci kuma wani bugun gajeren layi na Rangers din a kan jan hankali da bai taɓa kama da yin lebur.

rows.source: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.output: Yayin da Rangers yanzu suka fadi zuwa matsayi na shida, Livingston sun haura zuwa na uku kuma suna bayan Hibernian bisa bambancin kwallaye.
rows.reference: Yayin da Rangers yanzu ta sauka ƙasa zuwa ga matsayi na shida, Livingston kuwa ta hau sama ne zuwa ta uku kuma kawai a bayan Hibernian a kan ci na bambanci.

rows.source: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.
rows.output: Kuma akwai yiwuwar ƙarin matsala ga Rangers bayan da aka yi wa mai layi Calum Spence magani saboda raunin da ya samu a kai bayan wani abu da ake zaton an jefa daga ɓangaren da ba na gida ba.
rows.reference: Kuma za a iya samun ƙarin tashin hankali a ajiye ga Rangers bayan da sai da aka yi jinyar mai lura da layi Calum Spence na wani raunin ka bayan da a bayyane aka jefo wani abu daga ƙarshen wurin.

rows.source: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.
