rows.output: Taron manema labarai na kai tsaye ba kasafai ba ne.
rows.reference: Boyayen jawabin manema labarai na da wuya.

rows.source: In New York this week the president perhaps demonstrated why, making a freewheeling and at times bizarre appearance before gathered reporters.
rows.output: A New York wannan makon shugaban kasa watakila ya nuna dalilin hakan, inda ya yi wani bayani mara tsari kuma wani lokacin abin ban mamaki a gaban masu rubutun labarai.
rows.reference: A Birnin New York wannan satin, shugaban kasa ya nuna dalilin da ya sa, ya ke yin ganin daman sa da kuma fitowa lokuta masu ban mamaki kafin ya tattara manema labarai.

rows.source: Health secretary writes to EU workers at NHS Scotland over Brexit fears
rows.output: Sakataren lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU a NHS Scotland game da damuwar Brexit
rows.reference: Sakataren kiwon lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU a NHS Scotland game da tsoron Brexit

rows.source: The Health Secretary has written to EU staff working in Scotland's NHS to express the country's gratitude and wish for them to stay on post-Brexit.
rows.output: Ma'aikacin Lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU da ke aiki a NHS na Scotland don bayyana godiyar kasar da kuma fatan su ci gaba da zama bayan Brexit.
rows.reference: Sakataren Lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU da ke aikin NHS na Scotland don nuna godiya ga kasar kuma su na so su zauna bayan-Brexit.

rows.source: Jeane Freeman MSP sent a letter with less than six months to go until the UK withdraws from the EU.
rows.output: Jeane Freeman MSP ta aika da wasiƙa da kasa da watanni shida kafin Birtaniya ta fice daga EU.
rows.reference: Jeane Freeman MSP ta aika da wasika kasa da watanni shida don tafiya har sai Birtaniya ta janye daga EU.

rows.source: The Scottish Government has already committed to meet the cost of settled status applications for EU citizens working in its devolved public services.
rows.output: Gwamnatin Scotland ta riga ta yi alkawarin biyan kuɗin aikace-aikacen matsayin da aka kafa ga 'yan ƙasar EU da ke aiki a cikin ayyukanta na gwamnatin da aka raba.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin Scotland ta rigaya ta yi ƙoƙari don saduwa da farashin da za a bi don biyan bukatun 'yan ƙasa na EU waɗanda ke aiki a cikin ayyukan jama'a.

rows.source: In her letter, Ms Freeman wrote: "Over the summer, negotiations between the UK and EU on withdrawal have continued, heading towards expected decisions this autumn.
rows.output: A cikin wasikarta, Ms Freeman ta rubuta: "A cikin watannin bazara, tattaunawa tsakanin Birtaniya da EU kan ficewa sun ci gaba, suna tafiya zuwa ga yanke hukunci da ake sa ran a kai wa lokacin kaka.
rows.reference: A cikin wasikar ta, Ms Freeman ta rubuta: "A lokacin rani, tattaunawar tsakanin Birtaniya da EU a kan janyewa ya ci gaba, zuwa ga yanke shawarar wannan kakan.

rows.source: But the UK Government has also been stepping up its preparations for a possible no-deal scenario.
rows.output: Amma gwamnatin Birtaniya ta kuma fara shirin yin shiri don wata yuwuwar rashin yarjejeniya.
rows.reference: Amma Gwamnatin Birtaniya ta ci gaba da shirye-shirye don yiwuwar rashin daidaitawa.

rows.source: I know this must be a very unsettling time for all of you.
rows.output: Na san wannan lokaci ne mai matukar damuwa ga kowa.
rows.reference: Na san wannan lokaci dole yako rashin natsuwa gare ku duka.

rows.source: That is why I wanted to reiterate now how much I value the contribution of every member of staff, regardless of their nationality.
rows.output: Haka kuma ina so in sake jaddada yadda nake daraja da gudunmawar kowane ma'aikaci, ba tare da la'akari da asalinsa ba.
rows.reference: Shi ya sa nake so in sake nuna yadda kowone ma’aikaci ke da daraja a gudummawar da yake bayarwa, ko dan wane ƙasa ne.

rows.source: Colleagues from across the EU, and beyond, bring valuable experience and skills that strengthen and improve the work of the health service, and benefit the patients and communities we serve.
rows.output: Abokan aiki daga ko'ina cikin EU, da kuma wajen, suna kawo kwarewa da basira da ke kara karfi da inganta aikin sabis na lafiya, kuma suna amfanar marasa lafiya da al'ummomin da muke yi wa hidima.
rows.reference: Abokan aiki daga ko'ina cikin EU, da kuma bayan haka, su na ba da kwarewa mai mahimmanci don ƙarfafawa da inganta aikin kiwon lafiya, da kuma amfani da marasa lafiya da al'ummomin da muke bautawa.

rows.source: Scotland is absolutely your home and we very much want you to stay here."
rows.output: "Scotland ita ce gida mafi kyau kuma muna son ku zauna a nan."
rows.reference: Scotland ta zama cikakken gida kuma munfi son ku zauna nan."

rows.source: Christion Abercrombie Undergoes Emergency Surgery After Suffering Head Injury
rows.output: Christion Abercrombie ya yi aiki cikin gaggawa bayan ya ji rauni a kai
rows.reference: Anyi wa Christion Abercrombie Tiyatar Gaggawa Bayan Raunin da ya Samu a Kai

rows.source: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie underwent emergency surgery after suffering a head injury in Saturday's 31-27 defeat to the Vanderbilt Commodores, the Tennessean's Mike Organ reported.
rows.output: An yi wa ɗan wasan ƙwallon ƙafa na Jihar Tennessee Christion Abercrombie tiyata cikin gaggawa bayan ya ji rauni a kai a wasan da aka yi ranar Asabar 31-27 da Commodores na Jihar Vanderbilt, kamar yadda Tennessean Mike Organ ya ruwaito.
rows.reference: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie aka wa tiyata gaggawa bayan raunin da ya ji a kai ranar Asabar da ta sha kashi 31-27 ga Vanderbilt Commodores, kamfanin Organic na Tennessean suka kawo rehoton.

rows.source: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters the injury happened shortly before halftime.
rows.output: Kociyan kungiyar jihar Tennessee Rod Reed ya gaya wa manema labarai cewa raunin ya faru kusan mintuna kafin a tafi hutun rabin lokaci.
rows.reference: Shugaban kocin Tennessee Rod Reed ya shaida wa manema labaru cewa raunin da ya faru ya faru ne kafin rabin lokaci.

rows.source: "He came to the sideline and just kind of collapsed there," Reed said.
rows.output: Ya zo gefen filin sai kawai ya fadi a wurin.
rows.reference: Ya je daidai layin gefe kuma anan ya fadi”, Reed yace.

rows.source: Trainers and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.
rows.output: Masu horarwa da ma'aikatan likitanci sun ba Abercrombie iskar oxygen a gefen filin wasa kafin su sanya shi a kan gado su kai shi asibiti don ci gaba da tantancewa.
rows.reference: Masu horarwa da ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya sun ba Abercrombie oxygen a kan gefen layi kafin su sanya shi a kan shimfiɗa da kuma mayar da shi don ƙarin kimantawa.

rows.source: An official from Tennessee State told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee, that Abercrombie was out of surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.
rows.output: Wani jami'in gwamnati daga Jihar Tennessee ya gaya wa Chris Harris na WSMV a Nashville, Tennessee, cewa Abercrombie ya fita daga tiyatar da aka yi masa a Cibiyar Kiwon Lafiya ta Vanderbilt.
rows.reference: Jami’in daga Jaha Tennessee ya fada wa Chris Harris na WSMV a Nashville,Tennessee, cewa Abercrobie ya fito daga tiyatar a Asibitin Vanderbilt.

rows.source: Harris added that there are "no details on type/extent of injury yet" and Tennessee State is trying to figure out when the injury occurred.
rows.output: Harris ya kara da cewa, "babu wani bayani kan irin raunin ko tsanani ba tukuna" kuma Jami'ar Tennessee na kokarin gano lokacin da raunin ya faru.
rows.reference: Harris ya kara da cewa "babu cikakkun bayanai akan irin/yawan raunin tukunan" kuma Jihar Tennessee na kokarin gano lokacin da rauni ya faru.

rows.source: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after transferring from Illinois.
rows.output: Abercrombie, wani dan wasan da ya canza sheka, yana cikin kakarsa ta farko a Jihar Tennessee bayan ya koma daga Illinois.
rows.reference: Abercrombie, mai jar rigar sophomore,yana cikin kakar sa na farko tare da Jaha Tennessee bayan canja wuri daga Illinois.

rows.source: He had five total tackles Saturday before exiting the game, which brought his season total to 18 tackles.
rows.output: Ya yi wasu kwallaye guda biyar a ranar Asabar kafin ya fita daga wasan, wanda ya kai jimillar wasannin da ya yi a kakar wasa 18.
rows.reference: Yana da tabi biyar a ranar Asabar kafin fita daga wasan, wanda ya kawo kakarsa har zuwa tabi 18.

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK
rows.output: Masu sayen kaya daga waje za su biya haraji mai yawa idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya
rows.reference: Za a caje masu siya na ƙetare mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK with the extra cash used to help the homeless under new Tory plans
rows.output: Masu sayen kaya daga waje za su biya haraji mai yawa idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya tare da kudin da aka yi amfani da shi wajen taimakon marasa gida a karkashin sabbin shirye-shiryen Tory
rows.reference: Za a caje masu siya na ƙetare mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya tare da karin tsabar kudi da ake amfani da su don taimaka wa marasa gida a karkashin sabon shirin Tory

rows.source: The move will neutralise the success of Corbyn's drive to attract young voters
rows.output: Matakin zai kawar da nasarar da Corbyn ya samu wajen jawo hankalin matasa masu kada kuri'a
rows.reference: Wannan motsi zai kawar da nasarar Corbyn don jawo hankalin matasa masu jefa kuri'a

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on those who are not paying tax in the UK
rows.output: Harajin tambarin zai kasance akan wadanda ba sa biyan haraji a Birtaniya
rows.reference: Aikin hatimi zai yi tasiri a kan waɗanda ba su biyan haraji a Birtaniya

rows.source: The Treasury expects it raise up to £120 million a year- to help the homeless
rows.output: Ma'aikatar Kudi tana sa ran za ta tara har zuwa fam miliyan 120 a kowace shekara - don taimakawa marasa gida
rows.reference: Ma’ajiyar kudin tsammanin tashin sa har zuwa miliyan £120 a kowace shekara - don taimaka wa marasa gida

rows.source: Foreign buyers are set to be charged a higher stamp duty rate when they buy property in the UK - with the extra cash used to help the homeless, Theresa May will announce today.
rows.output: Masu sayen kayayyaki na kasashen waje za su biya kudin haraji mafi girma idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya - tare da kudin da aka tara za a yi amfani da shi wajen taimakon marasa gida, Theresa May za ta sanar a yau.
rows.reference: Ana sa ran masu siyan na ƙetare za a caje su mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya - tare da ƙarin tsabar kuɗin da ake amfani da su don taimaka wa marasa gida, Theresa May za ta sanar a yau.

rows.source: The move will be seen as an attempt to neutralise the success of Jeremy Corbyn's drive to attract young voters with pledges to provide more affordable housing and target high earners.
rows.output: Za a yi la'akari da matakin a matsayin yunƙurin kawar da nasarar Jeremy Corbyn na jan hankalin matasa masu jefa ƙuri'a tare da alkawuran samar da gidaje masu araha da kuma kai wa masu kudi.
rows.reference: Za a ga wannan matakin a matsayin ƙoƙarin kore nasarar da Jeremy Corbyn ya samu domin jawo hankalin matasa masu jefa kuri'a tare da alkawurra don samar da gidaje masu araha da kuma ƙaddara da samar da tsauraran matakai.

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on individuals and firms not paying tax in the UK, with the extra money boosting the Government's drive to combat rough sleeping.
rows.output: Harajin tambarin zai kasance akan mutane da kamfanoni da ba su biyan haraji a Birtaniya, tare da karin kudin da za a samu zai kara karfin gwamnati wajen yaki da barci a kan tituna.
rows.reference: Aikin hatimin zai tashi ga akan daidaiku da kamfani da rashin biyan haraji a Birtaniya, tare da karin kudaden tallafawa gwamnatin ta hanyar magance rashin barci.

rows.source: The surcharge - which is in addition to the present stamp duty, including the higher levels introduced two years ago on second homes and buy-to-lets - could be as much as three per cent.
rows.output: Ƙarin haraji - wanda ke ƙara wa harajin tambari na yanzu, ciki har da mafi girman matakan da aka gabatar shekaru biyu da suka gabata kan gidaje na biyu da gidaje na haya - zai iya kaiwa har zuwa kashi uku cikin dari.
rows.reference: Ƙarin - wanda da yake kari ne ga aikin hatimi na yanzu, ciki har da matakan da aka gabatar a cikin shekaru biyu da suka gabata a kan gidaje biyu da kuma sayen bada haya - zai iya zama kusan kashi uku cikin dari.

rows.source: The Treasury expects the move to raise up to £120 million a year.
rows.output: Ma'aikatar Kudi tana sa ran wannan matakin zai haifar da karin fam miliyan 120 a duk shekara.
rows.reference: Ma’ajiyar kudin na tsammanin tashin sa har zuwa miliyan £120 a shekara.

rows.source: An estimated 13 per cent of new-build London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it harder for first-time buyers to get a foot on the housing ladder.
rows.output: An kiyasta kashi 13 cikin 100 na sabbin gidajen da ake gina a Landan ana sayar da su ga wadanda ba 'yan kasar Birtaniya ba, wanda hakan ke kara tsadar gidaje da kuma sa ya zama da wahala ga masu sayen gidaje na farko su samu damar shiga harkar gidaje.
rows.reference: An kiyasta kimanin kashi 13 cikin dari na sababbin kayan haɗin gine-ginen London ana saye ne daga ‘yan kasar waje masu zama a Britaniya, farashin na hawa kuma yana sa masu sayen farko su wahala wajen samun gidajen shiga.

rows.source: Many wealthy areas of the country - particularly in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time out of the country.
rows.output: Yankuna masu arziki na kasar - musamman a babban birnin - sun zama "gari masu ban tsoro" saboda yawan masu sayen kayayyaki na kasashen waje da ke ciyar da mafi yawan lokacinsu a wajen kasar.
rows.reference: Yawancin yankuna masu arziki a kasar - musamman ma a babban birnin kasar - sun zama "biranen fatalwa" saboda yawan adadin masu saya na kasashen waje waɗanda mafi yawan lokutan basa zaune kasar.

rows.source: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a stamp duty cut to help more young people own their first home.
rows.output: Sabuwar manufar ta zo ne makonni kadan bayan da Boris Johnson ya yi kira da a rage haraji kan tambari don taimakawa karin matasa su mallaki gidansu na farko.
rows.reference: Sabuwar manufofi ya zo ne kawai makonni bayan Boris Johnson ya yi kira ga takaddamar hatimi don taimakawa matasan da suka mallaki gidansu.

rows.source: He accused big construction firms of keeping property prices high by snapping up land but not using it, and urged Mrs May to abandon quotas on affordable homes to fix Britain's "housing disgrace."
rows.output: Ya zargi manyan kamfanonin gini da kiyaye farashin kadarori da yawa ta hanyar sayen filaye amma ba a amfani da su ba, kuma ya bukaci Mrs May ta daina takaita gidaje masu araha don magance "disgrace na gidaje" na Birtaniya.
rows.reference: Ya zargi manyan Kamfanonin gine-gine da ajiye kayyaki masu manyan farashin ta hanyar karbe ƙasa ba tare da yin amfani da ita ba, kuma ya bukaci Mrs May ta bar kudaden shiga kan gidajen don magance "matsalar gidaje a Britaniya.”

rows.source: Mr Corbyn has announced an eye-catching series of proposed housing reforms, including rent controls and an end to "no-fault" evictions.
rows.output: Mista Koriya ya sanar da jerin gyare-gyaren gidaje masu ban sha'awa, ciki har da iya biyan kuɗi da kuma ƙarshen "ba tare da laifi ba" na korar mutane.
rows.reference: Mista Corbyn ya sanar da wani tsari na gyaran gidaje da aka tsara, ciki har da tsarin haya da kuma kawo ƙarshen “rashin-lafin” fitarwa.

rows.source: He also wants to give councils greater powers to build new homes.
rows.output: Haka kuma yana son baiwa majalisu karin iko wajen gina sabbin gidaje.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, yana so ya ba majalisa ikon da zai iya gina gidaje.

rows.source: Mrs May said: "Last year I said I would dedicate my premiership to restoring the British dream - that life should be better for each new generation.
rows.output: Matar May ta ce: "A shekarar da ta gabata na ce zan sadaukar da shugabancina na farko wajen maido da mafarkin Birtaniya - cewa rayuwa ya kamata ta fi kyau ga kowace sabuwar al'umma.
rows.reference: Mrs May tace: "A bara na ce zan keɓe mulki don maido da mafarkin Birtaniya - cewa rayuwa ta fi kyau ga kowane sabon ƙarni.

rows.source: And that means fixing our broken housing market.
rows.output: Kuma hakan na nufin gyara kasuwar gidajenmu da ta karye.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan yana nufin gyaran gidajen kasuwannin da suka rushe.

rows.source: Britain will always be open to people who want to live, work and build a life here.
rows.output: Birtaniya za ta kasance koyaushe tana bude kofa ga mutanen da ke son zama, aiki da gina rayuwa a nan.
rows.reference: Birtaniya za ta kasance a bude ga mutanen da suke so su zauna, aiki da gina rayuwa a nan.

rows.source: However, it cannot be right that it is as easy for individuals who don't live in the UK, as well as foreign-based companies, to buy homes as hard-working British residents.
rows.output: Duk da haka, ba daidai ba ne cewa yana da sauƙi ga mutanen da ba sa zama a Birtaniya, da kuma kamfanonin da ke wajen ƙasar, su sayi gidaje kamar yadda masu aiki tuƙuru na Birtaniya ke yi.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, ba daidai ba ne cewa yana da sauƙi ga mutanen da ba su zaune a Birtaniya, da kuma kamfanoni na kasashen waje, don sayen gidaje a matsayin mazaunan Birtaniya masu wahala.

rows.source: For too many people the dream of home ownership has become all too distant, and the indignity of rough sleeping remains all too real."
rows.output: Ga mutane da yawa, mafarkin mallakar gida ya yi nisa da yawa, kuma rashin kunya na barci a kan titi ya ci gaba da zama gaskiya."
rows.reference: Ga mutane da yawa mafarkin mallakar gida ya zama da nisa sosai, kuma rashin tausayi na mummunar barci yana kara tabbatuwa da gaske. "

rows.source: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'
rows.output: Jack Ross: 'Babban burina shine in gudanar da Scotland'
rows.reference: Jack Ross: 'Babban burin na shi ne in gudanar da Scotland'

rows.source: Sunderland boss Jack Ross says his "ultimate ambition" is to become the Scotland manager at some stage.
rows.output: Kociyan Sunderland Jack Ross ya ce burinsa na karshe shi ne ya zama kocin kungiyar Scotland a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: Shugaban Sunderland Jack Ross ya ce "burinsa" shi ne ya zama kocin Scotland a wani mataki.

rows.source: The Scot, 42, is relishing the challenge of reviving the North-East club, who currently sit third place in League One, three points off the top.
rows.output: Dan Scotland, mai shekaru 42, yana jin daɗin ƙalubalen sake farfado da kulob ɗin Arewa maso Gabas, wanda a halin yanzu yake matsayi na uku a gasar League One, maki uku daga saman.
rows.reference: Scot, mai shekaru 42, yana farin cikin kalubalantar dawoda kungiyar wasan na North-East, wanda a halin yanzu ke zama na uku a League na daya, maki uku daga saman.

rows.source: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren back to the Scottish Premiership last season.
rows.output: Ya koma filin wasa na haske a wannan bazara bayan ya jagoranci St Mirren zuwa gasar Premier ta Scotland a kakar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Ya koma Stadium mai Haske a wannan kakar rani bayan ya jagoranci St Mirren komawa fremiya kakar wasan Scotland.

rows.source: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.
rows.output: Na so in buga wa ƙasata a matsayin ɗan wasa.
rows.reference: "Ina so in buga wa kasarta wasa.

rows.source: I got a B cap and that was it," Ross told BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.output: Na samu B cap kuma hakan ya kare," Ross ya gaya wa BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.reference: Na samu hular B kuma wannan shi ne, "in ji Ross ya shaidawa BBC Scotland’s Muryarwasanni."

rows.source: "But I grew up watching Scotland at Hampden a lot with my dad as a kid, and it is always something that has drawn me back.
rows.output: Amma na girma ina kallon Scotland a Hampden da yawa tare da mahaifina a matsayin yaro, kuma koyaushe wani abu ne da ya ja ni baya.
rows.reference: "Amma na girma da kallon Scotland a Hampden da yawa tare da mahaifina a matsayin yaro, kuma yana da wani abu ke jawoni.

rows.source: That opportunity would only come, though, if I am successful in club management."
rows.output: Wannan damar za ta zo ne kawai, duk da haka, idan na yi nasara a cikin gudanarwar kulob."
rows.reference: Wannan damar za ta zo, duk da haka, idan na ci nasara a gudanar da kungiyar."

rows.source: Ross's predecessors as Sunderland manager include Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet and Paulo Di Canio.
rows.output: Manazarta da suka gabata a matsayin manajan Sunderland sun hada da Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet da Paulo Di Canio.
rows.reference: Wadanda suka gabaci Ross a matsayin masu gudarwa Sunderland sun hada da Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet da Paolo Di Canio.

rows.source: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he felt no trepidation in following such established names at such a big club, having previously rejected overtures from Barnsley and Ipswich Town.
rows.output: Tsohon kocin Alloa Athletic ya ce bai ji tsoro ba wajen bin irin wannan suna a babbar kungiya, bayan da ya ki amincewa da tayin daga Barnsley da Ipswich Town.
rows.reference: Tsohon shugaban Alloa Athletic ya ce ba ya tsoron abin da wadannan sunayen suka kafa a irin wannan babban kungiyar, bayan da yaki tayin Barnsley da Ipswich Town.

rows.source: "Success for me at the moment will be gauged by 'can I return this club to the Premier League?'
rows.output: " Nasara a gare ni a yanzu za a iya tantance ta da 'za a iya dawo da wannan kulob din zuwa gasar Premier?
rows.reference: "Nasara a gare ni a wannan lokacin shi ne 'zan iya mayar da kungiyar zuwa Wasanin Fremiya?'

rows.source: Because of the structure and facilities at this club, it undoubtedly belongs in the Premier League," he said.
rows.output: Saboda tsarin da kayan aiki a wannan kulob din, ba shakka yana cikin gasar Premier," in ji shi.
rows.reference: Saboda tsari da kayayyaki a wannan kungiya, ba abun mamaki ba ne mu na Wassanin Fremiya, "in ji shi.

rows.source: "It is not an easy task to get it there, but I would probably only view myself as being successful here if I can get the club back there."
rows.output: "Ba aikin da ya dace ba ne a samu shi wurin, amma ina ganin kawai zan yi nasara a nan idan zan iya dawo da kulob din wurin."
rows.reference: "Ba abu mai sauki ba ne don samun shi a can, amma zan iya ganin kai na kamar yadda na ci nasara a nan idan na iya samun kungiyar a can."

rows.source: Ross is only three years into his management career, after a period as assistant boss at Dumbarton and a 15-month spell on Hearts' coaching staff.
rows.output: Ross yana da shekaru uku kawai a cikin aikinsa na gudanarwa, bayan wani lokaci a matsayin mataimakin kocin Dumbarton da kuma wani lokaci na watanni 15 a cikin ma'aikatan kocin Hearts.
rows.reference: Shekaru Ross uku ne kawai a aikin gudanarwa, bayan wani lokaci a matsayin mataimakin mai gudanarwa a Dumbarton da kuma watanni 15 a Hearts 'koyon gudanar da wasanni.

rows.source: He then helped Alloa recover from relegation to the third tier, and transformed St Mirren from the brink of relegation to Championship title winners the following season.
rows.output: Sannan ya taimaka wa Alloa dawo da matsayin gasar ta uku, ya kuma canza St Mirren daga kusa da faduwa zuwa gasar zakarun Championship a kakar wasa ta gaba.
rows.reference: Ya kuma taimakawa Alloa ta sake farfadowa zuwa rukuni na uku, kuma ya sake canza St Mirren daga rawar ta taka a gasar zakarun Turai a kakar wasa ta gaba.

rows.source: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he ever did during his playing career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren and Hamilton Academical.
rows.output: Kuma Ross ya ce yana jin daɗi yanzu fiye da yadda ya taɓa ji a duk lokacin wasan ƙwallon ƙafa a Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren da Hamilton Academical.
rows.reference: Kuma Ross ya ce yana jin dadi fiye da yadda ya taba yi a lokacin da yake wasa a Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren da Hamilton Academical.

rows.source: "It was probably a real crossroads," he recalled, of taking charge of Alloa.
rows.output: "Yana yiwuwa wani gagarumin lokaci ne," ya tuna, game da karbar ragamar Alloa.
rows.reference: "Ya zama mai yiyuwa da rudarwa," ya tuna, ya karbi ragamar Alloa.

rows.source: "I genuinely did believe management was the right fit for me, more so than playing.
rows.output: Na yi imani da gaske cewa gudanarwa shine madaidaicin dacewa da ni, fiye da buga wasa.
rows.reference: "Na yi imani da gaske cewa gudanarwa ya fi dacewa da ni, fiye da wasa.

rows.source: It sounds bizarre because I did okay, made a reasonable living out of it, and enjoyed some reasonable highs.
rows.output: Yana da ban mamaki ne saboda na yi daidai, na yi rayuwa mai kyau daga ciki, kuma na ji wasu manyan abubuwa masu kyau.
rows.reference: Yana da ban mamaki saboda na yi kokari, na yi rayuwa mai kyau daga ciki, kuma na ji dadin wasu daukaka.

rows.source: But playing can be tough.
rows.output: Amma yin wasa na iya zama da wahala.
rows.reference: Amma wasa zai iya zama da wuya.

rows.source: There are a lot of things you have to get through on a weekly basis.
rows.output: Akwai abubuwa da yawa da za ku yi aiki da su a kowane mako.
rows.reference: Akwai abubuwa masu yawa da za ka fuskanta a kowane mako-mako.

rows.source: I still go through that in terms of the stresses and pressure of the job but management just feels right.
rows.output: Har yanzu ina wucewa ta hanyar hakan a cikin sharuddan damuwa da matsin lamba na aiki amma gudanarwa kawai yana jin daɗi.
rows.reference: Har yanzu ina ci gaba da wannan batun dangane da matsalolin da matsa lamba na aikin amma gudanarwa na ji daidai.

rows.source: I always wanted to manage and now I am doing it, it feels the most comfortable I have been in my own skin throughout my entire adult life."
rows.output: Ina so in yi aiki da kuma yanzu ina yi, yana jin mafi dadi da na kasance a jikina a duk tsawon rayuwata na babba."
rows.reference: A koyaushe ina so in gudanar kuma yanzu ina yin hakan, ina jin dadi sosai da ina cikin kumbin a tsawon rayuwana."

rows.source: You can listen to the full interview on Sportsound on Sunday, 30 September, on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST
rows.output: Za ka iya sauraron cikakken hirar a kan Sportsound a ranar Lahadi, 30 ga Satumba, a kan Rediyo Scotland tsakanin 12:00 zuwa 13:00 BST
rows.reference: Kuna iya sauraron cikakken tambayoyi game da Wasanni a Lahadi, 30 Satumba, a kan Radio Scotland tsakanin 12:00 da 13:00 BST

rows.source: Perfect time for a pint is 5.30pm on a Saturday, survey finds
rows.output: Lokaci mafi kyau don kwalba na giya shine karfe 5.30 na yamma a ranar Asabar, wani bincike ya gano.
rows.reference: Lokaci cikakken pint shi ne 5.30pm a ranar Asabar, binciken ya nuna

rows.source: The summer heatwave has boosted takings for Britain's struggling pubs but heaped more pressure on restaurant chains.
rows.output: Yanayin zafi na bazara ya kara kudaden shiga ga gidajen giya na Birtaniya da ke fama da matsala, amma ya kara matsin lamba a kan sarkar gidajen cin abinci.
rows.reference: Gudun zafi ya bunkasa shiga wajen shakatawa Birtaniya da ke fafatawa amma ya kara matsa lamba a kan gidajen cin abinci.

rows.source: Pub and bar groups saw sales rise 2.7 per cent in July - but takings in restaurants were down 4.8 per cent, figures revealed.
rows.output: Kungiyoyin mashaya da gidajen giya sun ga cewa tallace-tallace ya karu da kashi 2.7 cikin 100 a watan Yuli - amma kudaden da ake samu a gidajen cin abinci sun ragu da kashi 4.8 cikin 100, bayanan sun nuna.
rows.reference: Wajajen shakatawa da mashaya sun samu tashin ciniki da kashi 2.7 bisa dari, a yuli amma wajajen cin abinci sun sauka da kashi 4.8 cikin dari, adadi sun nuna.

rows.source: Peter Martin, of business consultancy CGA, which compiled the figures, said: "Continued sunshine and England's longer than expected participation in the World Cup meant July followed a similar pattern to the previous month of June, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants were hit even harder.
rows.output: Pita Martin, daga kamfanin shawarwari na kasuwanci CGA, wanda ya tattara lambobin, ya ce: "Ci gaba da hasken rana da kuma shiga Ingila cikin gasar cin kofin duniya fiye da yadda ake tsammani, ya sa watan Yuli ya bi irin wannan tsarin na watan Yuni da ya gabata, lokacin da gidajen giya suka karu da kashi 2.8 cikin dari, sai dai gidajen cin abinci sun fuskanci mummunan sakamako."
rows.reference: Peter Martin, mai kula da harkokin kasuwancin CGA, wanda ya hada da adadi, ya ce: "Ya ci gaba da haskakawa da Ingila fiye da yadda aka sa ran shiga cikin gasar cin kofin duniya a watan Yuli, wanda ya biyo bayan irin wannan yanayin zuwa watan Yuni na baya, a lokacin da aka samu kashi 2.8 cikin dari, sai dai yawancin gidajen cin abinci sun fi taɓuwa.

rows.source: The fall of 1.8 per cent in restaurant trading in June just got worse in July.
rows.output: Faduwar kashi 1.8 cikin 100 na cin abinci a wajen cin abinci a watan Yuni ya yi muni sosai a watan Yuli.
rows.reference: Faduwar kashi 1.8 cikin dari a cinikin sayar da abinci a watan Yuni kawai ya munana a watan Yuli.

rows.source: Drink-led pubs and bars performed by far the strongest with like-for-likes up more than restaurants were down.
rows.output: Gidan shan giya da mashaya da aka yi da giya sun yi mafi kyau, tare da kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-kamar-k
rows.reference: Rumfunan saida abin sha da mashaya sun kara karfi tare da ire-iren sa fiye da gidajen cin abinci da suka kasance kasa.

rows.source: Food-led pubs also suffered in the sun, although not as dramatically as the restaurant operators.
rows.output: Gidan abinci da ke kai wa mutane sun yi fama da zafi, kodayake ba kamar masu gudanar da gidajen cin abinci ba.
rows.reference: Rumfunan sayar da abinci suma sun sha wahala a rana, amma bai kai ga irin na ma’ikatan gidajen cin abinci ba.

rows.source: It seems people just wanted to go out for a drink.
rows.output: Yana kama da mutane kawai suna son fita don sha.
rows.reference: Da alama mutane su na so su fita ne don samun abun sha.

rows.source: Across managed pubs and bars drink sales were up 6.6 per cent for the month, with food down three per cent."
rows.output: A cikin gidajen cin abinci da mashaya da aka sarrafa, sayar da abin sha ya karu da kashi 6.6 cikin 100 na watan, yayin da abinci ya ragu da kashi uku cikin dari."
rows.reference: A duk wuraren da ake gudanar da shan giya da mashayar ababen sha sayarwa ya kai har 6.6 cikin dari na watan, da abinci kasa da kashi uku. "

rows.source: Paul Newman, of leisure and hospitality analysts RSM said: "These results continue the trend we've seen since the end of April.
rows.output: Paul Newman, na masu nazari na hutu da masauki RSM ya ce: "Wadannan sakamakon suna ci gaba da yanayin da muka gani tun karshen watan Afrilu.
rows.reference: Paul Newman, na manazartan shakatawa da karamcin RSM ya ce: "Wadannan sakamakon sun ci gaba da yayi tun daga karshen Afrilu.

rows.source: Weather and the impact of major social or sporting events remain the biggest factors when it comes to sales in the out-of-home market.
rows.output: Yanayi da tasirin manyan abubuwan da suka faru na zamantakewa ko wasanni sun kasance mafi girman abubuwan da ke shafar sayarwa a kasuwar waje.
rows.reference: Yanayi da kuma tasirin manyan abubuwan zamantakewar jama'a ko abubuwan dake faruwa a wasanni sun kasance manyan dalilai idan aka zo maganar sayarwa a kasuwar wajen gida.

rows.source: It comes as no surprise that restaurant groups continue to struggle, albeit a sales drop of 4.8 per cent year-on-year will be particularly painful on top of ongoing cost pressures.
rows.output: Yana da matukar mamaki cewa rukunin gidajen cin abinci suna ci gaba da fama da matsaloli, duk da cewa raguwar kudaden shiga na kashi 4.8 cikin 100 a duk shekara zai zama abin damuwa musamman idan aka yi la'akari da matsin lamba na farashi da ake ci gaba da yi.
rows.reference: Ba abin mamaki ba ne cewa kungiyoyin gidajen cin abinci na ci gaba da gwagwarmaya, don hana faduwar zuwa kashi 4.8 cikin dari a shekara domin zai kasance da tsananin ciwo a kan matsin lamba tsada da ake fuskanta.

rows.source: The long hot summer could not have come at a worse time for food-led operators and time will tell whether the more moderate temperatures we've experienced in August will provide some much-needed respite."
rows.output: Lokacin zafi mai tsawo ba zai iya zuwa a lokacin da ya fi muni ba ga masu gudanar da abinci, kuma lokaci zai nuna ko yanayin zafi mai matsakaici da muka fuskanta a watan Agusta zai ba da sauƙi.
rows.reference: Bazarar zafi mai tsawo ba zai iya zuwa a mafi munin lokaci ba ga masu sarrafa abinci kamar wannan ba kuma lokaci zai fada mafi matsakaicin yanayin da muka fuskanta a watan Agustan zai samar da jinkirin da ake bukata. "

rows.source: Total sales growth across pub and restaurants, including new openings, was 2.7 per cent in July, reflecting the slow down in brand roll-outs.
rows.output: Girman tallace-tallace gabaɗaya a cikin gidajen cin abinci da gidajen cin abinci, gami da sabbin buɗe, ya kasance 2.7 cikin ɗari a watan Yuli, yana nuna raguwar raguwar ayyukan alama.
rows.reference: Jimillar kudaden sayarwa a fadin wuraren shaye-shaye da gidajen cin abinci, wanda ya hada da budewa, ya kasance kashi 2.7 cikin watan Yuli, yana nuna jinkirin a fitarwar kamfanin.

rows.source: The Coffer Peach Tracker industry sales monitor for the UK pub, bar and restaurant sector collects and analyses performance data from 47 operating groups, with a combined turnover of over £9 billion, and is the established industry benchmark.
rows.output: Masana'antar bin diddigin peach na Coffer tana tattara da nazarin bayanan aiki daga ƙungiyoyi 47 masu aiki, tare da jimilar kudaden shiga sama da £9 biliyan, kuma ita ce ma'aunin masana'antu da aka kafa.
rows.reference: Kamfanin Kasuwancin Coffer Peach Tracker na sa idanu ga kamfanonin Birtaniya, yankin mashaya da gidajen cin abinci da ke tattarawa da kuma nazarin tattalin bayanan da aka samu daga kungiyoyi masu aiki 47, da karuwar fiye da dala biliyan 9,kuma shi ne tushen alamar masana'antar.

rows.source: One in five children - some as young as 11 - are creating social media accounts that they keep secret from adults.
rows.output: Daya cikin biyar na yara - wasu kuma suna da shekaru 11 - suna ƙirƙirar asusun kafofin watsa labarai da suke ɓoye daga manya.
rows.reference: Daya cikin yara biyar - wasu har yan shekara 11 - na kirkirar shafin yanar gizo da suke boyema manya.

rows.source: A survey of 20,000 secondary school pupils revealed a rapid growth in "fake Insta" accounts - a reference to photo-sharing site Instagram.
rows.output: An yi bincike na ɗalibai 20,000 na sakandare, wanda ya nuna cewa akwai saurin haɓakar asusun "fake Insta" - wanda ke nufin shafin Instagram na raba hotuna.
rows.reference: Bincike a kan yara yan makaranta 20,000 ya nuna saurin karuwar shafukan “Insta na karya” - nassoshi da raba hotuna a shafin yanar-gizo na Instagram.

rows.source: The news has heightened fears that sexual content is being posted.
rows.output: Labarin ya kara tsananta fargabar cewa abubuwan jima'i ana sanya su a shafin.
rows.reference: Labaren ya kara girmama tsoron cewa ana buga bayanan jima'i.

rows.source: Twenty per cent of pupils said they operate a sanitised "main" account to show parents, while also having private ones.
rows.output: Kashi ashirin cikin dari na dalibai sun ce suna amfani da asusun "mai tsabta" na farko don nuna wa iyayensu, yayin da kuma suna da na sirri.
rows.reference: Kashi ishirin na yaran sun ce su na aiki da "ainihin" tsaftataccen shafin don nunawa iyaye, yayin da suke da na sirri.

rows.source: One mother who stumbled across her 13-year-old's daughter's secret site found a teenager urging others to "rape me."
rows.output: Mahaifiyar da ta yi karo da gidan yanar gizon 'yarta mai shekaru 13 ta samu wata matashiya tana rokon wasu su "yi min fyade."
rows.reference: Wata mahaifiyar da ta yi tuntuɓe da shafin yanar gizon 'yarta mai shekaru 13 na sirri ta sami wata matashiya tana roƙon wasu su "yi min fyade.”

rows.source: The research, by Digital Awareness UK and the Headmasters" and Headmistresses" Conference (HMC) of independent schools, found 40 per cent of 11 to 18-year-olds had two profiles, with half of those admitting to keeping private accounts.
rows.output: Binciken, wanda Digital Awareness UK da kuma taron shugabannin makarantu masu zaman kansu (HMC) suka gudanar, ya gano cewa kashi 40 cikin 100 na yara masu shekaru 11 zuwa 18 suna da bayanai biyu, tare da rabin wadanda suka amince da kiyaye asusun sirri.
rows.reference: Binciken, wayar da kan Dijital UK da shuwagabannin makarantu da shugabar makarantun taron (HMC) din makarantu masu zaman kansu, sun samu kashi 40 na yan shekara 11 zuwa 18 na da bayanai biyu, da rabin su na amincewa su na da shafuka na sirri.

rows.source: HMC chief Mike Buchanan said: "It's disturbing so many teenagers are tempted into creating online spaces where parents and teachers cannot find them."
rows.output: Shugaban HMC Mike Buchanan ya ce: "Abin damuwa ne cewa da yawa daga cikin matasa suna sha'awar ƙirƙirar wuraren yanar gizo inda iyaye da malamai ba za su iya samun su ba."
rows.reference: HMC chief Mike Buchanan ya ce: “Abun damuwa ne matasa da yawa na sha’awar bude shafukan yanar gizo a inda iyaye da malaman su bazasu gano su ba.”

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle will be "voice for athletes" on Scottish Athletics board
rows.output: Eilidh Doyle za ta kasance "muryar 'yan wasa" a kan hukumar wasannin motsa jiki ta Scotland
rows.reference: Eilidh Doyle zai zama "murya ga 'yan wasa" a hukumar wasan ta Scotland

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle has been elected to the board of Scottish Athletics as a non-executive director at the governing body's annual general meeting.
rows.output: An zabi Eilidh Doyle a majalisar kungiyar wasannin motsa jiki ta Scotland a matsayin darakta mara gudanarwa a taron shekara-shekara na hukumar.
rows.reference: An zabi Eilidh Doyle zuwa kwamitin hukumar wasanni ta Scottish a matsayin karamin darekta a babban taron kungiyar gudanarwa na shekara-shekara.

rows.source: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and chairman Ian Beattie described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to benefit from her wide-ranging experience at international level over the past decade.
rows.output: Doyle ita ce mafi kyawun 'yar wasan gudu da tsalle-tsalle a Scotland, kuma shugaban Ian Beattie ya bayyana matakin a matsayin babbar dama ga wadanda ke kula da wasan motsa jiki don amfana daga gogewarta mai fa'ida a matakin kasa da kasa a cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Doyle ne mafi kyawun dan wasan gudu da sauran wasannin fili na Scotland kuma shugaba Ian Beattie ya bayyana cewa wannan matsayi ne mai matukar dama ga waɗanda ke jagorantar wasanni don samun damar amfani da ita a cikin matakin kasa da kasa a cikin shekaru goma da suka wuce.

rows.source: "Eilidh has massive respect across the Scottish, UK and world athletics community and we are sure athletics in Scotland would benefit hugely by bringing her on to the board," Beattie said.
rows.output: "Eilidh tana da girmamawa sosai a cikin al'ummar wasanni na Scotland, Birtaniya da duniya, kuma mun yi imanin cewa wasanni a Scotland za su amfana sosai ta hanyar kawo ta cikin kwamitin."
rows.reference: "Eilidh yana da girmamawa sosai a tsakanin al'ummar Scotland, Birtaniya da kuma kungiyar 'yan wasa na duniya, kuma mun tabbata yan wasa a Scotland za su amfana sosai ta hanyar kawo ta ga kwamitin," Beattie ya ce.

rows.source: Doyle said: "I am keen to act as a voice for athletes and I am hoping I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland."
rows.output: Doyle ya ce: "Ina matukar sha'awar yin aiki a matsayin murya ga 'yan wasa kuma ina fatan zan iya ba da gudummawa sosai kuma in taimaka wajen jagorantar wasan a Scotland."
rows.reference: Doyle ya ce: "Ina sha’awar inyi aikin muryar ga 'yan wasa kuma ina fatan zan iya bada gudunmawata da taimakawa wajen jagorancin wasanni a Scotland."

rows.source: The American, who won the 200 metres and 400 metres at the 1996 Games in Atlanta among his total of four Olympic golds and is now a regular BBC pundit, was left unable to walk after suffering a transient ischemic attack.
rows.output: Amurkawa, wanda ya lashe mita 200 da mita 400 a gasar Olympics ta 1996 a Atlanta a cikin jimillar zinare na Olympics guda hudu, kuma yanzu ya zama mai sharhi na BBC na yau da kullun, an bar shi ba zai iya tafiya ba bayan ya sha fama da bugun jini na wucin gadi.
rows.reference: Ba’amurken, wanda ya lashe gasar tseren mita 200 da mita 400 a wasannin 1996 a Atlanta a jimillar gwalagwalan sa na Olympic guda hudu kuma yanzu shi ne BBC pundit na yau da kullun, ya kasance baya iya tafiya bayan yayi fama da takaitattar cutar rashin jini.

rows.source: He wrote on Twitter: "A month ago today I suffered a stroke.
rows.output: Ya rubuta a shafin Twitter: "Mako guda da ya wuce, na yi harbin jini.
rows.reference: Ya rubuta a Twitter: “Yau wata daya da ya wuce kenen da na samu mutuwar barin jiki.

rows.source: I could not walk.
rows.output: Ba zan iya tafiya ba.
rows.reference: Na kasa tafiya.

rows.source: Doctors said only time will tell if I will recover or to what degree.
rows.output: Likitoci sun ce kawai lokaci ne zai gaya mana ko zan warke ko kuma har zuwa wane mataki.
rows.reference: Likitoci sunce lokaci ne kadai zai iya nuna idan zan warke ko kuma zuwa wane mataki.

rows.source: Its been grueling work but made a full recovery, re-learned how to walk and today doing agility drills!
rows.output: Aikin ya yi wahala amma ya warke gaba daya, ya sake koyon yadda ake tafiya, yau kuma yana yin horon saurin motsa jiki!
rows.reference: Ya kasance aikin grueling amma yayi cikakken farfadowa, sake koyan yadda ake tafiya kuma yau yana yin wasanin motsin jiki mas kara kuzari!

rows.source: Thanks for the messages of encouragement!"
rows.output: Na gode da sakonni na ƙarfafawa!"
rows.reference: Na gode da sakwannin karfafa gwiwar!”

rows.source: Breast pump advert comparing mothers to cows divides opinion online
rows.output: An yi watsi da tallan na injin shayarwa da ke kwatanta uwaye da shanu
rows.reference: Tallar Nau’rar tatsar nono wanda ke kwatanta iyaye mata da shanu ya rarraba ra'ayi a kan yanar gizo

rows.source: A breast pump company has divided opinion online with an advert that compares nursing mothers to cows being milked.
rows.output: Wani kamfanin na famfo na nono ya raba ra'ayoyi a yanar gizo da talla da ke kwatanta uwaye da suka haifi yara da shanu da ake kiwon su.
rows.reference: Wani kamfanin Nau’rar tatsar nono ya rarraba ra'ayi a kan yanar gizo da talla dake kwatanta na iyaye mata masu shayarwa da shanu ana tatsan su.

rows.source: To mark the launch of what is said to be the "world's first silent wearable breast bump," consumer tech company Elvie released a tongue-in-cheek music video-inspired advert to showcase the freedom the new pump gives to expressing mothers.
rows.output: Don nuna kaddamar da abin da ake kira "mabuɗin duniya na farko mara sauti mai sanyi," kamfanin fasahar masu amfani da Elvie ya fitar da wani bidiyo na talla da aka yi wahayi zuwa ga waƙar kiɗa don nuna 'yancin da sabon na'urar ke ba wa uwa masu bayarwa.
rows.reference: Don nuna kaddamar da abin da ake cewa shi ne "na’urar tatsar nono na sakawa a jiki na farko a duniya," kamfanin Elvie mai amfani da fasaha ya ba da tallan labaran kiɗa na launi don nuna 'yanci da sabon famfo ya bayar ga iyaye mata.

rows.source: Four real mothers dance in a hay-filled barn of cows to a track that includes lyrics like: "Yes, I milk myself, but you don't see no tail" and "In case you hadn't noticed these are not udders, they're my boobs."
rows.output: Mata hudu na gaske suna rawa a cikin gidan hay a cikin kaji zuwa wani shiri da ya haɗa da waƙoƙi kamar: "Eh, ina shayar da kaina, amma ba ka ga wani wutsiya ba" da "Idan ba ka gane waɗannan ba ƙwai ne, waɗannan ƙafafuna ne na."
rows.reference: Iyayen gaske mata sunyi rawa a kambu-cike da shanaye ga wakar da ke dauke da kalamai kamar haka: "Na'am,ina tatsar kaina, amma baku ganni da wutsiya ba" kuma "Idan ba ku lura cewa wadannan ba hantsa bane, nonuwa na ne."

rows.source: The chorus continues: "Pump it out, pump it out, I'm feeding them babies, pump it out, pump it out, I'm milking my ladies."
rows.output: Ƙungiyar ta ci gaba: "Ƙara shi, ƙara shi, Ina ciyar da jarirai, ƙara shi, ƙara shi, Ina shayar da matanina."
rows.reference: Ihun ya cigaba: "Matso shi, Matso shi, ina ciyar da su yaran, Matso shi, Matso shi, ina tatse nono matana."

rows.source: However, the advert, which has been published on the firm's Facebook page, has caused controversy online.
rows.output: Duk da haka, tallan, wanda aka buga a shafin Facebook na kamfanin, ya haifar da cece-kuce a yanar gizo.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, tallar, wanda aka buga a shafin yanar gizon kamfanin, ya haifar da rikici a yanar gizo.

rows.source: With 77,000 views and hundreds of comments, the video has received mixed reactions from viewers, with many saying it makes light of the "horrors" of the dairy industry.
rows.output: Tare da dubban 77,000 da kuma ɗaruruwan sharhi, bidiyon ya sami martani iri-iri daga masu kallo, tare da da yawa suna cewa yana yin haske game da "mummunan abubuwan da suka faru" na masana'antar madara.
rows.reference: Tare da ra'ayoyin 77,000 da daruruwan bayanai, bidiyon ya karbi ra’ayoyi mabanbanta daga masu kallo, tare da yawancin maganganun da ya nuna "ƙyama" na masana'antar madara.

rows.source: "Very poor decision using cows to advertise this product.
rows.output: "Yanke shawara mara kyau ne amfani da shanu wajen tallata wannan samfurin.
rows.reference: “Mummunan shawara ne amfani da shanu wajan tallata wannan samfuri.

rows.source: Like us they need to get pregnant and give birth in order to produce milk, except their babies are stolen from them within days of giving birth," one wrote.
rows.output: Kamar mu, suna buƙatar su yi ciki su haifi yara domin su samar da madara, sai dai jariran nasu ana sace su daga gare su cikin kwanaki kaɗan bayan haihuwa," wani ya rubuta.
rows.reference: Kamar mu yakamata suyi ciki su haihu domin samar da madara, sai dai ana sace yayan su daga gurin su bayan haihuwar su,” wani ya rubuta.

rows.source: The Elvie breast pump fits discreetly inside a nursing bra (Elvie/Mother)
rows.output: Mai shayarwa Elvie yana da kyau a cikin rigar ma'aikaciyar jinya (Elvie/Mother)
rows.reference: fumfon nonon Elvie yana shiga sajewa a ciki rigar mama (Elvie/Mother)

rows.source: Another commented: "Understandably traumatic for both mother and baby.
rows.output: Wani ya ce: "Yana da ma'ana ya zama abin damuwa ga uwa da jariri.
rows.reference: wani kuma yace: “A faiyace akwai damuwa ga uwa da jaririn.

rows.source: But yeah why not use them to advertise a breast pump for mothers who get to keep their babies?"
rows.output: Amma eh, me yasa ba za a yi amfani da su wajen tallata na'urar shayarwa ga uwaye da suka samu damar riƙe 'ya'yansu ba?
rows.reference: amma eh don me ba’ayi amfani da tallar famfon nono ga iyaye da ke son ajiya yayan su ba?”

rows.source: Someone else added: "Such an out of touch advert."
rows.output: Wani ya kara da: "Wannan tallan yana da nisa sosai."
rows.reference: wani ma ya kara da: “Tallar bata da ma’ana.”

rows.source: Others defended the advert, with one woman admitting that she found the song "hilarious."
rows.output: Wasu sun kare tallan, tare da wata mata ta yarda cewa ta samu waƙar "mai ban dariya."
rows.reference: Sauran sun kare tallar, tare da wata mace ta yarda cewa ta sami waƙar "da dadi."

rows.source: "I think this is a genus idea.
rows.output: Ina ganin wannan wani ra'ayi ne na jinsi.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin wannan kwararren shawara ce.

rows.source: I would've had one if I was still breastfeeding.
rows.output: Zan yi da ɗaya idan har yanzu ina shayarwa.
rows.reference: dana sayi daya inda ina shayarwa har yanzu.

rows.source: Pumping made me feel exactly like a cow.
rows.output: Yin famfo ya sa na ji kamar shanu.
rows.reference: Tatsowar na sani inji kamar saniya.

rows.source: The advert is a little mad but I took it for what it was.
rows.output: An sanar da tallan yana da ɗan hauka amma na ɗauke shi kamar yadda yake.
rows.reference: tallar gaskiya akwa dan hauka amma na dauke ta yadda ta ke.

rows.source: This is a genius product," one wrote.
rows.output: Wannan samfurin ƙwararren ne," wani ya rubuta.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin wannan kwararren shawara ce,” wani ya rubuta.

rows.source: Another commented: "This is a fun advert aimed at mums who pump (often in their workplaces or toilets) and feel like "cows."
rows.output: Wani ya ce: "Wannan talla ce mai nishadi da aka yi wa mahaifiyar da ke shayar da nono (wanda yawanci a wuraren aiki ko bandakuna suke) kuma ta ji kamar "saniya."
rows.reference: wani kuma yace: “tallar na da nishadi mai manufa ga matan da ke tatsewa (musamman a guraren aiki ko bayan gida) kuma su ji kamar “shanaye.”

rows.source: This is not an advert praising or judging the dairy industry."
rows.output: Wannan ba talla ce da ke yabawa ko hukunta masana'antar madara ba.
rows.reference: wannan ba talla bane na yabo ko shari’ar kamfanin madara.”

rows.source: At the end of the video the group of women reveal they've all been dancing with the discreet pumps tucked in their bras.
rows.output: A ƙarshen bidiyon, ƙungiyar mata sun bayyana cewa duk suna rawa tare da ƙananan famfo da aka ɓoye a cikin rigar su.
rows.reference: a karshen bidio gamayyar matan sun nuna cewa su na ta rawa sanye da nau’rar famfon a rigar nonon su.

rows.source: The concept behind the campaign is based on the insight that many women who breast-pump say they feel like cows.
rows.output: Manufar yakin neman zabe ta dogara ne akan fahimtar cewa da yawa daga cikin matan da ke shayarwa suna cewa suna jin kamar shanu.
rows.reference: Munufan dake tattare da wannan kamfen shi ne game da bincike cewa mata da ke tatso nono na ji kamar shanaye.

rows.source: The Elvie Pump however, is completely silent, has no wires or tubes and fits discreetly inside a nursing bra, giving women the freedom to move, hold their babies, and even go out while pumping.
rows.output: Mai shayarwa Elvie, duk da haka, ba ta da hayaniya, ba ta da wayoyi ko bututu, kuma tana dacewa da kyau a cikin rigar haihuwa, tana baiwa mata damar motsawa, rike jariransu, har ma su fita yayin shayarwa.
rows.reference: fomfo Elvie duk da haka, bashi da kara, ba shi da wayoyi ko shambura kuma yana sajewa cikin rigar nono mai shayarwa, yana ba mata 'yanci su motsawa, su na riƙe da jarirai, har ma sun fita yayin da suke yin famfo.

rows.source: Ana Balarin, partner and ECD at Mother commented: "The Elvie Pump is such a revolutionary product that it deserved a bold and provocative launch.
rows.output: Ana Balarin, abokin tarayya da ECD a Uwar, ta ce: "Elvie Pump wani samfurin da ya canza duniya ne wanda ya cancanci kaddamar da shi da ƙarfi da kuma ƙarfi."
rows.reference: Ana Balarin, abokin tarayya da ECD da iyaye sunyi sharhi: “Famfon Elvie samfurin juyin juya hali ne da ya dace da karfin hali da mummunar gabatarwa.

rows.source: By drawing a parallel between expressing women and dairy cows we wanted to put breast pumping and all its challenges in the spotlight, while demonstrating in an entertaining and relatable way the incredible sense of freedom that the new pump will bring.
rows.output: Ta hanyar jawo kwatancen bayyana mata da shanu masu madara, muna son mu sanya shan nono da duk kalubalen da ke tattare da shi a cikin haske, yayin da muke nuna a cikin nishadi da kuma hanyar da za a iya danganta shi da irin jin dadin 'yanci da sabon na'urar za ta kawo.
rows.reference: Ta hanyar zana layi tsakanin bayyana mata da shanu mun sanya tatsar nono da kuma duk kalubale a cikin hasken, yayin da yake nunawa a cikin wani yanayi mai ban sha'awa da kuma yadda za a iya nuna cewa 'yanci da sabon famfo zai kawo.

rows.source: This is not the first time the Elvie pump has made the headlines.
rows.output: Wannan ba shine karon farko da aka yi wa Elvie fama da suna ba.
rows.reference: wannan ba shi ne karin farko da famfo Elvie ke fitowa a kannun labarai ba.

rows.source: During London Fashion Week, a mother of two appeared on the catwalk for designer Marta Jakubowski while using the product.
rows.output: A lokacin London Fashion Week, wata uwa mai yara biyu ta bayyana a kan titin wasan kwaikwayo ga mai zanen Marta Jakubowski yayin da take amfani da samfurin.
rows.reference: A lokacin London Fashion Week, wata mahaifiyar yara biyu ta bayyana tana tafiyar gayu ga zanen Marta Jakubowski yayin amfani da samfurin.

rows.source: Hundreds of Migrant Children Quietly Moved to a Tent Camp on the Texas Border
rows.output: Dubban Yara Migrant da ke Ƙaura an Ƙaura su zuwa Wurin Gida na Tufafi a Kan Iyakar Texas
rows.reference: Daruruwan yara 'Yan gudun hijira sun tafi a hankali zuwa sansanin alfarma a kan iyakar Texas

rows.source: The number of detained migrant children has spiked even though monthly border crossings have remained relatively unchanged, in part because harsh rhetoric and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it harder to place children with sponsors.
rows.output: Yawan yaran ƙaura da aka kama ya ƙaru duk da cewa yawan shigowar ƙasa a kowane wata ba ya canzawa sosai, a wani ɓangare saboda tsauraran maganganu da manufofin da gwamnatin Trump ta gabatar sun sa ya yi wahala a sanya yara da masu kula da su.
rows.reference: Yawan adadin yara 'yan gudun hijirar da ake tsare da su sun karu ko da yake haɗin kan iyakoki a kowane wata ya kasance ba tare da canzawa ba, a wani bangare saboda rashin amincewa da manufofi da gwamnatin Trump ya gabatar da shi ya sa ya fi ƙarfin sanya yara tare da masu tallafawa.

rows.source: Traditionally, most sponsors have been undocumented immigrants themselves, and have feared jeopardizing their own ability to remain in the country by stepping forward to claim a child.
rows.output: A al'ada, yawancin masu tallafawa sun kasance 'yan gudun hijira ba tare da takardar shaidar ba, kuma sun ji tsoron lalata damar su na ci gaba da zama a kasar ta hanyar fitowa fili don daukar yaro.
rows.reference: A al'adance, yawancin masu tallafawa sun kasance baƙi ne ba tare da izini ba, kuma su na jin tsoro samun daman ikon kansu na kasancewa a cikin ƙasa ta hanyar ci gaba da bukata yara.

rows.source: The risk increased in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult members of their households would have to submit fingerprints, and that the data would be shared with immigration authorities.
rows.output: Hatsarin ya karu a watan Yuni, lokacin da hukumomin tarayya suka sanar da cewa masu daukar nauyin da sauran manya a gidajensu za su bukaci su gabatar da yatsun hannu, kuma bayanan za a raba su da hukumomin shige da fice.
rows.reference: Haɗarin ya haɓaka a watan Yuni, lokacin da hukumomin tarayya suka bayyana cewa masu tallafawa da sauran 'yan ƙananan mazaunan su a gida zasu bada zanen hannun su, kuma za a raba bayanai tare da hukumomin shige da fice.

rows.source: Last week, Matthew Albence, a senior official with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testified before Congress that the agency had arrested dozens of people who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.
rows.output: A makon da ya gabata, Matthew Albence, wani jami'in gudanarwa na Hukumar Shige da Fice da Kula da Iyakoki, ya shaida wa Majalisar Dokoki cewa hukumar ta kama wasu mutane da dama da suka nemi a dauki 'ya'yansu marasa kula.
rows.reference: A makon da ya gabata, Matthew Albence, babban jami'in ma'aikatar kula da Shige da fice da kwastam, ya shaida wa majalisar cewa, hukumar ta kama mutane da dama da suka nemi tallafa wa kananan yara.

rows.source: The agency later confirmed that 70 percent of those arrested did not have prior criminal records.
rows.output: Hukumar ta tabbatar da cewa kashi 70 cikin 100 na wadanda aka kama ba su da tarihin aikata laifuka a baya.
rows.reference: Daga bisani hukumar ta tabbatar da cewar kashi 70 cikin dari na waɗanda aka kama ba su da takardun laifi.

rows.source: "Close to 80 percent of the individuals that are either sponsors or household members of sponsors are here in the country illegally, and a large chunk of those are criminal aliens.
rows.output: "Kusa da kashi 80 cikin 100 na mutanen da ko dai masu daukar nauyin ko mambobin gidan masu daukar nauyi ne a nan a kasar ba bisa ka'ida ba, kuma babban kaso daga cikin wadannan 'yan kasar ne masu laifi.
rows.reference: "Kusan kashi 80 cikin dari na mutanen da suke da goyon baya ko masu goyon baya na gida su na nan a cikin kasar ba tare da izini ba, kuma babban ɓangare na waɗanda su ne masu laifi.

rows.source: So we are continuing to pursue those individuals," Mr. Albence said.
rows.output: Don haka muna ci gaba da farautar wadannan mutane," in ji Mista Albence.
rows.reference: Don haka mu na ci gaba da bin wadannan mutane, "in ji Mr. Albence.

rows.source: Seeking to process the children more quickly, officials introduced new rules that will require some of them to appear in court within a month of being detained, rather than after 60 days, which was the previous standard, according to shelter workers.
rows.output: Yin gaggawar aiwatar da yaran, jami’an sun gabatar da sabbin dokoki da za su bukaci wasu daga cikinsu su bayyana a kotu cikin wata guda da aka kama su, maimakon bayan kwanaki 60, wanda shi ne tsarin da ya gabata, a cewar ma’aikatan sansanin.
rows.reference: Nema don aiwatar da yara da sauri, jami'ai sun gabatar da sababbin ka'idodin da zasu bukaci wasu daga cikinsu su bayyana a kotu a cikin wata daya da aka tsare, maimakon bayan kwanaki 60, wanda shi ne daidaitattun baya, bisa ga ma'aikatan tsari.

rows.source: Many will appear via video conference call, rather than in person, to plead their case for legal status to an immigration judge.
rows.output: Da yawa za su bayyana ta hanyar kiran bidiyo, maimakon a zahiri, don rokon shari'a na matsayin shari'a ga alkalin shige da fice.
rows.reference: Mutane da yawa za su fito ta hanyar kiran taro na bidiyo, maimakon mutum, don yin jigilar su game da shari'a, a matsayin mai hukunci.

rows.source: Those who are deemed ineligible for relief will be swiftly deported.
rows.output: Wadanda aka dauka ba su cancanci a samu taimako ba za a kwashe su cikin sauri.
rows.reference: Waɗanda ake zaton ba su cancanci taimako ba za mu mayar da su.

rows.source: The longer that children remain in custody, the more likely they are to become anxious or depressed, which can lead to violent outbursts or escape attempts, according to shelter workers and reports that have emerged from the system in recent months.
rows.output: Yara da suka tsaya a gidan yari na tsawon lokaci suna da yuwuwar su ji damuwa ko kuma su fuskanci damuwa, wanda zai iya haifar da tashin hankali ko kuma yunkurin tserewa, a cewar ma'aikatan cibiyar da kuma rahotanni da suka fito daga tsarin a cikin watannin baya-bayan nan.
rows.reference: Yawancin yaran su na kasancewa a gidan tsaro, mafi yawan su so samu damuwa ko girgiza, wanda zai iya haifar da tashin hankali ko kuma yunkurin tserewa, bisa ga ma'aikatan tsari da rahotanni da suka fito daga cikin tsarin kwanan nan.

rows.source: Advocates said those concerns are heightened at a larger facility like Tornillo, where signs that a child is struggling are more likely to be overlooked, because of its size.
rows.output: Masu goyon bayan sun ce damuwar ta karu a wani babban wurin kamar Tornillo, inda alamun cewa yaro yana fama da matsala sun fi yiwuwa a yi watsi da su, saboda girman wurin.
rows.reference: Masu bada shawara sun ce wadanada ya shafa su na damuwa sosai a manya gidajen kamar na Tornillo, wurin da alamun cewa yaro na gwagwarmaya na da saukin a kyale shi, saboda girman shi.

rows.source: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.
rows.output: Sun kara da cewa, ƙaura yara zuwa cikin birnin sansani ba tare da samun isasshen lokaci don shirya su ta hankali ko kuma su yi bankwana da abokansu ba, zai iya ƙara waɗanda da yawa ke fama da raɗaɗi.
rows.reference: Sun kara cewa mayar da yara birnin alfarwa ba tare da isashen lokaci a shirya hankalin su ko yi ya wabokanansu sallama ba zai iya kara masu takaici wanda da yawan su ke fama da shi.

rows.source: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately
rows.output: Suriya ta umurci dakarun Amurka, Faransa da Turkiyya da su fice daga kasar nan nan da nan
rows.reference: Sham ta fada wa ‘sojojin mamaya’ na Amurka, Faransa da Turkiya zasu janye ba tare da jinkiri ba

rows.source: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.
rows.output: A yayin da ake magana da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Ministan Harkokin Waje Walid al-Moualem ya kuma yi kira ga 'yan gudun hijira na Siriya da su dawo gida, duk da cewa yakin kasar ya kai shekara takwas.
rows.reference: A jawabi ma Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Ministan Harkokin Waje al-Moualem yayi kira ga masu gudun hijira na da su dawo gida, duk da yakin kasar yanzu yana cikin shekara na takwas.

rows.source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.output: Moualem, wanda kuma yake aiki a matsayin mataimakin firaminista, ya ce dakarun waje suna cikin ƙasar Siriya ba bisa ƙa'ida ba, a ƙarƙashin dalilin yaki da ta'addanci, kuma "za a yi musu hukunci."
rows.reference: Moualem, wanda yake kuma matsayin mataimakin firayam minista, yace sojojin kasar wajen su na Sham ne ba tare da izini ba, a karkashin babatun yaki da ta’addanci, kuma “za’a magance su yadda ya kamata.”

rows.source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
rows.output: "Suna bukatar su fice nan take kuma ba tare da wani sharadi ba," ya gaya wa taron.
rows.reference: “Dole su janye ba tare da jinkiri ba kuma ba tare da wani sharaɗi ba,” ya fada wa taron.

rows.source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
rows.output: Moualem ya tabbatar da cewa "yakin da ake yi da ta'addanci ya kusan ƙare" a Siriya, inda sama da mutane 360,000 suka mutu tun daga shekarar 2011, tare da miliyoyin da suka rasa gidajensu.
rows.reference: Moualem ya dage cewa “yaki da ta’addanci ya kusan karewa” a Sham, wurin da fiye da mutane 360,000 suka rasa rayuwar su tun 2011, tare da rashin gidajen miliyoyin mutane.

rows.source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
rows.output: Ya ce Damaskus za ta ci gaba da "yaki da wannan yaki mai tsarki har sai mun kawar da dukkan yankunan Siriya" daga kungiyoyin ta'addanci da "duk wani kasashen waje mara izini."
rows.reference: ya ce Damascus zata ci gaba da “yakin nan mai sarki har sai an tsarkake dukka yankunan Sham” na duk kungiyoyin ta’addanci da “duk wani jami’i da ke nan ba tare da izini ba.”

rows.source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: Amurka tana da sojoji kusan 2,000 a Siriya, musamman horar da kuma ba da shawara ga duka sojojin Kurdawa da 'yan Siriya da ke adawa da shugaba Bashar al-Assad.
rows.reference: Amurka tana da wasu sojoji 2,000 a Sham, akasarinsu su na ba da horo da shawara wa sojojin Kurdawa da Larabawan Sham da basa son Shugaban kasar Bashar al-Assad.

rows.source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
rows.output: Faransa tana da sojoji sama da 1,000 a kasar da ke fama da yaki.
rows.reference: Faransa tana da fiye da sojoji 1,000 a kasar da ke fama da yakin.

rows.source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
rows.output: A kan batun 'yan gudun hijira, Moualem ya ce yanayin ya dace da su su dawo, kuma ya zargi "wasu kasashen yammacin duniya" da "yada tsoro mara ma'ana" da ya sa 'yan gudun hijira suka daina zuwa.
rows.reference: Akan batun yan gudun hijira, Moualem ya ce yanayin sun gyaru masu su dawo, kuma ya zargi “wasu ƙasashen yammaci” da “yada tsoro mara kyau” da yasa masu gudun hijira suka ƙi dawowa.

rows.source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
rows.output: "Mun kira al'ummar duniya da kungiyoyin agaji da su saukaka wadannan dawowar," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Mun yi kira ga kasashen duniya da kungiyoyin agaji su sauƙaƙe da dawowar su,” ya ce.

rows.source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
rows.output: "Suna siyasantar da wani abu da ya kamata kawai ya zama batun jin kai."
rows.reference: “Su na siyasance abun da zallan batun jin kai ne.”

rows.source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
rows.output: Amurka da Tarayyar Turai sun yi gargadin cewa ba za a samu taimakon sake gina ƙasa ga Siriya ba har sai an cimma yarjejeniyar siyasa tsakanin Assad da adawa don kawo ƙarshen yakin.
rows.reference: Amurka da Kungiyar Turai sun ba da gargadi cewa ba za’a bayar da agajin sake gine-ginen Sham ba har sai an samu yarjejeniya tsakanin Assad da ‘yan adawa ga yakin.

rows.source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
rows.output: Diplomats na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya sun ce yarjejeniyar da aka yi tsakanin Rasha da Turkiyya na kafa wani yanki mai kariya a cikin karshe na karshe na 'yan tawaye na Idlib ya samar da damar ci gaba da tattaunawar siyasa.
rows.reference: ma’aikatan hulɗa na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya sun ce wani yarjejeniya na kwanan nan tsakanin Rasha da Turkiya dan kebe tudun mun tsira a babban yankin karshe da ‘yan adawa suke rike da shi a Idlib ya samar da daman ci gaba da maganganun siyasa.

rows.source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
rows.output: Yarjejeniyar Rasha-Turkiyya ta hana wani babban hari da sojojin Rasha ke goyon bayan su a kasar Siriya suka kai kan lardin, inda mutane miliyan uku ke zaune.
rows.reference: Yarjejeniyar Rasha da Turkiyar ya kawar da babban hari da ‘yan Sham masu goyon bayan Rasha suka kai lardin, wurin da mutane miliyan uku suke zama.

rows.source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
rows.output: Moualem ya jaddada cewa yarjejeniyar tana da "takamaiman lokutan karewa" kuma ya bayyana fatan cewa ayyukan soji za su yi wa masu jihadi, ciki har da 'yan ta'adda daga kungiyar Nusra ta kungiyar Al-Qaeda, wadanda za a kawar da su.
rows.reference: Moualem duk da haka ya jadadda cewa yarjejeniyar ta na da “bayyanannen kwanaki” kuma sun bayyana sa rai cewa aikin sojoji zai mayar da hankali ga ‘yan ta’adda ne tare da mafaɗa daga Nusra Front masu alaka da Al-Qaeda, waɗanda “za’a magance.”

rows.source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
rows.output: Wakilin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya Staffan de Mistura na fatan gudanar da tarurrukan farko na wani kwamiti da ya kunshi mambobi daga gwamnati da kuma jam'iyyun adawa domin tsara kundin tsarin mulkin Syria bayan yakin da kuma kafa hanyar gudanar da zabe.
rows.reference: Wakilin Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya Staffan de Mistura yana sa ran cikin kwanan nan zai kira taron farko na kwamitin wanda ke kunsheda mambobin gwamnati da na ‘yan adawa su rubuta tsarin mulkin kasa bayan yaki na Sham ya kuma buɗe hanyar zabe.

rows.source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
rows.output: Moualem ya bayyana sharuddan da gwamnatin Siriya za ta shiga cikin kwamitin, inda ya ce aikin kwamitin ya takaita ne "kan duba sashe na kundin tsarin mulkin da ake da shi," kuma ya yi gargadi game da tsoma baki.
rows.reference: Moualem ya fitar da sharruɗan da zasu sa gwamnatin Sham ta shiga cikin kwamitin, yana cewa a kuntata aikin bangarorin “zuwa yin bitar dokokin wannan tsarin mulkin na yau,” kuma yana bada gargaɗin tsangwama.

rows.source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
rows.output: Me ya sa Trump Zai Yi Nasara a Zaben Shekara ta Biyu
rows.reference: Abun Da Ya Sa Trump Zai Sake Cin Zabe Karo na Biyu

rows.source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
rows.output: Ta wannan hanyar, Mista Trump zai sake lashe zaben 2020 sai dai, kamar yadda mutane da yawa masu ra'ayin mazan jiya suke fatan, cire shi da kuma rashin kunya za su kawo karshen shugabancinsa da wuri.
rows.reference: Bisa ga wannan dabarar, Mr. Trump zai sake cin zabe karo na biu a 2020 sai dai idan, yadda mambobin jam’iyyar ‘yanci da yawa suke sa rai, tsiguwa da abubuwan kunya sun kawo karshen shugabancin shi kafin lokacin sa.

rows.source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
rows.output: A cikin abin da ba shakka zai zama "Mafi ban mamaki na karshe na shugabanci a kowane lokaci!"
rows.reference: A abun da ba ko gardama zai zama “mafi ban mamakin karshen shugabanci har abada!”

rows.source: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
rows.output: A yanzu, babu alamun gajiya daga masu kallo.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, babu wani alamar gajiyar mai kallo.

rows.source: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
rows.output: Tun daga shekarar 2014, kudin shiga na lokacin aiki ya ninka fiye da miliyan 1.05 a CNN da kusan ninki uku zuwa miliyan 1.6 a MSNBC.
rows.reference: Tun 2014, kididdigar firayim lokaci ya nunku fiye da gida biyu zuwa miliyan 1.05 a CNN da kuma kusan nunki uku zuwa miliyan 1.6 a MSNBC.

rows.source: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.
rows.output: An kiyasta cewa Fox News tana da masu kallo na dare miliyan 2.4, wanda ya karu daga miliyan 1.7 shekaru hudu da suka gabata, bisa ga bayanan Nielsen, kuma MSNBC ta "The Rachel Maddow Show" ta yi fice a cikin jerin abubuwan da suka fi dacewa da masu kallo miliyan 3.5 a daren da labarai suka yi.
rows.reference: Fox News su na da matsakaicin masu kallon firayim lokaci miliyan 2.4, sama daga miliyan 1.7 shekaru huɗu da suka wuce, a cewar Nielsen, da “Wasar Rachel Maddow” na MSNBC ya yi rinjayen kididdigar kebur da masu kallo har zuwa miliyan 3.5 a daren manyan labarai.

rows.source: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.
rows.output: "Wannan wuta ce da mutane ke jan hankali saboda ba wani abu ne da muke fahimta ba," in ji Neal Baer, mai kula da shirin talabijin na ABC "Designated Survivor," game da sakataren majalisar wakilai wanda ya zama shugaban kasa bayan wani hari ya lalata majalisar dokokin Amurka.
rows.reference: “Wannan wuta ne da ake jawo mutane zuwa saboda ba abu ne da muke ganewa ba,” inji Neal Baer, mai gudanar da wasan kwaikwayon ABC “Designated Survivor”, akan sakataren majalisa da ya zama shugaban kasa bayan an kai hari da ya hallaka Capitol.

rows.source: Nell Scovell, a veteran comedy writer and author of "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," has another theory.
rows.output: Nell Scovell, wata marubuciya mai ban dariya mai kwarewa kuma marubuciyar "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," tana da wata ra'ayi.
rows.reference: Nell Scovell, tsohon marubucin ban dariya da kuma marubucin “Kawai Sassan Ban Dariyan: Da Wasu Gaskia Mara Daɗi Akan Yin Laɓaɓa Zuwa Cikin Kungiyar Mazan Hollywood”, yana da wani zato.

rows.source: She remembers a cab ride in Boston before the 2016 election.
rows.output: Ta tuna da tafiya a cikin motar taksi a Boston kafin zaɓen 2016.
rows.reference: Ta tuna wani tafiya a taksi a Boston kafin zaben 2016.

rows.source: The driver told her he would be voting for Mr. Trump.
rows.output: Direban ya gaya mata zai zabi Mista Trump.
rows.reference: Direban ya ce mata zai zabi Mr. Trump.

rows.source: Why? she asked.
rows.output: Me yasa? ta tambaya.
rows.reference: Dan meye? ta tambaya.

rows.source: "He said, "Because he makes me laugh,"" Ms. Scovell told me.
rows.output: "Ya ce, "Saboda yana sa ni dariya,"" Ms. Scovell ta gaya mani.
rows.reference: “Yace, “Saboda yana bani dariya,” Mr. Scovell ta faɗa mun.

rows.source: There is entertainment value in the chaos.
rows.output: Akwai darajar nishaɗi a cikin rudani.
rows.reference: Akwai darajar nishaɗi a hargitsi.

rows.source: Of course, unlike anything else on TV, the story lines coming out of Washington could determine the future of Roe v. Wade, whether immigrant families can reunite and the health of the global economy.
rows.output: Tabbas, ba kamar komai a talabijin ba, layukan labarai daga Washington na iya tantance makomar Roe v. Wade, ko iyalan 'yan gudun hijira za su iya sake haduwa da lafiyar tattalin arzikin duniya.
rows.reference: dama ai, ba kamar duk wani abu dake telebijin ba, labaran dake fitowa daga Washington zasu iya kayyade zaman gaban Roe v. Wade, ko ‘yan gudun hijira zasu iya sake haɗuwa da kuma lafiyar tattalin arzikin duniya.

rows.source: Tuning out is a luxury only the most privileged viewers can afford.
rows.output: Cirewa wani abu ne da kawai masu arziki suke iya yi.
rows.reference: Fitowa alfarma ne da zababbun masu kalo kawai ke iya wa.

rows.source: And yet, it goes beyond being an informed citizen when you find yourself on hour six of watching a panel of experts debate Bob Woodward's use of "deep background" sourcing for his book "Fear," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("a garment thick with hubris," The Washington Post said) and the implications of Stormy Daniels's lurid descriptions of Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.
rows.output: Kuma duk da haka, ya wuce zama ɗan ƙasa mai ilimi lokacin da kake kan sa'a shida na kallon wani kwamiti na masana suna muhawara kan amfani da "bayanin baya" na Bob Woodward don littafinsa "Fear," rigar fuka-fukan da Paul Manafort ya biya dala 15,000 ("kayan da aka yi da fuka-fukan," in ji The Washington Post), da kuma tasirin bayanai masu ban tsoro na Stormy Daniels game da jikin Mr. Trump, um, anatomy.
rows.reference: kuma a hakan, ya wuce zama ɗan kasa sananne idan ka ga kan ka a awa shida na kallon kwamitin gwanaye su na tattauna amfani da “bayanai masu zurfi” na Bob Woodward yana nemar ma littafin shi “Tsoro,” Jaket ɗin fata mai zanen jimina na Paul Manafort mai farashin dala 15,000 (“wani kaya mai kauri da kima,” Washington post sun ce) da kuma muhimmancin tsatsan bayanin, um, jikin Mr Trump da Stormy Daniel ya yi.

rows.source: I, for one, will never look at Super Mario the same way again.
rows.output: Ni, daya daga cikin mutanen nan, ba zan sake kallon Super Mario haka ba.
rows.reference: Ni, Musamman, bazan sake kallon Super Mario kamar yadda na saba ba.

rows.source: "Part of what he's doing that makes it feel like a reality show is that he is feeding you something every night," said Brent Montgomery, chief executive of Wheelhouse Entertainment and the creator of "Pawn Stars," about the Trump show's rotating cast and daily plot twists (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).
rows.output: "Wani ɓangare na abin da yake yi wanda ke sa ya ji kamar shirin gaskiya shi ne cewa yana ciyar da ku wani abu kowace dare," in ji Brent Montgomery, shugaban gudanarwa na Wheelhouse Entertainment kuma mai kirkirar "Pawn Stars," game da nuna Trump na nuna wani ɗan wasa da ke canzawa kowace rana da kuma juyayi (fada da N.F.L., yabon Kim Jong-un).
rows.reference: “Cikin abubuwan da yake yi yana sa ya zama kamar wasan gaskia shi ne yana ciyar da kai wani abu kowane dare,” inji Brent Mongomery, babban shugaban Wheelhouse Entertainment da kuma makerin “Pawn Stars,” akan wasan Trump mai juyin yan wasa da tsari (zabin faɗa da N.F.L, da yabon Kim Jong-un).

rows.source: You can't afford to miss one episode or you're left behind.
rows.output: Ba za ka iya yin watsi da wani shiri ba ko kuma za ka bari a baya.
rows.reference: Ba za ka so ka rasa kowane kashi ba ko a bar ka a baya.

rows.source: When I reached Mr. Fleiss this week, it was a sunny 80 degrees outside his home on the north shore of Kauai, but he was holed up inside watching MSNBC while recording CNN.
rows.output: Lokacin da na kai Mista Fleiss wannan makon, rana ce mai kyau 80 digiri a wajen gidansa a bakin tekun arewa na Kauai, amma yana kulle a ciki yana kallon MSNBC yayin da yake rikodin CNN.
rows.reference: Lokacin da na sami Mr. Fleiss wannan satin, akwai rana sosai har zuwa digiri 80 a wajen gidan shi a arewacin tashar Kauai, amma ya boye a ciki yana kallon MSNBC a yayin da yake rikodin CNN.

rows.source: He couldn't peel himself away, not with Brett Kavanaugh set to face the Senate Judiciary Committee and the future of the Supreme Court hanging in the balance.
rows.output: Bai iya cire kansa ba, ba tare da Brett Kavanaugh da ke shirin fuskantar kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattijai da kuma makomar kotun koli da ke cikin hadari ba.
