rows.source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.output: Moualem, onye na-eje ozi dị ka onye isi ala, kwuru na ndị agha mba ọzọ nọ n'ala Siria n'ụzọ iwu na-akwadoghị, n'okpuru ihe atụ nke ịlụ ọgụ megide iyi ọha egwu, na "a ga-ahazi ha nke ọma."
rows.reference: Moualem, onye na arụkwa ọrụ ka osote praịm minista, kwuru na ndị agha ofesi ahụ nọ n’ala Syrian n’ụzọ gabigara iwu, n’okpuru nzuzo nke iluso ndị alụọ alaa ọgụ, na “a ga-emeso ha omume otu ekwesịrị.”

rows.source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
rows.output: "Ha ga-ewepụ onwe ha ozugbo na-enweghị ọnọdụ ọ bụla," o kwuru n'ọgbakọ ahụ.
rows.reference: “Ha ga-apụrịrị ozugbo na enweghị ọnọdụ ọ bụla,” ọ gwara ọgbakọ ahụ.

rows.source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
rows.output: Moualem kwusiri ike na "agha megide iyi egwu agwụla n'ụzọ dị ukwuu" na Syria, ebe ihe karịrị mmadụ 360,000 anwụọla kemgbe 2011, na nde mmadụ ọzọ a chụpụrụ n'ụlọ ha.
rows.reference: Moualem kwusiri ike na “ọgụ nke ihe ụjọ agwụchaala” na Syria, ebe ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ 360,000 anwụọla na 2011, ebe ọnụọgụ nde ka achụpụrụ n’ụlọ ha.

rows.source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
rows.output: O kwuru na Damaskọs ga-aga n'ihu "ịlụ ọgụ a na-achọsi ike ruo mgbe anyị kpochapụrụ ala ndị Syria niile" nke otu ndị na-eyi ọha egwu abụọ na "onye ọ bụla nọ n'ala mba ọzọ na-enweghị ikike."
rows.reference: O kwuru Damascus ga-aga n’ihu “ịlụ ọgụ a ruo mgbe anyị chụpụrụ ndị alụọ ọlaa Syria niile” maka otu abụọ nke ndị ụjọ yana “ọnụnọ ofesi ọ bụla gabigara iwu.”

rows.source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: Ndị agha United States nwere ihe dị ka ndị agha 2,000 na Syria, bụ́ ndị na-azụ na ndụmọdụ ma ndị agha Kurdish na ndị Arab Syrian na-emegide Onye isi ala Bashar al-Assad.
rows.reference: United States nwere ndị agha 2,000 n’ime Syria, bụkarị maka ọzụzụ na ịnye ndụmọdụ maka ndị agha Kurdish yana Syrian Arabs na agba Onye Isi Ala Bashar al-Assad mgba.

rows.source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
rows.output: Ndị agha France nwere ihe karịrị 1,000 ndị agha n'ala n'ala nke agha na-akpata.
rows.reference: France nwere karịa ndị agha 1,000 n’ala n’obodo ahụ ọgụ mebichagoro.

rows.source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
rows.output: N'ihe gbasara ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ, Moualem kwuru na ọnọdụ dị mma maka ha ịlaghachi, na ọ kwara "ụfọdụ mba ọdịda anyanwụ" maka "ịgbasa ụjọ na-ezighị ezi" nke mere ka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ghara ịlaghachi.
rows.reference: N’okwu maka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ, Moualem kwuru ọnọdụ ndị ahụ dị mma maka ha ịlaghachite, wee tinye ụta n’isi “ụfọdụ obodo ọdịda anyanwụ” maka “ịfesa ụjọ na enweghị isi” nke manyere ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ịnọte aka.

rows.source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
rows.output: "Anyị ekwela ndị obodo mba ụwa na òtù ndị na-enye enyemaka ka ha mee ka a laghachite ndị a."
rows.reference: “Anyị akpọọla ogbe ndị ofesi yana ọgbakọ ndị enyemaka mmadụ iji bido nlaghachite ndị a,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
rows.output: "Ha na-eme ka ihe na-eme ka ọ dị ka ihe gbasara ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị."
rows.reference: “Ha ji ihe kwesịrị ịbụ naanị nsogbu enyemaka mmadụ eme ndọrọndọrọ.”

rows.source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
rows.output: Ndị United States na European Union ekwela nkwa na enweghị enyemaka iji wughachi Syria ruo mgbe e nwere nkwekọrịta ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị n'etiti Assad na ndị mmegide iji kwụsị agha ahụ.
rows.reference: United States na European Union adọọla aka na ntị na agaghị enwe enyemaka nrụgharị maka Syria ruo mgbe enwere nkwekọrịta ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị n’etiti Assad yana ndị mbuso agha iji kwụsị ọgụ ahụ.

rows.source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
rows.output: Ndị nnọchi anya UN na-ekwu na nkwekọrịta n'oge na-adịbeghị anya n'etiti Russia na Turkey iji guzobe ebe nchekwa na ebe ikpeazụ nke nnupụisi, Idlib, emeela ka ohere dịrị iji gaa n'ihu na mkparịta ụka ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị.
rows.reference: Ndị nnọchite UN kwuru na nkwekọrịta nso nso a n’etiti Russia na Turkey iji tọọ mpaghara nchekwa n’ebe ndị mbuso agha ikpeazụ ka siri ike dị na Idlib nọ emepụtala ohere ij wee na achụ okwu ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.

rows.source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
rows.output: Nkwekọrịta Rọshịa-Tọrọkụ a zọpụtara mwakpo buru ibu nke ndị agha Siria nke Rọshịa kwadoro na mpaghara ahụ, ebe nde mmadụ atọ bi.
rows.reference: Mkpebi Russian-Turkish ahụ kwụsịrị nnukwu nluso agha nke ndị agha Syria ndị Russia na akwadobe na mpaghara ahụ, ebe ọnụọgụ nde 3 ndị mmadu bi.

rows.source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
rows.output: Moualem kwuru na nkwekọrịta ahụ nwere "oge doro anya" ma gosipụta olileanya na ihe agha ahụ ga-elekwasị anya na ndị jihadist gụnyere ndị agha sitere na Nusra Front nke jikọtara ya na Al-Qaeda, bụ ndị "ga-akpochapụ."
rows.reference: Moualem kaosiladị kwụsịrị ike na nkwekọrịta ahụ nwere “oge njedebe ndị doro anya” ma kwupute olile anya na mmereme ndị agha ga-achụba ndị jihadist gụnyere ndị ọgụ si na Nusra Front jikọrọ al-Qaeda, ndị “ ga-ekpochapụ.”

rows.source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
rows.output: Onye nnọchi anya UN Staffan de Mistura na-atụ anya ịkpọkọta nzukọ mbụ nke otu ọhụrụ nke gụnyere ndị gọọmentị na ndị mmegide iji dee iwu post-war maka Syria na ịkwado ụzọ maka ntuli aka.
rows.reference: Onye ozi UN Staffan de Mistura na atụ anya ịme nzụkọ izizi ndị ahụ nke ọgbakọ ọhụrụ emepụtara n’ime ndị gọọmentị na ndị otu mbuso agha iji depụta akwụkwọ iwu osote ọgụ maka Syria ma dozie ụzọ maka ntuli aka.

rows.source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
rows.output: Moualem tọrọ ntọala ọnọdụ maka itinye aka n'ọchịchị Siria n'ime kọmitii ahụ, na-ekwu na ọrụ kọmitii ahụ kwesịrị ịdị na "nyocha isiokwu nke iwu ugbu a," ma dọọ aka ná ntị megide ịbanye n'ọrụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Moualem tụsara ọnọdụ maka nsonye gọọmentị Syria n’ọgbakọ ahụ, na ekwu na ọrụ ọgbakọ ahụ kwesịrị ka amachie ya na “inyocha edemede nke akwụkwọ iwu dị ugbu a,” ma dọọ aka na ntị maka itinye aka.

rows.source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
rows.output: Gịnị mere Trump ji ga-emeri oge nke abụọ
rows.reference: Ihe Kpatara Na Trump Ga-emeri Agba Nke Abụọ

rows.source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
rows.output: N'ime echiche ahụ, Maazị Trump ga-emeri ntuli aka 2020 ọzọ, ma ọ bụrụ na, dị ka ọtụtụ ndị na-ekiri ihe nkiri nwere echiche liberal nwere ike ịnọgide na-atụ anya, ịchụpụ na ọdịda nke ọchịchị ya ga-emecha tupu oge eruo.
rows.reference: Site na echiche ahụ, Maazị Trump ga-emeri nhọpụtagharị na 2020 belụsọ na, ebe imirikiti ndị nghọta ezi uche nwere ike ị na atụ anya, mwepu n’oche na agwa ọjọọ ga-akwụsị ọchịchị ya n’oge.

rows.source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
rows.output: N'ime ihe nke ga-abụ "Ihe kachasị mkpa n'ikpeazụ nke onye isi ala!"
rows.reference: N’ihe ga-abụ na enweghị mgbagha “Ngwụcha ikpeazụ nke onye isi ala kachasị dị egwu!”

rows.source: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
rows.output: N'oge a, enweghị ihe ịrịba ama nke ike ịhụ onyonyo.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, enweghị mgbama nke ike ọgwụgwụ nke nlele.

rows.source: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
rows.output: N'afọ 2014, ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-ekiri ihe nkiri n'oge ọkọchị agafeela nde 1.05 na CNN na ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ okpukpu atọ ruo nde 1.6 na MSNBC.
rows.reference: Kemgbe 2014, ogo oge-mgbasa ozi kachasị agbagoola mkpị ruru nde 1.05 na CNN ebe ọ fọdụrụ ntakịrị ka ọ gbagoo mkpị atọ na nde 1.6 na MSNBC.

rows.source: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.
rows.output: Ndị Fox News nwere ihe dị ka nde mmadụ 2.4 na-ekiri n'oge ọkọchị, nke ruru nde mmadụ 1.7 afọ anọ gara aga, dịka Nielsen siri kwuo, na MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-ekiri ihe kachasị elu na kọbọd na ihe ruru nde mmadụ 3.5 na abalị akụkọ dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Fox News nwere ndị nlele oge mgbasa ozi kachasị bụ nde 2.4, gbagoro nde 1.7 n’afọ anọ gara aga, ka Nielsen si kọwaa, na MSNBC “The Rachel Maddow Show” anọrọla n’isi ogo kebụl site na iji ndị nlele nde 3.5 n’abalị akụkọ ndị dị oke mkpa mere.

rows.source: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.
rows.output: "Nke a bụ ọkụ nke ndị mmadụ na-adọta n'ihi na ọ bụghị ihe anyị ghọtara," ka Neal Baer kwuru, onye na-ahazi ihe nkiri ABC "Designated Survivor," gbasara onye odeakwụkwọ kabinet nke ghọrọ onye isi ala mgbe mwakpo na-ebibi Capitol.
rows.reference: “Nke a bụ ọkụ a na adọta ndị mmadụ na ya n’ihi ọ bụ ihe anyị na aghọta,” Neal Baer kwuru, onye ọmenka nke ejije ABC bụ “Designated Survivor,” bụ maka ọde akwụkwọ kabinet bụrụ onye isi ala ka mbuso agha mebichara Capitol.

rows.source: Nell Scovell, a veteran comedy writer and author of "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," has another theory.
rows.output: Nell Scovell, onye na-ede ihe nkiri ọchị na onye edemede nke "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," nwere echiche ọzọ.
rows.reference: Nell Scovell, ọdee ihe ọchị ama ama yana ọdee akwụkwọ nke “Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," nwere echiche ọzọ.

rows.source: She remembers a cab ride in Boston before the 2016 election.
rows.output: Ọ na-echeta ịnya ụgbọ ala tupu ntuli aka nke 2016.
rows.reference: Ọ chetara ọnyịnya ụgbọ ala na Boston tupu nhọpụta 2016.

rows.source: The driver told her he would be voting for Mr. Trump.
rows.output: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ gwara ya na ọ ga-eme ntuli aka maka Maazị Trump.
rows.reference: Ọkwọ ụgbọ ahụ gwara ya na ọ ga-atụnyere Maazị Trump.

rows.source: Why? she asked.
rows.output: Gịnị kpatara? ọ jụrụ.
rows.reference: Maka gịnị? ọ jụrụ.

rows.source: "He said, "Because he makes me laugh,"" Ms. Scovell told me.
rows.output: "Ọ sịrị, "N'ihi na ọ na-eme m ọchị,"" Ms. Scovell gwara m.
rows.reference: “O kwuru, “N’ihi ọ na eme ka m chịa ọchị,”” Nwada Scovell gwara m.

rows.source: There is entertainment value in the chaos.
rows.output: Enwere uru ntụrụndụ n'ọgba aghara ahụ.
rows.reference: Enwere uru ntụrụndụ n’ọgbaghara ahụ.

rows.source: Of course, unlike anything else on TV, the story lines coming out of Washington could determine the future of Roe v. Wade, whether immigrant families can reunite and the health of the global economy.
rows.output: N'ezie, dị iche na ihe ọ bụla ọzọ na TV, akụkọ akụkọ na-esi na Washington pụta nwere ike ikpebi ọdịnihu nke Roe v. Wade, ma ezinụlọ ndị na-abata nwere ike ịgbakọta ọnụ na ahụike nke akụ na ụba ụwa.
rows.reference: N’ezie, nke na adịghị ka ihe ọzọ na Igwe onyonyoo, akụkọ ndị si na Washington apụta ga-ekpebi ọdịnihu nke Roe v. Wade, ma ndị ezinụlọ ndị gbabatara n’obodo nwere ike ijikọtagharị yana ọdịmma nke akụnụba ụwa.

rows.source: Tuning out is a luxury only the most privileged viewers can afford.
rows.output: Igbo: Ịgbachi nkịtị bụ ihe ọṅụ naanị ndị na-ekiri ihe nkiri nwere ike ịkwụ ụgwọ.
rows.reference: Iwepu uche bụ okomoko naanị ndị nlele ji ego nwere ike ịmenwu.

rows.source: And yet, it goes beyond being an informed citizen when you find yourself on hour six of watching a panel of experts debate Bob Woodward's use of "deep background" sourcing for his book "Fear," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("a garment thick with hubris," The Washington Post said) and the implications of Stormy Daniels's lurid descriptions of Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.
rows.output: Ọbụna, ọ na-aga n'ihu ịbụ onye ọchịchị nwere ihe ọmụma mgbe ị na-ahụ onwe gị na elekere isii na-ekiri otu ndị ọkachamara na-arụrụ ọrụ na-eche banyere iji "omimi nke ndabere" nke Bob Woodward maka akwụkwọ ya "Ọnwụ," uwe elu $15,000 nke Paul Manafort ("uwe elu nke juputara na obi ike," akwụkwọ akụkọ Washington Post kwuru) na ihe ọ pụtara
rows.reference: Mana ka ọ dị ugbu a, ọ gafere ịbụ onye amaala ma ihe na eme mgbe ị chọtara onwe gị n’elekere isii nke ị na elele ogwe ndị ọkachamara rụrịta ụka maka ojiji Bob Woodward nke isi “okirikiri miri emi” maka akwụkwọ ya “Fear,” uwe ahụ bọmba akpụkpụ ostrich nke Paul Manafort bụ $15,000 (“uwe juputara na hubris,” The Washington Post kwuru) yana ndapụta nke nkọwapụta Stormy Daniels maka anụahụ Maazị Trump jọrọ njọ.

rows.source: I, for one, will never look at Super Mario the same way again.
rows.output: M, maka otu, agaghị m ele Super Mario anya otu ụzọ ọzọ.
rows.reference: M, agaghị ele Super Mario anya otu m si ahụbu ya ọzọ.

rows.source: "Part of what he's doing that makes it feel like a reality show is that he is feeding you something every night," said Brent Montgomery, chief executive of Wheelhouse Entertainment and the creator of "Pawn Stars," about the Trump show's rotating cast and daily plot twists (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).
rows.output: "Otu n'ime ihe ọ na-eme nke na-eme ka ọ dị ka ihe ngosi eziokwu bụ na ọ na-enye gị ihe ọ bụla kwa abalị," ka Brent Montgomery, onye isi oche nke Wheelhouse Entertainment na onye okike nke "Pawn Stars," kwuru banyere ihe ngosi Trump na-eme ka ndị na-eme ihe nkiri na-agbanwe kwa ụbọchị na atụmatụ (ịlụ ọgụ na N.F.L., na-eto Kim Jong-un).
rows.reference: “Akụkụ nke ihe ọ na eme nke na eme ka ọ dị ka ihe ngosi ntụrụndụ bụ na ọ na enye gị otu ihe kwa abalị,” Brent Montgomery kwuru, onye isi oche nke Wheelhouse Entertainment yana onye mmepụta nke “Pawn Stars”, maka ihe ngosi nke Trump na agbanwe ndị nka yana ntụgharị akụkọ kwa ụbọchị (iluso N.F.L. ọgụ, ito Kim Jong-un).

rows.source: You can't afford to miss one episode or you're left behind.
rows.output: Ị gaghị enwe ike ịhapụ otu ihe omume ma ọ bụ na ị ga-ahapụ ndị ọzọ n'azụ.
rows.reference: Ị kwesịrị ịghara otu nsotanso ma ọ bụ aghara gị.

rows.source: When I reached Mr. Fleiss this week, it was a sunny 80 degrees outside his home on the north shore of Kauai, but he was holed up inside watching MSNBC while recording CNN.
rows.output: Mgbe m rutere Maazị Fleiss n'izu a, ọ bụ ụbọchị anwụ na-acha 80 n'èzí ụlọ ya n'akụkụ ugwu nke Kauai, ma ọ nọ n'ime ụlọ na-ele MSNBC anya ebe ọ na-edekọ CNN.
rows.reference: Mgbe m nwetara Maazị Fleiss n’izu a, anyanwụ nọ na acha digri 80 na ilo be ya dị n’akụkụ osimiri nke ugwu nke Kauai, mana ọ n’ime ụlọ na elele MSNBC ebe ọ na edekọ CNN.

rows.source: He couldn't peel himself away, not with Brett Kavanaugh set to face the Senate Judiciary Committee and the future of the Supreme Court hanging in the balance.
rows.output: Ọ nweghị ike ịpụ, ọbụna na Brett Kavanaugh na-aga n'ihu Senate Judiciary Committee na ọdịnihu nke Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu na-ese n'elu mmiri.
rows.reference: Ọ nwenwughi ike ịdọpụ onwe ya, ọbụghị ka Brett Kavanaugh chọrọ izute Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe nke Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu yana ọdịnihu nke Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị kodoro n’ikuku.

rows.source: "I remember when we were doing all those crazy shows back in the day and people said, "This is the beginning of the end of Western civilization,"" Mr. Fleiss told me.
rows.output: "Ana m echeta mgbe anyị na-eme ihe ngosi ndị ahụ na-adịghị mma n'oge ahụ, ndị mmadụ kwuru, "Nke a bụ mmalite njedebe nke ọha mmadụ ọdịda anyanwụ."
rows.reference: “M chetara mgbe anyị na eme ihe ngosi nzuzu ndị ahụ niile n’oge ochie, ndị mmadụ kwuru, “Nke a bụ mbido nke njedebe mmepe ndị ọdịda anyanwụ,”” Maazị Fleiss gwara m.

rows.source: "I thought it was sort of a joke, but it turns out they were right."
rows.output: "Echere m na ọ bụ ụdị ihe ọchị, ma ọ pụtara na ha kwuru eziokwu."
rows.reference: “M chere na ọ bụ njakịrị, mana ọ pụtara na ha ziri ezi.”

rows.source: Amy Chozick, a writer at large for The Times covering business, politics and media, is the author of the memoir "Chasing Hillary."
rows.output: Amy Chozick, onye edemede na-ahụ maka azụmahịa, ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na mgbasa ozi maka The Times, bụ onye edemede nke akwụkwọ akụkọ "Chasing Hillary."
rows.reference: Amy Chozick, ọdee akwụkwọ maka The Times na ekpuchi azụmahịa, ndọrọndọrọ na mgbasa ozi, bụ ọdee akwụkwọ nke ihe ncheta “Chasing Hillary.”

rows.source: Outside money floods into tightest midterm election House races
rows.output: Mgbasa ozi ego na-abanye n'ọsọ ọsọ nke ntuli aka nke etiti
rows.reference: Ewepuga nsọbanye ego n’agbamọsọ nhọpụta etiti afọ kachasị sie ike maka House

rows.source: It's not surprising that Pennsylvania's 17th is seeing a flood of cash, thanks to a realignment of a congressional districts that landed two incumbents in a race for the same seat.
rows.output: Ọ bụghị ihe ijuanya na Pennsylvania nke iri na asaa na-ahụ nnukwu ego na-abata, n'ihi nhazigharị nke mpaghara ndị omeiwu nke tinyere ndị nọ n'ọkwa ọchịchị abụọ n'ọsọ maka oche otu.
rows.reference: Ọ bụghị ihe ntụnanya na Pennsylvannia nke 17th na ahụ nsọbanye ego, ekele dịịrị nhazigharị nke ogige ndị kọngress nwetara mmadụ abụọ nọ n’ọchịchị ka ha banye n’ọsọ maka otu oche ahụ.

rows.source: This recently redrawn suburban Pittsburg district pits Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - who won his seat in another district in a special election last spring.
rows.output: Nke a bụ mpaghara ime obodo Pittsburg nke a na-ese ọhụrụ nke na-egosi onye omeiwu Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - onye meriri oche ya na mpaghara ọzọ na ntuli aka pụrụ iche n'oge opupu ihe ubi.
rows.reference: Ogige ime obodo Pittsburg esegharịrị nso nso a dowere Rep. Demokrats Conor Lamb - onye meriri oche ya n’ogige ọzọ na nhọpụta pụrụ iche emere na spring gara aga.

rows.source: Lamb is running against another incumbent, Republican Keith Rothfus, who currently represents the old Pennsylvania 12th district, which overlaps heavily with the new 17th.
rows.output: Ehi na-agba ọsọ megide onye ọzọ na-achị, onye Republican bụ Keith Rothfus, onye na-anọchite anya mpaghara Pennsylvania 12 ochie, nke na-ejikọta nke ọma na mpaghara 17 ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: Lamb na azọcha ya onye ọzọ nọkwa n’ọchịchị, Repọblikan Keith Rothfus, onye nke na anọchite ogige Pennsylvania 12th ugbu a, nke na amachi nnukwu n’elu 17th ọhụrụ.

rows.source: The maps were redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the old districts were unconstitutionally gerrymandered in Republicans' favor.
rows.output: E megharịrị maapụ ahụ mgbe Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu nke Pennsylvania kpebiri na Jenụwarị na mpaghara ochie ahụ gosipụtara n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi n'ịkwado ndị Republican.
rows.reference: Esegharịrị maapụ ndị ahụ ka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị nke Pennsylvania mara ikpe na Jenụwarị na ekewapụrụ ogige ndị ochie ahụ n’ụzọ gabigara iwu obodo iji menyere ndị Repoblikan.

rows.source: The race in the new 17th has touched off a campaign finance slugfest between the major party finance arms, the Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.output: Ụmụ nwoke na 17th ọhụrụ ahụ etinyela aka n'ọgụ ego mgbasa ozi n'etiti ndị isi ego nke otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị, Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) na National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.reference: Agbamọsọ ahụ dị na 17th ọhụrụ ebidola nsọbanye ego mgbasa ozi n’etiti ndi nkwado ego ndọrọndọrọ ndi kachasi, nke Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) yana National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).

rows.source: Lamb became a familiar name in Pennsylvania after a narrow win in a widely watched in March special election for Pennsylvania's 18th Congressional District.
rows.output: Lamb ghọrọ aha a ma ama na Pennsylvania mgbe mmeri dị warara na ntuli aka pụrụ iche nke March maka mpaghara Pennsylvania nke iri na asatọ nke Congress.
rows.reference: Lamb bụrụ aha ama ama na Pennsylvania ka ọ nwechara ntakịrị mmeri na nhọpụta pụrụ iche emere na Machị nke ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ lelere maka Ogige Kọngress Pennsylvania nke 18th.

rows.source: That seat had been held by a Republican for over a decade, and President Donald Trump won the district by 20 points.
rows.output: Oche ahụ nọ n'aka onye Republican karịa afọ iri, onyeisiala Donald Trump meriri mpaghara ahụ site na isi iri abụọ.
rows.reference: Onye Repọblikan ji oche ahụ kemgbe afọ iri, Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump ji akara 20 wee merie ogige ahụ.

rows.source: Political pundits have given Democrats a slight edge.
rows.output: Ndị ọkachamara n'ihe gbasara ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị enyela ndị Democrats obere uru.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkachamara ndọrọndọrọ enyela ndị Demọkrats obere nzọụkwụ n’ihu.

rows.source: U.S. Weighed Penalizing El Salvador Over Support for China, Then Backed Off
rows.output: Ndị U.S. na-atụle ịtụ ụtụ isi El Salvador maka nkwado ya maka China, wee kwụsị
rows.reference: U.S. Echere Ịnye El Salvador Ntaramahụhụ Maka Ịkwado China, Wee Kwụsị

rows.source: Diplomats noted that the Dominican Republic and Panama had already recognized Beijing, with little pushback from Washington.
rows.output: Ndị nnọchi anya ndị nnọchi anya kwuru na mba Dominican Republic na Panama enweela ihe ịga nke ọma n'ịmata ọchịchị Beijing, na enweghị nnukwu ihe ịma aka sitere n'aka Washington.
rows.reference: Ndị nnọchite anya rịbara ama na Dominican Republic na Panama akwadola Beijing, enwere obere mgbochi si na Washington.

rows.source: Mr. Trump had a warm meeting with President Juan Carlos Varela of Panama in June 2017 and had a hotel in Panama until partners evicted the Trump Organization's management team.
rows.output: Mazi Trump nwere nzukọ na-enye obi ụtọ na Onye isi ala Juan Carlos Varela nke Panama na June 2017 na o nwere ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na Panama ruo mgbe ndị mmekọ chụpụrụ otu ndị njikwa Trump.
rows.reference: Maazị Trump nwere nzụkọ dị mma n’etiti Onye Isi Ala Juan Carlos Varela nke Panama na Juun 2017 ma banye n’ụlọ nkwari akụ na Panama ruo mgbe ndị mmekọ chụpụrụ otu njikwa nke Ọgbakọ Trump.

rows.source: State Department officials decided to call back the American chiefs of diplomatic missions from El Salvador, the Dominican Republic and Panama over the "recent decisions to no longer recognize Taiwan," Heather Nauert, the department's spokeswoman, said in a statement early this month.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ nke Ụlọ Ọrụ Steeti kpebiri ịkpọghachi ndị isi ndị nnọchi anya America na El Salvador, Republic Dominican na Panama n'ihi "mkpebi ndị na-adịbeghị anya ịkwụsị ịmata Taiwan," ka Heather Nauert, onye na-ekwuchitere ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kwuru n'okwu nke ọnwa a.
rows.reference: Ndị ụlọ ọrụ Ngalaba Steeti kpebiri ịkpọghachite ndị isi njem nnọchite anya ndị America si El Salvador, Dominican Republic na Panama maka “mkpebi nso nso iji kwụsị ịkwado Taiwan,” Heather Nauert, onye okwu okwu nke ngalaba ahụ, kwuru na nkwupute na mbido ọnwa a.

rows.source: But penalties were only considered against El Salvador, which received an estimated $140 million in American aid in 2017, including for narcotics controls, development and economic support.
rows.output: Mana ntaramahụhụ bụ naanị ihe a na-atụle megide El Salvador, nke natara ihe dị ka nde $140 na enyemaka America na 2017, gụnyere maka njikwa ọgwụ ọjọọ, mmepe na nkwado akụ na ụba.
rows.reference: Mana atụlere ntaramahụhụ naanị maka El Salvador, nke nwetara ihe rutere ọnụọgụ nde $140 n’enyemaka si n’aka America na 2017, gụnyere njikwa ọgwụ ike, nkwado ntolite na akụnụba.

rows.source: The proposed penalties, which included cuts to financial aid and targeted visa restrictions, would have been painful for the Central American country and its high unemployment and murder rates.
rows.output: Ntuziaka ntaramahụhụ ndị a tụrụ aro, nke gụnyere mbelata ego enyemaka ego na mmachi visa e mere atụmatụ, gaara abụ ihe mgbu nye obodo Central America na ọnụ ọgụgụ enweghị ọrụ dị elu na ọnụ ọgụgụ igbu mmadụ dị elu.
rows.reference: Ntaramahụhụ ndị ahụ atụnyere, nke gụnyere mgbubi n’enyemaka ego yana mmachi visa ndị a ga-ezube iche, kwesịrị ịbụ ihe nhịahụ maka obodo Central America ahụ yana ogo enweghị ọrụ na igbu mmadụ ya.

rows.source: As internal meetings progressed, North American and Central American officials postponed a high-level conference focused on security and economic prosperity to follow up a similar gathering last year that was seen as a step forward in efforts to prevent migrants from heading to the United States.
rows.output: Ka ọ dị ugbu a, ndị ọrụ North America na Central America kwụsịtụrụ nzukọ dị elu nke lekwasịrị anya na nchekwa na ọganihu akụ na ụba iji soro nzukọ yiri nke ahụ n'afọ gara aga, nke a na-ahụta dị ka ihe ịga nke ọma n'ịgbalị igbochi ndị na-achọ ịbata na United States.
rows.reference: Ka nzụkọ ime ụlọ gara n’ihu, ndị ọrụ North America na Central America bugharịrị ọgbakọ ogo-dị-elu gbadoro anya na nchedo na ntolite akụnụba iji sochie otu mgbakọta ụdịrị ahụ n’afọ gara aga nke ahụrụ ka nzọụkwụ n’ọganihu na mbọ iji gbochie ndị mgbabata n’obodo na ịga na United States.

rows.source: But by mid-September, top administration officials made clear that they wanted the conference to go forward, effectively ending any consideration of penalties for El Salvador.
rows.output: Ma site na etiti Septemba, ndị isi ọchịchị kacha elu gosipụtara na ha chọrọ ka ogbako ahụ gaa n'ihu, nke mere ka a kwụsịtụ iche echiche banyere ntaramahụhụ maka El Salvador.
rows.reference: Mana tupu etiti-Septemba, ndị ọrụ nchịkwa dị elu mere ka o doo anya na ha chọrọ ka nzụkọ ahụ gaa n’ihu, na akwụsị ntụle ọ bụla maka ntaramahụhụ maka El Salvador ozugbo.

rows.source: Vice President Mike Pence is now slated to address the conference, now scheduled for mid-October, in a signal of the import the administration places on the gathering, the diplomats said.
rows.output: Onye isi oche nke United States, Mike Pence, a ga-ekwu okwu na nzukọ ahụ, nke a ga-eme na etiti Ọktoba, dị ka ihe ngosi nke mkpa ọ dị n'ọgbakọ ahụ, ndị nnọchi anya ahụ kwuru.
rows.reference: Atọrọ ka Osote Onye Isi Ala Mike Pence zute ọgbakọ ahụ, nke atọrọ ugbu a na etiti-Ọktoba, na mgbama nke mkpa nke nchịkwa ahụ dowere na nzụkọ ndị ahụ, ndị nnọchite anya ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: And the three American envoys quietly returned to El Salvador, Panama and the Dominican Republic with no new tough messages or punishments from Washington.
rows.output: Na ndị nnọchi anya America atọ ahụ laghachiri n'udo na El Salvador, Panama na Dominican Republic na-enweghị ozi ọhụrụ siri ike ma ọ bụ ntaramahụhụ site na Washington.
rows.reference: Ndị ozi America atọ ahụ jiri nwayọ laghachi El Salvador, Panama na Dominican Republic na enweghị ozi ike ma ọ bụ ntaramahụhụ ọhụrụ si na Washington.

rows.source: A White House spokesman for Mr. Bolton declined to comment on the details of the debate that were described by the three American officials, including two diplomats, who agreed to discuss the internal deliberations on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Onye na-ekwuchitere ụlọ ọrụ White House maka Maazị Bolton jụrụ ikwu okwu banyere nkọwa nke arụmụka ahụ nke ndị ọrụ America atọ, gụnyere ndị nnọchi anya abụọ, kwetara ikwu banyere mkparịta ụka n'ime ụlọ n'okpuru ọnọdụ aha na-adịghị.
rows.reference: Onye nkwuchite White House maka Maazị Bolton jụrụ ikwu okwu na nkọwapụta nke nrụrịta ụka ahụ nke ndị ọrụ America atọ ahụ kọwara, gụnyere ndị nnọchite anya abụọ, ndị kwenyere ịkparịta arụmarụ ndị ime ụlọ ahụ n’ọnọdụ nke nzuzo.

rows.source: Their accounts were corroborated by an outside analyst who is close to the administration and also spoke on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Akwụkwọ ndekọ ha kwekọrọ na onye nyocha nọ n'èzí nke dị nso na ọchịchị ahụ ma kwuo ya n'okpuru ọnọdụ nke amaghị aha.
rows.reference: Onye nyocha mpụga kwadoro akụkọ ha, onye nọ nso na nchịkwa ahụ ma kwukwaa okwu n’ọnọdụ nke nzuzo.

rows.source: Study History
rows.output: Mụta akụkọ ihe mere eme
rows.reference: Ndekọ Mmụta

rows.source: The next shoe to drop could be the special counsel Robert Mueller's report on Mr. Trump's possible obstruction of justice, of which there now is very substantial evidence in the public record.
rows.output: Nke na-esote akpụkpọ ụkwụ ịdaba nwere ike ịbụ akụkọ pụrụ iche nke Robert Mueller, akụkọ banyere ihe Mr. Trump nwere ike ime iji gbochie ikpe ziri ezi, nke ugbu a nwere ihe akaebe dị ukwuu n'akwụkwọ ndekọ ọha.
rows.reference: Akpụkpụ ụkwụ na esote a ga-edowe nwere ike ịbụ mkpesa nke kansụl pụrụ iche nke Robert Mueller maka ọmụme ndachi nke akwụmọtọ n’aka Maazị Trump, nke enwere ihe akaebe doro anya dị na ndekọ ọhaneze.

rows.source: Mr. Mueller is reportedly also turning his investigation to whether Mr. Trump's campaign colluded with Russia in its attack on our elections.
rows.output: Nna-ukwu Mueller na-ekwu na ọ na-eleba anya ma ọ bụrụ na mkpọsa Mr. Trump na-arụkọ ọrụ na Rọshịa n'oge mwakpo ha wakporo ntuli aka anyị.
rows.reference: Ekpesara na Maazị Mueller na atụgharịkwa ka nyocha ya bụrụ ma ndị mgbasa ozi Maazị Trump na Russia ejikọrọ aka na mbuso agha ya na ntuli aka anyị.

rows.source: Should Congress change hands, Mr. Trump will find himself facing accountability in that body, just as he prepares to go again before the voters, and perhaps eventually a jury of his peers.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na Congress gbanwee aka, Maazị Trump ga-ahụ onwe ya na-eche ịza ajụjụ n'ime ahụ, dị ka ọ na-akwado ịga ọzọ n'ihu ndị ntuli aka, ma eleghị anya n'ikpe ikpe nke ndị ọgbọ ya.
rows.reference: Kọngress ahụ ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aka, Maazị Trump ga-ahụ onwe ya na eche ajụjụ na nke ahụ, ka ọ na akwadobe ịga ọzọ n’ihu ndị ntuli aka, ma ikekwe emechaa n’ihu ndị ọkaikpe nke ndị ọgbọ ya.

rows.source: That is a lot of ifs, and I do not mean to suggest that Mr. Trump's fall is inevitable - nor that of his equivalents in Europe.
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ ọtụtụ ma ọ bụrụ, na m anaghị ekwu na mgbada nke Maazị Trump bụ ihe a na-apụghị izere ezere - ma ọ bụ nke ndị yiri ya na Europe.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ bụ ọtụtụ enwee ike, ọ bụghị na m chọrọ ịtụnye na ọdịda Maazị Trump ga-abịarịrị - ma ọ bụ nke ndị otu ya na Europe.

rows.source: There are choices to be made by all of us on both sides of the Atlantic that will affect how prolonged the struggle may be.
rows.output: Enwere nhọrọ ndị a ga-eme site n'aka anyị niile n'akụkụ abụọ nke Atlantic nke ga-emetụta ogologo oge agha ahụ nwere ike ịdị.
rows.reference: Enwere mkpebi anyị niile ga-eme n’akụkụ abụọ nke Atlantik ga-emetụta ogologo oge ole mgba ahụ ga-abụ.

rows.source: In 1938, German officers were ready to stage a coup d"état against Hitler, if only the West had resisted him and backed the Czechoslovaks at Munich.
rows.output: N'afọ 1938, ndị ọrụ German dị njikere ịkwado ọchịchị aka ike megide Hitler, ma ọ bụrụ na ọdịda anyanwụ emeghị ya ma kwado ndị Czechoslovak na Munich.
rows.reference: Na 1938, ndị ọrụ Germany dị njikere ịnapụ ọchịchị n’aka Hitler, ọ bụrụ na Ọdịda Anyanwụ gbochiri ya ma kwadobe ndị Czechoslovaks na Munich.

rows.source: We failed, and missed an opportunity to avoid the years of carnage that ensued.
rows.output: Anyị dara, ma tụfuo ohere ịzere ọtụtụ afọ nke ọbara ọgbụgba nke sochiri ya.
rows.reference: Anyị dara, ma ghara ohere iji zere afọ nke nnukwu mbibi merenụ.

rows.source: The course of history pivots around such inflection points, and democracy's inexorable march is accelerated or delayed.
rows.output: Nke a na-eme ka ọdịnihu nke akụkọ ihe mere eme na-akpụ akpụ, na ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na-aga n'ihu na-aga n'ihu ma ọ bụ na-egbu oge.
rows.reference: Usoro nke akụkọ ala na agbagharị n’ụdịrị isi mgbanwe ahụ, ọgụga ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na anaghị akwụsị akwụsị ga-aga n’ihu ma ọ bụ gbutu oge.

rows.source: Americans face several of these inflection points now.
rows.output: Ndị America na-eche ọtụtụ n'ime isi ihe ndị a ihu ugbu a.
rows.reference: Ndị America na eche ọtụtụ isi mgbanwe ugbu a.

rows.source: What will we do if Mr. Trump fires Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, the man who controls the fate of Mr. Mueller's investigation?
rows.output: Kedu ihe anyị ga-eme ma Maazị Trump chụpụrụ onye osote onye ọka ikpe, Maazị Rod Rosenstein, onye na-achịkwa ọdịnihu nyocha nke Maazị Mueller?
rows.reference: Gịnị ka anyị ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na Maazị Trump chụọ Osote Ọkaiwu Obodo General Rod Rosenstein, nwoke na ejikwa akaraka nke nyocha Maazị Mueller?

rows.source: Rosenstein has been in hot water ever since this paper reported that, last year, he suggested secretly recording the president and speculated about his being unfit for office.
rows.output: Rosenstein nọ n'ime mmiri ọkụ kemgbe akwụkwọ akụkọ a kọrọ na n'afọ gara aga, o kwuru na ọ ga-achọ ịdekọ onye isi ala n'ezoghị ọnụ ma na-eche banyere ịdị mma ya n'ọfịs.
rows.reference: Rosenstein anọrọla na nnukwu nsogbu kemgbe akwụkwọ a kpesara nke ahụ, afọ gara aga, ọ tụnyere ịdekọ onye isi ala na nzuzo ma boo ebubo na ọ dịghị mma maka ụlọ ọrụ.

rows.source: Mr. Rosenstein says The Times's account is inaccurate.
rows.output: Maazị Rosenstein na-ekwu na akụkọ Times adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Maazị Rosentein kwuru akụkọ nke The Times ezighi ezi.

rows.source: "How will we respond if the newly requested F.B.I. investigation of Brett Kavanaugh is not full or fair - or if he is confirmed to the Supreme Court despite credible accusations of sexual assault and dishonest testimony?
rows.output: "Kedu ka anyị ga-esi zaghachi ma ọ bụrụ na nyocha F.B.I. ọhụrụ nke Brett Kavanaugh adịghị zuru oke ma ọ bụ nke ziri ezi - ma ọ bụ ma ọ bụrụ na a họpụtara ya n'Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu n'agbanyeghị ebubo siri ike nke mwakpo mmekọahụ na ụgha n'okwu ya?"
rows.reference: “Kedu otu anyị ga-esi zaghachi ma ọ bụrụ na nnyocha F.B.I ọhụrụ arịrịọ maka Brett Kavanaugh emeghị n’uju ma ọ bụ dị mma - ma ọ bụ ọ bụrụ na etinye ya na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị agbanyeghị ebubo nke nwakpo nwanyị doro anya yana ihe akaebe na ezighi ezi?

rows.source: And above all, will we vote in the midterms for a Congress that will hold Mr. Trump accountable?
rows.output: Na n'elu nke ahụ, ọ̀ ga-abụ na anyị ga-eme ntuli aka na etiti oge maka ọgbakọ nke ga-aza ajụjụ Maazị Trump?
rows.reference: N’isi ihe niile, anyị ga-eme ntuli aka n’etiti afọ maka Kọngress nke ga-ejide Maazị Trump n’ọrụ?

rows.source: If we fail those tests, democracy will be in for a long winter.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na anyị emeghị nke ọma n'ule ndị ahụ, ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya ga-abanye n'oge oyi ogologo.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na anyị daa nnwale ndị ahụ, ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya ga-akwadobe maka oge njụmoyi toro ogologo.

rows.source: But I believe we will not fail, because of the lesson I learned in Prague.
rows.output: Ma m na-ekweta na anyị agaghị ada, n’ihi nkuzi m mụtara na Prague.
rows.reference: Mana ekwenyere m na anyị agaghị ada, n’ihi ihe ndị mụtara na Prague.

rows.source: My mother was a Czechoslovak Jew who was deported to Auschwitz by the same Nazi regime that once occupied my ambassadorial home.
rows.output: Nne m bụ onye Juu Czechoslovak bụ ndị Nazi chụpụrụ n'ogige mkpọrọ Auschwitz nke otu ọchịchị Nazi nke jikwa ụlọ nnọchite anya m n'oge gara aga.
rows.reference: Nne m bụ onye Czechslovak Jew onye nke achụpụrụ na Auschwitz n’otu aka ndị ọchịchị Nazi ahụ nọchiri ụlọ ebe nnọchite m.

rows.source: She survived, immigrated to America and, 60 years later, sent me off to light Sabbath candles on that table bearing the swastika.
rows.output: Ọ dị ndụ, kwaga America ma, afọ iri isii ka e mesịrị, zitere m ebe a na-akụ ọkụ kandụl Sabbath n'elu tebụl nke nwere swastika.
rows.reference: Ọ dị ndụ, gbabata na America ma, ka afọ 60 gachara, zipuru m gaa kandụl Sabbath ọkụ n’elu tebul ahụ bụ swastika.

rows.source: With that as my heritage, how can I not be an optimist about our future?"
rows.output: N'ime ihe nketa ahụ, kedu ka m ga-esi ghara ịbụ onye na-enwe olileanya maka ọdịnihu anyị?"
rows.reference: Ka nke ahụ bụ ọdịbendị m, kedu otu m ga-esi nwee ezigbo olile anya maka ọdịnihu anyị?”

rows.source: Norman Eisen, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, is the chairman of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington and the author of "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.output: Norman Eisen, onye ọkachamara n'ọrụ na Ụlọ Akwụkwọ Brookings, bụ onye isi oche nke Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington na onye edemede nke "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.reference: Norman Eisen, otu okenye na Ewumewu Brookings, bụ onye isi oche nke Ndị Amaala maka Ọrụ na Omume na Washington yana ọdee akwụkwọ nke “The Last Palace: Narị Afọ Ọgbaghara nke Europe na Five Lives and One Legendary House.”

rows.source: Rangers' Graham Dorrans optimistic ahead of Rapid Vienna clash
rows.output: Ndị Rangers' Graham Dorrans na-enwe olileanya tupu ọgụ ha na Rapid Vienna
rows.reference: Graham Dorrans nke Rangers nwere ezigbo olile anya maka asọmpi Rapid Vienna

rows.source: Rangers host Rapid Vienna on Thursday, knowing that victory over the Austrians, following the impressive draw in Spain against Villarreal earlier this month, will put them in a strong position to qualify from Group G of the Europa League.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers na-akwado Vienna na Tọzdee, na-ama na mmeri ha meriri ndị Austria, na-esote mmeri dị egwu ha meriri Villarreal na Spain n'oge gara aga n'ọnwa a, ga-etinye ha n'ọnọdụ siri ike iji ruo eru na Group G nke Europa League.
rows.reference: Ndị Rangers na anabata Rapid Vienna na Tọsde, mara na mmeri n’elu ndị Austria ahụ, sotere egwu onye laba onye laba mara mma agbara na Spain n’etiti Villareal na mbido ọnwa a, ga-etinye ha n’ọnọdụ siri ike iji tozue pụta na Otu G nke Europa League.

rows.source: A knee injury prevented midfielder Graham Dorrans from making his first appearance of the season until the 2-2 draw with Villarreal but he believes Rangers can use that result as a springboard to greater things.
rows.output: Mmerụ ahụ n'ikpere nke gbochiri Graham Dorrans ịme egwuregwu mbụ ya n'oge ruo mgbe ha gbara Villarreal 2-2, ma o kwenyere na Rangers nwere ike iji nsonaazụ ahụ dị ka ebe ịmalite ihe ndị ka ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ahụ mmerụ n’ikpere gbochiri onye etiti Graham Dorrans n’ime mpụta izizi nke afọ asọmpi ahụ ruo mgbe egwuregwu 2-2 dị n’etiti Villareal mana ọ kwenyere Rangers nwere ike iji nsonaazụ ahụ dị ka nzọụkwụ iji mee ihe ndị dị egwu.

rows.source: "It was a good point for us because Villarreal are a good side," said the 31-year-old.
rows.output: "Ọ dị mma maka anyị n'ihi na Villarreal bụ otu dị mma," ka onye dị afọ iri atọ na otu kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ ezigbo akara maka anyị n’ihi Villareal bụ ezigbo akụkụ,” nke onye afọ 31 ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: "We went into the game believing we could get something and came away with a point.
rows.output: Anyị banyere n'egwuregwu ahụ kwenye na anyị nwere ike nweta ihe ma pụọ na otu isi.
rows.reference: “Anyị banyere egwuregwu ahụ kwete na anyị nwere ike ịnwete ihe ma jiri otu akara wee pụta.

rows.source: Maybe we could have nicked it in the end but, overall, a draw was probably a fair result.
rows.output: Ma eleghị anya, anyị nwere ike ịtụ ya n'ikpeazụ, mana, n'ozuzu, ọ bụ ihe ziri ezi.
rows.reference: Ikekwe anyị kwesịrị ịnweta mmeri na ngwụcha mana, na nchịkọta, onye laba onye laba bụkwa nsonaazụ dị mma.

rows.source: They were probably better in the first half and we came out in the second half and were the better side.
rows.output: Ha nwere ike ịbụ ndị ka mma n'ime ọkara mbụ, anyị wee pụta n'ọkara nke abụọ wee bụrụ akụkụ ka mma.
rows.reference: Ọ dị ka ha aka mma n’ọkara nke izizi, ma anyị pụtara n’ọkara nke abụọ ma bụrụ akụkụ ka mma.

rows.source: Going into Thursday, it's another big European night.
rows.output: N'abalị Tọzdee, ọ bụ abalị Europe ọzọ dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ịbanye Tọsde, ọ bụ nnukwu abalị Europe ọzọ.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can get three points but that will be tough game because they had a good result in their last game but, with the crowd behind us, I'm sure we can push on and get a positive result.
rows.output: N'ezie, anyị nwere ike nweta isi atọ ahụ, ma nke ahụ ga-esi ike n'ihi na ha nwere ezigbo nsonaazụ n'egwuregwu ikpeazụ ha, ma, na ndị na-akwado anyị n'azụ, enwere m ntụkwasị obi na anyị nwere ike ịkwado ma nweta nsonaazụ dị mma.
rows.reference: N’olile anya, anyị nwere ike ịnweta akara atọ mana ọ ga-esi ike n’ihi ha nwetara nsonaazụ mara mma n’egwuregwu ikpeazụ ha mana, ndị igwe mmadụ nọnyere anyị, adị m njikere na anyị nwere ike ịga n’ihu ma nweta nsonaazụ mara mma.

rows.source: Last year was definitely tough, between everything that happened with my injuries and the changes at the club itself but there's a feelgood factor about the place now.
rows.output: N'afọ gara aga siri ike, n'etiti ihe niile mere na mmerụ ahụ m na mgbanwe na klọb n'onwe ya mana enwere ihe dị mma gbasara ebe ahụ ugbu a.
rows.reference: Afọ ikpeazụ siri nnukwu ike, n’ime ihe niile mere ma ahụ mmerụ m yana mgbanwe n’otu asọmpi ahụ n’onwe ya mana enwere ezi mmụọ gbasara ebe ahụ ugbu a.

rows.source: The squad's good and the boys are really enjoying it; the training's good.
rows.output: Ndị otu ahụ dị mma ma ụmụ okorobịa na-enwe mmasị na ya; ọzụzụ ahụ dị mma.
rows.reference: Otu egwuregwu ahụ dị mma, ndị otu m nwoke na enwe ọhụụ ya; ọzụzụ dị mma.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can push on now, put last season behind us and be successful."
rows.output: N'ezie, anyị nwere ike ịga n'ihu ugbu a, hapụ oge ikpeazụ n'azụ anyị ma bụrụ ndị ọzọ na-aga nke ọma."
rows.reference: N’olile anya, anyị nwere ike ịkwara gaba n’ihu ugbu a, tinye afọ asọmpi gara n’azụ anyị ma mee nke ọma.”

rows.source: Women are losing sleep over this retirement savings fear
rows.output: Ụmụ nwanyị na-efunahụ ụra n'ihi ụjọ a na-echekwa ezumike nká
rows.reference: Ụmụ nwanyị na agbakasị ahụ n’ihi ụjọ ego nchekwa oge ezumike nka

rows.source: Despite the fact that survey participants had a clear idea of how they wanted to be cared for, few people were talking to their family members about it.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ndị sonyere na nyocha ahụ nwere echiche doro anya banyere otú ha chọrọ ka e si elekọta ha, ọtụtụ ndị anaghị ekwu okwu na ezinụlọ ha banyere ya.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị n’eziokwu ndị sonyere na nyocha ahụ nwere alo doro anya otu ha siri chọọ ka elekọta ha, ndị mmadụ ole ma ole nọ na agwa ndị otu ezinụlọ okwu maka ya.

rows.source: About half of the individuals in the Nationwide study said they were speaking with their spouses about the cost of long-term care.
rows.output: Ihe dị ka ọkara nke ndị mmadụ n'ọmụmụ ihe mba ahụ kwuru na ha na-ekwu okwu na ndị òtù ezinụlọ ha banyere ọnụ ahịa nlekọta ogologo oge.
rows.reference: Ihe dị ka okara nke ndị mmadụ ahụ na mmụta Nationwide emere kwuru na ha na agwa di ma ọ bụ nwunye ha okwu gbasara ụgwọ nke nlekọta ogologo oge.

rows.source: Only 10 percent said they spoke with their kids about it.
rows.output: Naanị pasentị iri n'ime iri n'ime ha kwuru na ha na-ekwu okwu na ụmụ ha banyere ya.
rows.reference: Naanị pasentị 10 kwuru na ha gwara ụmụaka ha maka ya.

rows.source: "People want a family member to care for them, but they aren't taking the steps to have the conversation," said Holly Snyder, vice president of Nationwide's life insurance business.
rows.output: Ndị mmadụ chọrọ onye òtù ezinụlọ ka na-elekọta ha, ma ha anaghị eme ihe iji nwee mkparịta ụka ahụ," ka Holly Snyder, onye isi nke azụmahịa mkpuchi ndụ nke obodo niile kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ chọrọ ka onye otu ezinụlọ ha lekọta ha, mana ha anaghị eme ihe ọ bụla iji kpaa nkata ahụ,” Holly Snyder kwuru, osote onye isi nke azụmahịa nchekwa ndụ nke Nationwide.

rows.source: Here's where to begin.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ebe ị ga-amalite.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ ebe ị ga-ebido.

rows.source: Talk to your spouse and the kids: You can't prepare your family to provide care if you don't make your wishes known well ahead of time.
rows.output: Kparịta ụka na nwunye gị na ụmụaka: Ị gaghị eme ka ezinụlọ gị dị njikere inye nlekọta ma ọ bụrụ na ị naghị ekwupụta ọchịchọ gị nke ọma tupu oge eruo.
rows.reference: Gwa nwunye ma ọ bụ dị gị yana ụmụaka: Ị nweghị ike ịkwadobe ezinụlọ gị iji nye nlekọta ma ọ bụrụ na i kwuputeghi ihe ndị ị chọrọ n’oge.

rows.source: Work with your advisor and your family to discuss where and how to receive care, as those choices can be a significant factor in determining the cost.
rows.output: Na-arụkọ ọrụ na onye ndụmọdụ gị na ezinụlọ gị iji tụlee ebe na otú ị ga-enweta nlekọta ahụike, n'ihi na nhọrọ ndị a nwere ike ịbụ ihe dị mkpa na-ekpebi ọnụ ahịa.
rows.reference: Gị na onye ndụmọdụ gị na ezinụlọ gị rụkọta ọrụ iji kpakọrịta ebe yana otu a ga-esi nweta nlekọta, ebe nhọrọ ndị ahụ nwere ike ịbụ ihe ndị dị mkpa na ikpebi ụgwọ ya.

rows.source: Bring in your financial advisor: Your advisor can also help you come up with a way to pay for those expenses.
rows.output: Kpọọ onye ndụmọdụ gị gbasara ego: Onye ndụmọdụ gị nwekwara ike inyere gị aka ịchọta ụzọ ị ga-esi kwụọ ụgwọ maka mmefu ndị ahụ.
rows.reference: Webata onye ndụmọdụ ego gị: Onye ndụmọdụ nwekwara ike ịnyere gị aka ịtụnye ụzọ iji kwụọ ụgwọ maka mmefu ego ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Your funding choices for long-term care can include a traditional long-term care insurance policy, a hybrid cash-value life insurance policy to help cover these expenses or self-insuring with your own wealth - as long as you have the money.
rows.output: Nhọrọ ego gị maka nlekọta ogologo oge nwere ike ịgụnye ihe mkpuchi nlekọta ogologo oge ọdịnala, ihe mkpuchi ndụ nwere uru ego jikọtara ọnụ iji nyere aka kpuchie ụgwọ ndị a ma ọ bụ ịzụrụ onwe gị na akụ̀ na ụba gị - ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ego zuru ezu.
rows.reference: Nhọrọ ego gị maka nlekọta ogologo oge nwere ike ịgụnye iwu nchekwa nlekọta ogologo oge dị adị, iwu nchekwa ndụ uru-ego achịkọtara ọnụ iji nyere gị aka kpuchie mmefu ego ndị a ma ọ bụ nchekwa-onwe site na iji akụ nke gị - ma ị nwee ego ahụ.

rows.source: Hammer out your legal documents: Head off legal battles at the pass.
rows.output: Mee akwụkwọ iwu gị: Gaa n'ihu n'ọgụ iwu n'ọnụ ụzọ.
rows.reference: Kpaa maka akwụkwọ iwu gị: Kpebie nsogbu iwu n’ohere ahụ.

rows.source: Get a health-care proxy in place so that you designate a trusted individual to oversee your medical care and ensure that professionals comply with your wishes in case you're unable to communicate.
rows.output: Nweta onye na-ahụ maka ahụike n'ọnọdụ ka ị kọwaa onye ị tụkwasịrị obi ka ọ na-elekọta ahụike gị ma hụ na ndị ọkachamara na-agbaso ọchịchọ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị gaghị enwe ike ịkparịta ụka.
rows.reference: Dowe ihe nnọchite nlekọta-ahụike na njikere ka ị nwee ike ịkenye ya mmadụ atụkwasịrị obi iji hụ maka nlekọta ahụike gị ma gbaa mbọ hụ ndị ọkachamara mezuru na mmasị gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike ikwukọrịta okwu.

rows.source: Also, consider a power of attorney for your finances.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, tụlee ikike ọkachamara maka ego gị.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa, tụlee ikike nke ọkaiwu maka ego gị.

rows.source: You would select a trusted person to make financial decisions for you and ensure your bills get paid if you're incapacitated.
rows.output: Ị ga-ahọrọ onye a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi ka ọ mee mkpebi ego maka gị ma hụ na akwụ ụgwọ gị na-akwụ ụgwọ ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike.
rows.reference: Ị ga-ahọpụta otu onye atụkwasịrị obi iji meere gị mkpebi ego ma hụ na akwụrụ ụgwọ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike.

rows.source: Don't forget the small details: Imagine that your elderly parent has a medical emergency and is on the way to the hospital.
rows.output: Echefula obere nkọwa: Chee echiche na nne ma ọ bụ nna ochie gị nwere nsogbu ahụike ma na-aga ụlọ ọgwụ.
rows.reference: Echefuna obere ihe: Chee echiche na nne na nna gị kara nka nwere ihe mberede ahụike ma nọrọ n’ụzọ na aga n’ụlọ ọgwụ.

rows.source: Would you be able to answer questions on medications and allergies?
rows.output: Ị nwere ike ịza ajụjụ gbasara ọgwụ na ihe na-akpata ọrịa?
rows.reference: Ị ga-enwe ike ịza ajụjụ maka ọgwụ na ihe ndị ha na ezere?

rows.source: Spell out those details in a written plan so that you're ready.
rows.output: Kọwapụta nkọwa ndị ahụ n'ime atụmatụ edere ka ị dị njikere.
rows.reference: Kwupute nkọwapụta ndị a n’atụmatụ edere ede ka ị nwee dị njikere.

rows.source: "It's not just the financials that are in play, but who are the doctors?" asked Martin.
rows.output: "Ọ bụghị naanị ego ka dị n'ọrụ, ma onye bụ ndị dọkịta?" jụrụ Martin.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị naanị ego ka a na ekwu maka ya, mana kedu ndị bụ dọkịnta ya?” Martin jụrụ.

rows.source: "What are the medications?
rows.output: Kedu ọgwụ ndị ahụ?
rows.reference: “Gịnị hụ ọgwụ ndị ahụ?

rows.source: Who will care for the dog?
rows.output: Ònye ga-elekọta nkịta ahụ?
rows.reference: Onye ga-elekọta nkịta?

rows.source: Have that plan in place."
rows.output: Nwee atụmatụ ahụ n'ọnọdụ."
rows.reference: Hazie atụmatụ ahụ."

rows.source: Man shot multiple times with air rifle in Ilfracombe
rows.output: Nwoke gbara ọtụtụ oge na egbe ikuku n'Ilfracombe
rows.reference: Eji egbe ikuku gbaa otu nwoke ọtụtụ oge na llfracombe

rows.source: A man has been shot multiple times with an air rifle as he walked home from a night out.
rows.output: Otu nwoke ka a gbara ọtụtụ oge na egbe ikuku ka ọ na-ala n'ụlọ site na abalị.
rows.reference: Ejirila egbe ikuku wee gbaa otu nwoke ọtụtụ oge ka o ji ụkwụ alaghachi ụlọ ka ọ pụchara n’abalị.

rows.source: The victim, in his 40s, was in the Oxford Grove area of Ilfracombe, Devon, when he was shot in the chest, abdomen and hand.
rows.output: Onye ahụ metụtara, n'afọ iri anọ ya, nọ n'ógbè Oxford Grove nke Ilfracombe, Devon, mgbe a gbagburu ya n'obi, afọ na aka.
rows.reference: Onye ọ metụtara, nọ n’afọ 40, nọ n’ogige Oxford Grove nke llfracombe, Devon, mgbe agbara ya egbe n’obi, afọ yana aka.

rows.source: Officers described the shooting, which took place at about 02:30 BST, as a "random act."
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ kọwara ogbunigwe ahụ, nke mere ihe dị ka elekere 02:30 BST, dị ka "omume enweghị usoro."
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii kọwara ọgbụgba egbe ahụ, nke mere n’ihe dị ka 02:30 BST, ka “omume na enweghị kpatara ya.”

rows.source: The victim did not see his attacker.
rows.output: Onye ahụ a tara ahụhụ ahụghị onye wakporo ya.
rows.reference: Onye ihe ahụ metụtara ahụghị onye makporo ya.

rows.source: His injuries are not life-threatening and police have appealed for witnesses.
rows.output: Mmerụ ahụ ya adịghị njọ ndụ, ndị uwe ojii ekwela ndị akaebe ka ha bịa.
rows.reference: Ahụ mmerụ ya abụghị ihe ga-egbu ya, ndị uwe ojii arịọla maka ndị akaebe.

rows.source: Earthquakes and tsunamis in Indonesia
rows.output: Mgbawa ala na ọkụ mmiri na Indonesia
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji na tsunami na Indonesia

rows.source: At least 384 people have been killed by a powerful earthquake and tsunami that hit the Indonesian city of Palu on Friday, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.
rows.output: N'afọ 384, ndị ọrụ gọọmentị kwuru na ha anwụọla n'ihi ọdachi ala ọma jijiji na tsunami siri ike nke dakwasịrị obodo Palu nke Indonesia na Fraịde, na-atụ anya na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ ga-abawanye.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe ndị mmadụ 384 nwụrụ ka nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami dara n’obodo Palu nke Indonesia na Fraịde, ndị ọrụ kwuru, atụrụ anya na ọnụọgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ ga-agbakọ.

rows.source: With communications knocked out, relief officials have not been able to get any information from Donggala regency, an area north of Palu that is closer to the epicenter of the 7.5 magnitude quake.
rows.output: N'ịbụ ndị nkwukọrịta na-akụda, ndị ọrụ enyemaka enweghị ike ịnweta ozi ọ bụla site na mpaghara Donggala, nke dị n'ebe ugwu nke Palu ma dị nso n'ebe etiti ala ọma jijiji nke 7.5.
rows.reference: Ka akụpụrụ ụzọ nkwukọrịta, ndị ọrụ enyemaka enwebeghị ike ịnweta ozi ọ bụla n’aka ala ọchịchị Donggala, mpaghara ugwu nke Palu nọketere nso na etiti nke ala ọmajiji 7.5 ahụ.

rows.source: In Palu, more than 16,000 people were evacuated after the disaster struck.
rows.output: N'ime Palu, ihe karịrị mmadụ 16,000 ebugara n'ụlọ ọgwụ mgbe ihe mberede ahụ mere.
rows.reference: Na Palu, karịa ndị mmadụ 16,000 kwapụrụ n’ụlọ ka ọdachi ahụ mere.

rows.source: Here are some key facts about Palu and Donggala, on the island of Sulawesi:
rows.output: Nke a bụ ụfọdụ ihe ndị dị mkpa gbasara Palu na Donggala, n'agwaetiti Sulawesi:
rows.reference: Ndị a bụ ụfọdụ eziokwu gbasara Palu na Donggala, n’agwaetiti nke Sulawesi:

rows.source: Palu is the capital of Central Sulawesi province, located at the end of a narrow bay on the west coast of Sulawesi island, with an estimated population of 379,800 in 2017.
rows.output: Palu bụ isi obodo steeti Central Sulawesi, dị n'akụkụ ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri dị warara n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke agwaetiti Sulawesi, nwere ihe dị ka mmadụ 379,800 na 2017.
rows.reference: Palụ bụ isi ala nke ogige Central Sulawesi, dị na ngwụcha nke warawara ọnụ mmiri dị na akụkụ mmiri ọdịda anyanwụ agwaetiti Sulawesi, nwere ọnụọgụgụ ndị mmadụ 379,800 na 2017.

rows.source: The city was celebrating its 40th anniversary when the quake and tsunami hit.
rows.output: Obodo ahụ na-eme ememe ncheta afọ iri anọ ya mgbe ọdọ mmiri ahụ na tsunami kụrụ.
rows.reference: Obodo ahụ nọ na eme emume ncheta 40 ya mgbe ala ọmajiji na tsunami ahụ dara.

rows.source: Donggala is a regency stretching along more than 300 km (180 miles) of coastline in the northwest of Sulawesi island.
rows.output: Donggala bụ ógbè na-agbatị n'akụkụ ụsọ oké osimiri karịa 300 km (180 kilomita) n'akụkụ ugwu ọdịda anyanwụ nke agwaetiti Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Donggala bụ ala ọchịchị dọtịrị n’ogologo 300 km (maịlụ 180) nke akụkụ osimiri dị na ọdịda anyanwụ na ugwu nke agwaetiti Sulawesi.

rows.source: The regency, an administrative region below a province, had an estimated population of 299,200 in 2017.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ nchịkwa, bụ mpaghara nchịkwa dị n'okpuru mpaghara, nwere ihe dị ka mmadụ 299,200 na 2017.
rows.reference: Ala ọchịchị ahụ, mpaghara nchịkwa dị n’okpuru ogige, nwere ọnụọgụgụ ndị mmadụ ekpebiri na 299,200 na 2017.

rows.source: Fishing and farming are the mainstays of the Central Sulawesi province's economy, especially the coastal region of Donggala.
rows.output: Ịkụ azụ na ọrụ ugbo bụ isi ihe na-akwado akụ na ụba mpaghara Central Sulawesi, karịsịa mpaghara ụsọ oké osimiri nke Donggala.
rows.reference: Ịkọ azụ na ịkọ ugbo bụ isi ọrụ nke akụnụba ogige Central Sulawesi, karịchara mpaghara akụkụ mmiri nke Donggala.

rows.source: Nickel mining is also important in the province, but is mostly concentrated in Morowali, on the opposite coast of Sulawesi.
rows.output: Ịkụ azụ́ nickel dịkwa mkpa n'ógbè ahụ, ma ọ dị n'ọtụtụ ebe na Morowali, n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Ngwụpụta nickel bụkwa mkpa n’ogige ahụ, mana agbakojuru karịa na Morowali, na nchebe ihu nke Sulawesi.

rows.source: Palu and Donggala have been hit by tsunamis several times in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.
rows.output: Palu na Donggala enwetala ọtụtụ tsunami n'ime afọ 100 gara aga, dịka ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka ịgwọ ọrịa na Indonesia siri kwuo.
rows.reference: Tsunami adaala na Palu na Dongalla ọtụtụ oge n’afọ 100 gara aga, nke Ụlọ Ọrụ Mgbochi Ọdachi nke Indonedia kwuru.

rows.source: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of houses in Donggala.
rows.output: N'afọ 1938, ọkụ mmiri nke mere ka mmadụ karịrị 200 nwụọ ma mebie ọtụtụ ụlọ n'obodo Donggala.
rows.reference: Na 1938, tsunami gburu karịa ndị mmadụ 200 ma mebie narị kwụrụ narị ụlọ na Donggala.

rows.source: A tsunami also struck western Donggala in 1996, killing nine.
rows.output: Otu tsunami kụkwara n'ebe ọdịda anyanwụ Donggala n'afọ 1996, gbuo mmadụ itoolu.
rows.reference: Otu tsunami dakwara n’akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ Donggala na 1996, na egbu itoolu.

rows.source: Indonesia sits on the seismically Pacific Ring of Fire and is regularly hit by earthquakes.
rows.output: Indonesia nọ n'elu ọkụ ọkụ nke Pacific na-eme ihe na-eme ihe mgbe ụfọdụ.
rows.reference: Indonesia tukwu n’etiti Pacific Ring of Fire, ala ọmajiji na akụ ya kwa oge.

rows.source: Here are some of the major quakes and tsunamis in recent years:
rows.output: Nke a bụ ụfọdụ n'ime ihe ndị dị mkpa na-eme n'oge na-adịbeghị anya:
rows.reference: Ndị bụ ụfọdụ nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami n’afọ nso nso:

rows.source: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: Mgbawa dị ukwuu n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke Indonesia's Aceh Province na Northern Sumatra na Disemba 26 kpalitere tsunami nke kụrụ mba iri na anọ, gbuo mmadụ 226,000 n'akụkụ oke osimiri Indian Ocean, ihe karịrị ọkara n'ime ha nọ na Aceh.
rows.reference: 2004: Nnukwu ala ọmajiji n’akụkụ osimiri ọdịda anyanwụ nke ogige Aceh Indonesia dị n’akụkụ ugwu Sumatra na Dis. 26 kpalitere tsunami kụrụ obodo 14, na egbu ndị mmadụ 226,000 n’ogologo akụkụ osimiri nke Nnukwu Osimiri India, karịa ọkara ha nọ na Aceh.

rows.source: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.
rows.output: 2005: Otu usoro nke ọkụ ọkụ siri ike kụrụ n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke Sumatra n'oge ikpeazụ nke Maachị na mmalite nke Eprel.
rows.reference: 2005: Nsotanso nnukwu ala ọmajiji kụrụ akụkụ osimiri ọdịda anyanwụ nke Sumatra na ngwụcha Machị yana na mbido Eprel.

rows.source: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.
rows.output: Puku ndị mmadụ nwụrụ n'Ọwụwa Anyanwụ Nias, nke dị n'akụkụ ụsọ oké osimiri Sumatra.
rows.reference: Narị kwụrụ narị nwụrụ na Agwaetiti Nias, na mpụga akụkụ osimiri nke Sumatra.

rows.source: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.
rows.output: 2006: Mmetụta 6.8 n'akụkụ ndịda nke Java, agwaetiti Indonesia nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ kasị ukwuu, kpatara tsunami nke kụrụ n'akụkụ ndịda, gbuo ihe dị ka mmadụ 700.
rows.reference: 2006: Ọmajiji 6.8 kụrụ akụkụ ndịda nke Java, agwaetiti nke Indonesia kachasị nwee mmadụ, na akpalite tsunami jiri iwe daa na akụkụ osimiri nke ndịda, na egbu ihe ruru ndị mmadụ 700.

rows.source: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.
rows.output: 2009: Mgbawa ala 7.6 mere nso obodo Padang, isi obodo West Sumatra.
rows.reference: 2009: Ala ọmajiji ruru 7.6 dara n’akụkụ obodo Padang, isi ala nke ogige West Sumatra.

rows.source: More than 1,100 people were killed.
rows.output: Karịrị mmadụ 1,100 nwụrụ.
rows.reference: Egburu ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ 1,100.

rows.source: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.
rows.output: 2010: Mgbawa nke 7.5 n'ogologo mere n'otu n'ime agwaetiti Mentawai, n'akụkụ Sumatra, nke mere ka a na-ebute tsunami nke ruru 10 mita nke bibiri ọtụtụ obodo ma gbuo ihe dị ka mmadụ 300.
rows.reference: 2010: Ọmajiji 7.5 dara n’otu agwaetiti Mentawai, na mpụga Sumatra, na akpalite tsunami ruru mita 10 nke mebiri ọtụtụ ime obodo ma gbuo ndị mmadụ ruru 300.

rows.source: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.
rows.output: 2016: Mgbawa dị nro kụrụ Pidie Jaya regency dị na Aceh, na-akpata mbibi na ụjọ ka ndị mmadụ na-echeta mbibi nke ọgba aghara ọnwụ nke 2004 na tsunami.
rows.reference: 2016: Obere ọmajiji kụrụ ala ọchịchị Pidie Jaya dị na Aceh, na ebute mmebi na ọgbaghara na echetere ndị mmadụ mmebi nke ọmajiji na tsunami 2004 gburu ọtụtụ.

rows.source: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị tsunami kpalitere oge a, mana ihe karịrị 100 nwụrụ site na ụlọ ndị dara.
rows.reference: Enweghị tsunami akpalitere n’oge a, mana ụlọ ndị na ada gburu karịa ndị mmadụ 100.

rows.source: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.
rows.output: 2018: Mgbawa dị ukwuu mere na agwaetiti Lombok nke ndị njem nlegharị anya nke Indonesia, gbuo ihe karịrị mmadụ 500, ọtụtụ n'akụkụ ugwu nke agwaetiti ahụ.
rows.reference: 2018: Nnukwu ọla ọmajiji dara n’agwaetiti ndị njem nke Lombok dị na Indonesia, na egbu karịa ndị mmadụ 500, karịchara n’akụkụ ugwu nke agwaetiti ahụ.

rows.source: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.
rows.output: Mgbawa ahụ mebiri ọtụtụ ụlọ ma hapụ ọtụtụ ndị njem nlegharị anya n'ala.
rows.reference: Ọmajiji ahụ mebiri puku kwụrụ puku ụlọ ma hapụ ụfọdụ ndị njem na nsogbu ntakịrị oge.

rows.source: Sarah Palin's Eldest Son Arrested on Domestic Violence Charges
rows.output: Nwa mbụ Sarah Palin nwụrụ anwụ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ maka ebubo ịwakpo ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ejidere Nwa Nwoke Sarah Palin Tọchara N’ihi Ebubo Ịmekwasị Mmadụ Ihe Ike

rows.source: Track Palin, the eldest son of former Alaska governor and vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on assault charges.
rows.output: N'afọ 2014, a tụrụ Sarah Palin, onye bụbu gọvanọ Alaska na onye na-azọ ọkwa onyeisiala, n'ụlọ mkpọrọ maka ebubo ebubo na ọ wakporo di ya.
rows.reference: Track Palin, nwa nwoke tọchara nke gọvanọ Alaska gara aga yana osote onye nhọpụta isi ala Sarah Palin, ka ejidere maka ebubo ịmekwasị mmadụ ihe ike.

rows.source: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on suspicion of domestic violence, interfering with a report of domestic violence and resisting arrest, according to a report released Saturday by Alaska State Troopers.
rows.output: Palin, 29, nke Wasilla, Alaska, ka a na-enyo enyo na ime ihe ike n'ụlọ, ime ka a ghara ịkọ akụkọ banyere ime ihe ike n'ụlọ, na iguzogide ijide, dị ka akụkọ e wepụtara na Satọde site n'aka ndị agha steeti Alaska.
rows.reference: Ejidere Palin, 29, nke Wasilla, Alaska, na nyocha nke ịmekwasị mmadụ ihe ike, na etinye aka na mkpesa nke mmekwasị ihe ike yana igbochi njide, site na mkpesa Alaska State Troopers buputere na Satọde.

rows.source: According to the police report, when a female acquaintance attempted to call police to report the alleged crimes, he took her phone from her.
rows.output: N'akwụkwọ akụkọ ndị uwe ojii, mgbe otu nwanyị enyi ya nwara ịkpọ ndị uwe ojii ka o kọọ mpụ ndị a na-ebo ebubo, o wepụrụ ekwentị ya.
rows.reference: Site na mkpesa ndị uwe ojii ahụ, mgbe otu enyi nwanyị nwara ịkpọ ndị uwe ojii iji kpesa mpụ eboro na ebubo, ọ were ekwentị ya n’aka ya.

rows.source: Palin is being remanded in Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 unsecured bond, reported KTUU.
rows.output: A na-ejide Palin n'ụlọ mkpọrọ Mat-Su Pretrial ma na-ejide ya na mgbazinye ego $500 na-enweghị nchebe, akụkọ na-ekwu na KSTU.
rows.reference: Ejidere Palin na Ewumewu Tupu-Ikpe Mat-Su, ejidere ya na bọnd na enweghị nchekwa $500, nke kTUU kpesara.

rows.source: He appeared in court Saturday, where he declared himself "not guilty, for sure" when asked his plea, reported the network.
rows.output: Ọ pụtara n'ụlọ ikpe na Satọde, ebe o kwupụtara onwe ya "enweghị ikpe, n'ezie" mgbe a jụrụ ya maka ịdị njikere, ka netwọk ahụ kọrọ.
rows.reference: Ọ pụtara n’ụlọ ikpe na Satọde, ebe ọ kọwara onwe ya “ka ọ onye aka dị ọcha, n’ezie” mgbe ajụrụ ya arịrịọ ya, netwọk ahụ kpesara.

rows.source: Palin faces three Class A misdemeanours, meaning he could be imprisoned for up to a year and fined $250,000.
rows.output: Palin na-eche ihe atọ nke klaasị A na-akwụghị ụgwọ, nke pụtara na ọ nwere ike ịnọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ ruo afọ otu na ịkwụ ụgwọ $250,000.
rows.reference: Palin na eche mpụ Klaasị A ato, ọ pụtara enwere ike ịtụ ya nga ruo otu afọ ma ọ bụ daa ya nra $250,000.

rows.source: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.
rows.output: Ọ na-akwụkwa ụgwọ maka mpụ klaasị B, nke a na-akwụ ụgwọ site na otu ụbọchị n'ụlọ mkpọrọ na ụgwọ $2,000.
rows.reference: Eboola ya ebubo nke mpụ Klaasị B, enwere ike iji otu ụbọchị n’ime nga ma ọ bụ nra $2,000 wee nye ntaramahụhụ ya.

rows.source: It is not the first time criminal charges have been filed against Palin.
rows.output: Ọ bụghị oge mbụ ka a na-ekpe ikpe mpụ megide Palin.
rows.reference: Ọ bụghị ebubo mpụ nke izizi a na etinye maka Palin.

rows.source: In December 2017, he was accused of assaulting his father, Todd Palin.
rows.output: N'ọnwa Disemba afọ 2017, a na-akpọ ya ebubo na ọ wakporo nna ya, Todd Palin.
rows.reference: Na Disemba 2017, eboro ya ebubo nke ịmekwasị nna ya ihe ike, Todd Palin.

rows.source: His mother, Sarah Palin, called police to report the alleged attack.
rows.output: Nne ya, Sarah Palin, mere akụkọ maka mwakpo ahụ.
rows.reference: Nne ya, Sarah Palin, kpọrọ ndị uwe ojii iji kpesa mbuso agha ahụ eboro n’ebubo.

rows.source: The case is currently before Alaska's Veteran's Court.
rows.output: Ihe a na-ekwu ugbu a n'ihu Ụlọikpe Ndị Agha Alaska.
rows.reference: Okwu ahụ nọ n’ihu Ụlọ Ikpe nke Ndị Agha Ochie nke Alaska.

rows.source: In January 2016 he was charged with domestic assault, interfering with the report of a domestic violence crime, and possessing a weapon while intoxicated in connection with the incident.
rows.output: N'ọnwa Jenụwarị afọ 2016, a mara ya ikpe maka ịwakpo ụlọ, ịkpaghasị akụkọ banyere mpụ ime ihe ike, na inwe ngwa agha mgbe ọ na-aṅụbiga mmanya ókè n'ihe metụtara ihe ahụ.
rows.reference: Na Jenụwarị 2016 agbara ya akwụkwọ maka ịmekwasị mmadụ ihe ike, itinye aka na mpụ ịmekwasị mmadụ ihe ihe, yana iji ngwaọgụ ka mmanya na egbu ya na njikọ nke okwu ahụ.

rows.source: His girlfriend had alleged that he punched her in the face.
rows.output: Nwa agbọghọ ya ekwuola na o kụrụ ya ihu.
rows.reference: Enyi ya nwanyị boro ya ebubo na ọ kụrụ ya ọkpọ n’ihu.

rows.source: Sarah Palin was criticised by veterans groups in 2016 after linking her son's violent behaviour to PTSD stemming from his service in Iraq.
rows.output: N'afọ 2016, Sarah Palin chere nkatọ site n'aka òtù ndị agha gbasara ọrụ ya mgbe ọ jikọtara omume ime ihe ike nke nwa ya nwoke na PTSD nke sitere na ọrụ ya na Iraq.
rows.reference: Ndị agha ochie kọtọrọ Sarah Palin na 2016 ka ejikọchara omume ihe ike nwa ya na PTSD bidoro n’ọrụ ya na Iraq.

rows.source: Indonesia earthquake tsunami: hundreds killed
rows.output: Ụgbọ ala ọkụ na-efe efe: ọtụtụ ndị nwụrụ
rows.reference: Tsunami ala ọmajiji Indonesia: egburu narị

rows.source: At least 384 people have died after an earthquake hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi on Friday.
rows.output: N'afọ 384, mmadụ anwụọla mgbe ọdachi ala ọma jijiji dakwasịrị agwaetiti Sulawesi nke Indonesia na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe ndị mmadụ 384 anwụọla ka ala ọmajiji dara na agwaetiti nke Sulawesi nke Indonesia na Fraịde.

rows.source: The 7.5-magnitude earthquake triggered a tsunami and has destroyed thousands of homes.
rows.output: Mgbawa ala ọma jijiji nke 7.5 n'ogologo kpalitere tsunami ma mebie ọtụtụ puku ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji ruru ike 7.5 kpalitere tsunami ma mebie puku kwụrụ puku n’ụlọ.

rows.source: Electricity and communication networks are down with death tolls expected to rise in coming days.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ eletrik na nkwukọrịta na-akwụsị akwụsị, na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ na-atụ anya na ọ ga-abawanye n'ime ụbọchị ndị na-abịa.
rows.reference: Netwọk latrik na nkwukọrịta mebiri emebi, ebe atụrụ anya na ndị nwụrụ anwụ ga-agbago n’ụbọchị ndị na-abịa.

rows.source: The earthquake hit just off central Sulawesi which is northeast of the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.
rows.output: Mgbawa ahụ kụrụ n'akụkụ etiti Sulawesi, nke dị n'ebe ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ nke isi obodo Indonesia, Jakarta.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji ahụ dara na obere mpụga etiti Sulawesi nke bụ akụkụ ọwụwa anyanwụ na ugwu nke isi ala Indonesia, Jakarta.

rows.source: Videos are circulating on social media showing the moment of impact.
rows.output: Vidiyo na-ekesa na soshal midia na-egosi oge mmetụta ahụ.
rows.reference: Vidio ndị na agagharị n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze gosiri oge ọ dara.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a beach festival in the city of Palu when the tsunami smashed on shore.
rows.output: N'ime obodo Palu, ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ gbakọtara maka emume osimiri mgbe tsunami kụrụ n'akụkụ osimiri.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ narị ndị mmadụ kpokọtara maka emume akụkụ osimiri n’obodo nke Palu mgbe tsunami ji iwe daa n’akụkụ mmiri ahu.

rows.source: Federal prosecutors seeking rare death penalty for NYC terror attack suspect
rows.output: Ndị ọka iwu gọọmentị etiti na-achọ ọnwụ dị oke ọnụ ahịa maka onye a na-enyo enyo na ọ bụ onye mwakpo tọọrọ na NYC.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkaikpe etiti obodo na achụ ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ maka onye a na enyo enyo maka agha ụjọ mere na NYC

rows.source: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.
rows.output: Ndị ọka iwu gọọmentị etiti na New York na-achọ ọnwụ maka Sayfullo Saipov, onye a na-enyo enyo na mwakpo tọọrọ na New York City nke gburu mmadụ asatọ -- ntaramahụhụ na-adịghị ahụkebe nke a na-eme na steeti ahụ maka mpụ gọọmentị etiti kemgbe 1953.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkaikpe nọ na New York na achọ ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ maka Sayfullo Saipov, onye a na enyo enyo na agha ụjọ mere na New York nke gburu ndị mmadụ asatọ -- ntaramahụhụ na adịkabeghị nke emebeghị na steeti ahụ maka mpụ etiti obodo ọ bụla kemgbe 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, 30, allegedly used a Home Depot rental truck to carry out an attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, mowing down pedestrians and cyclist in his path on Oct.
rows.output: Saipov, iri atọ, na-ekwu na o ji ụgbọ ala ụlọ ahịa Home Depot mee ihe ike n'ụzọ ụgbọ ala West Side na Lower Manhattan, na-akpụ akpụ ndị na-agba ọsọ na ndị na-agba ịnyịnya n'ụzọ ya na Ọktọba.
rows.reference: Saipov, 30, eboro ya ebubo ji gwongworo mgbaziri Home Depot wee mee ihe egwu ahụ n’ụzọ anyịnya igwe dị n’ogologo West Highway dị na Lower Manhattan, na ebetu ndị ji ụkwụ aga yana ndị na akwọ anyịnya igwe n’ụzọ ya na Ọkt.

rows.source: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.
rows.output: Iji gosi na a ga-ata ahụhụ, ndị ọka iwu ga-egosi na Saipov "n'uche" gburu ndị mmadụ asatọ ahụ na "n'uche" kpatara mmerụ ahụ siri ike, dịka akwụkwọ ịdọ aka ná ntị ha na-achọ ịta ahụhụ, nke e debere na mpaghara ndịda New York.
rows.reference: Iji gosi ihe kpatara ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ ji dị mma, ndị ọkaikpe ga-egosi na Saipov “kpachara anya” gbuo ndị mmadụ asatọ ma “kpachara anya” merụọ ndị mmadụ nnukwu ahụ, site n’ọkwa nke ebumnuche iji chọọ ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ, nke Southern District nke New York gbara n’akwụkwọ.

rows.source: Both of those counts carry a possibly death sentence, according to the court document.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị nke ọ bụla n'ime ọnụ ọgụgụ abụọ ahụ nwere ike ịbụ ikpe ọnwụ, dịka akwụkwọ ikpe ahụ si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ebubo abụọ ndị a nwere ike ibu ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ, site n’aka akwụkwọ ụlọ ikpe ahụ.

rows.source: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.
rows.output: N'izu ole na ole ka mwakpo ahụ gasịrị, otu ndị ikpe mpaghara gọọmentị jidere Saipov na ebubo 22, nke gụnyere ebubo asatọ nke igbu mmadụ n'ịkwado ịzụ ahịa, nke a na-ejikarị ndị ọka iwu gọọmentị etiti na ikpe mpụ nke òtù, na ebubo nke ime ihe ike na ịkụ ụgbọala.
rows.reference: Izu sotechara mbuso agha ahụ, ndị otu ikpe etiti obodo manyere Saipov ebubo ngụ-22 nke gụnyere ebubo asatọ maka igbu mmadụ n’enyemaka nke izu oyi, nke ndị ọkaikpe etiti obodo na ejikarị n’okwu ajọ mpu, yana ebubo nke ihe ike na mmebi nke ụgbọ ala.

rows.source: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."
rows.output: Mwakpo ahụ chọrọ "atụmatụ dị ukwuu na atụmatụ tupu oge eruo," ndị ọka iwu kwuru, na-akọwa ụzọ Saipov si mee ya dị ka "ihe na-adịghị mma, obi ọjọọ na nke na-adịghị mma."
rows.reference: Mbuso agha ahụ chọrọ “nhazi na ntụle echiche dị ọkpụrụkpụ,” ndị ọkaikpe kwuru, na akọwara omume nke Saipov jiri mee ya ka “arụ, jọrọ njọ na mmetọ.”

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.
rows.output: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov kpatara mmerụ ahụ, mmebi, na mfu nye ezinụlọ na ndị enyi nke Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, na Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," ozi nke ebumnuche na-ekwu.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov butere mmerụ ahụ, mmekpa ahụ, na mbibi maka ezinụlọ na ndị enyi nke Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, na Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," ọkwa nke ebumnuche kwuru.

rows.source: Five of the victims were tourists from Argentina.
rows.output: Puku ise n'ime ndị ihe metụtara bụ ndị njem nlegharị anya si Argentina.
rows.reference: Mmadụ ise nke ndị ahụ emetụtara bụ ndị njem si Argentina bịara ịlegharị anya.

rows.source: It has been a decade since the Southern District of New York last prosecuted a death penalty case.
rows.output: Ọ dịla afọ iri kemgbe mpaghara ndịda nke New York gbara ikpe ikpe ọnwụ ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụla otu afọ iri kemgbe Southern District nke New York kpere ikpe okwu ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ.

rows.source: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was convicted of murdering two drug suppliers but was ultimately sentenced to life in prison in September 2009.
rows.output: Onye a na-azara, Khalid Barnes, mara ikpe maka igbu mmadụ abụọ na-ere ọgwụ, mana n'ikpeazụ, a mara ya ikpe ịga mkpọrọ ndụ n'ọnwa Septemba afọ 2009.
rows.reference: Onye ahụ eboro ebubo, Khalid Barnes, nwetara amamikpe nke igbu mmadu abụọ na ere ọgwụ ike mana emechara tụọ ya nga ndụ ya niile n’ikpeazụ na Septamba 2009.

rows.source: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.
rows.output: Oge ikpeazụ e ji ntaramahụhụ ikpeazụ mee n'okwu gọọmentị etiti New York bụ na 1953 maka Julius na Ethel Rosenberg, di na nwunye a mara ikpe maka ịgba izu nzuzo maka Soviet Union n'oge Agha Nzuzo afọ abụọ tupu.
rows.reference: Oge ikpeazụ emere ntaramahụhụ ọnwụ na okwu etiti obodo nke New York bụ na 1953 maka Julius na Ethel Rosenberg, di na nwunye egburu ka amachara ha ikpe maka ịkpa nkata iji mee ọrụ sabo maka Soviet Union n’oge Cold War afọ abụọ ya gara aga.

rows.source: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.output: Ndị Rosenbergs abụọ ahụ e gburu ha site n'ọkụ eletrik na June 19, 1953.
rows.reference: Eji oche latrik wee gbuo Rosenberg abụọ ahụ na Juun 19, 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, a native of Uzbekistan, demonstrated a lack of remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.
rows.output: Saipov, onye si na Uzbekistan, egosipụtaghị mwute n'ụbọchị na ọnwa ndị na-esochi mwakpo ahụ, dịka akwụkwọ ikpe si kwuo.
rows.reference: Saipov, onye amaala nke Uzbekistan, gosiri enweghị obi mmadụ n’ụbọchị na ọnwa sotere mbuso agha ahụ, nke akwụkwọ ụlọ ikpe gosipụtara.

rows.source: He stated to investigators that he felt good about what he had done, police said.
rows.output: Ọ gwara ndị nchọpụta na ọ nwere obi ụtọ maka ihe ọ mere, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.
rows.reference: Ọ gwara ndị nyocha na ihe ọ mere dị ya mma, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.

rows.source: Saipov told authorities he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the indictment.
rows.output: Saipov gwara ndị ọchịchị na ọ kpaliri ya ime mwakpo ahụ mgbe ọ na-ekiri vidiyo ISIS na ekwentị ya, dị ka ebubo ahụ si kwuo.
rows.reference: Saipov gwara ndị ikikere na ihe kpalitere ya ịme mbuso agha ahụ bụ ka ọ lelechara vidio ndị ISIS n’ekwentị ya, nke ebubo ahụ gosiri.

rows.source: He also requested to display the ISIS flag in his hospital room, police said.
rows.output: Ọ rịọkwara ka e gosipụta ọkọlọtọ ISIS n'ime ụlọ ọgwụ ya, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.
rows.reference: Ọ rịọkwara ka o gosipụta ọkọlọtọ ISIS n’ime ụlọ ọgwụ ya, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.

rows.source: He has pleaded not guilty to the 22-count indictment.
rows.output: Ọ gbara arụkwaghịm na ebubo iri abụọ na abụọ.
rows.reference: Ọ rịọla na aka ya dị ọcha n’ebubo ngụ-22 ahụ.

rows.source: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders representing Saipov, said they are "obviously disappointed" with the prosecution's decision.
rows.output: David Patton, otu n'ime ndị na-ekpe ikpe gọọmentị etiti na-anọchite anya Saipov, kwuru na ha "nwere ihe ndabara" na mkpebi ịgba akwụkwọ.
rows.reference: David Patton, otu n’ime ndị mgbachite etiti obodo maka ọhaneze na anọchite Saipov, kwuru ha nwere “nnukwu mwute” maka mkpebi nke ikpe ahụ.

rows.source: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.
rows.output: "Anyị kwenyere na mkpebi ịchọ ọnwụ kama ịnakwere ikpe ọmụma ịnọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ ndụ na-enweghị ike ịhapụ ga-eme ka mgbu nke ihe omume ndị a na-aga n'ihu maka onye ọ bụla metụtara," ka Patton kwuru.
